tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/
༄༅/bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/oṃ swa sti/sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi chos sde yongs rdzogs kyi them byang bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ sprul pa'i gter chen rtsa gsum gling pa yi/ /bka' gsang zab gter bdun cu'i cha shas las/ /padma sbas tshal las byon bka' brgyad rmad/ /gsang ba zil gnon chos sde'i them byang 'god/ de'ang o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa'i zab gter rtsa gsum rab 'byams kyi sgrub thabs sna tshogs pa las/ 'di ni zab pa rtsa ba'i chos sde yi dam sgrub sde bka' brgyad ces rgyud sde dang sgrub sde thams cad kyi rtsa ba ru gyur pa yin la/ rang gzhung las/ e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan rjes 'brang dang : smon lam las can chos bdag bu yi don: bka' brgyad yang snying gsang ba zil gnon bzhag: ces dang*/ 'o ma'i rgya mtsho'i chos dka' mang lags kyang : snying thig zab mo 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rgyud sde lung gi bshad pa mang lags kyang : kha tshang don 'dus 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rgya chen sbas lags kyang : phyi nang gsang gsum gcig dril 'di 'dra med: ces gsungs pa bzhin/ dur khrod bsil ba'i tshal du bka' bab rig 'dzin brgyad la so sor/ mkha' 'gro ma las kyi dbang mos sgrom bu dngos su gtad cing*/ de thams cad slob dpon chen po sangs rgyas gnyis par bka' bab/ slob dpon chen pos bsam yas mchims phu brag dmar ke'u tshang du thugs sras snying gi bu dgu la sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur/ de rnams la gsang ba'i rgyud lung man ngag mang du byung ba'i nang gses/ 'di ni gu rus gnas chen sbas yul padma bkod bal phu yar 'brog mtshor sbas pa/ gter sgrom mthong ba don ldan rgyu bram ze snying po'i dbu klad las grub pa rin po che ru bya'i mdog can sgo gsum dang ldan pa/ sgo dang po la rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang zhi khro na raka dong sprugs/

phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu dang bcas pa bzhugs/ sgo bar pa la bka' brgyad yongs rdzogs kyi rgyud lung man ngag dang bcas pa/ sgo 'og ma la dregs pa srog thig nag po'i man ngag lag len dang bcas pa/ sku tshab padma mthong grol dam rdzas khro 'dus ril bu/ a thaṃ ma bsgoms sangs rgyas/ gu ru'i phyag mtshan rdo rje rtse dgu/ las phur bdud dpung zil gnon/ mkhan slob chos rgyal gsum gyi na bza' gos ber mtsho rgyal gyi dbu skra sogs khrom gter du gdan drangs pa'i chos sde chen po glegs bam sa bcu'i grangs ldan bzhugs pa las/ rdzogs chen bla med snying po dang*/ phyi rgyud theg pa rim dgu sogs rgyud lung man ngag du ma dus 'gyur skabs slar mi mngon pa'i dbyings su thim par snang la/ skabs 'dir 'dzin ma'i khyon 'dir ji snyed bzhugs pa kun rtsol bas bsdus pa rnams kyi them byang 'god pa ni/ smad cha pod wam̐ rtags can la/

ka) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi/ spyi chings 'phrul gyi drwa ba rin chen lde mig kha) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi gsol 'debs rje drung byams pa 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa/ ga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dkar gtor 'dod yon char 'bebs/ nga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sgrub pa'i las byang ye shes phreng ba/ ca) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: las byang khro bo 'dus pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung*/ cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: spyan 'dren tshangs pa'i gdung dbyangs/ ja) sman mchod rje drung byams pa 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa/ nya) rjes chog mchod bstod/ ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: hūm̐ sgrub srid gsum zil gnon/ tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: phrin las bsdus pa'i cho ga rdzu 'phrul drwa ba ye shes sdong po/ da) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mdun bskyed pho brang rngam klong chen mo/ na) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bskang ba dngos grub char 'bebs/ pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmag bskul drag sngags 'brug sgra/ pha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsad pa dug gi spu gri nag po/ ba) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rtsang bzlog pho nya myur mgyogs/ ma) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: kun bzang zhi ba'i bzlog pa dug lnga dbyings grol/ tsa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: che mchog khro bo'i bzlog pa stobs bcu rang shar/ tsha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: yang dag he ru ka'i bzlog pa bsod nams gter bum/ dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'jam dpal sku'i bzlog pa me yi spu gri dmar po/ wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gsung rta mgrin gyi bzlog pa zil gnon stobs 'dus/

zha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: phrin las phur pa'i bzlog pa rngam pa glog phreng*/ za) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: yon tan ma mo'i bzlog pa drag sngags spu gri/ 'a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bzlog pa bdud bzhi g.yul 'joms/ ya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'jig rten khro bo'i bzlog pa dgra yul dpung 'joms/ ra) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmod pa drag sngags kyi bzlog pa ki kang 'khor lo/ la) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bya khyung dgu'i bzlog pa me'i 'khor lo/ sha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs kyi bzlog pa mtshon cha gzer 'debs/ sa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gter srung gi bzlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo/ ha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ltas ngan brgyad cu'i bzlog byang srid pa'i 'khor lo/ a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'dre mo bong zhon gyi bzlog pa rmi lam bsgyur chog ki) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: wa la sprel zhon gyi bzlog pa ltas ngan than zlog khi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsrung bzlog gur gyi drwa mig gi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gzu dpang gser skyems snang srid sgo 'byed/ ngi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: srin mo za lam mgyogs pa'i shugs 'chang*/ ci) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: glud rabs lha mi'i snang rgyan/ chi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gzu dpang dang zor mda' dug gi spu gri dgra bo'i snying gzer/ ji) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmod pa dgu'i bzlog zor/ nyi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dgongs gsol rngam yangs khyab brdal/ ti)

bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zor chen thog mda' reg chod/ thi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhun mar smon lam/ di) wa la sprel zhon gyi bca' thabs zin bris/ ni) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gter bdag gter srung kyi las byang dregs dpung nag po dgra snying dmar 'byin pi) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon las/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi cho ga khrigs su bsdebs pa gsang chen nor bu'i dga' ston bcas chos tshan zhe gnyis bzhugs so/ slar smras pa/ zab gter snying po bka' dgongs phur gsum las/ /sgrub sde rgya mtsho'i mthar thug bka' brgyad che/ /gsang ba zil gnon chos sde yid bzhin nor/ /cha shas gang rnyed phyogs bsdus 'di ru bkod/ /de slad dpal mgon bla ma yi/ /thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*/ /gang la me tog phog pa yi/ /gnam lcags zab gter gang de'i gtsos/ /rgyun dkon gsung rab bsdu skrun dang*/ /chad nye'i smin grol rgyun spel slad/ /'di yang bka' gter sri zhu ru/ /e wam̐ dpe skrun khang nas bsgrubs/ /des kyang snying po'i ring lugs 'di/ /bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas/ /snyigs ma'i rgud pa yongs su zhi/ /rdzogs ldan dpal la spyod par shog /ces pa'ang sgo chen sprul ming pas gnam lcags zab gter yongs rdzogs 'phrul par du drangs shing glegs bam re la brgya phrag lnga yi grangs kyi dpe skrun bgyis skabs rang gi 'dod don gsol ba btab pa bzhin 'grub par gyur cig/ // ka) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi/ spyi chings 'phrul gyi drwa ba rin chen lde mig bzhugs so/ gu ru pra bha kā ra rasmi bha wantu/ rnam mkhyen don gcig bla med rdo rje'i theg /gzhung lugs nam mkha' rgya mtsho'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /snang srid sgrib med nyi zla'i phreng ba phreng*/ /srid zhir 'chi med smag rum gdod nas dag khyab bdag kun bzang 'gogs med bkod pa bstan/

/ de yang bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon gyi 'don 'grigs bsdus pa'i rgyug byang bri bar byed pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gzhung chen sgrub chen dang 'brel ba'i dkyil 'khor bsham chog sta gon pra khrid sogs ni gzhan du gsal la/ 'dir bzlog pa'i las la dang po sngon 'gro theg chen dgu ldan/ dkar gtor/ bgegs gtor/ bla ma rig 'dzin las byang ye shes drwa ba sogs 'don la bsnyen pa ci 'grub bya/ de nas bka' brgyad las khro bo 'dus pa'i skyabs sems nas gzhung bzhin dkyus ltar la/ 'don nas spyan 'dren mtshams su spyan 'dren rgyas pa 'dzud/ bstod pa nas dzap bskul bya la bsnyen pa so so ltar ji bzhin bsgrubs la thun gtor so sor 'bul/ 'di'i skabs su rgyun khyer chag mi rung pa'i skor gang yod gtong*/ mgon po phyag bzhi pa'i las byang gsol kha/ dregs pa spyi spungs kyi gsol kha sogs gtong*/ gtor 'bul byed pa sogs skabs dang mthun/ de sogs sngon 'gro stod kyi le tshan no/ /de nas mdun bskyed pho brang rngam klong la 'jug pa ni/ gzhung ltar pho brang bskyed chog bya/ hūm̐: gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ sgra can/ / sogs/ las byang ltar lha bskyed bya la tshom bur bkod/ spyan 'dren nas bzung*/ bsnyen pa yan bskyal/ tshogs 'khor bya/ skong bshags rgyas pa bya/ dang po 'gugs pa gsum bya/ tha ma bsgral/ de yang dkyil 'khor gcig la gdab kha gnyis mi bya zer ba'i phyag bzhes kyang 'dug /gang ltar spyi gzhung ltar ro/ /de nas dmag bskul gtong ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ chos dbyings rnam dag yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sogs/ mtshams su gtor ma 'bul/ dgra bo'i snying la hur thum rbad bhyoḥ bar 'don/ de nas bsad las spu gri nag po la 'jug pa ni/ dang po gser skyems thogs la/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: sogs/ rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

zhes gser skyems mchod la gzu dpang bya/ de nas ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang la hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rang nyid dpal chen dmod pa'i khro rgyal zhes pas bskyed/ mdun du hom bskyed ni/ phaṭḥ mdun du e dang kam̐ las grub sogs nas/ bden stobs lan gsum brjod la rim bzhin pho nya bskyed/ khā kha mu kha dang hu lu mu kha gnyis kyis lha dbye bya la phur pas gzir zhing thun gyis rim bzhin brdeg hūm̐: dpal chen pho nya las mkhan 'bum: sogs kyis liṅga gtubs la zhal du bstab/ de nas rtsang bzlog bya ba ni/ hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba e yi klong : sogs/ de yang lha bzlog rgyan bzlog gi chad: de nas rim bzhin/ kun bzang zhi ba'i bzlog pa/ che mchog khro bo'i bzlog pa/ mtshams su liṅga gtor chung sha dum sogs kyis rim pa ltar 'bul/ de nas yang dag shar gyi bzlog pa/ 'jam dpal lho'i bzlog pa/ rta mgrin nub kyi bzlog pa/ phur pa byang gi bzlog pa/ rbod gtong shar lho'i bzlog pa/ bla ma rig 'dzin lho nub kyi bzlog pa/ 'jig rten mchod bstod nub byang gi bzlog pa/ dmod pa drag sngags byang shar gyi bzlog pa/ 'di dag dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i lugs su 'dod/ bka' srung gi bzlog pa/ bya khyung gi bzlog pa/ gter srung dregs dpung gi bzlog pa/ ltas ngan brgyad cu'i bzlog pa/ bca' sogs gzhung ltar bya/ bong zhon than bzlog /rnga mong khyung zhon/ za lam zor bzlog /than bzlog mtshams su btsud pa'i phyag srol 'dug rung gzhan gyi gzhung bstun/ de nas lhag ma btang*/ bzhag pa ci bder bya/ lhag ma byang shar matsams su spung zhes pa'i don/ de nas thugs dam bskul ba rim bzhin bya/ 'di mtshams chos skyong gtor 'bul bya/ chad mdo/ brtan skyong*/ rta bros mnan/ 'di la lugs mi 'dra ba gnyis/ bkra shis bya/ oṃ bhrūm̐ badzra ram̐ tsakra hūm̐/ zhes pas srung bzlog gur khang bsgom/ 'di la snga phyi khyad 'dug

/bsngo smon rgyas 'debs mi dmigs khyab brdal ngang du gnas/ /de sogs rgyun gyi rnal 'byor yin/ de yang rgyas bsdus gnyis las rgyas pa las byang chen mo/ bsdus pa las byang 'bring po ltar lha so sor mngon rtog dang mdun bskyed bsgral las gzhung ltar 'jug la/ bzlog pa so sor bya ba'i 'debs kha bya ba'i phyag bzhes yod/ zhal las shes/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba'i nyin/ las byang rgyas bsdus gang 'os bya la/ tshogs bskang bsgrags/ lhag ma 'bul/ mdun bskyed thon na legs shing ma thon kyang chad pa'i skyon du mi 'os/ bzlog pa gong ltar 'di mtshams chos skyong spyi bskul bya ba'i phyag srol yod/ de nas dkar gtor gser skyems kyis phyi'i zor lam dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams nas: sogs? mthu ldan rnams kyis phrin las mdzod: de nas dkyil 'khor sgo chas mchod g.yog pas thogs la/ hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma: sogs?nas myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las grub par mdzod: bar 'don 'di mtshams srin mo za lam btang*/ glud rab lha mi'i snang rgyan sogs sngon du btang la/ rang nyid che mchog he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i gar dgu'i ngang tshul gyis dmigs pa zhal shes/ mdos zhal bsgyur la/ thams cad rim par dpag /gzhung bskul dang chad tho'i tha tshig bsgrags/ rang chos lhad med phyag bzhes/ de nas rim bzhin dar nag ru mtshon gzings shing sngags pa zor thogs/ bon po gshang thogs/ skyes pa mtshon thogs/ bud med thal brdebs/ byis pa 'ur thogs dang bcas pas bswa sgra dang bcas lam 'gros ngang la/ 'bul sar phyin nas dkar gtor gser skyems mchod pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub ka dag klong yangs nas: sogs kyis mchod la mdun du hom bskyed bya/ 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya/ zor thogs la/ hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sogs rim bzhin phyogs skyong bcu'i zor 'phen/

zor gzhan yang de bzhin no/ /de nas liṅga me hom du bcug la phyag tu gtor chen thogs nas/ hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: sogs kyis dgongs gsol bzhes 'dren bya/ hūm̐: 'og min dag pa khyab gdal klong yangs nas: sogs kyis bzlog pa me hom du bsgyur/ dar nag g.yab/ gtor snod sbub gtor bro bya/ khyung nag gi phyi lam bcad/ nang du logs shing gur khang rim bzhin bsgoms la bkra shis gom pa bcu gsum mtshams su sbyin bdag gi bkra shis chang dang phye mar nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi phye mar srung brgyan pa'i phyag srol yod/ la sogs bya/ tshe 'gugs slar mchod bstod bya/ gzhung gi brtan ma skyong dngos grub len chog /bkra shis bsngo smon bya/ rjes su gtang rag la mar me'i mtha' brgyan smon lam bya na dkyil 'khor sgrub khog ltar bya'o/ /'di bris mi dge'i nyes pa mchis srid na/ /dkyil 'khor srung ma dam can tshogs la bshags/ /dge bas 'gro kun phan bde'i gru gzengs ltar/ /bdud bzhi'i g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /dge'o// // kha) bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon gyi gsol 'debs bzhugs so/ oṃ swa sti/ gdod ma'i mgon po khyab bdag kun tu bzang*/ /longs spyod yongs rdzogs bcom ldan rdo rje sems/ /sprul pa'i sku mchog shāka thub dga' rab la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ /gsang ba'i bdag po dpal ldan rdo rje chos/ /gsang mdzod brgyud 'dzin las kyi dbang mo che/ /dam pa'i rig can ind+ra bhū ti la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ /dpal chen khrag 'thung dngos sprul shrī sing*/ /sgrub sde'i shing rta grub pa'i slob dpon brgyad/ /sprul pa'i gar mkhan mtsho skyes rgyal ba la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ /brda yi gsang mdzod mtsho rgyal padma'i lcam/ /gangs can grub pa'i slob dpon rnam pa brgyad/ /bka' bab rgyud bskul sangs rgyas ye shes la/

/gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ /las 'phro gter 'byin rtsa gsum gling pa'i zhabs/ /gsang gsum sprul pa'i snang char shar rnams dang*/ /lung zin chos kyi gnyer thob mchog rnams la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ /gzhan yang dgongs pa brda dang snyan nas brgyud/ /shog ser tshig dang dbang lung man ngag gi /rtsa brgyud dpal ldan bla ma'i dkyil 'khor sar/ /gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ khyad par phyogs dus rgyal ba'i ngo bo nyid/ /rnam dag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho ye shes sar/ /yongs shar drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ /gsol ba 'debs so bde chen ye shes stsol/ /de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /gzhi rgyud zab gsal gnyis med rang rig pa/ /lam dus glo bur 'khrul pa'i dri spang ste/ /'bras bu'i khyab bdag khrag 'thung dpal chen po'i/ /'od gsal ye shes klong dgu'i snang ba las/ /rig gdang gzhon nu bum sku'i gzhal yas su/ /nang gsal thim la ma rmug sangs rgyas te/ /phyir snang sprul pas 'gro ba 'dren gyur cig / ces pa'ang byams pa'i ming gis bris pa dge'o/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// //

ga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dkar gtor 'dod yon char 'bebs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon la lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: dkar gtor bya ba'i rim pa ni: bse phor zangs snod rin chen snod: 'bru bcud gser skyems dkar gtor bcas: chu gtsang bran la 'di skad do: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharma nāṃ ādya nutpanna na twata om̐ āḥhūm̐ phaṭ swā hā: om̐ badzra yakṣa hūm̐: om̐ swa bhā wa shuddha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shuddho3 haṃḥ sngon 'gro'i gtor ma gser skyems mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i ngang las om̐ las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du: om̐ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bhyo bi shwa mu khe bhya: sarba thā khaṃ utga te spha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā: om̐ badzra a mṛ t sogs: om̐ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ā wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐: om̐ dzñā na a wa lo ki te na maḥs manta spha ra ṇa rasmi bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dzwa la ni hūm̐: om̐ na maḥ sa manta buddha nam gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza te ma hā sa ma ya swā hā': om̐ hūm̐ bhrūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ om̐ las 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga: bhrūm̐ las rin chen gzhal yas khang : trām̐ las sna tshogs ratna'i snod: hrīḥlas gsung dbyangs drug cur ldan: āḥlas ci 'dod phun sum tshogs: so so'i dga' mgu tshim byed pa: 'dod pa'i yo byad chen por gyur: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang : grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyi: bka' dang dam tshig gnyan la gnas pa yi: lha brgyad klu brgyad gza' brgyad rgyu skar brgyad: sde brgyad sde dpon sum cu rtsa gnyis dang : phyogs skyong bcu dang sa bdag dmu sman dang : phyi nang gsang ba'i dregs pa sde bcu gnyis: dpal gyi mgon po chen po bdun cu lnga:

rgyal chen bzhi dang dus kyi skyong ma 'bum: mkha' la rgyu ba'i yid gzugs gzhi bdag dang : lo zla zhag dus chu tshod dbang ba'i lha: skyes lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha: khyad par rin chen gter gyi srung ma dang : pha ri tshur kha g.yas g.yon mdun rgyab ri: steng 'og phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad gnas pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag rnams: 'dir gshegs gser skyems phud dang gtor ma bzhes: bdag gi legs nyes bya ba ci la yang : ko long ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par: rin chen gter gyi sa 'di myur du stsol: slob dpon padma'i bka' la ma 'da' bar: bdag gi bsam pa sgrubs la re ba skongs: las bzhi'i phrin las gang bcol myur du sgrubs: lo legs nad zhi sa phyogs bkra shis nas: dkar po dge bcu sgrub pa'i rogs dan sgrubs: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ bhū mi pa ti lo ka pa la sarba dharma pā la sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hiḥ zhes dkar gtor phyogs gtsang sar phul zhing : bkra shis pa'i phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: padma gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // nga) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: sgrub pa'i las byang ye shes phreng ba bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyi: yang gsang bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: snying byang dmar po gsang rgya can: yang zab shog dril mgul khug ma: tshig nyung don 'brel byin rlabs myur: gcig dril cha tshang khyad du 'phags: don gsal 'khyer bde go yang sla: byin chags lhan thabs sgrub thag nye: spel bar phangs nas gter du sbas: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sgrub la long med bar chad ldang : snying rje'i sa bon bral ba yi: ban btsun sngags pa gdug sems can: dregs pa phal cher bsgrub pa yis: shi nas ngan song gdug 'drer skye:

de phyir gab pa'i snying sgrub 'di: ka dag ye shes kho na'i phyir: 'di yi las byang mjal ba dang : dbang dang byin rlabs thob tsam gyis: 'og min zhing skye kun bzang mjal: bsgrub cing nyams su len pa rnams: sangs rgyas zhing nas phyir mi ldog: nam yang ngan song sa bon zad: de phyir rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras: 'brel tshad don ldan byang chub myur: 'di nyid nyams su len pa rnams: pad 'byung nga yi rgyal ba'i sras: tshe 'phos zangs mdog rnga yab gling : zhing khams bgrod par the tshom med: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs lnga brgya nyi shu'i dus: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: bkra shis rten 'brel ma nyams pa'i: gangs khrod dang ni nags kyi yul: rang byung brag phug shing gcig drung : dgra dang gcan gzan mi gnod cing : mi mang rnam g.yeng dben pa'i yul: nyi zla shar snga 'grib phyi ba: rgyab ri mtho la rngam lhun brjid: mdun ri rtsi shing nags tshal dang : sman ljongs chu bo'i rgyun 'bab sogs: sa dpal bzang po byung na rab: ma 'grigs nyams rtogs 'phel ba dang : bag grib chung bar sgrub gnas rung : sa ma ya: bsgrub pa yang mgo grim ma drag pa: mjug tu lhod ma drag pa: zhag du tsam bsgrub kyang : dkyil 'khor bca' gzhi dang bsham bkod man ngag kha tshang zhing mtha' 'dril bar bya: dgos ched ni: bsgrub pa kun la mthar phyin pa dang : sgab 'dre mi 'byung zhing chos de 'dzin pa'i brgyud pa rnams: bkra shis pa'i yon tan yod pa yin: sgrub pa che phra gang la yang mi 'ong ba'i khas len: mi 'grub pa'i blo rgya rnams dor dgos: ci'i phyir zhe na: rang gis rang nyid 'khrul pa'i rlung bskyed pa yin no: spyir chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong ma lus kyi: bsgrub tshul dbang dang sgrub khog pra khrid lha'i zhal phyag sogs 'dra min mang bar 'byung mod: sngon ston pa sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor zhes bya bas:

dbang po rab 'bring gi blo la dpag ste: bskyed rim sgyu ma'i sprul bsgyur bya ba: brda chos tsam las ma gtogs: don la kun bzang gzhi'i gnas lugs 'di: shes rgyud ma 'khrul ba'i ting nge 'dzin gcig gis: rig pa de gtso bor bton: ci'-i phyir zhe na: sngon ston pa mchog gi shes rgyud ma 'khrul ba'i ting nge 'dzin gdeng gi mdangs las: snang srid kyi skye 'gro lha mi kun gyi spyod 'gros shes rgyud thams cad thugs dbyings las 'byung ba'i phyir: dbyings kyi gzhi de las brdar bstan pa'i chos theg pa rim dgu la: cha lag mtha' yas: spros pa gsungs shing yi ger btab pas: de rnams yang ro gcig pa'i phyir shar ba'o: de bzhin gsang sngags 'dus pa rnam bzhi'i brda chos kyang : gzhi ro gcig: lam brda chos: tshad shog ser: don gter zhes pa yang : nam mkha'i mtha' zad pas gter gyi shog dril brda gzhi rten 'brel sogs zad par gyur ro: de bzhin bsgrub pa'i bskyed rdzogs yi dam lha'i zhal phyag 'grub pa'i tshad: mthar phyin gyi rtags rnams: tshe rabs su dran pa mi brjed pa'i gzungs thob dgos: ci'i phyir zhe na: nam mkha' g.ya' dag snga dro phyi rim bzhin: nyi zla gsal zhing kun gzhi rnams kyang dwangs: blo bur khu rlangs sna tshogs gtibs pa yis: nyi zla mi mthong nam mkha' dag kyang sgrib: ces pa ltar: sgrub tshul deng nas bzung 'ja' lus phyir mi ldog ces pa: btsan sa gsum zin cing : g.yang sa gsum la ya mi nga ba'i shugs la ma gyur gyi bar du mtshams dang tshad ces bya ba bcad du med: ci'i phyir zhe na: nam mkha' che la sems yang che: bsgrub pa che la 'gog pa che: rnam rtog che la 'khor ba che: zhes pa ltar: gzhi ma bcos so ma'i rnal 'byor: lam ma bcos sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor: don ma bcos rang rig gi rnal 'byor: blo ma bcos dran stong gi rnal 'byor te: de bzhin du: bsgrub pa'i dus su: 'grub tu re ba dang :

mi 'grub kyi dogs pa dang bral bar rang babs kyis sgrubs: rtags bzang por byung yang dga' brod med cing : ngan pa ru 'dug kyang rnam rtog mi bya: rtags bzang ngan zhes pa ni: ye shes kyi rlung dang nyon mongs gi rlung mtho dman gyi tshad tsam las: don la yi dam spros bral gyi rang bzhin la: bzang ngan gyi rtags su ma grub par bshad cing : de bzhin phyis 'byung gi rjes 'jug rnams kyang bsgrub tshul gyi ngang de ltar bsring dgos: sgrub pa phran bu'i dus phyi lhong che bar 'byung yang bar chad ma yin pa: ngo bo de thog tu zhog dang rang sar zhi: lam du lhongs nas ci yang mi 'byung pa chos nyid zad pa'i nyams lta bu'o: sa ma ya: de yang sgrub pa'i pra khrid ni gzhung chen mor gsal zhing : 'di rgyun khyer sgrub pa'i las byang khol du phyung ba yin te: bzlog pa'i skabs ltar bdag bskyed byas kyang 'thus: rgyun khyer spros pa mi bya na rang lus dkyil 'khor byas kyang chog: rgyun gyi spros pa bya na: dkyil 'khor byung na rab: ma byung na 'bru tshom lha grangs bkod: dbus su bum pa kha rgyan mgul chings tshang ba'i nang du: chu gtsang rdzas dang sbyar ba sum gnyis bkang : steng du che mchog kun bzang gi tsakli gzug: mdun du sman gtor rakta bsham: phyi nang mchod rdzas tshang bar bsags: cung zad spro na bum pa'i g.yas su bhandha mtshan ldan ril bu phab rgyun ltar khengs par bya: ma rnyed na skye bdun ril bu: steng du me long sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor la: dbus su hūm̐: rtsibs drug tu ha ri ni sa siddhi dzaḥ zhes bris la bzhag: bum pa'i g.yon du sku 'bag gam ma 'byor na: rdo rje phur pa bshams te rgyas pa sgrub khog ltar bya: rgyun khyer byed na skyabs yul sngon du song nas dkar gtor gtong : de nas skyabs yul bsdus pa ni: na mo: ka dag kun gzhi sangs rgyas 'od mi 'gyur: ma 'gags tshogs drug cir snang chos kyi sku:

yengs med rtse gcig dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs: skyabs yul rang byung de bzhin skyabs su gsol: gnyis pa sems bskyed pa ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das bral ba snod bcud dag pa'i zhing : kun gzhi ma bcos ye nas sems bskyed bral: blo 'das sems can bdag gzhan gnyis su med: de don rig pas kun gzhir sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni: hoḥ chos dbyings lhun grub dag pa'i zhing : kun rgyu bla ma gshegs su gsol: rtog med shes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: ye grol khyod la don phyag 'tshal: 'gags med shar grol dbang pos mchod: zang thal kun rig khyod la bstod: dgag sgrub 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: khregs chod lta ba'i chos 'khor bskor: lhun grub bde stong dge ba bsngo: bzhi pa bgegs gtor gtong ba ni: chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: bdag ni skye med he ru ka'i: thugs las snying rje'i 'od zer 'phros: rang bzhin shugs 'byin stobs bcu yis: kun rtog ma rig gnyis 'dzin bgegs: bdag 'dzin gzhom phyir myur du khug: om̐ he ru ka ma ma dza dzaḥ gnod byed dam sri khug dzaḥ lnga pa bskrad pa ni: hūm̐: nga ni gsal stong he ru kas: bdag gzhan phye ba'i rnam rtog bgegs: ro gcig gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phyogs med chos sku'i klong du dengs: ci ste mi 'gro a 'thas na: kun rgyu khro mos rig rtsal bskyed: khregs chod rdo rje'i mtshon char 'beb: nga bdag 'gong po rdul phran gtor: de bas gnyis 'dzin phyir dengs shig: om̐ he ru ka dzñā na badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭḥ gnod byed u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ drug pa srung 'khor bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: snang srid mi shigs rdo rje'i mkha': rang byung me la rig pa'i rlung : rgya chad phyogs lhung bral ba yi: brdal khyab chen por mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra dharma ho tsakra rakṣa bhrūm̐: bdun pa sgrub pa'i dam bca' ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi: rang shar dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha:

rang gsal lhun grub de lta bu: rang byung de bzhin mi gtong bsgrub: om̐ badzra tsitta hūm̐: brgyad pa mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: phyi yi mchod pa tshogs drug lha mo'i gar: rig stong gsal stong bde stong de bzhin du: ma bcos spros bral brda bzhi yid 'phrog gzugs: phyi yi mchod pa ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: dgu pa nang mchod byin rlabs ni: hūm̐: bde ba chen pos ye shes bhandha ru: stong pa chen po byang sems haṃ gyis bskyil: gsal ba chen pos shes rab bhandha ru: grol ba chen po chags med raktas bkang : om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta āḥhūm̐: bcu pa gtor ma dang sbyor mchod byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: 'dus byas phung po dag pa'i gtor gzhong du: tshogs drug rang grol dpal gyi gtor ma btsugs: dug lnga ye shes gzhi gcig 'bral med sbyor: ma rig nga bdag bsgral ba'i dbang po spung : om̐ ma hā bha lingta māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na om̐ āḥhūm̐: bcu gcig pa byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: ka dag rang rig bla mas byin phob cig: rtsal snang ma 'gags zang thal pho brang nas: ye shes lnga ldan yi dam byin phob cig: gang yang ma chags dran rdzogs pho brang nas: thams cad skyed gzhi mkha' 'gros byin phob cig: chos sku bla ma'i byin rlabs thibs se thib: lnga ldan yi dam lha tshogs spungs se spung : dam tshig ma dang mkha' 'gro sha ra ra: gnas 'dir byin phob 'od gsal dbyings lta bur: klong yangs ma 'gags rtsal lnga'i 'od zer gyis: gshis lugs lta ba 'ja' tshon sprin phung gtibs: byin chen phob la dbang chen myur du bskur: om̐ badzra sa mā ya a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ bcu gnyis pa brda sgo dbye ba ni: hoḥ ye nas chos sku nyon mongs bral: sangs rgyas sems can kun gzhi gcig: ma dag 'khrul rgyun sgo bcad nas:

de don rig pa'i brda sgo phyes: om̐ badzra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ bcu gsum brdas brgyan pa ni: hūm̐: kun gzhi lta ba'i lha zhal mjal: rtog med rig pas brda phyag 'tshal: rtag chad bral ba'i brdas mchod bstod: klong yangs shugs 'byung brda yis bshags: om̐ badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ste: dang po khyab pa gzhi'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: smra brjod bral ba stong pa'i gzhi: khyab brdal ngang la lhun gyis gnas: rgya chad phyogs lhung spu ris bral: kun tu bzang pos de ltar smra: om̐ dharma dzñā na tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun snang las kyi ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: yid kyi rtog pa phra mo la: ma 'gags rtsal snang lam gyis shar: nga 'am gzhan zhes phra mor 'dzin: gnyis brtags rlung gis rang bzhin bskyed: om̐ badzra dharma hrī ta āḥ gsum pa rgyu'i ting 'dzin ni: hūm̐: kun snang 'dzin pa'i sa bon las: rten 'brel rgyu yi yi ge shar: gnas 'gyur phyag mtshan snang zhing stong : gzhal yas rang byung de bzhin gsal: om̐ dzra dharma bhrūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐:

bzhi pa 'byung lnga'i sa bon ni: hūm̐: rang shar nam mkha'i yig 'bru ni: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: de las 'byung ba rim pa bzhin: pho brang gzhal yas chen por bsgom: om̐ badzra bhrūm̐ sa ma ya hūm̐: lnga pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐: e las nam mkha' mthing nag klong : yam̐ las rlung gi rgya gram chags: ram̐ las bskal pa'i me ri 'bar: kham̐ las 'byung ba'i rakta 'khrugs: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhi brjid: keṃ las keng rus ri rab mkhar: bhrūm̐ las rdo rje'i gzhal yas gsal: om̐ bhrūm̐ dzñā na a bhrūm̐ tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: drug pa gzhal yas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung dur khrod e yi pho brang ni: rdo rje'i rmang gzhi mi shigs rang bzhin can: gru bzhi sgo bzhi rtsig pa sna lnga mdzes: 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba shar bu ste: mda' yab kha bad thod pa skam rlon ldan: lha brgyad gdung ma klu brgyad ka ba ste: ka gdan ru tra bam ros 'khun pa ldir: nang rnams thams cad rgyan dar phun sum tshogs: zhing chen g.yang gzhi thog steng khyab par bkab: sbrul nag pho mo'i dral lcam za ra tshags: rta babs rim bzhir ri dwags chos sgra nyan: nyi zla nor bu rin chen tog gis mdzes: phyogs bzhir rgyal mtshan zhing gi g.yang gzhi phyar: thod pa'i tog dang rin chen du mas mdzes: dbus su sna tshogs padma rin chen tog: phyi rol pad phreng dur khrod rdo rwa dang : mtshon cha sna tshogs me ri dmar nag gur: gter bum bzhi dang phyi nang dkyil 'khor ni: ma bcos zang thal klong yangs gsal stong bsgom: nang dbus zla gam mthing nag sgo gcig pa: padma nyi zla byol song gtso brgyad steng : rang byung che mchog dpal chen he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag dbu dgu shin tu khro: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal sgrol mche gtsigs: spyan rtsa sdang mig 'khyil zhing sma ra 'bar: dbu skra kham nag thod pa'i phreng bas brgyan:

dar nag cod pan sbrul nag chings rgyan 'khyugs: g.yas pa dgu na gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: g.yon pa dgu na bhandha dmar gyis bkang : zhing glang stod g.yogs sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad: khrag zhags thig le thal chen tshom bus brgyan: thod phreng rus rgyan chu srin stag sham brjid: yan lag lhu tshigs sbrul rigs sbal sbrul brgyan: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum dor stabs gling bzhi mnan: thugs kar padma zla gdan thig le'i dbus: kun bzang mthing nag bzang mo dkar gsal 'khyud: bde stong skyil krung phyag gnyis thabs shes bsnol: de yi thugs kar nā da gsal stong klong : ting 'dzin sems dpa' dkar gsal mnyam bzhag can: shes rab dmar mo rtsa yi rnam par bzhugs: de yi thugs kar hūm̐ ljang spus bris tsam: rang sgra dang bcas mi shigs lam gyis gsal: yum mchog gnam zhal dbyings phyug sku la 'khril: zhal gsum gdang zhing ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: spyan rtsa 'khrug cing dbu skra thod skam brgyan: g.yas gsum gri gug g.yon gsum dung dmar stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zung 'jug bde stong zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: mi bzad me ri smug nag klong du gsal: om̐ badzra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ: hūm̐: shar phyogs dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : thugs kyi lha mchog badzra he ru kaḥ mthing nag dkar dmar khro zhing dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung dang : g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rgyu zhags 'dzin: sgro gshog brgyangs shing kro ti shwa rir 'khyud: yang dag lha tshogs dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag dkar dmar zhal gsum khro zhing gtum: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs:

g.yas gsum be con ral gri dgra satwa dang : g.yon gsum bhan dmar sdigs mdzub mdung thung bsnams: bhe ta za byed yum 'khril gar dgu ldan: sku yi lha tshogs dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ badzra ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : gsung gi dbang mchog padma he ru kaḥ dkar dmar mthing zhal khro gtum dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags dang : g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog bsnams: sgro gshog brgyangs shing gzi ldan sku la 'khril: gsung mchog lha tshogs dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ badzra kro ta ha ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : phrin las bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing kha dkar dmar khro gtum sgro gshog brgyangs: g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga gdeng : g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ dur khrod chas: mtha' gnyis srid pa'i ri rab phur bu bsgril: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum 'khyud brjid pa'i nyams: phrin las lha tshogs dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar lho'i dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : yon tan bdag nyid rbod gtong he ru kaḥ ljang nag dkar dmar khro zhing dur khrod chas: phyag g.yas rdo rje khyung dang sbrul zhags bsnams: g.yon pas bhandha dmar zhing dbyug gu 'dzin: sgro gshog brgyangs shing nyid zhi sku la 'khril: yon tan lha tshogs dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ ghu ya dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ: ma ma yo gi ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho nub dur khrod zla gdan me dpung klong : che mchog drag po khrag 'thung thod phreng rtsal: dmar dkar sngo la khro zhing dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum gri gug rdo rje ral gri bsnams: g.yon gsum thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig 'dzin:

khro mo yum 'khyud sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad: drag po thod phreng lha tshogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nub byang dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : gnyis med khro bo 'jig rten he ru kaḥ dud kha dkar dmar khro zhing dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum rdo rje dregs pa lha brgyad mgo: g.yon gsum bhan dmar gdug pa klu brgyad mgo: sgro gshog brgyangs shing 'byung bzhi'i bdag mor 'khril: 'jig rten lha tshogs dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang shar dur khrod zla gam me dpung klong : yang sprul khro rgyal khrag 'thung dmod pa'i sku: nag dkar dmar la khro gtum dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum gri gug lha brgyad tsitta bsnams: g.yon gsum thod khrag klu brgyad tsitta dmar: spyi 'dul yum 'khril sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs wal gyis gsal: om̐ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho nub byang shar sgo bzhir rim pa bzhin: seng gdong stag gdong phag gdong dom gdong ma: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan gar dgu dgyes pa'i nyams: phyi nang dkyil 'khor gsang ba zil gnon lha: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma gandhe hoḥ de nas khyung bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyi: sprul pa'i bya khyung dgu rnams ni: rwa gzengs mchu brdar sder gshog bgrad: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa 'dzin: me ri dmar nag klong du gsal: om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas: bka' brgyad gsang ba'i lha tshogs spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dza dzaḥ a be sha ya dza dzaḥ dang po spyan 'dren pa ni:

hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub rang byung e yi klong : sku gsung thugs yon 'dus pa'i gnas mchog nas: che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: padma gsung gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: yon tan ma mo'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: thod phreng drag po'i lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ye shes khyung gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: phyi nang bka' sdod sgo skyong gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rtog med ye shes dur khrod gsang ba'i dbyings: lhun grub dga' ston skyon bral pad zla nyi: mi shigs rdo rje bde ba'i khri steng du: nyon mongs rlung gis mi bskyod brtan par bzhugs: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: rang byung lhun grub spros pa'i mtha' bral yang : 'gro ba'i yid snang zhi khro'i gar bsgyur ba: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las 'dus pa'i dpal: gsang ba zil gnon lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: om̐ na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: spyan gzigs bkod pa sprin ltar gtibs pa 'di: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: lnga pa phyag rgya gar gyi mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: shes rab mkha' la bde ba'i rdo rje yis: srub skyed spel ba'i phyag rgya'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: legs bsgyur gar dang glu dbyangs rol pa'i rtsed: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul:

om̐ badzra padma kundha rakta nīrti gīrti āḥhūm̐: drug pa sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo mtshan ldan yangs pa'i nang : dri mchog sna tshogs sha chen rdzas kyis sbyor: 'chi med rang byung rnam dag bdud rtsi 'di: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: bdun pa sgrol mchod gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gtor snod yangs par nyi zla'i bhandha ru: ri rab gling bzhi snod bcud gtor mar bshams: dug lnga ru tra bsgral ba'i dbang pos brgyan: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya ri ni ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta khā hi: brgyad pa rakta'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings phyug bzang mo'i gsang ba'i mkha' lam nas: rdo rje rlung gi spyod pas rakta babs: dung chen snod du rba rlabs chi li li: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥkha kha khā hi: dgu pa bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ chos sku'i rang bzhin sku mdog smug nag 'bar: theg pa rim dgu khro zhal rngam zhing 'jigs: dbu skra bsig cing tshwa tshwas snang srid sngangs: g.yas dgu thabs kyi rdo rjes pho rgyud 'dul: g.yon dgu shes rab bhan dmar mo rgyud sdud: rdo rje'i sgro gshog dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: dur khrod chas kyis snang srid byad kha zlog: rnam shes tshogs brgyad rnam dag zhabs 'gying thabs: sems can 'dren phyir byol song gtso brgyad mnan: stong nyid don ldan thugs kar sems dpa' gsum: zil gnon che mchog khrag 'thung khro bor bstod: hūm̐: gsang pa'i yum mchog dbyings phyug gnam zhal ma: shes rab rang bzhin gsal 'tsher khro la chags: rtsa gsum mtshon phyir zhal gsum dkar mthing dmar:

rnam rtog tshar gcod g.yas gsum gri gug gdeng : dug lnga gzhom phyir bhan dmar yab la stob: phar phyin drug ldan dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: bde stong bskul phyir zhabs gnyis yab la 'khril: log lta tshar gcod me ri smug nag 'bar: yum chen khro mo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal yang dag he ru kaḥ mthing nag skur ston skye med hūm̐ sgra sgrog: phyag drug mtshon chas ma dag 'khrul rgyun gcod: sgro gshog gdeng zhing stong nyid don dang ldan: sa bcu rdzogs phyir dpa' bo'i chas bcus brgyan: tshad med bzhi ldan zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: bde chen yum mchog kro ti shwa rir 'khyud: gri gug 'dzin cing thod khrag yab la stob: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams la bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: rgyas pa'i dbang phyug sku mdog ser nag rngam: phyag drug mtshon gyis log rtog bag chags 'joms: rdzu 'phrul sgro gshog brgyang zhing rbod gtong 'dul: dur khrod mnga' sgyur chas bcu sku la mdzes: bdud bzhi tshar gcod zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: bhe ta yum 'khyud sprul pa'i khro tshogs 'gyed: gri thod 'dzin cing zhabs gnyis bde stong 'khril: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs rnams la bstod: hūm̐: gsung gi dbang phyug hya ghṛ wa'i sku: dmar nag dbang ldan log lta dbyings su sgrol: phyag drug mtshon chas bgegs tshogs gdon la 'debs: sgro gshog brgyang zhing bar snang 'byung po 'dul: dur khrod chas ldan gar dgu'i gzi byin 'bar: grol bzhi'i lam ston zhabs 'dor bam chen brdzis: padma gzi ldan gtum mo tshe bdag dbang : gri thod 'dzin cing zhabs 'khril stobs bcu brjid: padma gsung gi lha tshogs rnams la bstod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal badzra kī la ya: chos sku'i bzhin mdangs mthing nag skye 'chi gcod: phyag drug mtshon chas 'dre rgod snying la gzir:

sgro gshog dbyings brgyang srid gsum lha srin sngangs: dga' bzhi'i rang bzhin dor stabs bdud tshogs mnan: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril sbyor dbang sdud che: gri thod mgul 'khyud log lta zil gyis gnon: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs rnams la bstod: hūm̐: rbod gtong ma mo'i gtso mchog he ru kaḥ rlung sems mdangs ldan ljang nag ma bdud 'dul: phyag drug mtshon gyis dam sri tshar bar gcod: spu gri'i sgro gshog ma yams gdon tshogs gtor: log 'dren 'dul mdzad zhabs bzhi dor stabs brdzis: kun bzang nyid zhi gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: bde chen ngang nyid mkha' 'gro dbang du sdud: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bla ma drag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag me zer lha srin bsngangs shing 'dar: phyag drug mtshon chas gdug pa'i g.yul ngo 'joms: dur khrod chas rdzogs ging chen dpa' bos bskor: rdo rje'i sgro gshog 'dre rgod snying rtsa 'dar: yum mchog gsang ba gri thod bde stong sbyor: drag po thod phreng lha tshogs rnams la bstod: hūm̐: stobs ldan khro bo 'jig rten mchod pa'i rgyal: kham nag 'jigs tshul bgegs dpung sa la 'gyel: phyag drug mtshon gyis ma rungs byad ma bkums: sgro gshog me 'bar stong khams 'ub kyis bsregs: dur khrod chas ldan dregs pa las la bskul: zhabs bzhi dor stabs ma rungs snying la brjid: 'byung lnga yum 'khyud sde brgyad dmag tshogs sdud: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs rnams la bstod: hūm̐: khrag 'thung dregs 'joms khro bo dmod pa'i lha: nag po stobs ldan dgra yi srog la rngam: phyag drug mtshon chas bdud dpung sa la 'gyel: sgro gshog me 'od tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: dur khrod chas ldan khro tshogs dmag dpung bskyed: zhabs bzhi dor stabs dam sri pho mo brdzis: srid pa spyi 'dul yum 'khril khro bo 'gyed: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs phyag 'tshal bstod:

hūm̐: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las sprul pa'i khyung : lcags ru gzengs shing klu bdud sa bdag 'dul: dug sbrul gsol zhing gdol pa pho mo 'dzin: sprul pa khyung gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi bdag: gar dgu'i nyams ldan las kyi phyag mtshan 'dzin: sgo bzhi skyong zhing bstan pa'i bya ra ma: bdud 'dul sgo ma'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: phyi nang bar khyams 'khor yug la gnas pa'i: bka' sdod rab 'jigs sprul pa bsam las 'das: khro bo'i tshogs rnams hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: khro mo'i tshogs ni khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gar sgyur lings se ling : me 'od 'khrug cing stong khams shig shig 'gul: dam sri 'byung po glags lta tshar yang gcod: bstan pa'i bya ra bka' sdod tshogs la bstod: hūm̐: bstod cing phrin las drag po rgyud bskul nas: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dpal gyi dbang : 'dod don sgrub cing las bzhi'i dngos grub stsol:

ces bstod cing 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul: hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: bsgrub pa'i thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: chos dbyings drag sngags rang sgra 'brug ltar ldir: dbang bzhi stsol zhing dam tshig dus la bab: snang srid snod bcud lha 'dre mi gsum rnams: dbang sdud zil gnon tshe bcud mthu nus rnams: 'ub kyis bsdus nas rnal 'byor lus la stims: deng sang thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: 'byung 'jug rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: 'phro 'du dngos grub 'byung ba'i dus la bab: ka dag rang rtsal dbyings rig dngos grub stsol: de nas che mchog gi snying po ni: om̐ badzra kro ta ma hā shṝ he ru ka phaṭḥ yang dag gi snying po ni: om̐ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ 'jam dpal sku'i snying po ni: om̐ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭḥ padma gsung gi snying po ni: om̐ padma ta kri ta ma hā kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ phur pa phrin las kyi snying po ni: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma mo rbod gtong gi snying po ni: om̐ ghu ya dzñā na ma hā shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ ma ma yo gi ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ drag po thod phreng gi snying po ni: om̐ āḥhūm̐: artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ.āḥhūm̐: 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi snying po ni: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dmod pa drag sngags kyi snying po ni: om̐ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ khyung gi snying po ni: om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa tsa le tsa le hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas dkyil 'khor spyi'i las sngags ni: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags bzlas shing thun skabs dang bstun: yengs med chu bo'i rgyun ltar bzla ba gces:

rab bsnyen zla ba gsum: 'bring bsnyen zla ba gcig: tha ma nyer gcig bzlas pa gzhung spyi'i tshad: de yang dbang po rab rnams zhag bdun nas lha zhal mjal: de nas bum pa bsgrub pa ni: om̐ bhrūm̐ saṃ hūm̐: ho paṃ las padma 'dab ma brgyad pa rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa: de'i steng du bhrūm̐ las bum pa ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang phyi nang zang thal mtha' dbus tshad dang bral ba: lto ba che zhing zlum pa: mchu 'phyang ba: kha g.yel ba: zhabs zhum la mdzes pa: kha rgyan dpag bsam shing dang sgro mdangs me long rdo rje gzung gi thag pa dung dmar bdud rtsi dang ldan pa: de'i dbus su padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la: che mchog gtso gcig rdo rje dang thod pa 'dzin cing yum 'khril ba sku gsung thugs kyi sprul pa'i khro bo yab yum brgyad: phyi'i sgo srung bdud rtsi 'khyil pa hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya dang ldan pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs sna tshogs snang la rang bzhin dang bral bar gsal ba'i sku gsum gyi sa bon las 'od zer 'phros: rang 'dra'i ye shes pa dang dbang lha rgyal ba rigs lnga spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ zhes dbang bskur zhing lus gang dri ma dag: chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas kun bzang gis dbu brgyan par gyur: om̐ na ma sarba ta thā ga ta ye a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: ho ye shes pa 'od du zhu ste dam tshig gi bum lhar dbyer med par gyur: sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la 'khril te gzhal yas bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas thugs kar sngags phreng 'khor zhing thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul te snod bcud thams cad khro bo yab yum sngags sgra dang bcas pas gang : spro bsdu las bzhi'i phrin las thogs med du 'grub par gyur: ces bum pa bskyed cing sngags bzlas pas: mdun bskyed la phog pas thugs dam ci bsam pa bzhin du bskul bar bsam: de nas thun mtshams su thun gtor 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa lhun grub dbyings klong nas:

bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba'i thugs dam bskul: dug lnga bsgral ba'i sha khrag mchod pa 'bul: phyi nang rten 'brel dam tshig nyams pa bshags: dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bar chad zhi ba dang : sna tshogs phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod: om̐ sarba pañtsa rakta a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes thun gtor phul zhing las bzhi'i phrin las bcol: sngags kyi sham bu las bzhi sbyar kyang rung : dmigs rkang sgrub chen ltar bya: sa ma ya: de nas tshogs bya ba ni: tshogs chu gtsang gis bran la: hūm̐: rang nyid che mchog thugs ka nas: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ dang om̐ āḥhūm̐: bsregs gtor bkrus nas bdud rtsi yi: rang bzhin phun tshogs rdzas su gyur: om̐ sarba pañtsa ga ṇa tsakra om̐ āḥhūm̐: de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos spros bral rang bzhin pho brang nas: chos sku nyag gcig kun bzang bla ma la: 'od gsal mngon rdzogs rtog med tshom bus bskor: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: rnam dag rtsal lnga'i 'od phreng pho brang nas: ye shes lnga ldan longs sku'i ston pa la: rdzu 'phrul drwa ba smig rgyu'i tshom bus bskor: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sna tshogs der ston rtsol bral pho brang nas: rig 'dzin 'dus sde zhi khro bka' brgyad lha: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dam tshig rjes gcod mkhan: sprul pa'i chos skyong gter srung pho nya'i tshogs: ye shes tshogs la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: chos sku'i lha tshogs blo 'das ya la la: longs sku'i lha tshogs skye med sha ra ra: sprul sku'i lha tshogs thig le shigs se shig: zhi ba'i lha tshogs cod pan pu ru ru: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bro rdung khrigs se khrig: chos skyong gter bdag las byed khyugs se khyug: dri zhim spos ngad phyogs bcur chi li li:

'dod yon sna lnga'i tshogs mchod spungs se spung : dur khrod pho brang bag dro me re re: dkyil 'khor 'ja' tshon bkrag mdangs ta la la: 'dir tshogs dam can rig 'dzin khrigs se khrig: skal ldan pho mo dga' bro ya la la: 'dir 'dus 'khor tshogs rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras: rnga yab gling du yang yang 'tshogs bya'i phyir: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen myur du phob: mchog thun 'bad med chu bo'i rgyun ltar stsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ de nas gral du 'khod pa ni: hūm̐: chos sku rtog bral tshogs la rol: longs sku rtsal snang tshogs la rol: sprul sku bde chen tshogs la rol: zhi ba'i lha tshogs tshogs la rol: khro bo'i lha tshogs tshogs la rol: sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la rol: phyi nang gsang gsum gral du 'khod: om̐ badzra dharma ho dzñā na hūm̐: de nas tshogs 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dbyings las 'phros pa'i mkha' 'gro mdzes ma 'phyo: phyag na nyi zla bhandha yangs pa'i snod: 'dod yon tshogs mchod lhun po ltar bkod nas: phyag rgya brda skad glu gar rtse zhing mchod: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs ni mnyes gyur cig: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ga ṇa tsakra pū dza la kha kha khā hi: de nas bskang ba ni: hūm̐: gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla bye ba brgya: brjid chags mdzes ldan lta bas mi ngoms shing : rang bzhin kheng ba'i phyi nang mchod rdzas kyis: mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas phung po dpag med bkod: zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor thugs dam bskang : gsang ba zil gnon lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : sgrub chen bka' brgyad thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsal du gsol: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi phyi nang mchod pa la: phud nyams lhag phri tshig la chad cing lhag: nyes sgrib skyon can rang gnong 'gyod par bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa sa ma ya:

sogs sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : de nas tha ma bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: mdun du tha ma'i tshogs ling la: dmigs bya dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug: las mkhan pho nya'i dus la bab: om̐ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ de nas bsgral ba ni: hūm̐: khro rgyal stobs kyi phur bu 'di: myur mgyogs dpal ldan drag po'i shugs: bsgral zhing dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ byad ma nṛ tri ma rā ya rbad rbad: de nas sha khrag 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: zhi khro'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dug lnga ru tra bsgral ba yi: sha khrag bdud rtsir bsgyur nas 'bul: rtog med ka dag dbyings su hoḥ ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na ba su ta la khā hi: de nas tshogs la rol zhing mchog thun gyi dngos grub thob par bsam: hūm̐: 'di ni ngo mtshar dngos grub gter: gtsang btsog 'dzin pa'i rdul dang phrol: gdol pa khyi phag blang dor bral: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: a la la hoḥ pū dza hoḥ de nas lhag ma bya ba ni: hūm̐ bhyoḥ dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: dbang phyug ging dang laṅka pho nya'i tshogs: gnas bzang dur khrod 'grim zhing tshogs khang nyul: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing bhandha thogs: skyems bzang rakta 'thung zhing ro la 'dren: nyams pa'i sha la za zhing tshogs lhag sdud: sku mdog gcer bu skra dmar sa la gzhol: lhag ma 'di bzhes bstan pa'i mel tshe mdzod: om̐ utstshiṣṭa ba liṃ ta khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi: bdun brgya 'bum phrag lha tshogs ma lus pa: thugs rje phrin las mdzad phyir deng 'dir bskul: mthu stobs dpa' ba'i gzi brjid bdag la stsol: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma lnga bdo'i skabs: gsang sngags gnyan gyi bstan pa nub la nye: dam sri log 'dren 'byung po kha dar nas:

khro chen rgya mtsho'i mngon spyod dus la bab: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: zhing bcu nyams pa'i dgra bo rtsad nas chod: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: deng 'dir las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub pa mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul zhing phrin las bcol: de nas zor 'phang ba ni: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog zhi khro'i sku: nga ni khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal: deng 'dir drag po'i zor chen 'phen: pho nya dmar nag gtor ma'i dbal: mtshon thun tshwa tshwa spungs se spung : rbad cing las la bskul ba'i tshe: gnam lcags thog rgod lhung ba ltar: byad ma'i rten yul mkhar khang bcas: mgo mjug ldog cing sa la bsgyel: srog snying phral ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra ya du pra mo ha la ha la dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: dgra bo'i mkhar khang dpung bcas rim pa dgu'i 'og tu bzlog par bsam: de nas chad mdo bshams shing : hūm̐: sngon tshe 'og min ka dag pho brang du: kun tu bzang po dbyings phyug mkha' 'gro gnyis: lhun grub rang gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma rgyud khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la chad mdo dran par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i drung : grub pa thob pa'i rig 'dzin rnam brgyad la: las kyi dbang mos sgrom bu gtad pa'i tshe: zhing skyong gnas nyul srung mas khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bsam yas mchims phu'i gnas mchog tu: padma 'byung gnas mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal gnyis: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: dbang phyug ging sman sde brgyad khas blangs bzhin: gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sbas gnas chen po padma bkod pa ru: gter bdag gling pa gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro gnyis: zil gnon bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes tshe: gter bdag dam tshig srung mas khas blangs bzhin:

gtor ma bzhes la tha tshig dran par mdzod: om̐ badzra kro ti shwa ri sa ma ya bhakṣa si bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: bod khams skyong ba'i brtan ma bcu gnyis ni: bdud mo gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi bzhi ni: lhab lhub rgyan dang dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: glu len bro rdung g.yer kha si li li: 'dir gshegs brgyan pa'i gtor ma 'di bzhes la: gsang sngags gnyan gyi mel tshe mdzad du gsol: om̐ badzra pra mo ha ni hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ i daṃ bha lingta kha kha khā hi: de nas dngos grub blangs shing dbang bskur ba ni: bum pa thogs la: hūm̐: bum pa rnam dag chos dbyings gzhal yas khang : nang du bka' brgyad gsang ba'i lha tshogs bzhugs: dbang bskur sku yi dkyil 'khor la gnas shog: om̐ badzra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas bhandha thogs nas: hūm̐: bhandha lhun grub longs sku'i rtsal snang rdzogs: dam tshig mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'khor los sgyur: dbang bskur gsung gi dkyil 'khor la gnas shog: om̐ badzra wākka a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor thogs nas: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor gtso bo gsang ba zil gnon lha: sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs dang gnyis su med: dbang bskur thugs kyi dkyil 'khor la gnas shog: om̐ badzra tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas gtor ma dang sku 'bag thogs nas: hūm̐: che mchog sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dang : gnyis med dam rdzas dngos grub gtor ma yi: dbang bskur thams cad yongs rdzogs thob par shog: om̐ badzra sa ma ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: de nas dngos grub rol ba ni: hūm̐: bde chen mkha' dbyings zag med nam mkha'i gter: tshe chos zas nor snyan grags mnga' thang stobs: deng 'dir skal ldan bdag gis thob gyur cig: om̐ sarba siddhi pha la hūm̐: de nas bkra shis brjod brtan pa'i me tog 'thor: tshe 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: rig 'dzin 'dus par dkyil 'khor rgya mtshos bskor:

mgyogs ma sgo skyong mda' dar bum pa 'dzin: snang srid tshe bsod bcud bsdus bdag la stims: om̐ badzra gu ru ā yurdzñā na hrīḥ zhes dbang dang tshe sgrub bya: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dgra sri bkug cing : rta bro ni: hūm̐: che mchog buddha thod phreng rtsal: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i bro brdungs te: tshad med bzhi yi phur bu bsgrubs: btab pas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol: mnan no ru tra ma ldang cig: om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: satwaṃ bha ya nan: de nas gtor gzhong yar bslangs la me tog 'thor: bzod par gsol ba ni: hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: phyi nang gsang ba'i dam tshig 'gal ba dang : ma 'byor nyams dang lhag chad 'khrul pa'i tshogs: mthol zhing bshags la mi sgrib tshangs par stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: zhes yig brgya bzlas shing bzod gsol bya: chad lhag bkang : de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor mtha' nas mi dmigs dbus su yal: yum rnams yab thim yab yang hūm̐ la bsdu: hūm̐ yig gyen ldog nā da stong pa'i dbyings: skye 'gag mtha' bral mi dmigs a la bzhag: aḥ.aḥ.āḥ

de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ bsngo bya ka dag bsngo byed ye nas stong : bsngo yul sangs rgyas sems can kun rgyu gcig: bsngo ba'i dngos po smra bsam brjod las 'das: mtha' yas sems can rang ngo shes phyir bsngo: smon lam ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor zab mo gnyan gyi dal bzung nas: tshe rabs 'bral med yi dam lhar 'byung zhing : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i go 'phang myur thob ste: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su skye bar shog: ces dmigs med gsal stong ngang du thun cig bzhag: de nas bkra shis brjod pa ni: hūm̐: chos longs sprul gsum zhi khro 'dus pa yi: dkyil 'khor gnyan dang nam yang mi 'bral zhing : tshogs gnyis mthar phyin don gnyis lhun grub nas: phun tshogs yar zla ltar rgyas bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing bden tshig brjod: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa yin na rgyas pa ltar: rang nyid sgrub pa gzhung lugs 'di nyid kyis 'thus so: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgya gar slob dpon rig 'dzin pad 'byung ngas: yang snying zab pa shog dril mgul khug ma: gsang ba zil gnon sgrub pa'i mthar thug bzhag: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal mi brjed gzungs kyis zungs: rin chen rlung gis shog ser ngos su bris: brda yi ri mo shwa na ma mo'i lugs: rgyas thob rin chen gser gyi sgrom bur chugs: shar lho padma sbas pa'i lung gi cha: mi nub gsang rgya brtan pa'i klu la bcol: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: dus dang sa rtags lung bstan dus bab tshe: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa'i ming la sprod: bka' yi rgya 'di las kyi mgon pos srungs: skal ngan bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: sngon sbyang las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas yul nas lcags byi lor gdan drangs shing : gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ro:

sarba maṅga laṃ// // ca) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: las byang khro bo 'dus pa dgos 'dod kun 'byung bzhugs so: zhi khro 'dus pa'i gtso bo bde gshegs sgrub pa bka' brgyad la phyag 'tshal lo: e ma nyon dang ye shes rje 'bangs grogs: snying gi byang bu zab khyad gdams pa yi: dkyil 'khor 'dus pa sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi: yang theg 'dus pa bsgrub pa'i las rim dang : rgyud dang cha lag kha skong la sogs pa: gcig tu bsgril ba'i khyad chos gdams pa bstan: dbyangs can lha mo mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: mi brjed brda yi ri mo shog ser gzugs: 'dod rgu 'byung ba rin chen brda sgrom bskyil: rgya rim bdun gyis mi shigs 'khor los sgyur: padma bdag gis lung bstan padma'i yul: padma'i ming la 'phrad par mtshams sbyar te: klu bdud mgo dgu bya ra tha bsgrags nas: rba rlabs phyur ba'i klong du gnas bca' zhing : gdong can bka' yi gnas su gdam pa'i yul: ma 'ongs yang mtha' sum cu kha dar nas: nyi shu 'byung ba'i mgo bo la lcogs tshe: da lta'i gnubs ston buddha dzñā na khyod: phyi ma o rgyan gter bdag gling bzung dus: snying thig bka' brgyad 'di dang 'phrad par shog: sprod cig bdud mgon drag po seng gdong rgya: gnod sbyin bzhi dang ma gza' shan pa bdun: bka' skyong las kyi ma mor gnyer gtad rgya: dam nyams bdud rigs lag tu ma shor rgya: las 'phro smon lam can la sprod cig rgya: sa ma ya: zhi khro 'dus pa bka' brgyad chen mo'i: bsgrub pa'i rim pa ni: dang po bkra shis dge ba'i ri'am: byin gyis brlabs shing mdzes pa'i yul: rab ltar gangs ri dang mtsho chen 'khyil pa'i gling : skyed mo'i nags tshal lam: sman ljongs lung pa nyams rtogs skye ba'i rang byung phug pa sogs: mi rgod dang gcan gzan ma rungs pa'i rigs: dgra dang 'du 'dzi las dben pa'i gnas su: mchod rdzas sogs gzhung dang mthun par bya ste:

sgrub pa po kha shar du gyu zhing bde ba'i gdan la 'dug ste: sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa ran par bya: de yang thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i las rim ste: dang po skyabs yul gyi rim pa ni: na mo hūm̐: hoḥ 'das dang ma byon da ltar yi: sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs zhing la: rtag par bdag cag skyabs mchis kyis: 'gro kun bde ldan lam gnas shog: gnyis pa rgyud smin par bya ba sems bskyed ni: hoḥ 'khor 'das bral ba'i gshis lugs la: ka dag zang thal 'od zer gyis: ma rig 'khrul ba'i mun pa bsal: ye grol chen por sems bskyed do: gsum pa yan lag bdun pa ni: hūm̐: kun bzang klong yangs dkyil 'khor nas: cho 'phrul longs sku'i zhi khro rnams: dran rdzogs wal gyis lhang nger gshegs: skyon bral padma'i gdan la bzhugs: nyag gcig sprul skur phyag 'tshal lo: tshogs drug rang grol mchod pa bzhes: bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i sgrib pa bshags: ye grol chen po khyed la bstod: tshogs gnyis mthar phyin chen por bsngo: smon lam kun khyab dbyings gnas shog: bzhi pa bgegs bskrad pa ni: bgegs gtor chu gtsang gis bran zhing yig 'bru gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs nas: 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐ mdzad phyag rgya bya: hūm̐: che mchog khro rgyal stobs 'dus thugs ka nas: las kyi pho nya 'gugs byed glog ltar 'phros: dkyil 'khor sgrub la mi dbang bgegs kyi rigs: gtor ma len phyir gnas 'dir myur du mchis: om̐ shrī he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐: gnod byed dam sri 'byung po dza dzaḥ zhes bsngo zhing tshims par bskyed de: rang nyid khro bo'i nga rgyal dang bcas nas thun brdeg cing : hūm̐: bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sku: zhi rgyas dbang drag phrin las rdzogs: bdun brgya nyer lngas 'bar zhing sreg: gzi brjid glog dmar chi li li: drag sngags 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: nyams 'gyur me char spungs se spung :

dkyil 'khor khro bo'i pho brang du: glags lta'i gdon bgegs mi gnas par: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: mtshon cha drag po thog ltar 'bebs: mgo lus tshal pa phye mar gtong : rdul du brlag par gdon mi za: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: om̐ shrī he ru ka hūm̐ hūm̐ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ ces bskrad cing phyi rol du bskyal: bdag nyid che mchog thugs ka nas mtshams gcod khro bo bcu la: sprul pa'i phra thabs dang bcas pas 'byung ba'i rang bzhin du gsal ba'i gur khang cis kyang mi shigs par bsgom zhing : hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal thugs ka nas: mtshams gcod sprul pa'i khro bcu spros: gzi brjid chos dbyings 'od stong 'khyil: phyag mtshan pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: hūm̐: steng nas mtshams gcod khro chen hūm̐ ka ra: sgra 'byin sbyor zhing phag dang rmigs bu 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: steng phyogs dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta hūm̐ ka ra steng gi gnod byed gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar nas mtshams gcod khro chen rnam par rgyal: snyems ma sbyor zhing stag dang bya rgod 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: shar gyi dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta bi dza ya hūm̐: shar gyi gnod byed ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho nas mtshams gcod khro chen gshin rje'i gshed: dur khrod sbyor zhing shwa ba 'ug pa 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: lho yi dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta ya mānta ta ka hūm̐: lho yi gnod byed pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nub nas mtshams gcod khro chen rta mgrin rgyal: gtum mo sbyor zhing byi la pu shud 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: nub kyi dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig:

om̐ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hūm̐: nub kyi dgra bgegs 'byung po hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang nas mtshams gcod khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil: rlung 'byin sbyor zhing seṅge pha waṃ 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: byang gi dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li hūm̐: byang gi gnod byed 'byung po tshindha tshindha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar lho'i mtshams gcod khro chen dbyug sngon rgyal: sder mo sbyor zhing sprul pa byang g.yag 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: shar lho dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra nī la daṇḍa hūm̐: shar lho'i gnod byed da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho nub mtshams gcod khro chen mi g.yo mgon: gtun khung 'khyud cing gzig dang khwa ta 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: lho nub dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta a tsa le hūm̐: lho nub kyi gnod byed bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nub byang mtshams gcod khro chen 'dod pa'i rgyal: mda' snyen sbyor zhing sprul pa khra spyang 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: nub byang dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta a pa rā dzi ta hūm̐: nub byang gi gnod byed hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang shar mtshams gcod khro chen rnam par rgyal: gsod byed sbyor zhing dom dang sre mong 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: byang shar dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig: om̐ badzra kro ta trai lokya bi dza ya hūm̐: byang shar gyi gnod byed bhindha bhindha hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: 'og nas mtshams gcod khro chen stobs po che: bskul byed sbyor zhing dred dang byi la 'gyed: yang sprul pho nya bka' yi las byed rnams: 'og gi dgra bgegs 'byung po mtshams chod cig:

om̐ badzra kro ta ma hā bā la hūm̐: 'og gi gnod byed pho ṭa pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ de'i phyi rol du gur khang dgu bsgom pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ ye shes thugs las srung ba'i gur khang 'phros: dang po khro chen ye shes 'bar ba'i gur: de yi phyi rol rdo rje rgya gram gur: de yi phyi rol ral gri bsnol ma'i gur: de yi phyi rol gsod byed gri gug gur: de yi phyi rol gcod byed spu gri'i gur: de yi phyi rol 'joms byed tri shul gur: de yi phyi rol gnam lcags so 'thab gur: de yi phyi rol me rlung stobs ldan gur: de yi phyi rol khro chu'i pha lam gur: de yi phyi rol khro bo phyir gzigs gur: de yi phyi rol ri rab phur pa'i gur: de yi phyi rol dug rlangs reg gcod gur: de yi phyi rol stong nyid chos dbyings gur: bcu gsum mi shigs khro chu'i pha lam ltar: bsrung mtshams med pa'i gzhal yas chen po gyur: om̐ badzra kro ta shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ e tiṣṭha rakṣa rakṣa bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐ bhrūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhrūm̐ badzra rakṣa bhrūm̐: de nas brda sgo dbye ba ni: ye nas snod bcud thams cad buddha'i zhing khams yin pa lhan skyes kyi rang ngo 'phrod phyir rig pa ye shes kyi brda sgo phye ba ni: hūm̐: kun nas klong yangs buddha'i zhing : ma rtogs 'dzin pa'i mun bsal nas: nga bdag 'khrul pa'i sgo gcod phyir: ye shes rig pa'i 'char sgo phyes: bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe a tsand+ra: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: dzñā na pañtsa pra be sha ya phaṭḥ de nas ye shes lnga'i sgo phye zhing rang lus ye nas kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams kyi dkyil 'khor yin par thag chod phyir lta ba'i lha zhal mjal ba ni: hūm̐: kun bzang khyab brdal rol pa las: ye shes lta ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: rang gsal chen po'i zhal mjal phyir:

nyag gcig de la brda phyag 'tshal: om̐ badzra bha ru la bhrūm̐ pra be sha ya na mo hūm̐: brda bshags 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ye nas 'khor 'das gnyis su med: ma rtogs gzung 'dzin sgrib pas rmongs: bag med kha yan 'khor bar 'khyams: da nas rang byung chen por bshags: om̐ badzra sa ma ya shuddhe āḥ de nas brda mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: rtog med shes pa'i snod mchog tu: blo 'das bde stong mchod pas bkang : kun rig zang thal dgyes phyir 'bul: ro gcig rtog bral pū dza hoḥ om̐ badzra he ru ka siddhi pū dza hoḥ brda bstod bya ba ni: hūm̐: brdal khyab kun bzang zhi khro'i lha: rtsal snang ma 'gags tshom bur shar: snod bcud ye shes sgyu ma'i ngang : kun mdzad dbang por brdas bstod do: om̐ he ru ka pra ti pū dza hoḥ dam bca' zhing dkyil 'khor bzung ba ni: hoḥ bla ma che mchog yi dam lha: mkha' 'gro ma sring bsgrub pa'i dal: ye nas tshe rabs bdag gis bsgrubs: phyin chad mi gtong brtan por bzung : om̐ badzra he ru ka bo dhi tsitta sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: de nas byin dbab pa ni: rol mo dbyangs dang bcas shing spos sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang : mtshan ldan gyi rig ma rgyan gyis spras te dkyil 'khor gyi mtha' bskor ging 'cham: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings pho brang nas: khyab brdal klong dgu'i mdzod gling rdol: kun bzang yab yum byin phob cig: tsitta longs sku'i pho brang nas: brda don rtsal lnga'i 'od zer shar: las kyi dbang mos byin phob cig: shar phyogs dur khrod bsil tshal nas: yang dag thugs kyi dngos grub brnyes: hūm̐ chen ka ras byin phob cig: lho phyogs dur khrod sku la rdzogs: 'jam dpal sku yi dngos grub brnyes: mañdzu shrīs byin phob cig: nub phyogs dur khrod laṅka brtsegs: padma gsung gi dngos grub brnyes: nā gardzu nas byin phob cig: byang phyogs dur khrod padma brtsegs: phrin las phur pa'i dngos grub brnyes:

pra bha hastīs byin phob cig: shar lho dur khrod lhun grub gter: bdud rtsi yon tan dngos grub brnyes: bi ma mi tras byin phob cig: lho nub dur khrod gsang chen rol: rbod gtong ma mo'i dngos grub brnyes: dha na saṃ skṛs byin phob cig: nub byang dur khrod he chen brdal: 'jig rten mchod bstod dngos grub brnyes: rombu gu hyas byin phob cig: byang shar dur khrod 'jig rten brtsegs: drag sngags dmod pa'i dngos grub brnyes: shāntiṃ garbhas byin phob cig: dbus phyogs dur khrod bde byed brtsegs: yongs rdzogs 'dus pa'i dngos grub brnyes: au ḍī ya nas byin phob cig: ke'u ri gsang ba'i dur khrod nas: brda bzhi mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod brnyes: go byi dhe was byin phob cig: yongs rdzogs dpal gyi mchims phu ru: bka' bab lung gi dngos grub brnyes: rje 'bangs nyer lngas byin phob cig: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : che mchog 'dus pa'i tshom bu dgu: dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mnga' bdag rnams: gnas 'dir byin chen myur du phob: dbang chen rigs kyis dbang bskur la: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ

zhes byin dbab cing dkyil 'khor brtan par bya ba'i phyir me tog 'thor: skabs 'dir tshig bdun brjod kyang rung : sa ma ya: de nas mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: phyi mchod rnam lnga dbang po mdangs ldan can: yid 'phrog lha mo brda 'gros gar ma gzugs: 'phan dar bla bre rgyan tshogs ba dan 'phyangs: dpag med bkod pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur: om̐ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra nai wi dye āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra rū pa āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra gandhe āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra rā sa āḥhūm̐: om̐ badzra sparshe āḥhūm̐: zhes byin gyis brlabs shing spel: de nas nang gi mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: rang byung rlung me keng rus thab kyi khar: mchog chen mtshan ldan chos nyid bhandha ru: shar lho nub byang dbus lnga rim pa bzhin: hūm̐ bhrūm̐ om̐ dzaṃ kham̐ na dha ha sha: zhu ba las byung dam tshig bdud rtsi ni: byang sems dri chen sha chen rakta dang : dri chu mi sha rta sha ba glang sha: khyi sha la sogs rdzas chen rnam pa dgu: legs par sbyong byed dam tshig yi ge bcu: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī ā yig rnam pa lnga: mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐ lnga phyogs bcur mtshan: rim bzhin sbyong byed yi ge 'bru gsum 'phros: yam̐ las rlung byung g.yo byed ba dan bskyod: ram̐ las me byung dngos 'dzin bag chags bsregs: kham̐ las chu byung a 'thas 'dzin pa bkrus: om̐ las 'od 'phros sku yi dam tshig bskul: āḥlas zer 'gyed gsung gi bdud rtsi khol: hūm̐ las rgyud byung rigs lnga yab yum zhu: hrī las srub skyed mchod pa'i lha mo 'phros: trām̐ las gar sgyur dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mchod: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ lan bdun nam gsum gyis sbyang : de nas rakta sbyang ba ni:

hūm̐: gru gsum zla gam dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du: bhandha lcang lo ral pa'i ba dan can: rgya khyon dpag tshad chos dbyings blo dang ldan: hūm̐: mkha' dbyings bzang mo'i mu kha chos 'byung dbus: he ru ka pa las kyi rdo rje dgyes: ro ma'i klong nas rlabs chen drag tu g.yos: bhandhar bskyil bas rakta chi li li: ra las byung ba'i lha mo'i gri gug gis: bsrub cing dkrugs pas bde chen raktar gyur: hūm̐: ma hā rakta mchog chen mi yi khrag: ghu na rakta dbyings phyug gsang ba'i khrag: padma rakta rigs bzang rtsa yi khrag: mu la rakta 'dod sred sbyor ba'i khrag: endza rakta rgyud drug bsgral ba'i khrag: du na rakta dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag: 'bri mog rgya skag la sogs 'byung ba'i khrag: ye nas 'khor 'das gnyis med sbyor ba yi: rakta rba klong phyogs bcur 'phro zhing mchod: bde gshegs bsgrub pa'i lha tshogs dgyes par bskyed: om̐ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍal hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis dkrug: de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: nyi zla yangs pa'i 'khor 'das gtor gzhong du: snod bcud dag pa'i rigs drug bha ling bshams: gling bzhi ri rab bye ba'i gtor kyus bskor: gsal stong chos dbyings 'od gsal brgyan btags pas: dam rdzas ye grol chen por dgyes par bskyed: hūm̐: kun gzhi klong yangs chos nyid bhandha ru: rang shar gnas lugs rig pa'i gtor ma bshams: tshogs drug sgrib med sa le'i gtor kyus bskor: mngon rdzogs lug rgyud thig le'i rgyan btags pas: kun gzhi gtor ma ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐: khyab brdal klong yangs bem shun gtor gzhong du: sha khrag klad rus dwangs lnga'i gtor ma bshams: 'byung lnga rtogs grol shes pa'i gtor kyus bskor: dbang po sgo dgu'i 'khor lo'i rgyan btags pas: gzugs phung gtor ma ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: hūm̐: phyi nang snod bcud gsal ba'i gtor ma dang :

longs spyod rgya mtsho dgyes pa'i bha ling rnams: gtor mchod srung ba'i khro bos byin brlabs pas: zad med nam mkha' mdzod kyi gtor mar gyur: om̐ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes lan bdun nam gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: de nas ḍā ma ru dang dril bu rdo rje rnams byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ badzra ḍā ma ru he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pas: hūm̐: thod pa ltag sprod las kyi rtags rgya can: zhing chen zhing chung bsgral ba'i pags pas g.yogs: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'bod pa'i rdzas su gyur: om̐ mu hrī ghu land+ra badzra hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shes rab sgra ldan dkyil 'khor dbyings kyis phyug: bla med rgya mtsho'i rgyud mchog mnyes mdzad ma: gsung dbyangs drug cus 'gro ba 'dren mdzad shog: ces pas byin gyis brlab: de nas rdo rje byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ badzra tsakra ya he ru ka na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: thabs mchog mi shigs brtan mdzad phyir: rdo rje 'bar ba 'khor los sgyur: zung nas rab tu 'brel gyur cig: ces pas byin gyis brlab: de nas rnga dang rnga lcag byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ dharma dhā tu garbhe āḥhūm̐ phaṭḥ ā gsung gi dbang phyug kun bzang mo: hūm̐ chos dbyings rang sgra stong khams sgrog: om̐ kun tu bzang gis 'khor los bskul: zhes pas byin gyis brlab: de nas bgrang phreng byin gyis brlab pa ni: om̐ me kha li badzra trām̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: rang sngags sgra ldan rin chen phreng : spro bsdu 'gugs stim 'dren pa'i phyir: 'od zer rnam lnga'i phreng bar gyur: ces byin gyis brlab: de nas rtsa khams yi dam lha ru ngo sprad cing byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: kun bzang che mchog dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor rnams: ye nas rang byung rang la gnas pa'i phyir: rang gsal ma bcos rig pa chos dbyings klong : zhi dang khro bo'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang :

blo rtog ma rig a 'thas kun gsal phyir: ye shes pho brang dkyil 'khor gnas 'dir gshegs: ye nas rang gsal dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: zang thal 'dzin med ngang la phyag 'tshal bstod: dug lnga ma spangs rang grol mchod pa 'bul: sku gsum lhun grub rje la bdag yi rang : khregs chod lta ba'i rgyud la chos 'khor bskor: dbang chen 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor byin chen phob: sku yi dbang mchog ye shes 'khor los bskur: gsung gi dbang mchog bde stong 'khor los bskur: thugs kyi dbang mchog gsal stong 'khor los bskur: yon tan dbang mchog lhun grub 'khor los bskur: phrin las dbang mchog klong yangs 'khor los bskur: dkyil 'khor rdzas la bkrag mdangs gzi brjid phob: mchod rdzas rgya mtshor ro bcud rnam lnga spel: 'dir 'dus skal ldan chos dbyings brda ru khrol: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin dam tshig rgyun bzhin bskul: tshe rabs kun tu dkyil 'khor la gnas shog: om̐ shrī he ru ka ghu na hrī ta dzñā na badzra tsitta sa ma ya swā hā: a be sha ya phaiṃ phaiṃ dzaḥdzaḥ zhes byin dbab cing ye nas rang rgyud bsre bar bya'o: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas 'khor thams cad ye nas rang byung du yod par thag chod pa'i gshis lugs ngang la rgyu dang mtshan nyid rab tu dbye ba'i phyir: dang po ting 'dzin rnam gsum las: khyab pa gzhi'i ting nge 'dzin ni: hoḥ kun gzhi ma bcos spros dang bral: ye nas rang byung brjod med klong : 'khor 'das bya ba'i mtshan ma stong : mtha' dbus 'dzin khyon blo las 'das: om̐ ma hā shū n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa ātma ko3 haṃ: gnyis pa gsal ba lam gyi ting nge 'dzin ni: hoḥ khyab brdal chen po'i rol rtsal las: gsal snang ngo bo lam gyis shar: bdag gzhan 'dzin pa'i rgyu 'byung ba: rang byung rig pa'i ri mor grub: om̐ badzra dzñā na swa bhā satwaṃ: gsum pa rgyu 'byung 'bras bu'i ting nge 'dzin ni:

hūm̐: rgyu 'byung ngang la rim par chags: kun rgyu spros pa'i yi ge hūm̐: 'byung lnga la sogs rim pa bzhi: ma bsgoms gsal rdzogs so sor shar: om̐ badzra tsitta sa ma ho hūm̐: de nas 'byung ba rim brtsegs ni: hūm̐ bhrūm̐ dzñā na badzra swa bhā satwaṃ: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: hūm̐: e las chos 'byung nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings: yam̐ las rlung ri rgya gram 'khor lo chags: ram̐ las me ri kha dog sna lnga 'bar: kham̐ las rgya mtsho rba rlabs phyogs bcur bskyod: sum̐ las dbang chen sa gzhir lcags ris bskor: keṃ las rus pa'i ri rab bang rim ldan: bhrūm̐ las dur khrod pho brang gzhal yas khang : om̐ badzra hūm̐ dzñā na maṇḍa la: e yam̐ ram̐ kham̐ sum̐ keṃ bhrūm̐: a tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ma sūrya maṇḍa la: paṃ padma maṇḍa la: ru tra kro ti ti ra baṃ: hūm̐ pha ra na phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: raṃ sa ra ṇa phaṭḥ yaṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: om̐ badzra he ru ka ātma ko3 haṃ: de nas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa ni: om̐ swa bhā w stong pa'i ngang las snod bcud kyi chos thams cad bdag med pa'i rang bzhin stong par sbyangs: de'i ngang las ma bcos lhun grub ye nas gsal ba'i rang bzhin nam mkha' e mthing nag 'bar ba: chos nyid kyi rang sgra dang bcas pa: de la kun tu rgyu ba'i rig pa ma 'gags pa'i rtsal las lam 'gags med du shar ba'i: 'gyu ba dang po gnyis su 'dzin pa'i rtog pa phra mo de la: 'gyu byed kyi rlung ltar bskal pa ye nas srog 'dzin byed pa de: rig dang ma rig tu g.yos pas: bsnol thabs rgya gram btegs pa: de'i steng du 'od gsal sgong bu dmar po tsha ba'i ngad ldan can rlung gis g.yos pa: bskal pa'i me ri kha dog lnga ldan 'bar ba: de'i steng du kham̐ las byung ba'i sgong bu bsil ba'i rang bzhin can: de me yis shugs las zhu ba'i chu yi rba rlabs 'phyo zhing khol bas: rakta ltar dmar ba: de'i rba las lbu ba shin tu 'khrigs pa gcig tu gyur pa las:
