keṃ zhes pa'i ri rab bskal pa'i khyon dang mnyam pa: de'i snyigs ma dang bar pa gnyis las: sum̐ zhes pa'i dbang chen sa gzhi gser ri lcags ri rol mtsho bdun phrag dang ldan pa: de'i steng du 'dzin khyon chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa: mi shigs rdo rje'i rgya gram chen po: shar gyi rwa dkar la gnam lcags ur mo las grub pa: lho'i rwa ser la pha lam khro chur grub pa: nub kyi rwa dmar la mi shigs khro lum gha rir grub pa: byang gi rwa ljang la sra mkhregs gnam lcags 'khyugs mor grub pa: de'i lte bar yi ge hūm̐ dang bhrūm̐ yongs su gyur pa las: che mchog sprul pa'i pho brang chen po: gzhal yas mtha' las 'das pa: gru bzhi sgo bzhi gling bzhi'i rang bzhin steng : phyi nang gsum dang ldan pa: dbus kyi dang po yi ge bhrūm̐ dmar smug yongs su gyur pa las: rnam shes rtog pa'i 'char sgo zla gam dmar gsal 'od kyi sgong bu chen po rgyu rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa sgo gcig pa: chos sku nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong chen po phyi nang zang thal can: bkra shis rtags brgyad: rgyal srid sna bdun gyis spras pa: de'i steng gi bang rim chos 'khor nyi zla rim pa bzhin 'od kyi sgong bu gsal byed rtsa'i sgron me dag gis mtshan pa nang thams cad rgyan dar dang 'phan 'phyang du mas spras pa: lte ba zhi ba'i gdan nyi zla dang padma dmar po: 'dab ma bzhi pa: de'i phyi rol 'dab ma brgyad la: shar du me long ye shes: lho ru mnyam nyid ye shes: nub tu sor rtogs ye shes: byang du bya grub ye shes: shar lhor stong nyid ye shes: lho nub 'da' ka ye shes: nub byang kun rtogs ye shes: byang shar nan tan ye shes: de dag tshom bu rnams kyang 'od lnga'i drwa ba mu khyud rtsibs bzhi dang ldan pa'o: zhes gzhal yas khang zla gam sgo gcig pa'i rang bzhin chos sku'i klong : gnyis pa longs sku'i gzhal yas bskyed pa ni: hūm̐:

de'i phyi rol ye shes lnga las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang chen po gru bzhi sgo bzhi pa: mtshan nyid dang ldan pa dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga te: de la bhandha skam rlon gyi kha bad dang ldan cing : khro chu khol ma'i gzer gyis bsdams pa: rmang thams cad pha lam las grub pa: lha chen brgyad kyi ka ba dang : klu chen brgyad kyi gdung ma bris pa: gza' chen brgyad kyi za ram dang : rgyu skar rnams kyi dral lcam btab cing : zhing chen pags pa thog steng g.yogs pa: nyi ma dang zla ba'i ka zhu la g.yu 'brug gis ka ba brgyan pa: chu srin gyis ka gdan byas shing nang gi gzhi thams cad smug nag me ri dang rakta'i zhal bu 'khyil ba: mi lpags skam rlon gyi bla bre dang don snying lnga yi 'phan 'phyangs pa: nang logs thams cad rgyu ma'i lda ldi ris bris pa: rin po che'i pha gu la rus pa'i rgyan du ma dang ldan pa: drwa ba'i klong thams cad bskal pa'i mun nag 'khrigs shing : de'i nang nas gzugs med kyis rngam sgra dang 'o dod ldir ba: rgyu ma dang rgyud pas drwa ba byas shing dril bu dang rnga yab 'phan rtse gsum pas brgyan pa: mi'i mkhal ma dang mchin pas pho rdo byas shing : g.yer kha'i sgra du ma dang ldan pa: rlung ras sngon po'i shar bu la mi lpags dang stag lpags sbrul nag gi rgyan 'phyang lhab lhub bskyod pa: mda' yab dkar po zla gam las grub pa'i gzhi la: shel gyi pu shu dang dung gi rgyangs grags: byi ru'i gandho la: g.yu'i he gha che byas shing mchod rten grangs med dang ldan pa: phyogs bzhi'i ka ba brgyad ni: las kyi gshin rje brgyad la byas shing : gdung ma rnams phyogs skyong bcu la phub pa: khro bo'i zhu chen: khro mo'i zhu chung : keng rus kyi ka rgyan: klu bdud pho mos ka gdan byas pa: de'i g.yas g.yon gdong rnams su zhing skyong pho mo bye ba 'phros pa: shar gyi ka rgyan gnyis seṅge'i pags pa la byas pa:

lho yi ka rgyan gnyis g.yu 'brug gi pags pa la byas pa: nub kyi ka rgyan gnyis chu srin gyi pags pa la byas pa: byang gi ka rgyan gnyis rgya stag gi pags pa la byas pa: rta babs rnams rim bzhin du las kyi ma mo'i bzhin la byas pa: klong gur chen po rnam rgyal khang bzang dgu dang ldan pa: de la ma mo chen mo kau rī ma 'gyu ba: chos 'khor bcu gsum la khro bo dang khro mo rnams kyis rang sgra sgrog pa: za ram rnams la ā li dang kā li'i dbyangs dang ldan pa: zla ba dang nyi ma nor bu rnams: lha'i bu dang bu mo mang pos mchod pa sna tshogs thogs te zlos gar rtse ba: chos 'khor gyi g.yas g.yon du: rnam shes kyi ri dwags pho mo gnyis: ye shes kyi khyung gnyis: rig pa'i rma bya gnyis: tshogs drug gi mi gcer bu dang brgyad de: gang shar chos kyi sgra nyan pa'o: gzhal yas kyi steng thams cad mi lpags kyi rgyal mtshan la thod pa'i tog gis spras pa: keng rus gar bsgyur zhing rgyan du mas spras pa: de'i nang gi bar khyams rnams la rtsal snang longs sku'i tshom bu brgyad de: re re la nyi ma dang zla ba'i gdan: de'i steng du: shar du dbang po dang mtha' yas: lhor tshangs pa dang 'jog po: nub tu dbang phyug dang dung skyong : byang du khyab 'jug dang stobs rgyu: shar lhor bhri gi ri ti dang padma chen po: lho nub tu dga' byed dbang phyug dang hu mun ta: nub byang du tshogs kyi bdag po dang rig ldan: byang shar du dkar ti ka dang bā su te lha klu rnams bsnol ba: de'i steng du seṅge dang stag dang : gzig dang dom dang glang po che dang ma he dang chu srin dang sbrul la sogs te shin tu khro ba'i gdan: de'i steng du gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i khri'o:

gsum pa rtsal rdzogs khro bo'i pho brang ni: hoḥ snod bcud thams cad drag po e yi klong yangs 'byung lnga'i rang bzhin du 'khrugs pa: yam̐ las bskal pa'i rlung nag bu yug 'tshub cing spu gri'i 'khor lo ltar chags pa: de'i steng du ram̐ las bskal pa'i me ri smug nag rab tu 'bar ba: de'i steng du kham̐ las rakta'i rba klong dmar nag tu g.yo ba: de'i steng du: sum̐ las bam ro gsar rnying bskal pa'i rdul ltar nyil ba: de'i steng du: keṃ las dur khrod kyi pho brang rdza ltar nyil ba: de'i steng du: las kyi gshin rje lag brgyad dang mig dgu: 'chi bdag dang 'dzin byed chen po te yongs su gyur pa'i ngo bo chu srin kha nas rdo rje'i rwa rnams mi shigs par 'dzin pa: de'i dbus kyi gzhal yas kyi phyi rol du: khro bo'i pho brang chen po gzhi thams cad rdo rje pha lam dang gnam lcags ur mo las grub pa: rmang thams cad khro chu khol ma las grub pa: srin po pho mo'i thod pa skam rlon la mig nas me 'bar zhing kha nas khrag skyug pa: sna nas 'brug sgra ldir ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa: gru bzhi sgo bzhi dur khrod kyi pho brang can: gshin rje brgyad kyi ka ba: ma mo brgyad kyi gdung ma: gnod sbyin brgyad kyi zhu lam: gza' rgod brgyad kyi za ram: ging chen brgyad kyi thog g.yogs: dam sri brgyad kyi ka gdan dang : g.yu 'brug brgyad kyi gyen skyes bsgrengs pa: nang thams cad lha brgyad kyi pags pa dang : klu brgyad kyi tsittas spras shing khrag zhag gi rba rlabs 'phyo ba: 'dod snam la khro mo 'bum gyis rol rtsad ling ba: khro chu pha wang dmar por brtsegs pa: mun nag 'jigs pa'i klong nas shan pa 'bum gyis gar stabs bsgyur zhing chu srin gyi kha nas mi mgo skam rlon gyi drwa ba 'phyangs pa: zhing chen smug po'i shar bu la: dur bya'i mgo dang mi'i lag pa rkang pa dang : thod rlon skra'i ba dan nag po dril bus brgyan pa 'phyangs pa:

keng rus dkar nag gi mda' yab la: ha ha rgod pa'i mi mgo dang rta mgo sna tshogs kyi mig nas sbrul nag 'khyugs pa: de'i zur bzhi'i seṅge'i kha nas dril bu g.yer kha me long gis spras pa: phyi'i ka ba bzhi gnyis thams cad rgyal chen sde bzhi la byas shing : phyogs skyong bcu'i gdung ma bres pa: nyi zla'i zhu chen la sbrul nag gi za ram btab pa: ka rgyan rnams la dpal mgon bdun cus brgyan pa: sgo zur gyi mun nag la bya sha zan stong 'jums pa: mthongs skar la dge sdig 'gyed pa'i lha dang bdud 'phros pa: rta babs bcu gsum dang ldan pa: de la dur khrod kyi bkod pas brgyan cing : thod skam gyis spel ba'o: chos 'khor rnams la rus pa'i gha dha ha mang pos spras shing : za ram rnams hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ kyi sgra sgrog pa: zla ba dang nyi ma'i tog gi dkyil 'khor la: he ru ka'i rngam sgra sgrog pa'o: pho brang gi thog mi lpags skam rlon gyi rgyal mtshan bsgrengs shing don snying sna tshogs kyi tog gis spras pas: keng rus kyi shar bu du ma dpyangs pa: chos 'khor gyi phyogs bzhir khyung chen gnyis: seṅge gnyis: rma bya gnyis: g.yu 'brug gnyis te brgyad kyis mdzes pa'o: pho brang de rnams kyi phyi rol du padma'i phreng ba sna lnga dang ldan pa: dur khrod brgyad: mchod rten brgyad: rig 'dzin brgyad: shing brgyad: rnal 'byor brgyad: chu brgyad: klu brgyad: sprin brgyad: lha brgyad: me brgyad: gza' brgyad: rlung brgyad: rgyu skar brgyad: bam ro brgyad: kau rī ma brgyad gzhan yang bya dang gcan gzan dur phag dug sbrul keng rus ro langs la sogs pa'i dur khrod kyi bkod pa bsam las 'das pa: zla phyed rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor zhing mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi gur khang ste: dgu pa de'i phyi rol du me ri kha dog lnga dang ldan pa'i rwa bas bskor ba'i pho brang chen po ma bcos yongs su rdzogs pa drag po'i klong du gsal ba'o:

de nas gzhal yas dbus kyi lha bskyed pa ni: dang po dbus su che mchog he ru ka'i lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: lha chen yab yum bsnol ba'i khri steng du: ye shes bskal pa'i me 'bar klong yangs dbus: gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ sgra can: skad cig gnas 'gyur dpal chen he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag srid gsum dbyings dang mnyam: nyi shu rtsa gcig zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: spyan mig drug cu rtsa gsum sdang mig 'khyil: sma ra smin ma bskal pa'i me chen 'bar: shangs nas rlung g.yos stong gsum 'jig rten 'ur: dmar ser dbu skra stong khams g.yo zhing bskyod: ral pa'i gseb nas seṅge khyung chen 'phro: drag po'i thod skam keng rus skam rlon brgyan: dmar nag cod pan du ma pu ru ru: sbrul rigs rnam lnga'i chings rgyan nyi li li: g.yas pa nyer gcig rdo rje rtse dgu gsor: g.yon pa nyer gcig dung chen rakta bsnams: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad: zhing chen g.yang gzhi seng glang pags pas g.yogs: khrag zhag thig le thal chen tshom bus brgyan: chu srin stod g.yogs sbrul rigs lhu tshigs dkris: thod rlon do shal stag lpags sham thabs gsol: bco brgyad zhabs rnams gling bzhi ri rab bgrad: bskal pa'i me 'bar smug nag klong du gsal: gtso bor 'khyud pa'i khro mo gnam zhal ma: sku mdog mthing nag zhal dgu rab tu khro: sdang mig rtsa bdun me zer tshwa tshwa khol: shangs rlung 'bud cing ljags 'dril mche ba gtsigs: dmar ser ral pa thod skam phreng bas brgyan: dar nag cod pan rdo rje'i rigs bdag rdzogs: sbrul rigs lnga yi skra chings sma ra 'bar: g.yas g.yon snyan la nyi zla 'bar bas brgyan: g.yas dgu gri gug yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon dgu thod khrag yab kyi zhal du stob: rus pa'i rgyan drug khrag zhag thig le mdzes: yan lag sbrul rgyan thod rlon do shal 'phyangs: gzig sham mdzes shing brkyang bskum 'khril sbyor rol:

che mchog yab yum ye shes klong du gsal: spyi gtsug 'od lnga'i tshom bu nyi zla'i steng : bla ma kun bzang mthing nag zhal gsum pa: zhi ma khro la dbu skra spyi bor bcings: dang po gnyis kyis mnyam bzhag bde bar gsal: tha ma bzhi yis rdo rje bhandha 'dzin: dbyings phyug dkar mo rdo rje bhandha 'khyud: yab yum sku la dar dpyangs ang rag mdzes: rdo rje skyil skrung zung 'jug gnyis med bsgom: de yi spyi bor nā da dkar gsal klong : zla gdan dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' dkar: zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: gsang ba mkha' 'gro dmar mo gri thod 'khyud: zung 'jug skyil krung bde stong ngang la gsal: de yi phyi rol ye shes brgyad rnams su: shar du ye shes he ru ka pa dkar: lho ru gsal stong he ru ka pa ser: nub tu rig stong he ru ka pa dmar: byang du bde stong he ru ka pa ljang : shar lho mngon 'byung he ru ka pa smug: lho nub dran rig he ru ka pa mthing : nub byang lhan skyes he ru ka pa dud: byang shar kun grol he ru ka pa nag: thams cad dbu dgu khro 'jigs 'tsher la rngam: g.yas pa dgu yis gri gug rab 'bar phyar: g.yon pa dgu yis thod khrag dmar zhing stob: dmar ser ral par rigs lnga'i thod skam ldan: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la brgyangs: seng glang stag lpags zhing chen thod rlon phreng : khrag zhag thal chen sbrul rigs yan lag brgyan: zhabs brgyad bgrad cing dor stabs 'gying bag can: tshogs brgyad khro mo rang mdog sku la 'khril: zhal gsum khro 'dzum phyag drug gri thod 'khyud: rus rgyan gzig sham dar dpyangs bde stong ngang : ye shes me dpung gzi 'bar klong du gsal: sgo srung khro bo don gyi he ru kaḥ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug 'bar: g.yas gsum gri gug ral gri gsang rnga ldir: g.yon gsum kha ṭwāṃ thong gshol rgyu zhags 'phen:

sgro gshog ldan zhing dur khrod chas dgus spras: zhabs bzhi dor stabs me dpung klong dgu 'bar: khro mo dmar ser bum pa lcags kyu 'khyud: zung 'jug bde chen 'od klong gsal bar bskyed: de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: pho brang gzhal yas ye shes 'khor lo'i klong : tshom bu 'bar ba zhi khro'i rang mdog ltar: shar phyogs tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: kun bzang mthing nag mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: dbyings phyug dkar mo rdo rje dung dmar 'khyud: rin 'byung ser po rin chen dril bu 'dzin: mi bskyod mthing ka rdo rje dril bu bsnams: rnam snang dkar po 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin: snang mtha' dmar po padma dril bu 'dzin: don grub ljang khu rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: spyan ma mā kī gos dkar sgron ma rnams: phyogs kyi chas brgyan dril bu yab la 'khyud: hūm̐: shar lho'i tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: sa snying dkar po rin chen myu gu 'dzin: nam snying ser po ral gri 'dzin cing mdzes: spyan ras gzigs dbang dmar po padma bsnams: phyag na rdo rje ljang khu rdo rje 'dzin: lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti mas: me tog phreng ba pi waṃ gling bu 'dzin: hūm̐: lho phyogs tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: byams pa dkar po phyag na klu shing 'dzin: sgrib sel dmar po phyag na po ti 'dzin: kun bzang dmar ser phyag na snye ma 'dzin: 'jam dpal ljang khu utpal ral gri 'dzin: bdug spos me tog mar me dri chab mas: spos sgron chu skyes zhun me dung chos 'dzin: hūm̐: lho nub tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: gshin rje mthing kha ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin: rta mgrin dmar po dbyug pa lcags sgrog 'dzin: stobs chen dmar ser rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin: bdud rtsi ljang khu rdo rje ral gri 'dzin: rang rang rigs mthun gri thod yum dang sbyor: hūm̐: nub phyogs tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin:

lha dbang brgya byin dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin: thag bzang sngon po phyag na go cha 'dzin: shāka thub ser po gseg shang par bu 'dzin: seṅge rab brtan mthing ka po ti 'dzin: thub pa kha 'bar dmar po sgrom bu 'dzin: chos kyi rgyal po mthing nag me chu 'dzin: zhi ba'i tshul dgu gzi 'bar klong du gsal: hūm̐: nub byang tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: raksha he ru ka pa smug nag zhal: 'khor lo thod khrag raksha kro ti 'khril: ghu na he ru ka pa ser nag zhal: rin chen thod khrag ghu ya kro ti 'khril: bhi shwa he ru ka pa dmar nag zhal: padma thod khrag bhi shwa kro ti 'khril: yaksha he ru ka pa ljang nag zhal: rgya gram thod khrag yaksha kro ti 'khril: hūm̐: byang phyogs tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: dri za 'dul byed tri shul 'khor lo dkar: me lha 'dul byed me dbal dbyug to dmar: gshin rje 'dul byed dgra satwa thod dbyug mthing : srin po 'dul byed smug nag ral gri zhags: klu rnams 'dul byed padma spu gri dmar: rlung lha 'dul byed rnga yab ba dan sngo: gnod sbyin 'dul byed padma dril bu ljang : dbang ldan 'dul byed rgya gram dril bu mthing : lha rnams 'dul byed sngo skya mda' gzhu 'gengs: sa bdag 'dul byed dud kha thod pa zhags: ya mānta kri dkar po lcags kyu 'dzin: pra nya ta kri ser po zhags pa 'dzin: padma ta kri dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: bighnān ta kri ljang gu dril bu 'dzin: hūm̐: byang shar tshom bu ling tshe'i rim pa bzhin: lce spyang dkar mo seng gdong shel rnga rdung : lce spyang ser mo stag mgo gser rnga rdung : lce spyang dmar mo gzig mgo mchong rnga rdung : lce spyang nag mo dom mgo lcags rnga rdung : lce spyang sngon mo spyang mgo g.yu rnga rdung : lce spyang dmar mo kang mgo bswe rnga rdung : lce spyang khrag mdog bya mgo gsang rnga rdung : lce spyang dmar mo dred mgo khro rnga rdung :

de ltar dkyil 'khor gsang chen 'dus pa yi: lha tshogs zhi dang khro gar bsgyur ba'i tshogs: gsal snang 'ja' tshon ma bcos 'ja' shar bzhin: gdod nas dag pa phyi nang gsang ba yi: tshom bu bzhin du 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: ma yengs yid yul ting 'dzin gsal bar bsgom: om̐ badzra kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phyi'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs zla gam ru tra pho mo'i gdan: bcom ldan che mchog badzra he ru kaḥ thugs kyi bdag nyid sku mdog mthing nag 'bar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal tshom spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdeng : g.yas pa'i dang po rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pas dril bu bhandha lcags sgrog dang : lhag ma klu brgyad tsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : las kyi yum chen kro ti shwa ri mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ gri gug gdeng : g.yon gsum bhan dmar dung khrag yab la stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: hūm̐: phyi nang tshom bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhin: thugs kyi bdag nyid buddha he ru kaḥ smug nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas gsum rdo rje g.yon gsum rgyu zhags 'dzin: buddha kro ti shwa ri gnyis med 'khril: yon tan bdag nyid ratna he ru kaḥ ser nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas gsum rin chen g.yon gsum ri rab 'dzin:

ratna kro ti shwa ṛ gnyis med 'khril: gsung gi bdag nyid padma he ru kaḥ dmar nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bgrad: g.yas gsum padma g.yon gsum ti ra 'dzin: padma kro ti shwa ri gnyis med 'khril: phrin las bdag nyid karma he ru kaḥ zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi dor stabs bgrad: g.yas gsum rgya gram g.yon gsum 'khor lo 'dzin: karma kro ti shwa ri gnyis med 'khril: yum rnams g.yas pas gri gug mgul nas 'khyud: g.yon pas dung dmar yab kyi zhal du stob: ye shes me dpung klong du rngam par gsal: hūm̐: kau rī dkar mo bhan dmar zhing dbyug 'dzin: tsau ri ser mo phyag na mda' gzhu 'gengs: pra mo dmar mo chu srin rgyal mtshan 'dzin: bai ta nag mo mthing nag rdo rje 'dzin: pukka dmar ser bam ro rgyu ma 'dren: ghasma ljang gu dung chen khrag bkang 'thung : tsaṇḍa ser skya bam ro mgo lus za: sme sha mth-ing nag bam ro mgo lus phral: seng gdong dmar mo zhing chen phrag la gzar: byā gṛ dmar mo stag gdong lag gnyis bsnol: sri la nag mo wa gdong zhing chen ldog: shwa na mthing nag spyang mgo sha chen za: kri ta dmar mo rgod mgo dung gri 'dzin: kaṅka dmar smug zhing chen dung dmar 'dzin: khā kha nag mo bya rog bhan gri bsnams: hu lu mu kha 'ug gdong mche zhags bsnams: stag gdong dkar mo phyag na lcags kyu 'dzin: phag gdong ser mo phyag na zhags pa bsnams: seng gdong dmar mo phyag na lcags sgrog 'dzin: spyang gdong ljang gu phyag na dṛl bu 'dzin: hūm̐: g.yag mgo srin mo dmar nag tri shul 'dzin: sbrul mgo tshangs pa dmar ser rtse lnga 'dzin: gzig mgo lha chen dmar ser dbyug to 'dzin: sre mgo rtog 'dod ser mo 'khor lo 'dzin: dred mgo gzhon nu dmar skya bam dbyug 'dzin: dom mgo brgya byin dmar mo rgyu zhags 'dzin: pha waṃ rdo rje sngon po bum pa 'dzin: chu srin bdud rtsi sngo skya bhandha 'dzin:

sdig gdong zla ba rnam dag tho rlon 'dzin: khra mgo be con dmar nag rgyu zhags 'dzin: wa gdong srin rje nag mo bam chen 'dzin: rta gdong za ba dmar mo khog chen 'dzin: rgod mgo dga' ba dmar nag rdor dbyug 'dzin: stag gdong stobs chen dkar dmar bhandha 'dzin: khyung mgo rdo rje dmar ser byis pa 'dzin: khyi gdong 'dod pa dkar dmar padma 'dzin: pu shud nor bsrung dmar skya bhandha 'dzin: shwa mgo rlung lha ljang nag rnge'u chung 'dzin: spyang gdong gsod byed dmar ser me sgron 'dzin: skyin mgo me lha ljang ser mche ba 'dzin: phag mgo phag nag ljang sngon dung khrag 'dzin: khwa mgo rga byed dmar ljang bam chen 'dzin: skya ga rdo rje ser mo spu gri 'dzin: ba glang sna chen ljang nag bdud rtsi 'dzin: sbrul mgo chu lha nag mo lcags kyu 'dzin: khu byug rdo rje sngon mo zhags pa 'dzin: ra mgo rdo rje dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: seng gdong rdo rje ljang nag dril bu 'dzin: de ltar tshom bu shar phyogs dkyil 'khor lha: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas sku'i lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: lho phyogs zla gam chu glang bsnol ba'i steng : bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: sku yi bdag nyid sku mdog ser nag 'bar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro chu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal tshom spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdengs: g.yas pa dang po rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: be con ral gri dgra satwa lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pa sdigs mdzub mdung dang bhandha dmar: lhag ma klu brgyad tsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : las kyi yum chen bhe ta za byed ser: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum tri shul me dpung gri gug gdengs: g.yon gsum bhan dmar dung khrag yab la stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: bka' nyan sprul pa phag dang rmigs bu 'gyed: g.yas g.yon phyag na lcags kyu phur pa 'dzin: hūm̐: phyi nang tshom bu 'khor lo rim pa bzhin: gsod byed chen po ya ma ra tsa mthing : zhal gcig yum 'khyud 'khor lo dgra satwa 'dzin: sgrol yum dpal 'bar ral gri ne'u le 'dzin: dbang po myos byed gdug pa ser nag 'bar: gtum mo yum 'khyud be con dgra satwa bsnams: khrag gi bdag mo spu gri tsitta 'dzin: ārya me ru rtse pa dmar nag gtum: 'od zer yum 'khyud thod khrag dbyug to bsnams: gling bzhi gtsug 'byams tsitta bhan dmar stob: ral pa tshal dgu ljang nag mi gdug gzugs: re ti yum 'khyud gtun shing dung dmar stob: srin mo mgo 'phyang dung khrag dgra satwa phyar:

hūm̐: snag 'joms mthing nag rdo rje dgra satwa 'dzin: nag mo ral gcig yab 'khyud dung dmar stob: phya sang dkar po bum pa rdo rje 'dzin: shel ging gdong dgu yab 'khyud zangs gri bsnams: khrag 'joms dkar ser brag dang 'khor lo 'dzin: shel mig yab 'khyud lcags kyu dung dmar stob: glang mgo smug nag kha ṭwāṃ lcags kyu 'dzin: dkar skya mche gtsigs yab 'khyud dung dmar stob: gsod byed chen po ral gri phur pa 'dzin: ya ba ti sngo ral gri lcags kyu 'dzin: dred gdong yab 'khyud khram shing bhandha stob: bdud mo gser mdog nad rkyal zhags pa 'dzin: mig dmar smug nag ral gri phur pa gdengs: khrag gi ral gcig yab 'khyud dung dmar stob: za ba dmar nag gser gyi 'khor lo 'dzin: rmigs pa dung ka lcags sgrog phreng ba thogs: klu mo spus 'gros yab 'khyud dung dmar stob: me yi kha rlangs nad rkyal 'phyo ba 'dzin: gdol pa sngo nag spu gri dgra satwa bsnams: mche gtsigs yum 'khyud bhandha rakta stob: dug ti dmar mo lcags kyi sog le khur: bdud 'joms smug nag tho ba bhandha bsnams: ral gcig yab 'khyud dung dmar rakta stob: tsitta nag po zangs kyi phur pa 'dzin: chos rgyal dkar ser rdo rje khram bdag bsnams: rdo rje ral 'khyud zhags pa dung dmar stob: gdong dgu nag mo bswe yi gzhong pa 'dzin: phya sang mthing nag ral gri be con bsnams: 'bar ma yum 'khyud rtsis byang gtun shing 'dzin: dmar mo mgo dgu tri shul bhan dmar stob: thod dbyug mthing nag tir dbyug shwa rde'u 'dzin: phag mgor 'khyud cing zhags pa thod khrag stob: srin mo zangs mgo khram shing 'khor lo 'dzin: hūm̐: sgo yi las byed pho nya mo rnams ni: rgod mgo dung mdog rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin: nag mo stag gdong rin chen zhags pa 'dzin: kaṅka bswe dmar padma lcags sgrog bsnams: spyang mgo ljang nag rgya gram dril bu bsnams:

hūm̐: shar ging dkar po dung gi ral gri bsnams: lho ging ser po gser gyi ral gri bsnams: nub ging dmar po zangs kyi ral gri bsnams: byang ging sngon po g.yu yi ral gri bsnams: dung khrag gser khrab bswe khrab g.yu khrab gyon: hūm̐: shar bdud rol pa dung gi ral gri bsnams: khram bdag 'chi bdag srog bdag khram shing thogs: zla bdud rol pa ser nag zhags pa thogs: srog bdud nag po gser gyi satwa re thogs: sku mdog nag po dam nyams gshed du gsal: hūm̐: nyi ma dang po lha bdud shwa rdel dkar: nyi ma gnyis pa phung bdud shwa rdel ser: nyi ma gsum pa nyon mongs shwa rdel dmar: nyi ma bzhi pa 'chi bdag shwa rdel nag: kun kyang thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang dang : hūm̐: bdud kyi shan pa nag po nad rkyal thogs: btsan gyi shan pa dmar po zangs gri thogs: klu yi shan pa sngon po sbrul zhags thogs: gza' yi shan pa nag po tsitta thogs: de ltar dkyil 'khor lha tshogs tshom bu'i lha: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: oṃ a kro te ka ya mānta ka ha na ma tha bhandza hūm̐ phaṭ: de nas padma gsung gi lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: nub phyogs zla gam klu bdud bsnol ba'i steng : bcom ldan dpal chen padma gsung gi lha: gsung gi bdag nyid sku mdog dmar nag 'bar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal tshom spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdengs: g.yas pa dang po rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul zhags lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pa dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog dang : lhag ma klu brgyad tsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal kyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir rol stabs 'gying :

las kyi yum chen padma gzi ldan 'bar: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum padma tri shul 'khor lo 'dzin: g.yon gsum bhan dmar dung khrag yab la stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: bka' nyan sprul pa byi la pu shud mgo: g.yas g.yon phyag na lcags kyu phur pa 'dzin: hūm̐: phyi nang tshom bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhin: rdo rje dbang chen sku mdog dkar la 'tsher: rdo rje phyar zhing thod khrag zhal du stob: ratna dbang chen sku mdog ser la brjid: rin chen phyar zhing thod khrag zhal du stob: padma dbang chen sku mdog dmar la rngam: padma phyar zhing thod khrag zhal du stob: karma dbang chen sku mdog ljang la gtum: rgya gram phyar zhing thod khrag zhal du stob: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi bdag: rigs mthun gri thod yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: hūm̐: zhi ba zil gnon zhi ba rigs lnga gnon: rdo rje padma mi pham yum chen sbyor: khro bo zil gnon 'jig rten khro bcu gnon: padma kha ṭwāṃ khro gnyer yum dang sbyor: ma mo zil gnon dbyings kyi yum drug gnon: sdigs mdzub lcags sgrog ro langs yum dang sbyor: khyung rnams zil gnon rigs lnga'i khyung chen gnon: rdo rje khyung 'dzin spyan ma yum dang sbyor: dregs pa zil gnon dregs pa'i lha brgyad gnon: rdo rje thod khrag rdo rje las byed sbyor: mo bdud zil gnon ma bdud sring bzhi gnon: ral gri zhags pa gshin rje las byed 'khril: klu rnams zil gnon gdug pa'i klu brgyad gnon: phyag gnyis sbal sbrul klu mo 'od ldan 'khril: gza' rnams zil gnon nyi zla gza' brgyad gnon: rdo rje dung khrag gnod byed las byed 'khril: de dag sku mdog dmar nag rngam zhing khro: rta skad lhang lhang phyogs bcu'i mkha' dbyings sgrog:

yum rnams kha ṭwāṃ thod khrag yab la stob: sgo srung pho nya dkar ser dmar ljang nag: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: hūm̐: khams brgyad ma mo mi bzad 'jigs pa'i gzugs: sku sprul ma mo dung dred mgo gsum ma: gsung sprul ma mo zangs 'phar mgo brgyad ma: thugs sprul ma mo lcags spyang mgo dgu ma: yon tan ma mo g.yu spyang mgo lnga ma: phrin las ma mo seṅge mgo bdun ma: gnyis med ma mo stag mo mgo bcu ma: sha za ma mo dom nag mgo drug ma: srog gcod ma mo phag nag mgo brgyad ma: hūm̐: khams gsum cho 'phrul long ba brgyad sbrel ni: kun rgyu long bas g.yu 'brug mgo dgu chibs: dar dkar gos gsol dgra satwa lcags kyu bsnams: 'dod khams long bas lcags sdig mgo dgu chibs: mun pa'i gos gsol lcags kyi bya khyung 'dzin: gzugs med long bas glog zhags mgo dgu chibs: me yi gos gsol dug sbrul zhags pa 'dzin: gzugs khams long ba dred mong mgo dgu chibs: zhing lpags gos gyon dbyug to gri mtshon bsnams: bco lnga bco lnga'i rang 'dra 'khor dang bcas: sku mdog mi sdug dud kha rngam zhing rgyug: hūm̐: chu yi pho nya zla 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: me yi pho nya nyi 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: rlung gi pho nya glog 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: sa yi pho nya mun 'dab 'jigs pa'i gzugs: hūm̐: rlung 'brug mthing nag spu gri'i 'dab gshog can: me 'brug dmar nag ral gri'i 'dab gshog can: sa 'brug khams nag chu gri'i 'dab gshog can: chu 'brug sngo nag rlung gri'i 'dab gshog can: hūm̐: bka' nyan sprul pa khyi brgyad spyang brgyad ni: dung khyi dkar po gser khyi ser po dang : zangs khyi dmar po g.yu khyi sngon po dang : mchong khyi smug po byi ru'i khyi mo dmar: lcags khyi nag po bswe khyi khra bo'o: thams cad kha gdang 'jigs 'phyo 'dur zhing 'jums: hūm̐: lcags spyang g.yu spyang zangs spyang bswe spyang dang :

mchong spyang dung spyang shel spyang byi ru'o: thams cad mgo dgu sha khrag srog la rngam: nub phyogs tshom bu phyi nang dkyil 'khor rnams: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ padma ta kri ta ma hā kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas phur pa phrin las kyi lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: byang phyogs zla gam lha chen bsnol ba'i gdan: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: phrin las bdag nyid sku mdog mthing nag 'bar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal tshom spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdeng : g.yas pa dang po rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: rdo rje rtse lnga rtse dgu lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pa me dpung kha ṭwāṃ klu brgyad snying : mtha' gnyis khro rgyal las kyi phur bu bsgril: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : las kyi yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum kha ṭwāṃ gri gug rdo rje dang : g.yon gsum bhan dmar dung khrag yab la stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: hūm̐: phyi nang tshom bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhin: sku yi sras mchog buddha kī la dkar: phyag g.yas phur bu g.yon pa thod khrag bsnams: yon tan sras mchog ratna kī la ser: g.yas pas dgra satwa g.yon pas phur pa bsnams: gsung gi sras mchog padma kī la dmar: g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams: phrin las sras mchog karma kī la ljang : g.yas pas mdung thung g.yon pas thod khrag bsnams:

sangs rgyas rin chen padma las dbang 'khyud: g.yas pas gri gug g.yon pas bhan dmar stob: hūm̐ chen sngo skya gnam lcags mda' gzhu 'gengs: rdo rje sgra 'byin be con thod khrag stob: sprul pa phra men phag dang rmigs bu'i mgo: rnam rgyal dkar po 'khor lo tri shul bsnams: rdo rje snyems ma ral gri bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men stag dang bya rgod mgo: dbyug pa sngon po me dbal dbyug to bsnams: rdo rje sder mo lcags kyu bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men g.yag dang bya rog mgo: gshin rje sngo skya thod dbyug dgra satwa rnams: dur khrod bdag mo dbyug to me dbal stob: sprul pa phra men shwa ba 'ug pa'i mgo: mi g.yo sngo skya ral gri zhags pa bsnams: rdo rje gtun khung tho ba bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo: rta mgrin dmar po spu gri zhags pa bsnams: rdo rje gtum mo spu gri bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men byi la pu shud mgo: 'dod rgyal dmar skya bhandha rnga yab bsnams: rdo rje mda' snyems tho ba bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men spyang ki khra yi mgo: bdud rtsi ljang nag rgya gram dril bu bsnams: rdo rje rlung 'byin dgra satwa bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men seṅge pha waṃ mgo: khams gsum rnam rgyal mthing ka rdo rje zhags: rdo rje gsod byed gri gug bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men dom dang sre mong mgo: stobs chen dud kha be con zhags pa bsnams: rdo rje spyod ma rtse gsum bhan dmar stob: sprul pa phra men dred dang byi ba'i mgo: yum rnams sku mdog yab mtshungs dur khrod chas: khra thabs de bzhin rdo rje phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: pu shud mgo can dkar mo lcags kyu 'dzin: skya ga'i mgo can ser mo zhags pa 'dzin: srin bya'i mgo can dmar mo lcags sgrog 'dzin: khra yi mgo can ljang khu dril bu 'dzin: hūm̐: shwa na mthing nag lcags spyang mgo dgu chibs:

shwa na dmar nag zangs wa rkang gsum chibs: sri la ser nag 'phar ba lce brgyad chibs: sri ka sngo nag g.yu yi khyi mo chibs: zhing lpags gos gyon phur pa 'dril zhing 'debs: hūm̐: mthing nag re tis dril rta rkang gsum chibs: zhing lpags gos gyon mchong gi phur pa 'debs: ser nag re tis gser shwa yu mo chibs: rma bya'i thul gyon gser gyi zor ba 'dzin: dmar nag re tis chu glang sngon po chibs: rtsod dmar la'u khram bam lcags kyu bsnams: ljang nag re dzu rnga mong sngo nag chibs: chu dar gos gsol mthing nag khram bam thogs: hūm̐: sa bdag chen mo ma mo 'jigs pa'i gzugs: ya byin mthing nag lcags phur ral pa can: mthing nag ber gsol bdud rta nag po chibs: de byin ser nag gser phur ral pa can: ser nag ber gsol gza' rta ser po chibs: bswe byin dmar nag zangs phur ral pa can: dmar nag ber gsol btsan gyi rta dmar chibs: phag byin sngo nag mchong phur ral pa can: ljang nag ber gsol klu yi rta sngon chibs: hūm̐: srin po'i skyes bu dkar po phur pa 'dril: gshin rje'i skyes bu ser po phur pa 'dril: bdud kyi skyes bu nag po phur pa 'dril: gnod sbyin skyes bu sngon po phur pa 'dril: hūm̐: shar bdud dkar pos dung gi phur pa 'dril: lho bdud sngon pos g.yu yi phur pa 'dril: nub bdud dmar pos zangs kyi phur pa 'dril: byang bdud mthing nag lcags kyi phur pa 'dril: pra ma ra tsa srin po'i ging chen dkar: ya ma ra tsa gshin rje'i ging chen ser: dha sha ghṛ wa bdud kyi ging chen dmar: yaksha pra ma gnod sbyin ging chen sngo: dregs pa'i dmag dpon phur bu 'dril zhing 'debs: phyi nang tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas ma mo rbod gtong gi lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: shar lho zla gam ma mo 'bum sde'i gdan: bcom ldan dpal chen bla med he ru kaḥ yon tan bdag nyid sku mdog ljang nag 'bar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal tshom spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdeng : g.yas pa dang po phyag ni rim pa bzhin: rdo rje khyung khra sbrul zhags lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pas bhan dmar zhing dbyug gwa'u dang : lhag ma klu brgyad tsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhi ri rab 'gying : las kyi yum chen kun bzang nyid zhi mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum kha ṭwāṃ rnge'u chung rdo rje dang : g.yon gsum bhan dmar dung khrag yab la stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: hūm̐: phyi nang tshom bu 'khor lo rim pa bzhin: gsal snang 'bar dkar rdo rje thod khrag bsnams: 'od gsal 'bar ser rin chen thod khrag bsnams: shes gsal 'bar dmar padma thod khrag bsnams: klong gsal 'bar ljang rgya gram thod khrag bsnams: rang mdog yum 'khyud 'khor lo thod khrag bsnams: hūm̐: bde 'gro mthing ka rdo rje thod khrag bsnams: thod phreng dkar mo snying phreng zhags pa bsnams: ma mo khros ma mdog nag spu gri dmar: khrag 'thung khros ma mthing nag thod khrag bsnams: bdud rtsi khros ma dmar mo spu gri 'dzin: bde sbyor khros ma ljang nag re ti bsnams: srid pa dkar mo skra yi zhags pa bsnams: sngon mo dbyings phyug zhing gi dbyug pa bsnams:

bdag nyid chen mos rgyu ma'i zhags pa bsnams: gcig spyad chen mos zhing gi g.yang gzhi bsnams: dkar mo chen mos bhandha zlum po bsnams: mthing nag chen mos thod pa bum ril bsnams: dbang sdud dmar mos bhandha lcang lo bsnams: ser mo las mkhan thod pa rgya gram bsnams: hūm̐: srid pa'i sman mo gdug pa'i gzugs can ma: srid pa chags byed mthing nag mi snying thogs: srid pa cha snyoms dmar mo thod khrag bsnams: 'dod khams gtso mo dmar mo khram shing thogs: ral gcig dkar mo khram shing mi ro thogs: rin chen srid 'bebs sngon mo gwa'u thogs: gling bzhi skyi phud dkar gsal lcags kyu thogs: padma gar dbang le brgan thod khrag thogs: rdo rje gar dbang ser mo bhandha thogs: harting dkar mo sa yi dkyil 'khor thogs: dunting nag mo me yi dkyil 'khor thogs: shanting nag mo chu yi dkyil 'khor thogs: grubting nag mo rlung gi dkyil 'khor thogs: srin mo dkar mos shel gyi phur pa thogs: srin mo sngon mos phur pa thod khrag 'thung : srin mo g.yang gzhi thod sgrom bhandha thogs: srin mo za ba lag na zhing lpags thogs: srin mo gsod byed lag na lcags kyu thogs: srin mo dmar ser thod khrag dril bu thogs: srin mo stob byed bhandha ljang gu thogs: dkar mo mche gtsigs thod pa dkar po thogs: nag mo mche gtsigs bhandha sngon po thogs: dmar mo zangs mchu bhandha dmar po thogs: ser mo skal ldan bhandha ser po thogs: singha khā kha hu lu pu ka sing : lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: hūm̐: ma mo chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: g.yas g.yon phyag na spu gri thod khrag 'dzin: rdo rje drag snyan phyag na zhing dbyug 'dzin: rdo rje ye shes zhing chen za ba'i tshul: rdo rje 'dod chags me yi kha rlangs can: rdo rje g.yu sgron sngon mo nad rkyal thogs: rdo rje gsal 'phro nag mo khram bam thogs:

hūm̐: lha yi sring mo dkar mo sbrul zhags thogs: gshin rje'i sring mo sngon mo thod dbyug thogs: klu yi sring mo sngon mo sbrul zhags thogs: gnod sbyin sring mo ser nag ne'u le thogs: sngon mo 'bum gyi gtso mo me long thogs: dkar mo dbu dgu bhandha bam chen thogs: smug nag dbu dgu bhandha rlon pa thogs: dkar mo las byed thod skam 'bar ba thogs: srid pa'i bu mo ser mo thod skam thogs: gling bzhi dbang chen ser nag bhandha thogs: smug nag sa gzhi dbang byed bhan dmar thogs: rgya mtsho'i gling dbang sngon mo bhandha thogs: hūm̐: shar gyi stag srin dkar mo zor ba thogs: lho yi bam srin dred gdong gri thogs ser: nub kyi skong srin glang gdong chu srin dmar: byang gi 'brog srin sngon po chu srin gdong : gnam gyi dpe har mun pa'i zug rngu can: 'jigs pa'i lus can bhandha khrag bkang bsnams: bar gyi glog dmar sprin chen g.yo ba mo: khrag gi bud med dmar nag bhan dmar thogs: sa yi phung byed nag po mun pa'i gzugs: g.yas kyi phyag na bhandha rlon pa thogs: ma mo gsod byed nag mo lcags kyu thogs: 'khrug byed nag mo khrag gi lcags kyu thogs: sgrol byed nag mo zangs kyi lcags kyu thogs: ro langs nag mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs: dza mun smug nag thod pa khrag bkang thogs: nam gru nag mo thod pa khrag bkang thogs: lha yi bu mo dung skyong rtsa mun tri: dkar mo phyag na ral gri 'bar ba bsnams: gnod sbyin bu mo dri nan tsant+ri kaḥ sngon mo phyag na nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: dpal gyi bu mo bdud 'dul re ma ti: nag mo phyag na bdud kyi khram shing thogs: dkyil 'khor gtso bo tshom bu lha tshogs rnams: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ ghu ya ma hā dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ ma ma yo gi ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs bskyed pa ni:

hūm̐: lho nub zla gam pad nyi ro yi steng : rdo rje drag po thod phreng he ru kaḥ kun 'dus bdag nyid sku mdog dmar smug rngam: zhal dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan dmar glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal chen spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdeng : g.yas pa dang po'i rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: gri gug rdo rje ral gri lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pa thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig dang : lhag ma klu brgyad tsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : las kyi yum chen gsang ba ye shes mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum kha ṭwāṃ gri gug mda' dar dang : g.yon gsum bhandha tshe bum yab la 'khril: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: spyi bor lnga ldan 'ja' 'od me dpung klong : snang srid zil gnod dkar dmar longs spyod rdzogs: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs: rdo rje dril bu rus rgyan dar dpyangs mdzes: gsang ba'i yum mchog rdo rje rnal 'byor 'khril: sku mdog dmar mo gri thod gtso la 'khyud: hūm̐: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog dkar: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin sku mdog ser: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin sku mdog dmar: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin sku mdog ljang : zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdor dril thor tshugs can: rin chen rus rgyan he ru ka pa'i chas: brkyang bskum 'gying bag gar rtsed ling nge bzhugs: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bdag po rig 'dzin chen po brgyad: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen rdo rje grub mchog rtsal:

nā gardzu na rdo rje drag po rtsal: hūm̐ chen ka ra rdo rje bsam 'grub rtsal: bi ma mi tra rdo rje gro lod rtsal: pra chen hastī rdo rje las rab rtsal: dha na saṃ skṛ rdo rje dbang sdud rtsal: rombu gu hya rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal: shāntiṃ garbha rdo rje thog 'bebs rtsal: kun kyang sku mdog dkar dmar zhi ma khro: zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu bsnams: thor tshugs rus brgyan dar dpyangs cod pan 'phur: brkyang bskum zhabs gnyis gar rtsed ling nger bzhugs: hūm̐: dgongs brgyud ye shes slob dpon chen po dkar: brda brgyud ye shes slob dpon chen po ser: snyan brgyud ye shes slob dpon chen po dmar: dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon chen po ljang : man ngag lung gi slob dpon chen po mthing : shes rab rgyud kyi slob dpon chen po sngo: nyams chag bskang ba'i slob dpon chen po smug: rus rgyan thor tshugs khro 'dzum dar dpyangs brgyan: rdo rje bhandha kha ṭwāṃ phyed skyil bzhugs: gsang ba'i yum chen rang 'dra rigs mthun bzhin: rdo rje rin chen padma las mkha' 'gro: sangs rgyas la sogs mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: mdzes ldan mnyen lcug 'ja' 'od bkrag mdangs 'khyil: tshom bu 'dus pa'i 'ja' 'od dkyil 'khor rnams: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra gu ru padma thod phreng rtsal he ru ka siddhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: nub byang zla gam dregs pa pho mo'i gdan: bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa he ru kaḥ gnyis med rang bzhin sku mdog kham nag 'bar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan: khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs snyan nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal chen spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdeng :

g.yas pa dang po rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: spu gri'i 'khor lo rdo rje lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pa thod khrag dung dmar rakta dang : lhag ma klu brgyad tsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : las kyi yum chen srid gsum spyi 'dul mthing : zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum kha ṭwāṃ rdo rje 'khor lo dang : g.yon gsum tsitta bhandha phur pa bsnams: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: hūm̐: ya ma ra tsa sgrol yum e ka nag: be con thod khrag 'khor lo thod khrag stob: skos rje drag dkar bdud mo re ti nag: khram shing dgra satwa nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: srin po glog phreng haṃ shaṃ sbal mgo nag: glog phreng ser ba phur pa mi mgo bsnams: gnod sbyin me dbal mon mo sha zan nag: rin chen zangs gri spu gri g.yu spyang thogs: hūm̐: lha yi sde dpon mthing ka gri gug g.yas: g.yon pas tsitta seṅge dkar mo chibs: u ma dhe wa dkar mo rtse gsum g.yas: g.yon pas thod khrag glang chen gwa pa chibs: srid pa'i rgyal mo mdog dkar 'khor lo g.yas: g.yon pas me long g.yu 'brug sngon po chibs: e ka dzā ṭi smug nag tsitta g.yas: g.yon pas rtse gsum dril rta rkang gsum chibs: rdo rje khyung rgyal pe har bdud zhags pas: g.yon pa spu gri glang chen sna ring chibs: tshangs pa dkar po spu gri 'bar ba g.yas: g.yon pas gri zor seṅge dkar mo chibs: rdo rje legs pa mdog dkar rdo rje g.yas: g.yon pas ru mtshon ra skyes kham pa chibs: gza' bdud mgo dgu mdog nag sbrul mjug can: g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu sbrul zhags 'brug sngon chibs: ma hā kā la mthing nag gri gug g.yas: g.yon pa beng chen rta nag rting dkar chibs:

rdo rje bdud 'dul mthing nag khrag kong g.yas: g.yon pas mdung thung dril rta kham pa chibs: dmu bdud nag po ral gri shang lang g.yas: g.yon pas mda' gzhu dmu rta mchong rgod chibs: kā la drag po g.yas pa tri shul 'dzin: g.yon pas thod khrag stag mo ri bkra chibs: gang ba bzang po dkar po ba dan g.yas: g.yon pas shel gri lug dkar gnam du chibs: thog 'bebs smug po gnam lcags thog rgod g.yas: g.yon pas ser glog 'brug mo mgo dgu chibs: spyi bdud rgyal po dkar po ru mtshon g.yas: g.yon pas ral gri sprin rta gro bo chibs: srog zan dmar po bswe yi mdung dmar g.yas: g.yon pas mda' gzhu btsan rta dmar po chibs: gnam thel dkar po'i mdung dar ba dan g.yas: g.yon pas shel gri rta dkar ze dmar chibs: yam shud dmar po ral gri shang lang g.yas: g.yon pas zangs kyi zhags pa rta dmar chibs: bgegs kyi rgyal po mthing ka kha ṭwāṃ g.yas: g.yon pas thod khrag bdud rta nag po chibs: nag po dus mtshan mtshon gyi gru gu g.yas: g.yon pas nad rkyal bya rog mchu dmar chibs: klu bdud nag po sbrul zhags nad rkyal thogs: sku smad sbrul 'khyil chu srin kham pa chibs: sa bdag nag po sbrul zhags nad rkyal thogs: sku smad sbrul mjug rus sbal mgo dgu chibs: kaṅka srin bya 'dre bya dur bya'i mgo: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu 'dzin: las byed sprul pa dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs: phyi nang tshom bu'i lha tshogs ma lus rnams: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bskyed: om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas dmod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: byang shar zla gam bgegs rgyal bsnol ba'i gdan: dpal chen dmod pa drag sngags he ru kaḥ sprul pa yang sprul sku mdog nag la rngam: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: sma ra dbu skra me 'bar thod skam brgyan:

khro bcu'i tshems gtsigs zhal nas 'brug stong ldir: shangs nas rlung g.yos khrag zhag thal chen spras: rdo rje rin chen sgro gshog mkha' la gdeng : g.yas kyi dang po rtsa phyag rim pa bzhin: rdo rje phur pa kha ṭwāṃ lha brgyad mgo: g.yon pas bhan dmar me zor dung khrag stob: lhag ma klu brgyadatsitta 'bar ba bsnams: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : las kyi yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mo nag: zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril: g.yas gsum me chu rlung gi 'khor lo 'dzin: g.yon gsum ri rab dung khrag yab la stob: gzig sham la sogs dur khrod chas rnams rdzogs: yab yum sku gsung thugs yig lam gyis gsal: gar dgu'i nyams ldan me dpung klong du brjid: hūm̐: phyi nang tshom bu dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin: gshin rje tshe bdag gsod byed ma mo nag: gri gug thod khrag zangs gri tsitta bsnams: bdud po me yi kha rlangs bdud mo nag: kha ṭwāṃ khram shing tri shul thod rlon bsnams: srin po gsod byed srin mo snying 'byin nag: ral gri thod pa gri gug bhandha bsnams: gang ba bzang po gnod sbyin sha za nag: ral gri ru mtshon dar nag mi lpags bsnams: hūm̐ chen dkar po bhandha shel gri bsnams: thar pa nag po mche gdong dug thun bsnams: rje btsun nag po dur phag zhags pa bsnams: yaksha nag po kha ṭwāṃ tri shul bsnams: ha mdzes nag po shel gyi dar dkar bsnams: yam shud dmar po mdung dmar ral gri bsnams: rdo rje mdzes pa dmar po ru mtshon bsnams: khu ye lag dgu khram shing dgra satwa bsnams: gzhon nu gtum po rus sbal bum pa bsnams: gnam sman sa sman chu sman me yi sman: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu bsnams: hūm̐: kun kyang mi lpags g.yang gzhi sku la gsol: tshom bu 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom:
om̐ badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas dkyil 'khor gyi bar khyams su gnas pa'i sgo skyong dang : ye shes 'jig rten phyi nang dgu'i lha tshogs bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: phyogs bzhi sgo skyong khro rgyal yab yum brgyad: shar phyogs ru tra ti ra'i gdan steng du: ya mānta kri dbyug tho lcags kyu thogs: pratsnya ta kri rtse gsum zhags pa thogs: padma ta kri thod dbyug lcags sgrog thogs: bighnān ta kri rgya gram dril bu thogs: rta phag sprel spyang gdong can ma mo bzhi: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu bsnams: yab yum phyogs mdog dkar ser dmar ljang 'bar: khro tshul brjid ldan me dpung klong du gsal: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor bar khyams 'khor yug la gnas pa'i: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ging dang ma sring dang : laṅka zhing skyong dur khrod bdag mo ste: smug nag g.yag mgo tri shul 'bar ba thogs: dmar ser sbrul mgo rdo rje rtse lnga thogs: ser nag gzig mgo sdigs mdzub dbyug pa thogs: sre mong mgo can dkar dmar dung khrag thogs: pha waṃ mgo can ser nag zhing dbyug thogs: dred kyi mgo can dmar skya bam dbyug thogs: dom gyi mgo can dmar ser dbyug pa thogs: chu srin mgo can sngo nag bam ril thogs: sdig pa'i mgo can sngo skya glo snying thogs: khwa ta'i mgo can ser nag rnga chung thogs: stag gi mgo can mthing nag zhing dbyug thogs: bya rgod mgo can dmar nag lcags sgrog thogs: chu srin mgo can dmar nag rdor dbyug thogs: khu byug mgo can ser nag rdo rje thogs: khra yi mgo can dmar nag byi bam thogs: pu shud mgo can dmar nag padma thogs: shwa ba'i mgo can ljang gsal zhing chen za: khra yi mgo can dmar nag rnga chung thogs: skya ga'i mgo can ljang nag me sgron thogs: srin bya'i mgo can ljang nag rgyu zhags thogs: phag gi mgo can dmar ser rtse lnga thogs: lcung ka'i mgo can dmar nag rgyu zhags thogs: pha waṃ mgo can ljang nag bam ril thogs:

bya rog mgo can sngo skya zangs gri thogs: khu byug mgo can nag mo lcags kyu thogs: ra yi mgo can sngon po zhags pa thogs: spre'u mgo can dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs: spyang mo'i mgo can ljang nag tri shul thogs: hūm̐: shar lho nub byang phyogs bzhi rim pa bzhin: rdo rje rin chen padma las mkha' 'gro: dkar ser dmar ljang brgyad tsho re re bzhin: rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing gar thabs 'khyug: hūm̐: khro bo'i rgyal po badzra ging ka ra: tri 'dzin khro mos khams gsum log rtog sgrol: rdo rje ging bzhi'i lag na shel gri thogs: ratna ging bzhi'i lag na tri shul thogs: padma ging bzhi'i lag na zangs gri thogs: las kyi ging bzhi'i lag na spu gri thogs: thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang phyogs kyi mdog: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo chen mo mched bdun ni: ye shes mkha' 'gro gri gug thod khrag thogs: ye shes shugs 'gro gri gug bhan dmar thogs: ye shes stag 'gro zhing gi dbyug pa thogs: ye shes za byed nag mo zhing chen za: ye shes kha 'bar nag mo me kha rlangs: ma mo re ti nag mo nad rkyal thogs: rdo rje gsal 'gro sngon po khram bam thogs: hūm̐: sring mo bzhi bzhi brgyad rnams ni: sring mo bri 'dul yid 'phrog ma: gling bzhi mgyogs ma lha yi sring : sring mo snang ba 'tsho byed ma: mkha' la rgyu ba gshin rje'i sring : sring mo bsnol byed chen po ste: klu sring dmar mo g.yag thod ma: sring mo rlung 'byin 'khor lo ma: gdong chags nag mo gnod sbyin sring : phyag na dbyug pa thod khrag thogs: hūm̐: laṅka chen po bcu drug ni: rdo rje laṅka rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rin chen laṅka rin chen dril bu thogs: padma laṅka padma tri shul thogs: las kyi laṅka rgya gram tri shul thogs: bzhi bzhi thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang ngo : hūm̐: zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams ni: shar lho nub byang rim pa bzhin:

dkar ser dmar ljang rang mdog bzhin: dril bu ru mtshon 'dzin pa'o: hūm̐: dur khrod bdag mo keng rus khro mo brgyad: lag na mchong phur zhing lung bhandha thogs: klu 'dul khyung brgyad gtsug na nor bu 'bar: mchu sder sbrul 'dzin za zhing sgro gshog brgyangs: hūm̐: 'bar ma chen mo pho nya mo: 'bar ma nyi zhags 'phen pa mo: 'bar ma glog phreng me zor thogs: 'bar ma gshin rje skar mda' 'phen: 'bar ma sring mo mdung thung 'phen: 'bar ma lce 'bebs glog sha mo: 'bar ma rlung g.yo ral gri can: 'bar ma gnod sbyin ba glang gdong : 'bar ma nyams byed khyung thogs ma: hūm̐: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi po: rdo rje pho nya seṅge'i gdong : rin chen pho nya stag gi gdong : padma pho nya zangs glang gdong : las kyi pho nya lcags spyang gdong : phyogs mdog bcu drug bcu drug po: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril: g.yang gzhi gyon pa drug cu bzhi: hūm̐: sa bdag 'dul byed sum cu rtsa gnyis po: sa bdag 'dul byed lcags kyu phur pa 'dzin: gza' rnams 'dul byed zhags pa phur pa 'dzin: klu rnams 'dul byed lcags sgrog phur pa 'dzin: btsan rnams 'dul byed tri shul phur pa 'dzin: brgyad tsho thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang ngo : 'bum phrag 'gyed pa'i mkha' 'gro ni: tshangs pa dri za drang srong dang : grul bum srin po klu chen po: rlung bdag gnod sbyin dbang ldan ma: sa bdag sman phran sha za dang : bdud mo gza' phran sa bdag phran: thams cad rang mdog rim pa bzhin: 'bum phrag gcig gcig re re 'o: dkar ser dmar ljang sngo smug ste: de yang 'bum phrag 'bum phrag go: hūm̐: bdag nyid chen mo rdo rje kun grags ma: dmar mo phyag na zhing dbyug 'bar ba bsnams: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : sngon mo lag na zangs phur 'dril zhing 'debs: gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : dkar mo lag na khram bam rkyal pa thogs: 'brog chen 'khor 'dus rdo rje bgegs kyi gtso:

gser mdog lag na lcags kyi phur pa thogs: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: dkar mo lag na dung gi phur pa 'dril: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: ser mo lag na gser gyi phur pa 'dril: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo rgyal: dmar mo lag na mchong gi phur pa 'dril: rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: sngon mo lag na seng ldeng phur pa 'dril: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : nag mo lag na lcags kyi phur pa 'dril: btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: dmar mo lag na bswe yi phur pa 'dril: mo btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil: dmar nag lag na gnam lcags phur pa 'dril: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: sngon mo lag na g.yu yi phur pa 'dril: na bza' lhab lhub mang po rgyan dang bcas: bran g.yog 'khor bcas ma lus gsal ba'o: hūm̐: dpyid kyi rgyal mo ljang nag bu yug can: shwa ba la chibs me long ba dan bsnams: dbyar gyi rgyal mo dmar nag char sprin mdog: g.yu 'brug zhon cing thog ser sgrom bu 'dzin: ston gyi rgyal mo ser skya skye ba'i gzugs: ba glang zhon cing 'bru bcud sgrom bu 'dzin: dgun gyi rgyal mo sngo nag khros pa'i gzugs: chu glang zhon cing chu shel sgong bu 'dzin: char 'bebs rgyal mo chu yi sgrom bu can: 'brug sgra lha mo glog gi zhags pa can: sprin sdud lha mo lho sprin 'dab ma can: lo thog smin byed 'bru bcud sgong bu can: snyom byed lha mo rlung gi gshog pa can: skyed byed lha mo 'byung lnga'i sgong bu can: dus drug ma rnams lhab lhub rgyan dang ldan: hūm̐: gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma: chibs su seṅge dkar mo chibs: phyag na mda' dar bum pa 'dzin: mthing gi zhal bzang g.yu 'brug chibs: phyag na snang gsal me long 'dzin: mi g.yo blo bzang glang po chibs: rin chen 'bras kyi snye ma 'dzin: gtad dkar 'gro bzang stag la chibs:

phyag na padma'i zhags pa bsnams: cod pan mgrin bzang shwa ba chibs: phyag na rtswa mchog dur ba 'dzin: thams cad dkar ser dmar ljang ngo : hūm̐: phyi nang skyong ba'i bka' sdod chos skyong dang : sprul pa yang sprul bka' yi las mkhan bcas: bde gshegs sgrub chen dpal dgu 'dus pa'i lha: ma yengs ting 'dzin yid yul gsal bar bsgom: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yaksha kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces dkyil 'khor rim pa bzhin du gsal gdab cing byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i dpal chen dbyings kyi lha: mthu rtsal rmad byung byin rlabs gzi brjid dbang : skal ldan lus ngag sems la myur du stsol: dkyil 'khor zab mo ye shes 'khor los bsgyur: om̐ āḥhūm̐ badzra dzñā na siddhi satwaṃ: de nas lus kyi sa bon bkod cing spyan 'dren phyir 'od zer spro ba ni: hūm̐: dung khang rdo rje rnam par snang mdzad om̐: longs spyod 'khor lo padma snang mtha' āḥ chos nyid 'khor lo rdo rje buddha hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo ratna rin 'byung trām̐: bde skyong 'khor lo karma don grub hrīḥ zhi ba dbyings nyid 'od 'phros 'khor lo hūm̐: drag po'i dbyings nyid gsang sngags drag po phaṭḥ ma rgyud 'khor lo phaiṃ gyis rgyud bskul bhyoḥ de ltar 'khor lo 'od zer dpag yas 'phros: phyogs bcu rab 'byams zhing khams mtha' yas nas: dbang lha spyan drangs dbang bskur sgrib pa dag: chu lhag yar lud kun bzang dbu rgyan gyur: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.ā badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas snod dang zhing ma dag pa mtshan 'dzin gyi phung po sbyangs te: dkyil 'khor gyi lha ye shes dregs pa gnyis kun tu ye nas ro gcig pa: chos dbyings kyi ngang tshul bzang ngan yin min rnam rtog gis blang dor bral ba'i rang bzhin thag chod par bya: dang po 'dzin pa ma grub pa'i chos sku:

bar du bdag 'dzin zhig pa'i longs sku: tha ma skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i sprul sku ste: ting 'dzin gsum gyi ngang du kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams 'dus pa dgu'i lha tshogs dbyings la 'ja' shar ba ltar snang la rang bzhin ma grub par skad cig dran rdzogs su bskyed par bya: rang gi gnas lnga nas 'od 'phros pas spyan drangs shing dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med par bsam zhing rol mo bya: dri zhim dang sha chen gyi dud pa btang nas dbyangs snyan po dang bcas nas spyan 'dren no: hoḥ de ltar gsal ba'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum las 'od zer 'phros pas: rang bzhin gyi gnas nas zhi khro gar dbang thugs kyi klong dgu'i lha tshogs rnams: snang srid snod bcud thams cad nyi zer la rdul 'khrigs pa bzhin du spyan drangs: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dza pheṃ pheṃ: dang po spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: ma bcos lhun grub ka dag pho brang nas: khyab brdal rol pa che mchog zhi khro'i lha: zhi rgyas dbang drag dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ e hya hi sa mā ya dza dzaḥ spyan 'dren rgyas pa 'dir bya/ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rtog med spros bral rnam dag lnga ldan khrir: che mchog dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dbyings las mi g.yo dbyer med ngo bo'i ngang : gdod nas rang gsal brtan par bzhugs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: zhes zhi ba rnams dang khro bo dregs pa sogs: dkyil 'khor gral du 'god pa rnams chos nyid rang rtsal du gang la gang 'dul der ston yin pa ngo shes shing : dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du bzhugs par bsam mo: de nas phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: gdod nas klong yangs kun gzhi'i chos nyid las: ma bcos rang shar che mchog 'dus pa'i lha: dbyer med dbyings nas sgyu mar sprul mdzad pa'i: rig pa ye shes dkyil 'khor la phyag 'tshal:

om̐ badzra sa ma ya a ti pu hoḥ pra tītstsha hoḥ de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog he ru kaḥ bde gshegs dpal dgu'i dkyil 'khor lha: bde stong yab yum mnyam sbyor ba'i: phyag rgya sgyu ma'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: bla med gar gyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas zung du 'jug par mnyes: om̐ mu ṭa rā ga ya hoḥ rā ga ya mi pra tītstsha hoḥ de nas rdo rje'i glu dbyangs kyi mchod pa ni: hūm̐: yid 'phrog lha mo nam mkha'i gar ma mdzes: lta na sdug cing tshul bzang dpag med kyis: grags stong glu dang nyams 'gyur gar gyi mchog: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: yid 'ong thugs la mos blo dwangs ma mnyes: om̐ ma hā ga na dhi gīrti badzra hoḥ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: dwangs ma'i mdangs ldan puṣpe nam mkha'i khyon: tshim byed ngad ldan dri mchog dhū pe ma: kun gsal 'od stong nyi zla ā lo ke: dag byed chang gi mdangs ldan gandhe ma: ro mchog mdangs ldan ri rab nai wi dye: 'brug sgra mkha' las rab ldir shabda ma: bde gshegs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda badzra āḥhūm̐: de nas rdo rje gar ma'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mchog reg: rdo rje lha mo yid 'phrog 'greng thabs ma: lang ling rtse ba mtha' lam 'gengs pa'i tshogs: kun bzang rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: dug lnga ye shes lnga'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: 'dod chags zhe sdang ma spangs rnam par dag: sku lnga lhun grub ye shes bdud rtsi ste: khams lnga 'byung lnga rang grol mchod pa 'di: bde gshegs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā pañtsa pū dza hoḥ de nas sha khrag rus pa'i mchod pa ni: hūm̐: gzugs phung 'dus byas sbyangs pa'i sha khrag rus:

dkar dmar dwangs ma lnga ldan rdzas mchod mchog: bde gshegs sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: rang grol chos dbyings bla med mchod pa bzhes: om̐ ma hā māṃ sa tsitta rakta go ro tsa na ba su ta la kha raṃ khā hi: de nas bdud rtsi sman mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: ga pur dzā ti a ga ru lu dang : a ru li shi ka ko la sogs pa: 'chi med sbyor ba'i sman mchod rgya mtsho 'di: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod pas dgyes phyir 'bul: om̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha raṃ khā hi: zhes skabs 'dir bla ma brgyud rim bzhin du bdud rtsi lag mchod 'bul kyang rung : de nas rakta rnam lnga 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bhandha lcang lo dum gcig yangs pa'i dbus: rakta'i rgya mtsho dmar chen kyi li li: rgyud drug bsgral ba'i khrag chen rgya mtsho 'di: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā rakta pū dza khā hi: de nas bdud rtsi rnam gsum sku gsung thugs dbang blangs shing myong : de nas gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: stong gsum bhandha chos dbyings klong yangs dbus: rmad byung gtor ma bskang rdzas ri ltar spungs: nyi zla gtor rgyan gling bzhi gtor kyus bran: bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: om̐ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya i daṃ bha lingta la khā hi:

de nas dza gad 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bde chen dza gad dpa' bo dpa' mo'i bcud: rin chen sna tshogs 'bru bcud 'bras kyi tshang : bla ma kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas dam tshig dbang gis bdag la stsol: om̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta la kha kha khā hi: de nas sbyor mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: thabs shes dbang po sbyor ba yi: bsrubs shing srub pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyis: 'khor lo'i lam nas legs byung ba: byang sems dkar dmar mchod pa 'di: kun bzang zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul: om̐ āḥhūm̐ sarba rā ga na pañtsa hūm̐ khā hi: de nas sgrol mchod 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i ru tra la: rig pa rdo rje'i mtshon gyis gtubs: dbyings la rab bsgral mchod mchog po: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra ma traṃ ru tra pra be sha ya phaṭḥ sa ma ya ti kha kha khā hi: de nas bstod pa 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog dpal chen rang byung he ru kaḥ nyer gcig zhal bgrad bzhi bcu'i rtsa phyag rdzogs: kun bzang gtsug brgyan gnam zhal pang du 'khyud: zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen thugs mchog he ru kaḥ dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: kro ti shwa ri khrag 'thung thugs sras 'gyed: gnas yul phyi nang sgo skyong srung mar bcas: yang dag thugs kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: sku lngas yum sbyor gshed bzhi sku sras 'gyed: phyogs skyong ging bdud sgo bzhi phra men bcas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen padma dbang gi lha: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: gzi ldan yum sbyor rigs bzhi gsung sras 'gyed: phra men zil gnon khro rgyal sgo skyong bcas: padma gsung gi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu che:

dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: rgyas 'debs yum sbyor khro bcu'i sras bzhi 'gyed: za gsod ma tshogs ming po sgo skyong bcas: phrin las phur pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen bla ma he ru kaḥ dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: nyid bzhi yum sbyor sras bzhi sprul 'khor 'gyed: sman mo sgo skyong ma sring srin mo bcas: ma mo rbod gtong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan drag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: gsang ba'i yum 'khyud zil gnon spyi bor brgyan: thugs sras slob dpon rigs bzhi sgo skyong bcas: bla ma rig 'dzin lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul pa: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: spyi 'dus yum sbyor thugs sras pho nya 'gyed: sde dpung zhi rgyas dbang drag sgo skyong bcas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: bcom ldan khrag 'thung dregs pa kun 'dul pa: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'jigs: kun grol yum sbyor thugs sras dregs pa 'gyed: las bzhi dregs can sgo skyong srung ma bcas: dmod pa drag sngags lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: hūm̐: zhi ba dbyings kyi lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: khro bo 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bka' sdod sgo skyong lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: gter bdag gter srung tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: ces bstod ste: chad cing lhag pa'i rigs: sgra ma dag pa sogs bskang ba ni: hūm̐: lhag pa'i lha mchog dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: bdag cag bag med las dbang g.yeng ba'i rkyen: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : phyi nang sngags kyi bskyed rdzogs ting 'dzin la: 'gal 'khrul nyes pa'i tshogs rnams mthol lo bshags: om̐ badzra he ru ka sa twa sa ma ya:

ma nu pā la ya: badzra he ru ka twe no p sogs badzrī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya he ru ka sa twa āḥ zhes yig brgya bzlas shing lhag chad bkang : de nas 'dzab kyis thugs dam bskul ba ni: hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: nyi zla padma bam chen gdan la gsal: dpal chen che mchog zhi khro 'dus pa'i bdag: mthu rtsal rmad byung gzi byin snang srid sngangs: zhi ba'i tshul dgu khro bo'i gar dgu ldan: phyag mtshan sa bon sngags phreng rdul ltar 'khrigs: sgra grags chos nyid ma 'gags 'brug ltar sgrog: dbyings nas bzhengs shig thugs dam rgyud bskul la: rang byung snying po'i sngags kyi phrin las rnams: ye shes dag pa'i klong yangs rmad byung gter: sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag la stsol: ma gsal bar du gshis lugs gzhi la pheb: ma 'grub bar du dam bcas srog ltar bzung : sngags phreng 'od zer tsha zer rang bzhin can: bdag bskyed zhal nas yum gyi klong du brgyud: chos 'byung lam nas yar drangs lte bar 'grim: snying kha'i dbus zhugs 'khor lo mgal me 'khor: zhi ba'i sngags rnams bung bcud sgra ltar sgrog: kun bzang yab yum ye shes klong du gsal: che mchog lha tshogs me ri kham nag 'bar: rang byung hūm̐ sgra grags stong 'brug sgra ldir: om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa sa twa kro ta mu ne ye swā hā: rigs brgya'i sngags ni: om̐ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ om̐ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ bzhi pa yab yum spyi'i sngags ni: om̐ hūm̐ trām̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lām̐ mām̐ pām̐ tām̐: zhes zhi ba'i sngags rnams sgra dal zhing 'jam la ring bar bzla: de nas che mchog gi sngags rnams ni: om̐ badzra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes dpal chen po'i sngags ni sgra 'bring por bzla zhing dmigs pa spro bsdu rgyud ltar bya: de nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum che mchog he ru kaḥ zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: thugs dam bskul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dug gsum sku gsum rang grol mchod pa 'bul: dug lnga rnam dag sku lnga'i klong du bshags: mtshan dpe'i brdas brgyan zhi khro'i rigs bdag la: 'du 'bral med par lus ngag yid kyis bstod: om̐ āḥhūm̐ ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta māṃ sa tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes zhi rgyas dbang drag las bzhi'i spro bsdu rnams sgrub chen bzhin bya'o: de nas shar phyogs yang dag thugs kyi 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs zla gdan lha chen bsnol ba'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon yang dag lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : om̐ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo phaṭḥ ces bzla: de nas rim pa bzhin gong gi 'dzab bskul de re re bzhin sbrags nas sngags phreng bzla: lho phyogs gshin rje la: hūm̐: lho phyogs zla gdan chu glang bsnol ba'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon sku yi lha tshogs rnams:

dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : bzlas pa ni: om̐ hrīṣṭi wiṣṭi ta na na hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas nub phyogs padma gsung la: hūm̐: nub phyogs zla gdan klu brgyad bsnol ba'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung :

ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : sngags ni: om̐ padma ta kri ta ma hā kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas byang phyogs phur pa phrin las la: hūm̐: byang phyogs zla gdan ma hā dhe wa'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon phrin las lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : om̐ badzra kī li kī li ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas shar lho'i ma mo rbod gtong la: hūm̐: shar lho'i zla gdan ma mo brtsegs pa'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon bla med lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs:

'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : om̐ ghu ya dzñā na ma hā shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri satwaṃ ma ma yo gi ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas lho nub bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa la: hūm̐: lho nub zla gdan bam chen bsnol ba'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon thod phreng lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : om̐ badzra ma hā gu ru sarba siddhi hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa thod phreng rtsal siddhi dza dzaḥ de nas nub byang 'jig rten mchod bstod la: hūm̐: nub byang zla gdan dregs pa pho mo'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon gnyis med lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu:

thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : om̐ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas byang shar dmod pa drag sngags la: hūm̐: byang shar zla gdan dgra bgegs pho mo'i steng : gsang ba zil gnon drag sngags lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thugs dam gnad nas bskul: dpal gyi chas bcu dur khrod chas brgyad spras: me dpung klong 'gying gzi brjid glog ltar 'gyu: thugs kar srog yig tha mar sngags kyis bskor: mdun bskyed zhal zhugs mas yar snying gar drangs: mchod pa'i sngags phreng 'dod yon lha mo 'phro: zil gnon sngags phreng khro bo'i gad rgyangs sgrog: dbang sdud sngags phreng sgo ma phyag mtshan 'phro: tshar gcod sngags phreng mtshon cha me zer 'phro: sreg bskrad sngags phreng me char thog rgod 'bebs: 'gugs bsgral sngags phreng pho nya skar ltar 'khrugs: srung gur sngags phreng rdo rje'i go khrab brtsegs: sgrub bsnyen sngags phreng 'od zer thag pa 'khor: stong nyid sngags phreng grags stong skye med ngang : ma gsal bar du snang stong dkyil 'khor bzung : ma grub bar du khyod nyid mi gtong ngo : om̐ badzra sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ

de nas drag po khyung gi lha tshogs rnams la: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal gsang ba zil gnon gyi: bka' sdod sprul pa'i bya khyung sde lnga'i tshogs: mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rjes skur bzhengs la: drag po phrin las thugs dam rgyud bskul phyir: snying po sngags kyi rang sgra 'brug ltar ldir: zil gnon dbang sdud tshar gcod las grub gyur: om̐ khrom̐ ga ru ṭa hūm̐ phaṭḥ sarba bha du ḍākki nī sa ma ya hriṃ hriṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces sngags rnams thun re'i las byang gzhung re re la stong las mi nyung bar bzla: sras 'khor yongs rdzogs la brgya re: yang sprul la nyer gcig: de nas spyi sngags chen mo ni: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ de nas las sbyor sham bu rnams btags pa mos pas zhi rgyas dbang drag gi sham bu kha bsgyur bya ba ni: 'jigs pa brgyad la sogs pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor pa drug puṣṭaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: khams gsum srid gsum gyi yon tan dang snang ba thams cad dbang du 'dus par gyur cig pa shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs dang gnod byed dug lnga thams cad tshar bcad par gyur cig hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ ces sgra ring thung dang che chung 'tshams pa grogs kyis go tsam brjod par bya: hūm̐ sgrub 'dir bya/ de yang dag pa gtsang ma ma 'dres pa ma chad pa ma lhag pa ma nyams pa stong skad min pa zur rno ba gtsang po cong rong 'bring po nas babs pa bzhin du bzla: srog yig mi 'gul zhing sngags phreng rnams lug rgyud sgrol ma ltar ram: mgal me 'khor ba ltar dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma bzhag par g.yeng ba'i bdud gsum spangs shing : ting 'dzin gsum dang mi 'bral bar bya: lus g.yeng ba'i sos dal: ngag g.yeng ba'i sgra chad/ sems g.yeng ba'i stong 'gyu rnams spangs:

lus phyi lhod la nang mi g.yeng ba bzla'o: de nas thun gtor spyi la sbyar ba ni: hūm̐: yang dag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: thugs kyi lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta tsitta go ro tsa na bha su ta khā hi: zhes rim pa bzhin: hūm̐: gshin rje rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: sku yi lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: gsung la: hūm̐: dbang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: gsung gi lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: zhes rim pa bzhin: phur pa phrin las la: hūm̐: phur pa rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: phrin las lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi:

ma mo rbod gtong la: hūm̐: ma mo rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: rbod gtong lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: bla ma rig 'dzin la: hūm̐: rig 'dzin rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: yon tan lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: 'jig rten mchod bstod la: hūm̐: 'jig rten rol pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: mchod bstod lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi: dmod pa drag sngags la: hūm̐: drag sngags dmod pa'i dkyil 'khor chen po nas: stobs 'dus lha tshogs phyi nang bka' sdod rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs: dug lnga dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: dkyil 'khor zab mo'i cho ga'i yan lag dang : sgra chad zur nyams ma tshang mthol lo bshags: bla med mchog gi dngos grub bdag la stsol: om̐ sarba pañtsa bha lingta ma hā māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta la khā hi:
