de nas bsgrub pa'i las rim sngags kyi rtags grangs dang lung mthun pa yang na rgyun gyi dngos grub 'don cing sngags kyi dbang bzhi zhu ba ni: hūm̐: gsang chen rol pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las klong nas bzhengs: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i skal ldan bdag cag la: 'gyur med sku yi dbang bzhi spyi bor bskur: 'gags med gsung gi dbang bzhi mgrin par bskur: 'khrul med thugs kyi dbang bzhi snying gar bskur: yon tan re skong dbang bzhi lte bar bskur: phrin las 'gro 'dul dbang bzhi gsang bar bskur: mi 'gyur mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: de ltar bsnyen cing bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha: rang byung dpal chen cho 'phrul rol pa'i rtsal: du ma ro gcig rang shar 'gags med dbyings: deng sang skya rengs ye shes klong nas shar: mi shigs rdo rje srin po nam langs nye: 'dod rgu dngos grub 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: mchog dang thun mong bde blag nyid du stsol: om̐ kā ya siddhi wākka siddhi tsitta siddhi ghu na siddhi gu hya siddhi sarba siddhi a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥhūm̐ sa ma ya siddhi siddhi dzñā na pha la hoḥ zhes sngags dbang blang : sgrub chen yin na dngos grub dang sbrags kyang chog: de ltar ma yin na spros med kyang bya: de ltar bsnyen sgrub rnams legs par brtson zhing lus ngag yid gsum rnal 'byor bzhi'i nyams len dang ldan par bya: sa ma ya: de nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bskyed par byed pa mchod pa dang tshogs la rag las yin pas: rgyu bsod nams phun sum tshogs pa'i tshogs 'khor bshams shing : dang po tshogs byin gyis brlab pa ni: chu gtsang gis bran zhing : ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: lan gsum: om̐ āḥhūm̐: gsum bya: om̐ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sogs kyis lan gsum byin gyis brlabs: om̐ swa bhā wa shuddho? sogs kyis stong par sbyang : stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i tshogs gzhong bhandha stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i nang du 'dod yon longs spyod tshogs kyi mchod rdzas sna tshogs kyi rgya mtsho chen por gyur:

om̐ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī phaiṃ phaiṃ: sarba dra byaṃ shwa dha na a mṛ ta ga ṇa pū dza a hoḥ de nas tshogs la spyan 'dren pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min phyogs bcu chos dbyings dag pa'i klong : ka dag lhun grub bde chen pho brang nas: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang yab yum la: ye shes lnga ldan zhi ba bzhi bcus bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bde chen pho brang drag po e yi klong : me ri smug nag 'khyil ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen khro rgyal che mchog he ru kaḥ khrag 'thung rgya mtsho khro bo 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: shar phyogs dur khrod me rlung dkar gsal klong : lha chen pho mo bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: thugs kyi bdag nyid badzra he ru kaḥ rigs bzhi la sogs khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: lho phyogs mnyam nyid dur khrod ser nag klong : gshin rje chu glang bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: sku yi bdag nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: rigs bzhi khro tshogs phyogs skyong 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: nub phyogs sor rtog dur khrod dmar gsal klong : klu rgyal pho mo bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: gsung gi bdag nyid dbang chen khro bo rgyal: zil gnon sgo skyong khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: byang phyogs bya grub dur khrod ljang gsal klong : ma hā dhe wa bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: phrin las bdag nyid rdo rje gzhon nu che: khro bcu phra thabs khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: shar lho klong gsal dur khrod ser nag dbus: bdud nag pho mo bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: yon tan bdag nyid bla med he ru kaḥ

ma lnga rje sman khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: lho nub dur khrod ye shes pho brang nas: nyi zla bam chen brtsegs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: zil gnon thod rtsal drag po me phreng can: rig 'dzin grub thob mkha' 'gro 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: nub byang dran rig dur khrod dmar nag klong : srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen khro rgyal dregs pa kun 'dul la: rigs bzhi sde dpon khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: byang shar rab rgyu dur khrod smug nag klong : ru tra pho mo bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dpal chen drag sngags stobs ldan nag po che: rigs bzhi sngags bdag khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: rngam brjid dur khrod rab 'bar nag po'i klong : dam sri zhing chen bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: dbang phyug ging dang zhing skyong laṅka'i gtso: sgo skyong yongs rdzogs khro tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: klu bdud gnyan rgod bsnol ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: khro rgyal sprul pa khyung chen rigs lnga la: yang sprul khro tshogs bya khyung 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: dur khrod gnas brgyad sha za 'gyu ba'i klong : dam tshig rnam bzhi skyong ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: gter bdag mgon po dpal ldan bya rog gdong : gter srung pho nya las mkhan 'bum gyis bskor: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren tshogs la gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: zhi ba'i lha tshogs gzi brjid ya la la: khro bo'i lha tshogs khrag 'thung ljibs se ljib: yi dam lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs brda gar khyugs se khyug:

chos skyong lha tshogs las byed shigs se shig: ging chen lha tshogs bro rdung khrigs se khrig: dam can lha tshogs rngam rgyug nyi li li: nor bdag lha tshogs bag dro me re re: gter bdag lha tshogs bzhad gad ya la la: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs stong khams 'u ru ru: dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang chen po 'dir: byin chen phob la dbang chen myur du bskur: tshogs rdzas rgya mtshor longs spyod bcud chen phob: 'dir 'dus skal ldan pho mo dam ldan rnams: dpa' bo rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror byin gyis rlobs: dbang bskur dkyil 'khor byin rlabs 'u ru ru: dam rdzas rgya mtsho'i bcud mchog chi li li: dngos grub rgya mtsho 'dod rgu sha ra ra: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub myur du stsol: om̐ sarba ma hā dzñā na gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī badzra sa mā ya dza dza dzaḥ de nas gral du 'khod cing 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang : dam can chos skyong srung ma ste: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ma lus kun: blang dor bral ba'i gdan la bzhugs: gzung 'dzin bral ba'i tshogs la rol: re dogs bral ba'i snang ba dgyes: gnyis 'dzin bral ba'i tshogs 'khor bskor: a la la te tshogs la hoḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha: che mchog 'dus pa'i lha tshogs la: zhal rdzas tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: mchod lha'i mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: la las nyi zla yangs pa'i snod: la las bhandha lcang lo'i snod: la las gser dngul g.yu yi snod: la las lcags zangs drag po'i snod: dpag med thogs pa bye ba 'bum: longs spyod tshogs kyi 'khor los bkang : gar dang 'khrul 'khor phyag rgya bsgyur: dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul zhing mchod: bzhes nas dbang dang dngos grub stsol: om̐ āḥhūm̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī he ru ka ghu na hrī ta sa ma ya kha kha khā hi: zhes pas dkyil 'khor phyi nang rim pa bzhin:

de nas tshogs kyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro mngar dang : reg 'jam na bza'i bye brag ji snyed kyis: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : che mchog khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : padma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bar khyams bka' sdod 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong phyi nang yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: sman raka bdud rtsi'i tshogs ni mtsho ltar 'khyil: bha ling gtor ma'i tshogs ni ri ltar spungs: sbyor sgrol mchod tshogs sprin ltar gtibs pa 'dis: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : che mchog khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : padma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bar khyams bka' sdod 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong phyi nang yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: spyan gzigs bla bre dar tshon sprin ltar gtibs:

rnga gling rol mo'i sgra snyan 'brug ltar sgrog: gzugs 'gros 'phur 'phyo'i tshogs ni lang ling gang : phyi nang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa 'dis: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : che mchog khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : padma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bar khyams bka' sdod 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong phyi nang yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : thugs dam bskangs la mchog thun dngos grub stsol: hūm̐: ga ṇa rgya mtsho ga ṇa pū dza dang : pañtsa ril bu pañtsa gam phye dang : 'bras rgyun bu ram ka ra tshogs kyi chang : zla rgyas zla khrom mar thud zho dang sbyar: mi sha rta sha khyi sha ba glang sha: co le nyo le nyi khri yag pa kaḥ tsa ru rtsi chen go snyod sga dang spod: rgun 'brum shing mngar star ga kham bu dang : ri sgog klung sgog sha mong sna tshogs dang : la phug gtsong sogs 'dod yon tshogs kyi rdzas: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas dpag med kyis: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : che mchog khro bo'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : padma gsung gi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : phur pa phrin las lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs thugs dam bskang :

bar khyams bka' sdod 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : sgo skyong phyi nang yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : gter bdag gter srung rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: g.yar dam sol la rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol:

zhes bskang zhing mchod: de nas bshags pa ni: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gnyan gyi mchod pa la: rgyu chung phud nyams lhag ma phri ba dang : dam rdzas ma tshang bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang : nya stong dus bzhi bskang ba chag pa sogs: bag med bgyi zhing dam las 'gal ba dang : ma tshang lhag chad nor 'khrul 'dzin pa zhugs: dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha skong bya: de nas bsgral ba bya ba ni: tshogs tha ma bskyed cing brub khung snod du 'gugs gzhug lan gsum bya ste phur bu thogs nas: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa'i sras: rdo rje gzhon nu phrin las yongs rdzogs pa: zhal gsum phyag drug dur khrod chas dang ldan: rtse dgu rtse lnga me dpung kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin: tha ma ri rab sras mchog phur bu bsgril: rgya mdud steng nas 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: 'chang bzung steng nas glog mar khyugs se khyug: chu srin kha nas tshwa tshwa si li li: zur gsum rtse nas me lce lhabs se lhab: dam nyams log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra bo 'di'i: dkar nag snying gi dkyil du kī la ya: om̐ badzra kī li kī la ya log tri hur thum mā ra ya rbad: ces thun btab cing rnam shes 'og min du 'phang : de nas thun rdzas brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: nyungs dkar rgyal po shwa rī raṃ: rakta rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'khrugs: 'byung ba'i dug thun rlung ltar 'tshubs: thogs med drag po las kyi thun: stobs ldan 'dus pa rdo rje'i thun: stobs chen drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: drag po thun gyis rdul du rlog: mtshon cha 'bar bas phye mar gtub: om̐ ha la ya ha la ya: chod chod gtub gtub: mā ra ya rbad bhyo rbad bhyoḥ zhes gtubs shing zhal du bstab pa ni: hūm̐: phyes shig dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i zhal phyes shig: ru tra dam sri bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: phung po khams dang rnam shes skye mched rnams:

kun bzang zhi khro rab 'byams tshogs la 'bul: bzhes shig dgyes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: rtsa sngags sham du: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la khā hi: ma hā rakta la khā hi: ma hā tsitta la khā hi: ma hā go ro tsa na la khā hi: ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: zhes sman raka gis bran la 'bul: de nas tshogs kyi dngos grub zhu ba ni: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dgongs su gsol: ngo mtshar mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: 'dir 'dus skal ldan legs par 'tshogs: dngos grub chen po stsal du gsol: de nas slob dpon gyis lan gsungs pa ni: hoḥ 'di ni ngo mtshar rmad du byung : bzang ngan 'dzin pa'i bag chags phrol: khyi dang gdol pa ci bzhin du: rang bzhin gcig tu dgongs te rol: de nas slob mas zhu ba: hoḥ ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub ste: skal ldan tshogs bsags rten 'brel che: 'dod yon sna tshogs yid 'ong gter: phun tshogs 'byor ldan e ma hoḥ de nas tshogs kyi dngos grub rol zin nas: hūm̐: bsod nams tshogs chen 'khor lo 'di'i: dge tshogs dpag yas smon lam gyis: longs spyod zad med rgyun thob cing : 'dod rgu dpal la spyod par shog: de nas lhag ma gnyis su phye ba ni: dang po phud lhag yar la mchod: om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes gsum: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i zhi khro'i lha: snang stong sgyu ma'i gar bsgyur nas: 'dir gshegs phud lhag mchod pa bzhes: thugs dam bskang zhing sor chud nas: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: om̐ gu ru dhe wa ḍākki nī sa ma ya kha kha khā hi: de nas phyi'i mchod pa ni: dkyil 'khor mu ran skyong ba rnams la 'bul: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis mi mchod rgyu: rig 'dzin gtso bo phud kyi bdag: bar du tshogs la mi rol rgyu: bka' brgyad zhi khro tshogs la dgyes: de nas lhag mas mi mchod rgyu: bran g.yog pho nya lhag la dbang : lhag ma kha chus mi bran rgyu: sngon tshe rdo rje'i dam tshig gcig:

dkyil 'khor mtha' la mi bzhag rgyu: bran g.yog pho nya'i tshul du gnas: dbyer med ro gcig mi bsre rgyu: ka dag ngang la 'khor 'das gcig: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan ma sring mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rigs bzhi shugs 'gro dbang phyug nyer brgyad dang : gnas nyul dur khrod mkha' 'gro sum cu gnyis: gnas bzang dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang 'grim: zas bzang sha la dgyes shing gar thabs sgyur: skom bzang rakta 'thung zhing bshugs glu sgrog: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon cing mkha' la 'gyu: skyogs bzang bhandha thogs shing lhag ma sdud: rten bzang dkyil 'khor srung zhing dgra srog gcod: dri bzang gsur la dgyes shing drod tshad nyul: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon rig 'dzin bka' bzhin du: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: cung zad dpag la: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud ma: ging chen bco brgyad sring mo mo bdud bzhi: 'bar ba'i pho nya sman phran tshogs dang bcas: shel ging pho mo gri thod zengs se zeng : ral pa phur bu mda' rtsal sha ra ra: sman mos bro rdung glu len kyu ru ru: rgyan cha phyag gdub sor gdub si li li: 'bar ma srin mo khrag ral g.yengs se g.yeng : nad rlung bu yug skyi bun thu lu lu: gnas bzang dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang 'grim: zas bzang sha la dgyes shing gar thabs sgyur: skom bzang rakta 'thung zhing bshugs glu sgrog: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing mkha' la 'gyu: skyogs bzang bhandha thogs shing lhag ma sdud: rten bzang dkyil 'khor srung zhing dgra srog gcod: dri bzang gsur la dgyes shing drod tshad nyul: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon rig 'dzin bka' bzhin du: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas btegs shing sman raka gis bran la: hūm̐: dpal gyi bka' nyan tshogs kyi lhag sdud ma: zhing skyong laṅka dur khrod bdag mo dang :

sman phran 'bum dang lha srin sde brgyad bcas: mi sdug gzugs 'chang 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrog: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs hab sha len: gnas bzang dur khrod pho brang tshogs khang 'grim: zas bzang sha la dgyes shing gar thabs bsgyur: skom bzang rakta 'thung zhing bshugs glu sgrog: gos bzang g.yang gzhi gyon zhing mkha' la 'gyu: skyogs bzang bhandha thogs shing lhag ma sdud: rten bzang dkyil 'khor srung zhing dgra srog gcod: dri bzang gsur la dgyes shing drod tshad nyul: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe slob dpon rig 'dzin bka' bzhin tu: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ ma hā shrī he ru ka sa ma ya dhe wi kro ti sarba dharma pā la kṣe ṭa pa la kha kha khā hi: om̐ āḥhūm̐ u tstshiṣṭa sa mu ṭa ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi: om̐ badzra dunti na gnod byed byad ma rbod gtong phur kha ngan pa dgra bo log 'dren rnams la bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces phul zhing phrin las bcol ba la: de nas thugs dam bskang ba dang tha tshig gnad nas bskul ba ni: hūm̐: mi mngon dbyings nas rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs: āḥ bzhengs shig skye med longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs: om̐: bskul lo mtha' yas sangs rgyas thob sar bskul: trām̐ḥ mdzod cig khams gsum 'khor ba stongs par mdzod: hūm̐: chos dbyings skye med ka dag pho brang nas: āḥ longs spyod rdzogs sku zhi khro bka' brgyad lha: om̐: dus gsum bdag gi sprul sku thams cad can: trām̐ḥ dam rdzas mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: hrīḥ mtha' yas sems can 'dren pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chos nyid zang thal rgya yan pho brang nas: kun tu bzang po chos sku 'od mi 'gyur: shes rab yum chen bzang mo zung 'jug 'khril: yab yum rigs bzhi sems dpa' thub drug bcas: zhi ba bzhi bcu'i dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma bcos lhun grub rgyal ba thugs dam can:

mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje skur bzhengs la: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mthar gyur tshe: dmu rgod sems can 'dul ba'i dus la bab: las ngan dbang gis sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i tshogs: nyon mongs srid pa'i rgya mtsho gting ring por: nyam thag 'khor cing duḥkha myong lags pas: thugs rje che khyed phrin las dus la bab: mar gyur sems can pha ma rigs drug rnams: 'dren pa'i lcags kyu'i thugs rje'i 'od 'phros te: nyon mongs las kyi dbang du gtong ra re: rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong ra re: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: 'gro kun byang chub thob pa'i phrin las mdzod: de nas khro bo spyi bskul ni: hūm̐: dbus phyogs me dpung khrag zhag e yi klong : nyi zla padma byol song gtso brgyad steng : bcom ldan dpal chen che mchog he ru kasaḥ gnam zhal yum sbyor gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi khro bcu sgo skyong lce spyang tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig khrag 'thung thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi ru tra bsnol ba'i steng : dpal chen yang dag badzra he ru kas: kro ti yum sbyor gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi gnas yul sgo skyong dbang phyug tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig khrag 'thung thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐: lho phyogs dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi chu glang bsnol ba'i steng : dpal chen khro bo 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: bhe ta yum sbyor gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi phyogs skyong sgo skyong shan bdud tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig gshin rje thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub phyogs dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi klu bdud bsnol ba'i steng : dpal chen khro bo padma dbang gi lhas: gzi ldan yum sbyor gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi zil gnon sgo skyong gcan spyang tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig gsung mchog thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang phyogs dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi ma hā dhe wa'i steng : khro rgyal phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu ches: rgyas 'debs yum sbyor gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi khro bcu sgo skyong phur srung tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig phrin las thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐: shar lhor dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi ma mo brtsegs pa'i steng : khro rgyal che mchog bla med he ru kas: nyid zhi yum 'khril gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: ma lnga rje sman skyong ba ma mo'i tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig bla med thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: lho nub dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi bam chen bsnol ba'i steng : bcom ldan dpal chen thod phreng drag po rtsal: rnal 'byor yum 'khril gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi bka' brgyad sgo skyong mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig rig 'dzin thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nub byang dur khrod me dpung klong dkyil nas: zla gam pad nyi lha chen bsnol ba'i steng : khro rgyal khrag 'thung dregs pa kun 'dul pas: spyi 'dus yum sbyor gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi sgo skyong sde dpon dregs pa'i tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig khro rgyal thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: byang shar zla gam dgra bgegs bsnol ba'i steng :

mthu stobs khro rgyal drag sngags he ru kas: 'byung lnga'i yum 'khril gzi brjid stong khams 'gengs: rigs bzhi drag sngags sgo skyong dregs pa'i tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig dmod pa thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: pho brang dur khrod 'khor yug phyi nang gi: zhing chen bam chen ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan: mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ging chen zhing skyong dang : laṅka 'bar ma ma sring phur 'debs dang : sgo skyong pho nya sa bdag mkha' 'gro ma: dus bzhi tshe ring brtan ma dgra 'dul tshogs: khro gtum 'jigs rngam rgod gshe dpa' stobs dgyes: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig dregs pa thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐:gsang chen dur khrod me ri rtsub pa'i klong : ru tra dam nyams bsnol ba'i khri steng du: gter bdag khrag 'thung las mgon bya rog gdong : gter srung seng gdong ma gza' rdo rje legs: khrag ral dung skyong btsan rgod bswe khrab can: ma mo bye ba sha za sman gyi tshogs: dur khrod chas rdzogs rno dbal mtshon cha gzengs: bskul lo bzhengs shig gnyer gtad thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i dus la bab: hūm̐: ri rgyal mchog rab lhun po yangs pa'i steng : dpag bsam gdugs btsugs shing gi pho brang dbus: gdol pa dkar nag bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng :

srog gzan bya khyung sprul pa sde dgu la: yang sprul nyid sprul bye ba 'bum gyis bskor: krang kring sgra sgrogs rus pa'i rgyan drug mdzes: sa bdag klu gnyan ma rungs srog rtsa sdud: bskul lo bzhengs shig bya khyung thugs dam can: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma rungs sde dgu log 'dren zhing bcu'i dgra: bstan la sdang zhing bdag la 'khu ba rnams: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shrī he ru ka ghu na tri ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya: phaiṃ dza li bhyo ya: dgra bgegs kyi māṃ sa rakta go ro tsa na bha su ta kha kha khā hi: om̐ ma hā du na ya byad ma dgra bgegs e dza ya bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: mā ra ya rbad bhyoḥ

phyi rol du 'bul na gtor ma zor ltar me dpung dang mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen gyi rang bzhin du bsam zhing 'phangs kyang rung : bzlog pa'i nang du 'bul na khā hi'i yan gyi sngags bskul zhing bgrang bar bya: de nas zor chen 'phen pa ni: gtor ma raktas bran cing : hūm̐: nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ nga ni snang srid yongs kyi gtso: nga ni che btsan 'gran zla bral: nga ni dgra bgegs gshed ma mchog: khro rgyal thugs las sprul pa yi: bka' sdod las mkhan bye ba 'bum: sgrol ba'i mtshon thogs sha ra ra: sra ba'i go gyon si li li: gtor zor thog mda' wa la la: dmod pa'i sngags sgra 'u ru ru: dar nag g.yab mo lings se ling : ru mtshon ba dan lhabs se lhab: bdud zhags dgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: yang sprul gcan gzan dur bya 'gyed: sha zan khrag 'thung kyu ru ru: rbad do bskul lo mthu ma chung : dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: sha zo khrag 'thung nang rul dkrugs: yul phung mkhar shigs skyabs dang phrol: myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma hā kā la thun bhyoḥ nag po kha la sum 'dril: dgra bgegs kyi sha la zo: yaṃ shud rbad bhyoḥ thun chod mā ra ya shig shig: ces gtor ma dgra bo'i phyogs su 'phang ngo : de nas chad mdo gyer ba ni: rnga brdung dung bus raktas bran zhing gtor ma la dpal 'bar sgron dza gad rnam lnga sbrengs shing : sngon gyi tha tshig rnams bsgrag pa 'di skad do: hūm̐: sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa'i dang po la: 'og min chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang du: thog ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum gyis: longs sku'i rtsal snang phra mo la brten nas: ye shes lnga ldan gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang : rtag chad mu bzhi dam la btags pa'i tshe: gdod ma'i gshis lugs snga ma thams cad dang : 'gyu ba'i tshogs drug gnyis snang bar gyi rigs: thob pa phyi ma snga lus thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang :

g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub bar mdzod: de 'og dbyings kyi tha tshig gnyis pa la: bcom ldan dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kas: mi phyed rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: las kyi ma mo dam la btags pa'i tshe: kau rī la sogs gnas kyi ma mo brgyad: singha la sogs yul gyi phra men brgyad: stag gdong la sogs ye shes sgo ma bzhis: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: de 'og bar bskal tha tshig gsum pa la: ston pa byang chub rdo rje chos dang ni: mkha' 'gro las dbang ye shes gtso mo yis: dgongs brgyud 'od gsal dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: log lta bdud rigs dam la btags pa'i tshe: mkha' 'gro dbang phyug ma rgyud thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: tha tshig bzhi pa mchod rten bde byed drung : grub thob 'dus pa rig 'dzin rgya mtsho yis: brda brgyud gter gyi dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: mu stegs 'byung po dam la btags pa'i tshe:

dregs pa'i sde dpon sha za ma lus kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og bar bskal tha tshig lnga pa la: bsam yas mchims phu dpal gyi pho brang du: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang : slob ma'i dwangs ma ye shes grogs lnga yis: sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: lha srin sde brgyad dam la btags pa'i tshe: rgyal po la sogs dregs pa bco brgyad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: de 'og bar bskal tha tshig drug pa la: dpal ri padma 'od kyi gzhal yas su: slob dpon chen po snang srid zil gnon dang : rnal 'byor sngags 'chang rdo rje bdud 'dul gyis: gsang rgya mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor zhal phyes nas: las kyi ma bdud dam la btags pa'i tshe: chos skyong pho nya las mkhan thams cad kyis: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: de 'og lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la:

sbas gnas chen po padma bkod pa ru: gter bdag gling pa gdong can mkha' 'gro gnyis: zab gter sgo 'byed dus la bab pa'i tshe: bya rog gdong dang zhing skyong mgon po sogs: btsan rgod ma bdun gter sgrom dngos gtad de: so so'i gzugs mchog dngos su bstan nas kyang : g.yar dam can la dngos grub stsol ba dang : bka' yi gtor ma len par ma chad dam: rnal 'byor tshe srog bsring bar ma chad dam: bcol ba'i phrin las bsgrub par ma chad dam: sngon tshe khas blangs dam las ma 'da' bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las rnam bzhi thogs med 'grub pa dang : rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ badzra bha ka si kro ti shwa ri ḍākki nī: dzwa ka dzwa ki ni: sarba dharma pā la ya: a ya ma du ru tsa sha na: sa ma ya: badzra tsa tri du ging ka ra ya du: rā hu la ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha: kṣe ṭa pa la ya i daṃ ba liṃ ta la kha kha khā hi: zhes tha tshig bsgrags shing gtor ma dgra phyogs su 'phang : gser skyems bcas nas 'bul: de nas brtan ma skyong ba ni: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas kyi: dam la gnas pa'i ma sring brtan ma sman: bdag nyid chen po rdo rje kun grags mo: dpal ldan ha ri rdo rje g.ya' ma skyong : gangs dkar sha med rdo rje kun tu bzang : 'brog chen kun 'dus rdo rje bgegasakyi gtso: brtan ma skyong ba'i ma sring mched bzhi rnams: lhab lhub dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: sil snyan sgra ldan gar bsgyur sgeg pa mos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: gangs kyi yum chen rdo rje g.yu bun ma: kha rag khyung btsun rdo rje dpal gyi yum: gser chen mkha' lding rdo rje klu mo skyong : rma ri rab 'byams rdo rje drag mo rgyal: sman mo chen mo mthu chen khyed bzhi yang : lhab lhub dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras:

sil snyan sgra ldan gar sgyur sgeg pa mos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: kong btsun de mo rdo rje bod khams skyong : btsan la rol pa'i rdo rje sman gcig ma: sman btsun ug chos rdo rje g.yar mo sil: g.yu yi dril bu rdo rje si le ma: gnod sbyin bdud mo mthun chen khyed bzhi yang : lhab lhub dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras: sil snyan sgra ldan gar sgyur sgeg pa mos: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: brtan ma skyong ba'i ma sring sman gyi tshogs: sngon tshe slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang : slob ma mthu chen rlangs chen dpal seng gis: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing chen gdan la bzhugs: dam tshig gnyan gyi bdud rtsi lce la btab: tha tshig dbang gis rdo rje cod pan bstan: dbang rtags phur pa lag tu gtad nas kyang : da rung khyed rnams 'jig rten ma 'das pas: byang chub thob pa'i sa bon ma chung ste: 'jig rten ma 'das bar du dam bca' gyis: ci bzhin bka' bsgos tha tshig mi dran nam: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i gral du bzhag nas kyang : ma 'ongs thar pa thob pa'i lung yang bstan: sngon tshe zhal bzhes dam la ma g.yel bar: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: om̐ badzra ma ma hriṃ hriṃ le le te te bha ka si bhakṣa ḍākki sa ma ya kha kha khā hi: zhes phul zhing phrin las bcol: de nas gtor gzhong 'og tu dam sri lan gsum bkug la kha sbub bo: rta bro brdung ba ni: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: gti mug chos dbyings ngang nyid las: che mchog buddha he ru kar: zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra zlum por me long dang : rdo rje gar thabs bde 'gros te: dngul lam dkar po'i shing rigs la:

mgo bo rgya mdud rdo rjes mtshan: 'chang bzung zlum po chu srin dbal: zhi ba'i sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas 'jigs brgyad zhi: btab par gyur pa smos ci dgos: zhi bar ma gyur gang yang med: zhi mdzad lha tshogs khyed la bstod: om̐ om̐ 'jigs brgyad mi mthun pa'i tshogs thams cad zhi ba shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: nga rgyal mnyam nyid ngang nyid las: che mchog ratna he ru kar: rgyas pa'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra gru bzhi lhun grub ngang : rin chen gar thabs sgrog 'gros te: gser ram ser po'i shing rigs la: mgo bo rgya mdud rin chen mtshan: 'chang bzung gru bzhi chu srin dbal: rgyas par ma gyur gang yang med: rgyas mdzad lha tshogs khyed la bstod: swa swa tshe dang bsod nams longs spyod mnga' thang rgyas par gyur cig: puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: 'dod chags sor rtog ngang nyid las: che mchog padma he ru kar: dbang gi lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra zla gam bde stong ngang : padma gar thabs brda 'gros ngang : zangs sam dmar po'i shing rigs la: mgo bo rgya mdud padmas mtshan: 'chang bzung zla gam chu srin dbal: dbang gi sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas khams gsum sdud: btab par gyur na smos ci dgos: dbang du ma 'dus gang yang med: dbang sdud lha tshogs khyed la bstod: a ā lha 'dre mi gsum thams cad dbang du 'du bar gyur cig: om̐ wā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las rdzogs: phrag dog bya grub ngang nyid las: che mchog karma he ru kar: drag po'i lha tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: bro ra gru gsum bdud 'dul ngang : rgya gram gar thabs rtse 'gros te: lcags sam drag po'i shing rigs la:

mgo bo rgya mdud rgya gram mtshan: 'chang bzung zur gsum chu srin dbal: drag po'i sngags dang lha tshogs ni: ngos la bkod pas dgra bdud bzhir: btab par gyur na smos ci dgos: sgrol bar ma gyur gang yang med: dgra 'dul lha tshogs khyod la bstod: hūm̐ hūm̐ bdud dang dam sri la sogs pa nyon mongs brgyad khri bzhi stong gi bdud thams cad brlag par gyur cig: hūm̐ mā ra ya phaṭḥ om̐ nan: āḥnan: hūm̐ nan: mā ra ya nan nan rbad rbad: ces so: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar bslang zhing mchod pa 'bul me tog 'thor ro: bzlog pa yin na las byang rgyud ltar bya: dngos grub 'gugs pa ni: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha: byin rlabs rmad byung 'dod rgu 'byung ba'i dpal: deng 'dir sgrub pa'i rig 'dzin bdag cag la: sku gsung thugs kyi dbang mchog bskur ba dang : 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'od gsal chos kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: zab gsang gter gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: snang gsal pra yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: snyan grags dpal gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: che btsan mthu yi dngos grub stsal du gsol: nus rtsal stobs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: gzi byin mdangs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: bkrag legs rgyan gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'jam phrug gos kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: rgyud 'dzin srid kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: 'dzad med nor gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dpa' rtsal gyad kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol: dbang sdud zil gnon dngos grub stsal du gsol: mchog thun lhun grub 'bad med chu bo'i rgyun: nam yang g.yo med rtag tu longs spyod shog: rtsa sngags mthar: om̐ kā ya siddhi: wākka siddhi: tsitta siddhi: sa ma ya siddhi pha la a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥhūm̐: zhes dngos grub blangs shing 'dod gsol sogs gang mos bya: de nas tshe 'gugs rgyas pa tshe sgrub ltar ram:

bsdu na: hūm̐: dpal chen 'dus pa'i pho brang lho nub mtshams: zla gam rin chen padma dar 'bol steng : 'chi med dbang po rig 'dzin thod pa rtsal: tshe dbang rigs bzhi rig 'dzin grub thob brgyad: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mgyogs ma 'bum gyis bskor: phyag na mda' dar tshe yi bum pa 'dzin: lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril 'dzin ma: dbang sdud lha mo tshe 'dzin mgyogs ma 'bum: steng 'og phyogs bcu'i lha mi'i tshe bcud mdangs: 'od zer sna lnga'i sbu gur nar gyis drangs: rig 'dzin sgrub pa'i lus la 'ub kyis bsdus: phyi nang rtsa khams 'khor lor ltem gyis gang : 'ja' lus rig 'dzin rdo rje'i srog tu bsgrub: nam yang mi shigs rdo rje'i ri rab ltar: sra brtan 'gyur med tshe yi dbang thob shog: om̐ badzra gu ru ā yurdzñā na bhe: de nas tshe ril dang tshe chang rnams rol zhing : mda' dar lnga dang bum pa'i dbang blangs shing : rjes bzod gsol ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor zab mo gnyan gyi sgor zhugs nas: bskyed rim sgyu ma ci bzhin ma gsal zhing : gdos gzugs lha ru 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: rdzogs rim 'od gsal stong nyid ma rtogs nas: rtag chad a 'thas gol ba mthol lo bshags: bzlas brjod grags stong brag char ma rtogs nas: sgra 'dzin bzang ngan bltas pa mthol lo bshags: dkyil 'khor spro bsdu rtsal snang ma shes nas: bdag mdun ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: mchod rdzas tshogs gtor bsod nams ma shes nas: phud nyams lhag ma phri ba mthol lo bshags: sbyor sgrol tshogs 'khor yi dam dam tshig la: gnyis 'dzin sme bar rtog pa mthol lo bshags: gsang spyod gnad bdun mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig la: skal med log ltar smras pa mthol lo bshags: dam tshig snying khrag gsang bar 'os pa la: nor 'dod ngo dgar byin pa mthol lo bshags: dug lnga ma spangs ye shes yin pa la: bzang ngan blang dor 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: shes rab gzungs ma dkyil 'khor yin pa la:

gsang mtshams 'das dang smod pa mthol lo bshags: rtsa rlung pho nya grol lam yin pa la: dug lnga kha 'byams shor ba mthol lo bshags: rdo rje mched lcam dam tshig gcig pa la: sgro skur skyon du bltas pa mthol lo bshags: sems can rigs drug pha ma'i rang bzhin la: nga bdag phyogs ris 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: rgyu 'bras dkar nag bslu med yin pa la: blang dor tshul bzhin ma bgyis mthol lo bshags: theg dman 'gog pa gol sar ma shes nas: sdug bsgur mtho rlom rang bcing mthol lo bshags: longs spyod bsod nams g.yeng bdud yin pa la: phyi rgyud bsgrubs nas nor 'gugs byas pa bshags: rang sems ngo mthong sangs rgyas yin pa la: dmigs gtad zhing khams smon pa mthol lo bshags: sems can sangs rgyas rang rgyud gcig pa la: bzang ngan gnyis su 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: ma bcos rang shar gnas lugs yin pa la: dgag sgrub lhan pa 'debs pa mthol lo bshags: chos dbyings lhun grub phyi nang med pa la: gnas 'gyu re dogs bsrung ba mthol lo bshags: rang lus dkyil 'khor longs spyod mchod pa la: lto bcad mchod rdzas rloms pa mthol lo bshags: rtsa khams zhi khro rab 'byams yin pa la: mtshan ma'i stong gzugs bsgom pa mthol lo bshags: ka dag rdzogs chen ye grol yin pa la: sa lam rim bgrod smon pa mthol lo bshags: skye med gshis lugs ye grol yin pa la: lta stangs mtshan mar 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: dkar nag dge sdig blang dor ma shes par: dkon mchog dkor la 'bag pa mthol lo bshags: khas grags dbang che dmyal ba'i sa bon la: ches cher 'bad pas bsgrub pa mthol lo bshags: yul snang bden med sgyu ma yin pa la: so nam phyi chas byas pa mthol lo bshags: sems can pha ma snying rje'i yul gyur la: khro gtum sdang tshig bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: hūm̐: dkyil 'khor zab mo gsang ba'i dal bzung nas: phyi nang bskyed rdzogs cha lag nor ba dang : ma 'byor 'khrul dang bag med rkyen gyur pas:

zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho la: sku yi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: gsung gi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: thugs kyi dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: yon tan dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: phrin las dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: rtsa ba bzhi dang ltung ba la sogs pa: so thar sdom pa nyams pa mthol lo bshags: mthol lo bshags so byang zhing dag par shog:

ces yi ge brgya pas lhag chad bkang : de nas dkyil 'khor bsdu ba ni: hoḥ dur khrod srung 'khor mi dmigs mtha' dang bral: gzhal yas khang bsdu 'khor rnams yum la thim: yum yab dam tshig ye shes sems dpar thim: ting 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje hūm̐ la thim: zhabs kyu ha khog mgo sked zla tshes thim: thig le nā da mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang : ka dag chos dbyings skye med ā ru ldang : aḥ.aḥ.āḥ zhes dmigs med ngo bo skyong : dang po dkyil 'khor spro ba yang : gzhi chos sku'i rtsal las lam rgyu ma 'gags pa'i dkyil 'khor: de la sprul sku chu nang gi nya ldang ba lta bu'i yi dam lha'i rol pa ste: lugs su 'byung ba'i dus: ci'i phyir zhe na: gzhi med stong pa'i rtsal mdangs las: ma 'gags rmi lam wa ler shar: gnyis 'dzin re dogs rlung las grub: de phyir lugs su 'byung ba'o: zhes pa'i don yin pas: tha ma bsdu ba yang nyi ma'i zer nyi mar ldog: chu'i rba rlabs rang mal thim: 'gyu ba dang po rim nas rang byung la brtseg: 'jig yang mkha' la thim: de bzhin dkyil 'khor spro ba yang : chos nyid ces pa: gzhi ma bcos pa rang sems nas spros: bsdu ba yang rig pa'i rang rtsal rig par bsdu ba lug ldog ces pas: rgyu med pas na mtshan ma med: rang bzhin med pa bya ba'i lam: ci phyir 'bras bus so 'cha' 'o: zhes pa'i don yin pa rang byung gzhi'i dkyil 'khor ngos bzung zhing : ma bcos spros bral āḥzhes mnyam par bzhag: de nas bsngo ba ni: hoḥ sna tshogs sgyu ma sems can lag pa'i gar: nyon mongs srid pa'i rgya mtsho cher snyog rnams: bla med byang chub go 'phang thob phyir bsngo: srid pa'i 'dam bur chags pa'i chos med dang : bag med dred po skal chad ngang ring rnams: mos gus blo sna yar la bskyed phyir bsngo: sgyu ma'i grong du mtha' med 'khor ba rnams: snga phyir dge bcus tshogs bsags chung lags pas: dge tshogs bla med lam la 'jug phyir bsngo:

rigs drug gnas su duḥkha myong bzhin bsnyeg: bslu brid snang ba ngan goms a 'thas pa: rang ngo shes phyir bag yod brten par bsngo: sdug bsngal me 'obs 'khor ba'i btson ra ru: bzod dka' myong ba rgyu 'bras las kyis phyes: de rnams phra zhib bstan phyir dge ba bsngo: gnas lugs don la rmongs pa'i chos gzugs tshogs: nyan bshad drang don mgo 'khor 'byams pa'i rigs: rtsol med dam bca' bral ba'i dge ba bsngo: mtshan ma'i bag chags sgrib pa 'thug pos g.yogs: gnyis 'dzin lam la kha yan 'byams pa dag: rang shes rig pa gnyis 'dzin bral bar bsngo: mtha' yas 'gro kun mar gyur sems can rnams: rdzogs sangs rgyas pa'i lam mchog ci bzhin du: gegs med byang chub thob phyir bdag gis bsngo: de nas smon lam bya ba ni: hoḥ zhi khro 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho yi: phyi nang bla med rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: tshe rabs yi dam lha dang mjal bar shog: bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i nyams len lhur blangs nas: rang gzhan don kun lhun gyis 'grub par shog: so thar nyan thos theg pa'i gzhi bzung nas: bsam gtan blo yi bag yod brten par shog: kṛ ya rgyud gsum theg pa'i gling bzung nas: gsang mdzod chos kyi brda don rtogs par shog: ma hā a ti 'od gsal rgyud bzung nas: du ma ro gcig ting 'dzin myong bar shog: mkha' 'gro'i rtags rgya shog ser brda brgyud nas: tshe rabs chos la gegs skyon mi 'byung shog: las can skal ldan chos 'di spyod pa'i tshe: bar chod bral zhing don gnyis 'grub par shog: bshad sgrub spel dang chos 'di dar ba'i yul: lo legs nad zhi dmag 'khrug mi 'byung shog: nyams su len cing tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i tshogs: chos skyong srung mas bka' bstan skyong bar shog: bla med dkyil 'khor 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs: smon lam don ldan zab chos mtha' rgyas shog: ces bsngo smon bya zhing legs lam bcu'i rgyu tshogs la gcig sgril bya'o:

de nas bkra shis brjod: hūm̐: chos sku'i bkra shis kun bzang thog ma'i mgon: ka dag chos dbyings rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: longs sku'i bkra shis rdor sems 'od mi 'gyur: sna tshogs rgyal sa zin pa'i bkra shis shog: sprul sku'i bkra shis bla ma rdo rje 'dzin: brgyud 'dzin nyi ltar gsal ba'i bkra shis shog: lta ba'i bkra shis zang thal thig le'i klong : 'od gsal gnas lugs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: sgom pa'i bkra shis ye grol khyab brdal ngang : gshis lugs tshad la 'khyol ba'i bkra shis shog: spyod pa'i bkra shis phyogs bral gtad med ngang : tshogs drug snang ba shar grol bkra shis shog: gzhi yi bkra shis khregs chod zab mo'i klong : chos nyid zad sar 'khyol ba'i bkra shis shog: lam gyi bkra shis 'dzin med rgya yan ngang : re dogs bdud las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog: 'bras bu'i bkra shis 'khor 'das gnyis su med: sems can sangs rgyas 'brel ba'i bkra shis shog: ngo bo'i bkra shis snang ba ma 'gags pa: 'dzin med lhug bzhag grol ba'i bkra shis shog: rang bzhin bkra shis skye med gzhi rtsa bral: 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bkra shis shog: thugs rje'i bkra shis 'khor 'das skyed pa'i gzhi: yin lugs tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: bde ba'i bkra shis gdod nas sdug bsngal bral: spros bral ro gcig rtogs pa'i bkra shis shog: gsal ba'i bkra shis phyi nang sgrib g.yogs bral: gti mug ngo bo rang gsal bkra shis shog: mi rtog bkra shis smra brjod bsam las 'das: yod med blo 'das rig pa'i bkra shis shog: rtsa yi bkra shis dbu ma 'khor lo lnga: shes rab gsal ba rig ma'i bkra shis shog: rtsa rlung bkra shis srog 'dzin sna tshogs 'gyu: rang dbang thob par 'byongs pa'i bkra shis shog: thig le'i bkra shis bcu drug dpa' bo'i lam: 'bebs ldog rgyud la khel ba'i bkra shis shog: sangs rgyas bkra shis ston pa o rgyan pa:

klong dgu lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis shog: chos kyi bkra shis rdzogs chen sa ya stong : nam mkha'i mtha' yas khyab pa'i bkra shis shog: dge 'dun bkra shis rje 'bangs ther 'bum khri: zab chos nyi ma rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: bla ma'i bkra shis rig 'dzin gar gyi bdag: brgyud pa dgu ldan 'byung ba'i bkra shis shog: yi dam bkra shis che mchog he ru kaḥ dngos grub rgya mtsho rnyed pa'i bkra shis shog: mkha' 'gro'i bkra shis ma gcig las kyi dbang : gsang mdzod rgyud dgu rnyed pa'i bkra shis shog: zhi ba'i bkra shis longs sku bye ba stong : lnga ldan zhing khams mthong ba'i bkra shis shog: khro bo'i bkra shis 'bar ba khrag 'thung stong : gzi brjid gar dgu 'gyed pa'i bkra shis shog: sku yi bkra shis 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: snang srid zil gyis gnon pa'i bkra shis shog: gsung gi bkra shis rta mgrin khro bo'i rgyal: drag sngags 'brug ltar ldir ba'i bkra shis shog: thugs kyi bkra shis yang dag he ru kaḥ dkyil 'khor rtsal dgu rdzogs pa'i bkra shis shog: yon tan bkra shis ma mo rbod gtong lha: 'byung lnga dbang du 'dus pa'i bkra shis shog: phrin las bkra shis rdo rje phur pa'i lha: las bzhi phrin las 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: dkyil 'khor bkra shis rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs: tshe rabs chos rgyud zin pa'i bkra shis shog: gnyis bsdus bkra shis 'jig rten mchod bstod lha: mchod rdzas bcud tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog: yongs 'dus bkra shis dregs pa mthu yi mchog: bstan dgra tshar bar gcod pa'i bkra shis shog: chos skyong bkra shis zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : mthu rtsal dpal shugs bskyed pa'i bkra shis shog: gter srung bkra shis las mgon bya rog gdong : zab chos mel tshe 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog: gtad rgya bkra shis ma gza' rdor legs btsan: skal med bdud rigs tshar gcod bkra shis shog:

phyi nang dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs bkra shis shog: ces me tog 'thor zhing : sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ kho bo bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan rjes 'brang dang : smon lam las can chos bdag bu yi don: bka' brgyad yang snying gsang ba zil gnon bzhag: dbang gi rgyal mo ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: sangs rgyas ye shes rje 'bangs grogs lnga rnams: zab gter brda dang rgya rtags ri mo dang : gter gyi sgrom bu 'di nyid sbas pa'i yul: 'don dang spel ba'i sa rtags dus dang skabs: lo zla rten 'brel la sogs bstan pa ni: mi brjed zungs la snying gi dkyil du chongs: kha byang lung byang gter byang yang byang bzhi: snyan brgyud bka' gtad lung bstan zab rgya'i skor: kho bo'i bka' ltar 'dzin 'chang spel bar gyis: 'o ma'i rgya mtsho chos dka' mang lags kyang : snying thig zab mo 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rgyud sde lung gi bshad pa mang lags kyang : kha tshang don 'dus 'di 'dra sbas pa med: rtsa ba'i sgrub thabs rgya chen sbas lags kyang : phyi nang gsang gsum gcig dril 'di 'dra med: zab khyad bzhi tshang ma 'ongs yang mtha'i chos: 'di nyid 'don dang spel ba'i dus rtags ni: sum cu kha ral nyi shu'i dus dang mnyam: dus rtags sa steng bdud kyis g.yo zhing 'joms: de dus zab chos 'di dang 'phrad par shog: bu la sprod cig las mgon bya rog gdong : bka' brgyad gter srung zhing skyong lha klu dang : ma gza' rdor legs btsan rgod khyed la bcol: dus la bab tshe gter bdag gling la sprod: chos 'dis bar chod skal ngan dbang po snubs: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gu hya: gtad rgya: gnyan rgya: spel rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas: rab byung bcu gnyis pa'i lcags byi lor gser 'phyang zhes pa'i hor zla bcu pa'i nyer lngar 'brug gi dus su padma sbas pa'i lung :

pha bong bya rog sha la rngam pa 'dra ba'i rke 'og mtsho 'khor rba rlabs drag tu 'phyo ba'i klong nas/ khrom lnga bcu'i skor dang bcas nas kun gyi mthong bar khrom gter du gdan drangs pa'i tshe/ gter srung gnod sbyin seng gdong gis gter sgrom dngos su gtad de spyan drangs shing*/ gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser zheng sor lnga dkyus 'khyud do'i tshad tsam gyi ngos su sha za mkha' 'gro'i yi ger 'dug pa nas/ chu glang lor zla tshes yar skar tshes bcu o rgyan gyi dus chen du zhal bshus so// // cha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: spyan 'dren tshangs pa'i gdung dbyangs bzhugs so: rol mo sna tshogs drag tu 'khrol la sha chen bsreg cing rkang gling gtser: spos dud btang nas dbyangs dang bcas la 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'og min lhun grub chos dbyings dag pa'i klong : me ri smug nag 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: che mchog zhi khro rab 'byams gshegs su gsol: rtsub 'gyur me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod chen po nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: shes rab gsang ba mchog gi dur khrod nas: padma gsung gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: kī li kī la sgrog pa'i dur khrod nas: phur pa phrin las lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: gtum drag tshang tshing 'khrigs pa'i dur khrod nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: rngam pa ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas: drag po rig 'dzin 'dus pa gshegs su gsol: u tsa la yi dur khrod chen po nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: gsang chen rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: ro langs srin mo tshogs pa'i dur khrod nas: sgo ma dam can chos skyong gshegs su gsol: khrag zhag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod nas:

gter bdag gter srung yongs rdzogs gshegs su gsol: zhi ba'i lha tshogs gzi brjid ya la la: drag po'i lha tshogs hūm̐ sgra di ri ri: ging chen dpa' bo'i bro rdung khrigs se khrig: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i gar byed khyugs se khyug: dpa' mo mdangs ldan glu len kyu ru ru: dam can chos skyong las byed shigs se shig: bka' gter srung ma myur mgyogs sha ra ra: byin rlabs char rgyun sprin tshogs thibs se thib: mthu stobs gzi byin me dpung 'u ru ru: dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs spungs se spung : byin chen 'bebs phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dbang bzhi bskur phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: phrin las bsgrub phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dgra bgegs bsgral phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: thugs dam bskul phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ a be sha ya a āḥ zhes byin dbab cing spyan drangs: zhi ba'i lha tshogs rnams dbus kyi dkyil 'khor: drag po'i lha tshogs gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: gtso bo brgyad kyi lha tshogs phyi rim lha'i dkyil 'khor du: mngon rtogs ltar bzhugs par bsam: de yang ye shes pa phebs pa'i rtags su khang khyim drod kyis tsha bun du 'khyil ba dang : lus g.yo ba sbrid pa 'bar zhing 'gul ba zil chem du 'phro ba dang : nyams 'bar dgod spro ba dang thugs dam gsal ba sogs 'byung : de ltar ma byung gi bar du yang yang spyan drangs shing bstims nas mi dmigs pa'i dbang bzhi yang blang : sa ma ya: dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams phal cher dregs pa ltar 'dug kyang : don la che mchog zhi khro'i rtsal las grub pa'i khro bo yin: ci'i phyir zhe na: zla ba ku mu'i gza' skar chu shar bzhin: so sor snang yang gzhi rgyu skor bu gcig: ces gsungs pa ltar: zhi khro'i rtsal yin no: de bzhin gsungs: sangs rgyas sems can gzhi gcig yang :

ma bsgom pa la sangs mi rgyas: zhes pa ltar: bskyed rdzogs kyi rtsal sbyang zhing : don gyi gzhi cha bzung bar bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling nas zhal bshus so// // ja) ༈ sman mchod mtshan don sbyar bar spro na/ mched lcam bdud rtsi'i thigs gtor la/ bla ma kun bzang rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' rab rdo rje dang*/ /shrī singha 'jam dpal bshes gnyen zhabs/ /bka' bab grub pa'i slob dpon rnam brgyad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ /'chi med rdo rje'i rig 'dzin padma 'byung*/ /phyag chen tshe dbang sa la gnas pa dang*/ /lhun gyis grub pa'i rdo rje'i rig 'dzin la/ sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin bde chen mtsho rgyal lcam/ /gnubs ston la sogs bod kyi grub chen brgyad/ /zab gter mnga' bdag rtsa gsum gling pa la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ gang de'i gsang gsum sprul pa'i zlos gar dang*/ /zab gsang chos kyi bdag por lung bstan pa'i/ /rtsa brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma thams cad la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ che mchog yang dag gshin rje padma dbang*/ /phur pa rbod gtong rig 'dzin dregs 'dul dang*/ /drag sngags dpal chen bka' brgyad gtso 'khor la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/ nag po chen po yab yum bka' sdod brgyad/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro dam can gter bdag dang*/ /gnas bdag gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong rnams la/ /sman mchod 'bul lo dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kha raṃ khā hi/

zhes mtshan don sbyar la 'bul lo/ dngos grub blang ba ni/ don dam thig le bde ba chen po las/ /mtshungs pa med pa bhandha'i snod yangs su/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs bdud rtsi rin chen gter/ /dngos po med las dngos grub blang bar bya/ /kā ya siddhi om̐: wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi rang gi gnas gsum du reg cing lces myong*/ zhes pa'ang byams pa'i ming gis bris pa shu bhaṃ/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // nya) ༈ gtang rag mchod bstod ni/ hūm̐: me tog bdug spos mar me dri chab ma: zhal zas rol mo gzugs sgra dri ro reg: spyan gzigs bkod pa sprin ltar gtibs pa 'di: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: om̐ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi: bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: gter srung bstod pa ni/ hūm̐: dpal chen nag po khrag 'thung rgyal: dpa' bo gyad kyi ya 'dor can: drag pos sa bcu gnon mdzad pa: legs ldan mgon por bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gzhan yang bka' yi las byed gnyer gyi bdag: mthu rtsal rmad byung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: phrin las bzhi ldan bstan pa'i bya ra mdzad: gsang sngags gnyan gyi chos 'khor skyong byed pa: gter srung yongs rdzogs bcas la bdag bstod do: spyi bstod ni/ bstod par 'os pa thams cad la: sogs? bzod gsol ni/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang : gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni: bgyis pa dang ni bgyid bstsal pa: de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol: yig brgya dbyangs gsal rten snying lan gsum bzlas/ lhag chad kha skong ba'o/ /brtan bzhugs ni/

'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu: 'khor ba srid du bzhugs nas kyang : nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang : mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol: om̐ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā: 'thor nas byas nas brtan pa'o/ /rgyun du srung bzlog 'dir gsungs nas dmigs pa spyi gzhung ltar bya'o/ bzod gsol bkra shis rdzogs rim bsngo smon las gzhung ltar du rgyas so/ /dge'o// // ta) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: hūm̐ sgrub srid gsum zil gnon bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bla med yang gsang hūm̐ sgrub bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: a ti bla med rnal 'byor pas: yang gsang hūm̐ sgrub brtson pa'i tshe: gnas ni nges med gang rung du: chu sgra rlung 'gyu drag po'i rong : shin tu 'jigs pa'i dur khrod dal: yang na rnam g.yeng med pa'i sar: gang shar chos sku ston pa'i phyir: drag po hūm̐ gi sgrub pa gces: 'khor 'das sa mtshams phye ba'i gnad: 'byin 'jug drag po hūm̐ la gnas: rtse gcig ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang : spros med hūm̐ gi sgrub pa ni: bde ba'i gdan la skyil krung bzhugs: yang na 'gro 'ong spyod gsum bya: dran rdzogs lha gsal hūm̐ sgra sgrog: gang shar hūm̐ gi ngo bor skyong : de nas hūm̐ sgrub bdag bskyed ni: hūm̐: ye nas chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings: ka dag rang byung e yi mkha': ma bcos rang shar pho brang ni: 'byung lngas mas phub yar la btegs: rlung dang tsha grang 'thab pa yis: gzhal yas phyi nang 'khor lor rdzogs: bskal pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: de dbus gnam lcags 'khor lo dang : nyi zla bam gyi gdan steng du: rdo rje rwa steng nag po langs: lte bar mthing nag hūm̐ gis mtshan: gnas 'gyur dran rdzogs skad cig gis: dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ

smug nag 'jigs byed khro bo'i rgyal: thig le nyer gcig rngam zhal bgrad: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril hūm̐ sgra sgrog: shangs nas rlung 'gyu dug lnga gtor: spyan rtsa sdang mig srid gsum sngangs: thod skam zhi ba bzhi bcu gtibs: dbu skra khrag 'thung lnga bcu 'bar: smin ma khro chung khra thabs 'gyed: bden gnyis sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: g.yas pa nyer gcig rdo rje la: hūm̐ dgu phaṭ dgu raṃ gyis mtshan: g.yon pa'i bhan dmar nyer gcig la: bhyo dgu phaiṃ dgu dza dgus mtshan: rtog med dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: bco brgyad zhabs kyis ya 'dor bgrad: dkyil 'khor gnam zhal pang du 'khyud: sku mdog mthing nag chos kyi dbyings: theg pa rim dgu'i khro zhal rngam: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril brda skad sgrog: shangs nas rlung 'bud bag chags gtor: spyan rtsa glog 'gyu ma sring sdud: thod skam khro mo sprin ltar gtibs: dbu skra nyi khri rig 'dzin stong : g.yas pa dgu yi gri gug gis: 'khor 'das skye rgyud rtsad nas gcod: g.yon pa dgu yi bhan dmar gyis: nyon mongs klad khrag zhal du gsol: phar phyin rus pa'i rgyan cha 'khrol: bcu drug zhabs ni yab la 'khril: mkha' gsang thabs shes sbyor ba yis: zung 'jug bde chen ye shes bskul: gnyis med sprul pa'i sras mchog brgyad: khro rgyal yab yum ba spu dang : bu ga la sogs sgo rnams nas: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par 'phros: phrin las sna tshogs bsgrubs par bsgom: bskal pa'i me dpung 'u ru ru: hūm̐ sgra tshwa tshwa si li li: sngags zer 'brug stong di ri ri: mtha' dbus khyab par hūm̐ gi zhing : gzugs rnams sna tshogs ngo bo hūm̐: sgra rnams grags stong 'dzin pa med: dran rig 'gyu stong ka dag hūm̐: stong pa ma bcos zang thal las: snang srid drag po brdal khyab hūm̐: snod bcud ma 'gags gang shar hūm̐: 'khor 'das ro gcig chos sku hūm̐: thams cad gnyis med ngang du hūm̐:

ye shes 'jig rten hūm̐ du gsal: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes drag po'i hūm̐ bzlas: de yang snang srid snod bcud kyi sgra thams cad grags stong hūm̐ du bsgom zhing bzang ngan legs nyes thams cad de gcig hūm̐ du gyur: shes pa gsal 'grib bying rgod rmugs pa thams cad ngo bo hūm̐ sgra de'i ngang la bsres: phyi lhong lha 'dres cho 'phrul: nang lhong sems kyi zug rngu: gsang lhong lus kyi na tsha la sogs pa thams cad sgra ring thung gi ngang la bsres: 'jigs shing skyi g.ya' ba'i dngos po thams cad hūm̐ re re bsres shing de thog ngo bo bsres: tshogs drug gang shar phyi'i snang ba dbyings kyi hūm̐ dang bsres: nang gi rig pa gsal ba'i hūm̐ dang bsres: rang gzhan 'char sgo ma 'gags hūm̐ dang bsres: tshogs drug gang shar sgyu ma'i hūm̐ dang bsres: bag chags ngan goms 'dzin med hūm̐ dang bsres: rgyu 'bras ro gcig ka dag hūm̐ dang bsres: khengs sems ngar 'dzin stong nyid hūm̐ dang bsres: dgag sgrub spang blang gzhi med hūm̐ dang bsres: nyon mongs a 'thas dbyings rig hūm̐ dang bsres: yin min thams cad ye grol hūm̐ dang bsres: chos sku mtshan bral stong nyid hūm̐ gi ngang : 'khor 'das de ltar shes pa'i gnas lugs skyongs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma hūm̐ sgrub zab mo bla med yang snying 'di: ma 'ongs las can thugs kyi sras la bzhag: tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub pa'i lam mchog nyid: yang gsang snying po'i hūm̐ sgrub 'di nyid zab: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i skal ldan rig 'dzin gyi: phyi nang bar chad zhi 'gyur the tshom med: dbyangs can gsang ba mkha' 'gro'i yi ger thob: ma 'ongs gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs pa'o// // tha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las:

phrin las bsdus pa'i cho ga rdzu 'phrul drwa ba ye shes sdong po bzhugs so/ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: e ma/ yang zab bcud thigs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /ka dag rang sgra'i ring lugs sor bzhag ste/ /sgra sdeb brda bsgyur lta ba'i rgyang zhags kyi/ /zer rtse'i thabs shes ri mor rab bkod de/ /rnam dpyod blo yi bum chen mi zhum pa'i/ /rgyan bzang 'di ko'i zlos gar spro 'os 'dud/ /bkod des lung rigs rnam dpyod ma rmongs so/ /sa ma ya/ zab gsang bla med rgyud sde rgya mtsho yi/ /yang snying gcig dril he ru ka pa'i rgyud/ /ngo mtshar rin chen phreng ba 'di nyid kyi/ /rgyun khyer phrin las sgrub par byed pa ni/ /rang lus gzhal yas gdod nas ye bzhugs ngang*/ /rig pa'i rgyal po he ru ka par mos/ /rtsa khams tshogs drug mchod sprin ci bzhin du/ /nges don shes phyir dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal/ /de yang kun rdzob blo kha chod pa'i phyir/ /mchod rdzas byin rlabs spyan 'dren la sogs pa'i/ /go rim phran bu tsam zhig bstan par bya/ /spros par 'dod na las byang 'bring po zungs/ /nyams su lon na rgyas pa byas kyang rung*/ /'on kyang rgyun khyer tsam ni 'dir 'dus so/ /sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/ dang po skyabs yul sems bskyed ni/ hoḥ gdod nas rnam dag snod bcud sangs rgyas zhing : bdag gzhan mi dmigs sems bskyed mnyam nyid ngang : snod bcud gzugs snang ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor tshogs: so ma ci bzhin rig der skyabs su gsol: gnyis pa rang byung lta ba'i mtshams gcod ni/ hūm̐: nga nyid ye nas dpal chen he ru kaḥ mkha' ltar khyab pa 'od gsal rdo rje'i thugs: ye shes lnga ru nam yang 'bral brlag med: rnam rtog ru tra gnyis 'dzin ka nas dag: chos dbyings brdal khyab bsrungs mtshams med par gsal: oṃ he ru ka dzñā na hūm̐ phaṭḥ nga bdag ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ

oṃ dharma dzñā na badzra tsakra satwaṃ: gsum pa rang byung mchod rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ hūm̐: 'khor lo rnam dag rang byung bhandha'i snod: blo yi khyon rtse yangs shing rgya che'i nang : phyi mchod me tog bdug spos mar me dri: zhal zas rol mo sil snyan gdung ba'i dbyangs: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dbang po lnga: gzugs mdzes glu dbyangs gar mo phyag rgya can: nang mchod dug lnga ye shes sman raka gtor: gsang mchod bde stong sbyar ba'i bdud rtsi lnga: sgrol mchod la sogs spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: ma tshang med pa ye nas bdud rtsir gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ lā sye mā lye gīrti nīrti swa ra swa tī oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ dzñā na pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā rakta dzwa la maṇḍa la hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ ma hā bha lingta te dzwa bha lingta bha la bha te gu hya sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ sarba a haṃ pañtsa ma tstsha nadyaṃ pū dza oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ he ru ka dzñā na hūm̐ ma traṃ ru tra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ dang po de bzhin nyid kyi ting 'dzin ni/ hūm̐: smra brjod bral ba stong pa'i gzhi: khyab brdal ngang la lhun gyis gnas: rgya chad phyogs lhung spu ris bral: oṃ dharma dzñā na tsitta hūm̐: gnyis pa kun tu snang ba'i ting 'dzin ni/ āḥ yid kyi rtog pa phra mo la: ma 'gags rtsal snang lam gyis shar: gnyis rtog rlung gis rang bzhin bskyed: oṃ badzra dharma hrī ta āḥ gsum pa skye med 'bras bu'i sa bon ni/ oṃ: kun snang 'dzin pa'i sa bon las: rten 'brel hūm̐ yig rdo rje shar: gnas 'gyur lha dang gzhal yas gsal: oṃ dharma bhrūm̐ dzñā na hūm̐: bzhi pa 'byung rim pho brang ni/ hūm̐: e yam̐ ram̐ sum̐ keṃ ru bhrūm̐: 'byung lnga bsnol brtsegs brtan pa'i steng :

rdo rje'i 'od zer gzhal yas khang : dkyil 'khor phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: ye shes lugs su 'byung bar bsgom: oṃ badzra bhrūm̐ sa ma ya hūm̐: oṃ padma maṇḍa la: sūrya maṇḍa la: tsand+ra maṇḍa la: ru tra ti ra baṃ: spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐: oṃ sarba shū n+ya ta badzra ātma ko3 haṃ: lnga pa lha bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐: de dbus zla gam sgo gcig pa: pad nyi byol song gtso brgyad steng : bdag nyid che mchog he ru kaḥ smug nag dbu dgu shin tu khro: g.yas dgus gnam lcags rdo rje gdengs: g.yon dgus bhandha dmar gyis bkang : dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum gling bzhir brjid: thugs kar sems dpa' sa bon hūm̐: gnam zhal dbyings phyug sku la 'khril: phyag drug gri thod mgul nas 'khyud: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ ma hā kro ti shwa rī satwaṃ: hūm̐: shar phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : thugs mchog badzra he ru kaḥ mthing nag dkar dmar zhal gsum khro: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ rnga: g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar zhags: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: kro ti shwa rī yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : sku yi bdag nyid gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag dkar dmar khro zhing gtum: be con ral gri dgra satwa g.yas: bhan dmar sdigs mdzub mdung thung g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: bhe ta za byed yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ ya mānta ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: klu dbang pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : gsung mchog padma he ru kaḥ dkar dmar mthing zhal khro la gtum: g.yas gsum rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ sbrul:

dril bu bhan dmar lcags sgrog g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: padma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra kro ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs pho brang zla gam dbus: gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : phrin las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing ka dkar dmar khro la gtum: rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga g.yas: g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ thogs: mtha' gnyis ri rab phur bu bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān bam̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar lho'i pho brang zla gam dbus: me lha pho mo bsnol ba'i steng : yon tan rbod gtong he ru kaḥ ljang dkar dmar la khro zhing gtum: g.yas gsum rdo rje khyung dang sbrul: bhan dmar zhing dbyug gwa'u g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: nyid zhi yum dang gnyis med sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ ghu ha dzñā na shrī he ru ka kro ti hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho nub pho brang zla gam dbus: che mchog drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar dkar sngo la khro zhing gtum: gri gug rdo rje ral gri g.yas: thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ lcags sdig g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: rdo rje gtum mo yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ āḥhūm̐ artsig nirtsig na mo bha ga wa te hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: nub byang pho brang zla gam dbus: 'jig rten khro bo he ru kaḥ dud kha dkar dmar khro zhing gtum: rdo rje lha brgyad mgo bo g.yas: bhan dmar klu brgyad mgo bo g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: 'byung bzhi'i bdag mo yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa sarba duṣṭāṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ

hūm̐: byang shar pho brang zla gam dbus: khrag 'thung khro rgyal dmod pa'i sku: nag dkar dmar la khro gtum brjid: gri gug lha brgyad tsitta g.yas: dung dmar klu brgyad tsitta g.yon: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog brgyangs: srid pa spyi 'dul yum dang sbyor: sras bzhi yab yum sprul 'khor gsal: oṃ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: pho brang skyong ba'i rim pa bzhin: rang mdog phyag mtshan rgyan gyis spras: khro gnyer gar gyi nyams dgu ldan: zil gnon dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: ma yengs ting 'dzin gsal bar bskyed: oṃ badzra aṅku sha ya dzaḥ oṃ badzra pā sha hūm̐: oṃ badzra spho ṭa hūm̐: oṃ badzra gaṇḍe hoḥ

dang po spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐: chos dbyings rang byung e yi klong : sku gsung thugs yon gnas mchog nas: che mchog lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: oṃ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis pa bzhugs gsol phyag 'tshal ni/ hūm̐: che mchog zil gnon lha yi tshogs: rtog med shes pa'i gdan la bzhugs: ye grol chen po'i dkyil 'khor la: rang byung de bzhin bdag phyag 'tshal: oṃ badzra sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan: na mo pu ru sha ya hoḥ gsum pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: zil gnon dpal chen dkyil 'khor la: 'dod yon lha mo'i phyi mchod 'bul: gzugs sgra dri ro reg mchod 'bul: dug lnga ye shes nang mchod 'bul: bde stong dga' bzhi'i gsang mchod 'bul: phyag rgya zung 'jug gar mchod 'bul: brda skad glu dbyangs snyan mchod 'bul: sha lnga bdud rtsi'i rdzas mchod 'bul: dri lnga ro brgya'i sman mchod 'bul: mkha' dbyings padma'i rakta 'bul: bcud ldan longs spyod gtor mchod 'bul: sgrol ba'i sha khrag dmar mchod 'bul: dza gad bdud rtsi'i phud mchod 'bul: rmad byung gha na'i tshogs mchod 'bul: spyan gzigs mnyes pa'i rgyan mchod 'bul: mchog gi ting 'dzin don mchod 'bul: bla med mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: zhi khro rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : bskangs gyur dbang dang dngos grub stsol: oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ rū pa shabda gandhe rā sa sparshe āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba dzñā na pañtsa āḥhūm̐: oṃ ā hūm̐ pra mo ti āḥhūm̐: oṃ mu tra ma tstsha ṇḍa āḥhūm̐: oṃ rā ga swa ra swa tī āḥhūm̐: oṃ māṃ sa pañtsa bi shwa āḥhūm̐: oṃ gandhe pañtsa rā sa āḥhūm̐: oṃ dhā tu padma rakta āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā bha lingta pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ ma hā māṃ sa pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ su ra ma dyaṃ pañtsa āḥhūm̐: oṃ gha na pha la pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ nai ṭa a wa lo ki bi shwa āḥhūm̐:

oṃ u ta dzñā na pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ a nu ta ra pū dza āḥhūm̐: oṃ shāntiṃ kro ta tsitta su ra hūm̐: oṃ su ra bha wantu siddhi pha la hūm̐: bzhi pa bstod pa bya ba ni/ hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong : byol song gtso brgyad phyogs skyong bcu: bam̐ dang pad nyi zla gdan steng : zhi bar sgeg bzhad gsal 'tsher 'bar: mnyen lcug 'khril zhing dgyes gar ldan: khro tshogs dgod gshe rngam gtum 'jigs: 'bar zhing drag rtsal mthu stobs 'byin: zhi dang khro gar dgyes pa'i lha: gsang ba zil gnon tshogs la bstod: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ rgyas par 'dod na mngon rtogs sham gyi sngags bgrang*/ dpal dgu rnams so sor phral nas bsgrub par mos na/ phyi'i gzhal yas bskyed nas/ lha rang rang gi mngon rtogs rdzogs nas spyan 'dren mchod bstod sogs kha bsgyur bya yang rung*/ bsnyen pa rnams gang 'grub bya/ 'di kho nar bsten te sgrub pa'i skabs yin na thun gtor 'bul/ rgyun khyer yin na ma 'byor kyang rung*/ 'os 'tshams grub nas thun gtor 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor gyi: che mchog khro rol lha tshogs rnams: bskul lo thugs dam dus la bab: skye med ye shes klong yangs nas: snying po sngags kyis rang sgra sgrogs: spro bsdu'i dngos grub 'byung ba'i phyir: dug gsum bsgral ba'i sha khrag 'bul: bdud bzhi'i dgra bgegs dpung gzhom nas: phrin las sna tshogs 'grub gyur cig: oṃ sarba bha lingta kha kha khā hi: zhes pas thun gtor 'bul so so'i phrin las bcol dgos yod na skabs 'dir sbyar/ gong gsal 'di tsam rgyas pa ma lcogs na/ rang nyid ting 'dzin rnam gsum dran rdzogs su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: rdo rje bhrūm̐ gyur gzhal yas lte ba'i dbus: byol song gtso brgyad pad nyi ro yi steng :

hūm̐ las che mchog dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad: rdo rje thod pa 'dzin cing zhabs brgyad 'gyings: dbyings phyug yum 'khyud phyag gnyis gri thod 'khyud: gzi brjid gar dgu ldan pa gtso bo yi: gnas lnga yan lag bzhi ru rim pa bzhin: gshin rje rta mgrin yang dag ma mo phur: drag po 'jig rten dmod pa bya rog gdong : rang 'dra'i yum 'khyud gtso 'khor dur khrod chas: rang rang phyag mtshan sa bon 'khor bcas gsal: me dpung klong bzhugs dpa' rngam brjid par bsgom: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ye shes spyan drangs dam tshig bdag la thim: gnas dang phyag bgyid mchod sprin sna tshogs 'bul: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dya shabda āḥhūm̐: oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta gha na tsakra pū dza āḥhūm̐: hūm̐: me dpung rab 'khrigs byol song gtso brgyad steng : che mchog dpal dgu mi bzad gar dang ldan: 'bar ba'i phyag mtshan dur khrod dpal chas rngam: zhi khro'i gtso 'khor yongs rdzogs lha la bstod: ces bstod cing bsnyen sgrub bya/ de tsam spros pa mi 'dod na/ 'di ltar nyams su blang bar bya'o/ hūm̐: dran rdzogs wal gyis che mchog yab yum gnas: dpal chen gtso brgyad yum sbyor gar dgus brgyan: phyag mtshan sa bon la sogs ma 'dres gsal: oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la ru pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces pa'i sngags phreng sham bur khā hi tsam sbyar mos kyang chog /med kyang mi dgos/ spros pa de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐ mūṃ: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta kro ti aṣṭa baṃ bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ spros pa de tsam yang ma lcogs na/

hūm̐ mūṃ kro ta kro ti wa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ de tsam ma lcogs na/ hūm̐ zhes rang la tshang*/ rgyud las kyang*/ skye med rdo rje'i ngo bo nyid: rdo rje hūm̐ ste hūm̐ sgra can: rdo rje rnon po ral gri can: rdo rje sku ste rang byung ba: rdo rje snying po skye med klong : ngo bo hūm̐ dang rdo rje'o: zhes gsungs pa ltar bya/ hūm̐ tsam yang ma lcogs na/ rgyud las/ e hoḥ sprul pa'i 'khor rnams nyon: dang po rang byung chen po'i dbus: ma 'gags stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid: bsdu bya snang ba'i yul las 'das: gnyis med ngo bo de kho na: zhes gsungs so/ de tsam nyams len mi mos na: stong stong mi stong 'dus ma byas: bzo bcos rkyen gyis ma bsgyur ro: zhes gsungs so/ /'di tsam nyams len ma lcogs na/ rgyud las/ rang mun ma rig: nga bdag rang dgra: a 'thas dmod 'khyams: nam yang du 'gro: gte pho don med: ces gsungs so/ /de bzhin phyi nang gsang gsum rgyas 'bring bsdus pa/ yang bsdus sngags phreng*/ don bsdus gnas lugs/ mchog bsdus blo 'das kho na nyid sogs zhi rgyas dbang drag dbye gsal don dang ldan pa khyad par can 'di/ phrin las rgyun khyer du nyams su len par bya'o/ /sku gsum rang dbang bskur ba ni/ hūm̐: bde chen 'khor lo kunda badzra oṃ: longs spyod 'khor lo wākka badzra āḥ chos kyi 'khor lo tsitta badzra hūm̐: sprul pa'i 'khor lo gu ṇa badzra trām̐: bde spyod 'khor lo gu hya badzra hrīḥ dbang bskur yongs rdzogs yi dam lhar gyur nas: sngags dang ting 'dzin rab tu gnas gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: zhes pas rang nyid ye nas yi dam lha yin bzhin ting 'dzin la gnas par bya/ de nas dkyil 'khor rang dbyings su bsdu ba ni/ hoḥ snod bcud gzugs snang dran rig rol pa'i rtsal: rang byung gnyug ma'i ye shes lha yi tshogs: bskyed pa sprul bsgyur rdzogs pa kun gzhi'i dbyings:

ka dag dran rig sbubs su mi rtog āḥ a a āḥ zhes dmigs med khyab brdal chen po'i ngang du bzhag: sa ma ya/ e ma/ ind+ra'i lha lam yangs pa'i mthing bzang rgyun/ /'thib pos nam yang ma reg dwangs ma'i mdangs/ /bzhin rgyas nyul ba gzi 'od 'khyil de yi/ /'bum phrag lta ba'i klong las legs shar te/ /srid pa'i khyon yangs gsal bas rab 'gengs nas/ /skye dgu'i rmongs lam sgo lnga rab tu rdol/ /sbubs las shes rab gzhon nu'i mdangs bltams te/ /cher smin yid nor dam pa'i dga' ston gyis/ /mthon rtse'i gtsug la spel bar rab bzhed kyis/ /'gro la mchog gi smin yon che der 'dud/ /sa ma ya/ zhes pa bsgrigs chags su bkod pa 'di nyid/ skyes chen dam pa rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa'i gdung gsob 'dzin pa/ rten 'brel du mas brgyan cing legs tshogs dge ba'i yon tan gzhal las 'das pa ka gnam sa bdag rgyal po chos rje gsang sngags bstan skyong nyid dang*/ gzhan yang skal ldan mang pos yang nas yang du bka' brgyad rgyun khyer nyung bsdus shig bsgrig rogs zhes bskul ba la brten nas/ kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas rgyud tshig yid bzhin nor bu dang 'dra ba de mu tig zer la sbrel ba ltar sor bzhag tu bsgrigs/ cung tshig rkang ma 'grigs pa rnams las byang 'bring po sogs 'ga' zhig nas bsdus te/ sdeb sbyor 'os pa re zung bdag gis phri bsnan bgyis yod pa 'di la/ chos spong gis bsre bslad dkrugs gsum du mi 'gro ba'i bzod gsol chos bdag ḍākki rgya mtsho rnams la 'bul lo/ /bzod par bzhes nas 'phral dang yun gyi bar chad du mi 'byung bar mdzad du gsol lo// // da) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: mdun bskyed pho brang rngam klong chen mo bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: mdun bskyed pho brang bya ba ni: las bzlog gtor zlog gnyis su 'dod: las bzlog bya na las byang bsrang :

gtor zlog lta bur bskyed pa ni: gcig dril bsgrub bam so sor phye: so sor phye na bzlog pa dgu: de yang cha tshang 'grigs par dgos: dgra bzlog yin na so sor phye: gcig tu dril na gtso bo la: bskor ba'i tshul la tshom bu bya: phyi 'di rtsang ra gcig la tshang : nang du rtsang sogs so sor phye: che mchog drag po rtsang gi tshad: 'gugs sor sum cu rtsa gnyis tshad: nang rtsang drug cu rtsa lnga la: phyi rtsang brgya dang brgyad du bya: gtso bo brgyad kyi rtsang tshad ni: mtho dman 'gugs sor nyer gcig la: nang rtsang sum cu rtsa gnyis so: phyi rtsang drug cu rtsa gnyis bya: zor rtsang dag ni so so'i gzhung : rtsang bsdus brgya dang rtsa gnyis so: rgyas pa lha grangs ltar du bya: gtor ma mtho dman gtso bo la: 'gugs sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis bya: khro zhal gtod cing me ris brgyan: rtse mor phyag mtshan bcas par bya: gtso bo brgyad kyi mtho dman ni: 'gugs sor nyi shu rtsa gnyis bya: 'khor rnams 'bring po bcu drug la: tha mar sor dgu 'dod par bya: gdan rnams so sor ma traṃ dang : chos 'byung brtsegs la mtho bar bya: rtse rnams thams cad khyung gis brgyan: dar nag gur phub srung bzlog 'dzugs: nang ni zor kong pho nya'i grangs: gzhan rnams lag len spyi dang mthun: tha ma bsdus pa nyin bzlog la: bzlog gzhi che ba gcig gi khar: thams cad tshom bu bzhin tu dgod: gtso bo rnams ni gtor ma la: pho nya skyong ba zor chen bya: shin tu bsdus pa 'di na gab: 'di nyid bsdus pa bskyed pa ni: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐: sogs bsang sbyang byed: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las e mthing nam mkha'i dbyings: rlung ri nag po rgya gram 'khor lo brtsegs: bskal pa'i me dpung dmar nag rab tu mched: rakta'i rba klong khrag zhag lbu ba 'khrigs: dur khrod sa gzhi bkod pa rdul ltar g.yo: keng rus skam rlon ri rab rdza ltar nyil: rdo rje'i rmang bzhi sra mkhregs brag dmar brjid:
