thod mkhar smug po srid gsum dbyings dang mnyam: gru bzhi sgo bzhi gnam lcags gzer gyis bsdams: phyi nang dur khrod bkod pa blo las 'das: gnam lcags spu gri drag po'i gzhal yas khang : phyi na zhe sdang me yi tshwa tshwa 'khrigs: logs su phrag dog 'jigs pa'i glog dmar 'khyugs: nang du 'dod chags rakta mtsho ltar 'khyil: mi ro rta ro'i lbu ba mkha' la 'phyur: bam ro gsar rnying lhu dum ri ltar nyil: ro langs sha za'i gad mo 'brug ltar sgrog: dur khrod gcan spyang ngar sgra 'u ru ru: gri thogs shan pa'i gar sgyur lams se lam: bzlog bsad drag po'i sngags sgra di ri ri: shin tu rab 'jigs pho brang e yi dbus: gru gsum zla gam khrag gi 'od zer 'khyugs: dbus dang phyogs brgyad phyi nang rim pa bzhin: sa bon gdan sogs skad cig gzhal yas gsal: de nas lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: ye shes bskal pa'i me 'bar klong yangs dbus: lha chen pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan gyi steng : gnam lcags rdo rje rtse dgu hūm̐ sgra can: sogs dkyil 'khor rim par tshom bu bkod: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus so// // na) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bskang ba dngos grub char 'bebs bzhugs so: bde gshegs sgrub chen zhi khro'i lha la 'dud: rgya rgya rgya: e ma nyon dang ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: ma 'ongs bskal pa yang mtha' snyigs ma'i tshe: sems can sdug bsngal log chos blo sna bzung : rdzas med bande sngags btsun glang gi snying : dbang dang dam med yi dam dam tshig yal: bka' dang lung 'brel dregs pas las mi khol: snying rje'i sems med rang phung ngan mthu bsgrub: de yis rkyen byas lha srin sde brgyad nang : dregs pa chos skyong phyi rgyud dkar phyogs khro: mi nad nor nad mtshon cha bu yug 'tshubs:

sad ser lo nyes 'bras bu'i bcud kyang yal: bkra mi shis shing yul phung sna tshogs 'byung : de dag rnams ni lha srin khros pa'i rtags: spyir yang sems can rmu rgod khengs sems che: zhe sdang spyad pas mtshon dal bar chod sdang : 'dod chags spyad pas mu ge'i srid pa che: nga rgyal bsten pas log lam bdud kyis khyer: phrag dog sdang bas thog ser bu yug g.yo: gti mug spyad pas dkar po'i dge bcu 'grib: gsog 'jog sred pas yi dwags yul du skye: 'gro kun dam tshig phan sems bral ba yis: mi 'dod sna dgu'i rkyen ngan sna tshogs 'byung : de yang nyams chag sdig sgrib dag las 'byung : de 'dra'i rkyen ngan bar chad bsal ba yang : dam tshig bral ba bskang zhing bshags pa yi: las rim zab mo snying gi byang bu bstan: yi ger thob la rin chen gter du sbos: skal ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas bskang ba'i rim pa ni: phyi nang spyan gzigs mchod pa bsham: rnga gling rol mo sna tshogs bsgrag: sha chen la sogs spos sna bsreg: rang nyid bde ba'i gdan du 'khod: dkyil 'khor gzhung bzhin grub rjes su: ting 'dzin bskyed rdzogs gsal ba'i ngang :

om̐ āḥhūm̐: zhes lan gsum gyis sbyang : de nas bskyed pa ni: om̐ swa bhā wa sa sbyangs: stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dam can gter bdag nor lha phyi rgyud srung ma la sogs mnyes pa'i mchod rdzas nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par gyur: om̐ badzra bhrūm̐ dzñā na siddhi pha la ho hūm̐: zhes rol mo lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs: de nas rol mo bya zhing dbyangs snyan pos 'di skad do: hūm̐: 'og min phyogs bcu kun khyab pho brang nas: kun tu bzang po zhi ba bzhi bcu gnyis: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: lhun grub rtsal lnga ma 'gags pho brang nas: che mchog 'dus pa khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: shar phyogs bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod nas: khro rgyal yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod nas: 'jam dpal gshin rje sku yi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: dbang chen khro rgyal gsung gi lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byang phyogs padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: phrin las rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: shar lho lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod nas: yon tan ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: lho nub gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rdo rje thod phreng rig 'dzin lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: nub byang he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod nas: khro rgyal 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs rnams:

thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: byang shar 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: dmod pa drag sngags 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dkyil 'khor phyi nang bar khyams 'khor yug tu: gnas pa'i sgo skyong pho nya las byed rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: gzhan yang rin chen gter gyi bka' srung mchog: chos skyong dam can gter bdag 'khor bcas rnams: thugs dam bskang phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phaiṃ phaiṃ a be sha ya hoḥ hūm̐: nyi zla 'bar ba baṃ gyi gdan la bzhugs: sku gsum yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha la bstod: phyi nang gsang ba bla med rdzas kyis mchod: gnyis med chos dbyings ngo bo la bstod cing : ma bcos lhun grub de bzhin ngang la bskang : sgo gsum bag med dam 'gal mthol lo bshags: don gnyis lhun grub bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: dang po zhi ba dbyings kyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: rnam dag khyab brdal klong yangs pho brang dbus: rin chen sna tshogs nyi zla padma'i gdan: thog ma'i sangs rgyas kun bzang 'od mi 'gyur: sku mdog mthing nag mnyam bzhag skyil krung mdzes: dbyings phyug mthing ka bde stong 'khril sbyor ngang : zung 'jug mtshan dpe'i rab brgyan 'ja' zer 'khyil: bskang ngo thugs dam gnyan po dbyings su bskang : sems dpa' rdo rje mnyam bzhag lhang nger bzhugs: ye shes sems dpa' chen po'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: sna tshogs rtag 'gyu ma spangs gnas su dag: bcom ldan rdor sems yab yum thugs dam bskang : dug lnga nyon mongs ma spangs gnas su dag: klong gsal ye shes lnga ldan thugs dam bskang : phung po lnga nyid ma spangs gnas su dag: rgyal ba rigs lnga'i lha tshogs thugs dam bskang : 'byung ba lnga nyid ma spangs gnas su dag: dbyings kyi yum chen lnga yi thugs dam bskang :

rnam shes tshogs brgyad ma spangs gnas su dag: byang chub sems dpa' brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : 'dzin pa brgyad po ma spangs gnas su dag: mchod pa'i lha mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: byol song gtso brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: dpal chen che mchog khro rgyal he ru kaḥ 'jigs byed stobs 'dus sku mdog smug nag brjid: dbu ni nyer gcig srid gsum g.yul rtser sleb: spyan rtsa nyi zla stong khams khengs shing bgrad: rdzu 'phrul gshog brgyangs bzhi bcu gnyis phyag ldan: dur khrod chas brgyad sku yi rgyan du mdzes: bco brgyad zhabs ni gling bzhir dor stabs 'gying : gnam zhal dbyings phyug kro ti yum chen 'khyud: me ri smug nag 'khyil zhing snang srid sreg: bskang ngo khrag 'thung yab yum thugs dam bskang : sgo gsum rnam brgyad ma spangs gnas su dag: he ru ka pa brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : nang yul 'dzin brgyad ma spangs gnas su dag: tshogs bdag khro mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : sa bcu'i kun rtog ma spangs gnas su dag: ye shes khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : snang ba tshogs drug ma spangs gnas su dag: bcom ldan thub pa rigs drug thugs dam bskang : rtag chad mu bzhi ma spangs gnas su dag: khrag 'thung khro bo rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : tshor bcu rtogs pa ma spangs gnas su dag: phyogs skyong chen po bcu yi thugs dam bskang : bdud bzhi rtog pa ma spangs gnas su dag: ta krita sgo ba bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : yul brgyad rtogs pa ma spangs gnas su dag: lce spyang ma mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: bcom ldan zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs kyi: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir:

dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phral: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings:

rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas shar phyogs yang dag gi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: shar phyogs me rlung khrag zhag 'khyil ba'i gnas: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod pho brang dbus: nyi zla bam ro padma'i gdan steng du: dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ mthing nag dbu dgu khro zhal 'jigs la rngam: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha bsnams: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: mthing nag kro ti shwa ri yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : nyon mongs bdud bzhi bdud dpung 'joms mdzad pa'i: he ru ka pa rigs bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dur khrod gnas nyul skyong ba'i ma mo 'bum: kau seng ma mo bcu drug thugs dam bskang :

legs nyes stangs 'dzin rjes gcod ma mo 'bum: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : tshad med sgo skyong bzhi yi las mkhan ma: sgo srung ma mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang 'khor yug bar khyams la gnas pa'i: bka' sdod bye ba 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan:

ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas lho phyogs gshin rje'i bskang ba ni: hūm̐: lho phyogs me dpung sprin nag gtibs pa'i gnas: sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod pho brang dbus: 'chi bdag pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du:

ya mānta ka 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: ser nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing 'jigs: bco brgyad phyag ni gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: ser mo bhe ta za byed yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong gsum bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: ma rungs bdud tshogs byad ma rang gshed 'beb: gshed chen yab yum bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : lho phyogs gshin rje'i khram kha dgra la 'debs: gshin rje yab yum so gsum thugs dam bskang : dam tshig las bzhi sgrub pa'i bdag nyid ma: sgo skyong gdong can bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma nyams pa'i gshed: gsod byed ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dam nyams dgra bgegs glo bur khram la 'debs: bdud po khram thogs bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo rtsis la 'debs: shwa thogs rtsis pa bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : slob dpon sku dgra myur du sgrol mdzad pa: shan pa srog bdag bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : gzhan yang gshin rje'i gshed kyi pho nya ba: bka' sdod bye ba 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gzigs dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs:

phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod:

rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

de nas nub phyogs dbang chen gyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: nub phyogs me rlung ro langs 'gyu ba'i gnas: laṅka brtsegs pa'i dur khrod pho brang dbus: klu bdud pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: hya ghṛ wa rta mchog he ru kaḥ dmar nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing brjid: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: dmar mo padma gzi ldan yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: snang srid dbang sdud gdug pa'i g.yul ngo gnon: dbang chen rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : snang srid pho rgyud zil gyis gnon mdzad pa: zil gnon yab yum bcu bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dam tshig sgo srung log pa'i sgo 'gog pa: sgo srung ma mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : snang srid mo rgyud gdug pa'i dal kha 'joms: khams brgyad ma mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : dgra la brda than ltas ngan 'bebs pa'i phyir: long ba brgyad sbrel 'khor g.yog thugs dam bskang : 'byung bzhi dbang bsgyur snang srid las la rgyu: 'dab can pho nya bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : srid pa'i dal kha nad yams dgra la 'beb: 'jigs pa'i 'brug mo sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dam nyams dgra bo'i srog la hab len byed: sprul pa'i khyi brgyad 'jigs rngam thugs dam bskang : slob ma dam nyams snying khrag had kyis 'jib: lcags spyang gcan gzan brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang las mkhan pho nya bye ba 'bum: bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyis dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir:

ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug:

lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas byang phyogs phur pa phrin las kyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: byang phyogs me rlung kī la sgrog pa'i gnas: padma brtsegs pa'i dur khrod pho brang dbus: gnod sbyin dam sri bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: phrin las khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: mthing nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing brjid: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: 'khor lo rgyas 'debs mthing ka yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong gsum bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa'i phyir: thugs sras rigs bzhi yab yum thugs dam bskang : steng 'og phyogs bcu'i bar chad rab bsgral phyir: khro bcu yab yum phra thabs thugs dam bskang :

lam bzhi ston mdzad sgo bzhi rang rang srung : sgo skyong chen mo rnam bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : sha khrag la rngam las kyi ma mo che: shwa na chen mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : dgra la nad yams bu yug char du 'beb: re ti ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : dam nyams dgra la mdze nad sna tshogs gtong : sa bdag ma mo mched bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : log lta bdud bzhi sgrol ba'i gnyen po che: skyes bu ging chen sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bstan dgra bdun rgyud thal bar brlag mdzad pa'i: dregs pa bdud po bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas bstan bshig snying khrag khong nas 'dren: srog gcod shan pa sde bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang bka' skyong bstan pa'i bya ra mkhan: pho nya las mkhan rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang :

rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi'i bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis:

gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas shar lho bla med he ru ka'i bskang ba ni: hūm̐: shar lho me rlung skyi bun g.yo ba'i gnas: lhun grub gter gyi dur khrod pho brang dbus: gson 'dre pho mo bsnol ba'i khri steng du: bla med kun 'dus dpal chen khro bo'i rgyal: ljang nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing brjid: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: mthing ka kun bzang nyid zhi yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: bde stong ngo bo chags med rnam par rgyal: gsal byed khro bcu yab yum thugs dam bskang : phyi nang 'byung ba'i bar chad bdud rigs 'joms: ye shes lha tshogs bcu gnyis thugs dam bskang : dus kyi chad pa sna tshogs dgra la 'bebs: dus kyi ma mo rtsa gsum thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sgo skyong bstan pa'i bya ra ba: sgo skyong srung ma rnams kyi thugs dam bskang : dus drug 'gyu zhing rnal 'byor drod tshad nyul: ma mo dus bdag mo yi thugs dam bskang : phyogs bzhi'i skag rigs bdud tshogs dgra la 'bebs: ma sring chen mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : sa brgyad mthar phyin gnas brgyad skyong ma mdzad: gtso mo chen mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : snang srid 'khrul pa'i cho 'phrul dgra la 'bebs: gling nyul ma mo nyer gsum thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sgo skyong 'khor yug la gnas pa'i: yang sprul 'khor tshogs bye ba'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram:

sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs:

de nas lho nub rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bskang ba ni: hūm̐: lho nub me rlung srin po 'gyu ba'i gnas: gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod pho brang dbus: mu stegs pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen rig 'dzin drag po thod phreng rtsal: dmar nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing 'jigs: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: mthing ka gsang ba ye shes yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: sgrub la 'chi med rig 'dzin stsol ba'i phyir: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : brgyud pa dgu ldan bstan pa'i sgron me sbar: brda brgyud slob dpon dgu yi thugs dam bskang : nyi ma gcig las mched pa'i 'bum phrag gzugs: snyan brgyud slob dpon nyer lnga'i thugs dam bskang : phrin las bzhi ldan 'gro lam ston mdzad ma: gsang ba'i mkha' 'gro 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus pa: dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di:

zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs:

srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas nub byang 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: nub byang me rlung 'byung po tshogs pa'i gnas: he chen brdal ba'i dur khrod pho brang dbus: bstan dgra pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: khrag 'thung khro rgyal dregs pa'i sde dpon che: kham nag dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing 'jigs: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: mthing ka srid gsum spyi 'dul yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong khams bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: sha za khrag 'thung bka' yi tha tshig srung : srog bdag yab yum bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : snang srid srog la dbang shing byad ma sgrol: dregs pa'i sde dpon rtsa gsum thugs dam bskang : phyogs bzhi sgo skyong bdud bzhi tshar bar gcod: sgo skyong sha za bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang las mkhan zhing skyong phra men dang : dkyil 'khor gsang ba yongs rdzogs thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir:

ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar mar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug:

lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas byang shar dmod pa drag sngags kyi bskang ba ni: hūm̐: byang shar me rlung sha za 'tshogs pa'i gnas: 'jig rten brtsegs pa'i dur khrod pho brang dbus: dam nyams bgegs srin bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: mthu stobs mnga' bdag drag sngags he ru kaḥ nag po dbu dgu khro zhal rngam zhing 'jigs: bco brgyad phyag na gdug pa'i mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas rdzogs zhabs brgyad dor stabs bgrad: nag mo 'byung lnga'i bdag mo yum dang sbyor: me 'od tshwa tshwas stong gsum bsreg cing 'khyil: bskang ngo yab yum thugs dam dbyings su bskang : hūm̐: srog bdag sde tshogs dmag dpon bye ba 'bum: gsod byed yab yum brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : snang srid gdug pa'i g.yul ngo dgra la 'beb: sde dpon chen po dgu yi thugs dam bskang :

phyi nang bar chod bsgral zhing sgo skyong ba: sman mo sgo skyong bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : phyi nang gnas dang yul la chags mdzad pa: shan pa bye ba 'bum gyi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: gzhan yang thugs dam bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo:

keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog: dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi'i bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas phyi yul bar khyams la gnas pa'i bskang ba ni: hūm̐: pho brang 'bar ba'i sgo skyong khro bo'i tshogs: rgod gshe rngam dang dpa' ba 'jigs su rung : khro gtum dgyes sgeg 'bar ba'i gar dang ldan: khro rgyal yab yum brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : dkyil 'khor chen mo skyong ba'i ma mo 'bum:

dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad thugs dam bskang : 'byung lnga dbang bsgyur dur khrod gnas bzhi nyul: ye shes khro bo sde lnga'i thugs dam bskang : sa bcu lam ston khro rgyal rngam pa'i gzugs: ging chen yab yum bcu yi thugs dam bskang : rim bdun rgya yi srung ma mthu mo che: las kyi ma mo bdun gyi thugs dam bskang : lam bzhi pho nya sa mkhan chen mo ste: sring mo bzhi dang brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : bdud kyi grong khyer rtsad nas bshig pa'i mchog: laṅka yab yum bcu drug thugs dam bskang : sangs rgyas bstan srung rnal 'byor skyong ba'i mchog: zhing skyong chen mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : dur khrod gnas brgyad bka' yi bya ra mkhan: keng rus khro mo brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : klu bdud sa bdag dal kha dgra la 'beb: sprul pa'i khyung chen brgyad kyi thugs dam bskang : ma rungs yams nad dgra la 'bebs mdzad ma: 'bar ma chen mo dgu yi thugs dam bskang : lo zla'i chad pa dgra la 'bebs mdzad pa: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi'i thugs dam bskang : bdud dang spar sme skag chen bsgyur mdzad ma: sa bdag so gnyis 'bum phrag thugs dam bskang : 'dzam gling dbang sgyur ma mo chen mo'i tshogs: brtan ma bcu gnyis yang 'khor thugs dam bskang : smin byed chen mo la sogs 'jigs byed ma: mnga' sgyur chen mo bzhi yi thugs dam bskang : lo phyugs dus 'dzin ma mo chen mo ste: dus drug lha mo 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang : bstan pa'i bya ra ma yengs skyong mdzad ma: tshe ring lha mo lnga yi thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: rin chen gter gyi srung ma mthu bo che: mgon chen sde bzhi zhing skyong ma mo gza': rdor legs btsan rgod gnod sbyin lha klu bdud: dge bsnyen klu mo sman phran bye ba 'bum: gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: sna tshogs spyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir:

puṣpe me tog sna tshogs bcal du bkram: sna tshogs dri yi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: dhū pe dri zhim ngad pa phyogs bcur khyab: sna tshogs yid kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: ā lo zhun chen sgron me nyi ltar gsal: sna tshogs shes bya'i bag chags 'dag bya'i phyir: gandhe dri chab gang ba mtsho ltar 'khyil: sna tshogs ljags kyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: nai wi zhal zas lhun po ri ltar brjid: sna tshogs snyan gyi dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: shabda rol mo'i tshogs ni phyogs bcur grags: sna tshogs reg bya'i dbang po tshim bya'i phyir: lha rdzas na bza' sna tshogs sprin ltar gtibs: phyi yi mchod sprin nam mkha'i khyon gang 'di: zhi khro gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor lha la 'bul: hūm̐: spyan gzigs dar tshon sna tshogs mkha' la bres: 'khril ldem mchod pa'i lha mo lang ling gar: lha yi khye'u pho mos mchod rdzas 'bul: pi waṃ cha lang rnga dang ganḍi sgrog: sna lnga'i mchod 'dzin sgeg mo lam lam bskyod: glu bro gar mo yid 'phrog lha lam gang : rgyal srid rin chen sna tshogs stong gsum khengs: srub skyed bdud rtsi dkar dmar mtsho ltar 'khyil: sbyor sgrol sman mchod bcud ldan sprin ltar gtibs: tshogs gtor ba liṃ gtor chen ri ltar spungs: mkha' dbyings rakta dmar chen mtsho ltar 'khyil: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i sha rus rdza ltar nyil: dbang po'i me tog gling bzhi'i 'dzin khyon gang : rnga gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: dur khrod g.yang gzhi lhab lhub dbyings la brgyan: ru tra'i zhing gzhi dbang chen thang la bdal: dug khrag zhag chu dmar chen rlabs su g.yo: keng rus gar sgyur bam chen lhu dum 'khrol: 'dab chags skad snyan 'gyur khug tser zhing 'jums: dur bya sha zan bam ro'i rgyu ma 'dren: seng khyung 'brug mo stong khams khengs par 'gyings: stag gzig dom dred dgra bo'i mgo snying phrol: sna tshogs gcan spyang 'dur zhing nga ro sgrog:

dur phag dur bya dug sbrul pho mo 'khyugs: g.yag rog rwa sngon bcu gsum ngar zhing 'gyings: rta nag shugs ldan bcu gsum rgyan gyis phyug: lug nag dpyi dkar bcu gsum 'ba' sgra ldir: ra skyes gnam ru bcu gsum bro rtsed 'khrab: ma he chu glang bcu gsum mtsho la 'phyo: bya rog mchu dmar bcu gsum rngam zhing 'jums: yid 'phrog lha mo bcu gsum mda' dar thogs: mi nag ging chen bcu gsum bam ro phral: mi dmar btsan gzugs bcu gsum bsha' gri brdar: mi sngon pho nya bcu gsum dgra bo drud: ru mtshon sna tshogs g.yab mo phyar phyar bskyod: rten dar g.yab dar mang po gnam du gzengs: srung bzlog rbad bskul 'khor lo rlung ltar bskor: phyag mtshan mtshon cha sna tshogs thog ltar 'phen: pha rol dgra bo'i mgo snying char ltar 'beb: las mkhan pho nya nyi zer rdul bzhin gtibs: dur khrod pho brang gling bzhi'i bkod ltar mdzes: rang rang dgyes pa'i bskang rdzas sprin ltar gtibs: mthun rdzas sgrub rdzas bskang rdzas gnyan po 'dis: gsang ba zil gnon che mchog bka' brgyad kyi: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs thugs dam dgyes bskangs nas: bar chad bsal zhing rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: g.yar dam sol chud dam tshig yar la gsos: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: ye shes dbyings kyi pho brang chen po nas: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: dur khrod me rlung rngam brjid klong yangs nas: che mchog khrag 'thung lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: zhe sdang me ri 'bar ba'i dur khrod nas: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: nga rgyal ri ltar brtsegs pa'i dur khrod nas: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong dkyil nas: padma gsung gi lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phrag dog rlung ltar g.yo ba'i dur khrod nas: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: gti mug mun ltar gtibs pa'i dur khrod nas: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: gsal stong 'od lnga gtibs pa'i pho brang nas: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: khrag zhag rba rlabs g.yo ba'i dur khrod nas: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: dug rlangs pho nya 'gyu ba'i dur khrod nas: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: pho brang chen po phyi nang la gnas pa'i: bka' sdod dam can gter bdag dgongs su gsol: thogs med thugs rjes ye shes dbyings nas dgongs: mos gus brtse ba'i mthol bshags bzhes su gsol: hoḥ klong yangs chos nyid mtha' dbus bral ba la: rtag chad mu bzhi bzung ba mthol lo bshags: rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas mngon sum la: gdos gzugs mi ru 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi 'brel ba'i gzungs ma la: ye shes mkha' 'gror ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: rdo rje mched lcam bstan pa'i srog 'dzin la: mos blos gus 'dun chung ba mthol lo bshags: rgyu 'bras dngos su ngo sprod dkyil 'khor la: sgom sgrub 'dzin spel chung ba mthol lo bshags: spangs rtogs chung bas nges don ma rtogs te: mtshan ldan bla mar smad pa mthol lo bshags: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gsang ba'i dal bzung nas:

bskyed rim so sor ma gsal mthol lo bshags: gnas lugs rang rig lta ba'i rgyud sbyangs nas: rdzogs rim sgyu mar ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: bzlas brjod snying nas sgrub pa'i srog btsal nas: sgra chad zur nyams gyur pa mthol lo bshags: mchod rdzas rgya mtsho bcud kyi don rtog nas: gsog 'jog phri lhag bgyis pa mthol lo bshags: bdud rtsi'i ngo bo byang chub gnas gzhi la: rmad byung yon tan ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: dam rdzas gter chen dngos grub rtsa ba la: dam med bya khyir byin pa mthol lo bshags: dmar chen mkha' dbyings brgyud nas babs pa la: bzang ngan sme bar 'dzin pa mthol lo bshags: sbyor mchod drug ldan dug lnga rang grol la: lhan skyes bdud rtsir ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: sgrol mchod 'khor 'das gcig tu bsres pa la: mtshan 'dzin ru trar dmigs pa mthol lo bshags: spyan gzigs tshogs drug snang ba'i longs spyod la: bzang ngan mtshan mar chags pa mthol lo bshags: snod bcud gzugs snang rig pa'i rang rtsal la: a 'thas yul la chags pa mthol lo bshags: dbang bskur dam mnos cho ga'i rgyud sbyang la: nya stong dus bzhi chags pa mthol lo bshags: so thar nyan thos phra mo'i sgor zhugs nas: khas blangs dam la 'gal ba mthol lo bshags: kṛ ya u pa rgyud sde'i sgor zhugs nas: dkyil 'khor dam tshig nyams pa mthol lo bshags: ma hā a ti bla med sgor zhugs nas: chos nyid sems su ma rtogs mthol lo bshags: 'khor 'das ro gcig mnyam pa'i ngang tshul la: bzang ngan ris su phyes pa mthol lo bshags: dug lnga ye grol ye shes lnga ru bshags: dug gsum sku gsum mnyam nyid ngang du bshags: rnam rtog tshogs drug mi rtag dbyings su bshags: kun gzhi ma rig ka dag ngang du bshags: phung khams rnam dag rigs lnga rgyal bar bshags: khams lnga rnam dag yum tshogs rigs lngar bshags: 'byung lnga rnam dag lha mo lnga ru bshags: sgo dgu'i 'dzin rtog theg dgu'i ngang la bshags:

rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad du bshags: skye mched bcu gnyis lha mo rnams la bshags: rigs drug 'khrul 'khor thub pa drug la bshags: rtag chad mu bzhi sgo ma bzhi ru bshags: 'khrul 'dzin sna tshogs dkyil 'khor lha la bshags: mthol lo bshags so bla ma yi dam lha: gnong ngo 'gyod do dam can chos skyong tshogs: mthol lo mthol lo yi dam lha la mthol: bshags pa de ni srung ma gnyan la bshags: gnong 'gyod drag po'i mthol bshags yar bzhes la: mi sgrib tshangs pa 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ratna sa twa hūm̐: om̐ padma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ karma sa twa hūm̐: om̐ gu ru sa twa hūm̐: om̐ dhe wa sa twa hūm̐: om̐ ḍākki sa twa hūm̐: om̐ he ru ka sa twa hūm̐ āḥ zhes yig brgya brjod cing chad lhag bkang : de nas bzlog pa ni: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: gzhan gyi bsam sbyor ngan pa zlog: ban bon gdug pa'i byad kha zlog: tshe zor nyungs zor 'phen pa zlog: he ru ka yi drag sngags zlog: ma mos dmod pa'i thun sngags zlog: 'byung pos thog zor 'phen pa zlog: gshin rjes 'khor lo bskor ba zlog: klu yi gtad khram ngan pa zlog: gza' yi 'gyu srang thebs pa zlog: dam can mi blo dkrugs pa zlog: rgyal pos snying rlung gtong ba zlog: btsan gyi jag sna rgyug pa zlog: lha yi bka' chad g.yo ba zlog: lha min mtshon cha 'khrugs pa zlog: gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debs pa zlog: 'dre mos mi bla khyer ba zlog: srin mos brda than gtong ba zlog: gnam 'khrug ri ltar nyil ba zlog: yul 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa zlog: dus 'khrug mu ge'i chad pa zlog: phywa g.yang dkor mdzod nyams pa zlog: gtad khram rtsis la 'debs pa zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ngan thams cad zlog: lo skag zla skag zhag skag zlog: za skag dus tshod skag rnams zlog: tshe zad za res 'khor ba zlog: spar sme dur du tshud pa zlog:

skag rigs sum brgya drug cu zlog: ye 'drog brgyad cu gya gcig zlog: glo bur dgu bcu rtsa gcig zlog: nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: byad zor phur kha ngan pa zlog: brgya yi mi kha ngan pa zlog: stong gi bram mchu bsdig pa zlog: pho bdud dal kha g.yas su sgyur: mo bdud dal kha g.yon du sgyur: spyi bdud dal kha mkha' la sgyur: chung bdud dal kha 'og tu sgyur: bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ha la tshal pa kha thun ya bhyo thun ya: rbad du ya: nan lo shag: dun ma mo ra tsa dgra la zlog zlog: ces bzlog pa lan gsum bskul lo: sa ma ya: e ma kho bo padma 'byung gnas ngas: ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams mar 'grib dus: dpal bskyed bsod nams yang ldan de yi don: snying byang dum bu tshigs su bcad pa yi: yang zab bskang ba dngos grub char 'bebs bzhag: ye shes mtsho rgyal brda yi ri mor gzugs: bskang ba'i yon tan phan yon blo las 'das: sngags bcud dam tshig nyams na bskang ba bya: dge slong 'dul khrims nyams na bskang ba bya: dus kyi chad pa byung na bskang ba bya: rdo rje slob dpon bka' 'gal bskang ba bya: yi dam bskyed rim log na bskang ba bya: mkha' 'gro'i bka' chad byung na bskang ba bya: chos skyong dam can 'khu na bskang ba bya: sngon dbang rkyen ngan byung na bskang ba bya: 'phral stobs rten 'brel log na bskang ba bya: yul 'khrug rtsod gzhi byung na bskang ba bya: dus 'khrug mu ge byung na bskang ba bya: nad dal rkyen kha byung na bskang ba bya: shes pa bying rmugs 'thib na bskang ba bya: 'byung bzhi tshe 'phrang che na bskang ba bya: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams na bskang ba bya: bskang chog zab mo'i phan yon bsam mi khyab: 'dod rgu dngos grub 'byung pa'i bskang ba la: yid blo sems dga' dge ba'i sa bon ste: gling bzhi mdzod gling dgos na 'di nas longs: de ltar ya mtshan bkod pa phun tshogs chos:

kho bo bdag gis shog dril mgul khug ma: snying byang zab mo+-i atsha sa ma ya: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye dus: o rgyan gter bdag gling dang 'phrad par shog: bka' 'di srungs shig las mgon bya rog gdong : skal ldan las 'phro can gyi lag tu sprod: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan gter bdag gling pas sbas yul padma bkod nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bsgyur/ yi ge pa ni o rgyan chos dar zhes pas bgyis pa'o/ /shog ser tsha bo las bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // pa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmag bskul drag sngags 'brug sgra bzhugs so: dpal chen he ru ka la bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e maḥ kho bo drag sngags pad 'byung ngas: dmag bskul chen mo drag sngags 'brug sgra bstan: dbang gi rgyal mo ye shes mtsho rgyal ma: rin chen brda yi shog ser logs su bris: ye shes 'khor lo gsang ba'i gter du sbos: ma 'ongs yang mtha' nyi shu la nye tshe: las can skyes bu de dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de yang dmag bskul bya ba'i rim pa ni: bla dar rten dar g.yab dar bsgreng : go cha ru mtshon sna tshogs bya: spyan gzigs mthun rdzas tshang bar bsham: thugs dam gnad nas bskul ba'i tshe: bla ma rig 'dzin yi dam dang : mkha' 'gro chos skyong ma lus kyis: rang rang dmag dang dpung tshogs rnams: 'bum phrag sa ya sdud mdzad nas: dgra yi yul du chas par bsam: dmag dang 'khrug rtsod bzlog par bsam: sku rim bsrung ba'i dus dag du: rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog par dmigs: zlog byed khro bo phyi ru gzigs: hūm̐ sgra dang bcas chas par bsam: sha khrag brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang : skyems bzang rakta rgyas par bsham: rnal 'byor dmod pa'i chas zhugs te: rol mo rnams kyang drag tu 'bir: rkang gling sgra ldan drag tu gtser: sha chen sna tshogs dud pa btang :

phyi nang bskyed rdzogs brtan par bya: bskul pa rim bzhin gtor ma 'bul: ka dag dbyings nas 'di ltar bskul: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: chos dbyings rnam dag yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: sna tshogs klong yangs padma'i gdan gyi steng : kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs dbyings nas bzhengs: thogs med thugs dam gnyan po rgyud bskul cig: sku mdog sna tshogs longs spyod phrin las rdzogs: phyag mtshan sa bon nyi zer rdul ltar g.yo: thugs rje'i gzi brjid 'od dpung 'ja' ltar shar: gsung dbyangs stong nyid sgra grags 'brug ltar sgrog: byin rlabs thugs rje'i nus rtsal sprin ltar gtibs: zhi ba'i tshul dgu ldan mdzad dbyings kyi lha: thugs dam gnyan po 'byin pa'i dus la bab: da lta dus ngan snyigs ma'i mtha' la thug: gsang sngags bstan pa'i sgron me nub la nye: dug lnga'i las kyi dmag dpung mtha' bzhir 'khor: mu stegs log chos mgo bskor dar lags te: mtha' yas sems can nyon mongs 'khor bar 'khyams: dkar po dge bcu'i bar chad rlung ltar 'tshub: nag po bdud rigs rkyen ngan kha dar bas: thugs rje mnga' ba'i nus rtsal mi 'byin na: blo gtad dpang btsugs khyed la byas lags sam: de bzhin thugs dam gnyan po dbyings nas bskul: nyon mongs bdud kyi dpung tshogs gzhom slad du: ye shes dbyings kyi lha tshogs dmag dpung bskyed: kun tu bzang po ka dag dmag tshogs 'bum: mi g.yo rdo rje'i go khrab si li li: stong nyid mtshon cha'i rno ngar zengs se zeng : snying rjes 'gugs byed lcags kyu khyugs se khyug: ro gcig dpa' ba'i rngam rgyug sha ra ra: gsal stong shes rab mkha' 'gro spungs se spung : longs sku lnga ldan dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: lhun grub chos kyi dbyings nas dmag dpung bskyed: rig 'dzin sgrub la ye shes spyan gyis gzigs: sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: drag po mthu yi dpung grogs phrin las bcol:

ma dag dug lnga'i dmag tshogs rtsad nas chod: kun bzang zhi ba'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis: sha khrag dmar chen bdud rtsi 'di bzhes la: khams gsum 'khor ba'i rigs drug stongs par mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas khrag 'thung khro bo che mchog lha tshogs kyi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: byol song gtso brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: dpal chen khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru kar: 'bar ba'i khro bo'i dmag tshogs 'bum gyis bskor: mi mngon dag pa chos kyi klong nas bzhengs: mthu ldan dmag dpung bskyed pa'i dus la bab: gzi byin stong khams me 'od 'u ru ru: drag po nyi zla'i spyan rtsa glog ltar 'khyugs: zhal nas hūm̐ sgra drag po 'brug ltar ldir: sgrol byed mtshon cha'i tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: stong nyid drag po'i go cha ri ltar brjid: srid gsum zil gnon sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad: gling bzhi brgyad kyi khro rgyal dmag tshogs sdud: yang sprul khro chung stong khams 'jig rten gang : thugs dam nus rtsal bskyed pa'i dus la bab: da lta snyigs ma lnga brgya tha ma'i dus: sangs rgyas bstan pa mtha' la nye gyur cing : rkyen kha glo bur bar chad dgra sdang bas: khro rgyal mngon spyod drag po'i dus la bab: pha tshogs khro bcu'i dmag tshogs thibs se thib: ma tshogs khro mo'i las byed sha ra ra: 'khor tshogs bka' yi srung ma nyi li li: drag sngags dmod pa'i mtshon cha sa la la: dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: khro bo 'dus pa'i lha tshogs rgyang ma ring : ma dag dam nyams bdud dmag cham la phob: rkyen kha glo bur bar chad dgra la byol: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha tshogs thams cad kyis: sha khrag dmar chen rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: sngags 'chang rig 'dzin bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: bdud 'dul g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod:

rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phul: de nas shar phyogs yang dag gi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: zhe sdang me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: dri za pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen khrag 'thung yang dag he ru kaḥ yum mchog kro ti shwa ris sku la 'khril: thugs sras rigs bzhi kau rī dbang phyug ma: sgo ma dam can chos skyong bye ba 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: shar gyi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi bka' nyan pa'i: mthing nag khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mo srog la rngam: kau rī dbang phyug sgo skyong tshogs: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rlung la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul ba'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang :

bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud par shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: hūm̐: rin chen gter gyi srung ma rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas 'jam dpal gshin rje'i bskul pa ni: hūm̐: nga rgyal ri ltar nyil ba'i klong dkyil nas: gshin rje pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen khrag 'thung 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed: yum mchog bhe ta za byed sku la 'khril: gshed chen sde brgyad gshin rje sum cu gnyis: sgo skyong ging bzhi bdud po shwa thogs dang : dam can chos skyong bka' sdod bye ba 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: lho yi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: gshin rje'i gshed kyi bka' nyan pa: ser nag khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: gsod byed ging dang bdud khram thogs: sho kha 'gyed dang srog bdag tshogs: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad g.yo: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rlung la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra:

dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog par shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan snang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud par shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas dbang chen rta mgrin bskul pa ni: hūm̐: 'dod chags khrag mtsho mer ba'i klong dkyil nas: klu bdud pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen khrag 'thung khro bo dbang gi rgyal: yum mchog padma gzi ldan sku la 'khril: dbang chen rigs bzhi zil gnon bcu gnyis pa: sgo srung khams brgyad ling pa 'dab can dang : 'brug mo khyi spyang gdug pa'i bka' sdod tshogs: dam can pho nya chos skyong bye ba 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: nub kyi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: dbang chen padma'i bka' nyan pa'i: dmar nag khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam:

khams brgyad long ba brgyad sbrel dang : 'dab ma can dang 'brug mo bzhi: khyi spyang la sogs dregs pa'i tshogs: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rlung la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: khro rgyal dbang chen lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas phur pa phrin las kyi bskul pa ni:

hūm̐: phrag dog rlung ltar 'tshubs pa'i klong dkyil nas: gnod sbyin pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: bcom ldan dpal chen badzra ku mā ra: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril: thugs sras rigs bzhi khro bcu sgo skyong che: shwa na re ti sa bdag skyes bu dang : bdud po ging bcas chos skyong bka' sdod 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bo cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: byang gi phyogs nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' nyan pa: mthing nag khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: shwa na re ti sa bdag sman: skyes bu bdud po ging chen tshogs: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu pa'i rlung la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang :

bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas ma mo rbod gtong gi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: gti mug mun ltar gtibs pa'i klong dkyil nas: me lha pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dpal chen khrag 'thung bla med he ru kaḥ yum mchog kun bzang nyid zhis sku la 'khril: gsal byed khro bzhi lha mo bcu gnyis pa: ma mo rtsa gsum sgo skyong dus kyi bdag: ma sring mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo chen mo brgyad: gling bzhi'i ma mo sgo skyong pho nya 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: shar lho'i mtshams nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro bo 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: bla med khrag 'thung bka' nyan pa: ljang nag khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mo srog la rngam: dus drug ma mo sring mo bzhi: gtso mo brgyad dang gling bzhi nyul: sgo srung bka' sdod dam can tshogs:

sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rlung la zhon: nam phyed dgra gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul pa'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa mang yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: bla med khro bo'i lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas thod phreng drag po'i bskul pa ni: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: srin po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du:

snang srid dbang sdud drag po thod phreng rtsal: yum chen gsang ba ye shes sku la 'khril: dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda brgyud slob dpon dang : snyan brgyud la sogs mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho dang : ma gza' shan pa phyi nang bka' skyong 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: lho nub mtshams nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: bla ma thod phreng bka' nyan pa: dmar smug khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: ma gza' rdor legs shan pa dang : mon pa gnod sbyin dmag tshogs rnams: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar nag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rta la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang :

'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i bran g.yog sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: drag po thod phreng lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chom: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas 'jig rten mchod bstod kyi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: dug rlangs sngo dmar g.yo ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'byung po pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: dregs 'dul chen po 'jig rten khro bo'i rgyal: yum chen srid gsum spyi 'dul sku la 'khril: srog bdag yab yum phyogs skyong sgo ba che: sde dpon sum cu khrag 'thung bye ba 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byaur bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: nub byang mtshams nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: 'jig rten khro rgyal bka' nyan pa: kham nag khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang : phyi nang bka' sdod dam can rnams: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyi stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes:

skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rta la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud par shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: 'jig rten khro rgyal lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas dmod pa drag sngags kyi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: sha khrag rba klong 'khrugs pa'i klong dkyil nas: dbang ldan pho mo bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: khrag 'thung khro rgyal drag sngags he ru kar: yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdag mos sku la 'khril: thugs kyi sras mchog gsod byed yab yum brgyad: sde dpon dgu dang sgo skyong pho nya 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: ṛg 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: byang shar mtshams nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags bka' nyan pa: nag po khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: srog bdag sde dpon sgo skyong tshogs: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rta la gzhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul ba'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang :
