bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i dgra bo sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtaur: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chom: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas bar khyams bka' sdod kyi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: pho nya glog ltar 'gyu ba'i klong dkyil nas: mi ro rta ro brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: sprul pa'i khro rgyal yab yum chen po brgyad: dbang phyug nyer brgyad ye shes mkha' 'gro lnga: ging dang ma mo sring mo laṅka dang : zhing skyong khro bo sprul pa'i khyung chen brgyad: 'bar ma pho nya sa bdag bstan ma dang : dus bzhi dus drug bdag mo tshe ring ma: dam can chos skyong srung ma mthu bo che: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: phyi nang mtshams nas dgra dang bgegs byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon bka' nyan pa: sna tshogs khro bo bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: khro bo brgyad dang dbang phyug ma: mkha' 'gro ging dang ma mo bdun:

sring mo laṅka zhing skyong brgyad: keng rus 'bar ma pho nya bcu: sa bdag bstan ma 'byung ba'i bdag: dus drug bdag mo tshe ring ma: bka' sdod dam can chos skyong rnams: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams dpag tshad khyab: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rta la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul ba'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog: dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i bran g.yog sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon bka' nyan rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chom: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas gter srung gi bskul ni: hūm̐: stong khams rlung ltar khyab pa'i klong dkyil nas: bstan dgra dam nyams bsnol ba'i gdan steng du: mgon chen sde bzhi zhing skyong ma mo gza': rdor legs btsan rgod gnod sbyin lha klu bdud: dge bsnyen klu mo sde brgyad bye ba 'bum: mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: drag po mthu yi dngos grub deng 'dir stsol: ma rungs gdug pa'i dgra bgegs cham la phob: gzi byin mthu stobs 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dmag tshogs bskyed la ru mtshon myur du phyor: zab gter gnyan la sdang ba'i dgra byung na: mthu ldan khro tshogs 'bum gyis sgrol bar mdzod: hūm̐: che mchog bka' brgyad bstan srung pa: rigs mthun khro tshogs bye ba 'bum: rab 'jigs khro mos srog la rngam: mgon chen sde bzhi ma mo gza': rdor legs gtsan rgod gnod sbyin lha: klu bdud dge bsnyen klu mo dang : sde brgyad sha za bye ba'i tshogs: sra ba'i go cha lus la gyon: rno ba'i mtshon cha lag na thogs: rdzu 'phrul rlung gi rta la zhon: stobs kyis stong khams khyab par g.yo: zas su sha khrag snying la dgyes: skom du dgra bgegs snying khrag gsol: las su srog dbugs snying rtsa sdud: tho rangs dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: skya rengs dkar po'i rta la zhon: nyin phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: dmar thag nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mun rub dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: smag nag 'gyu ba'i rta la zhon: nam phyed dgra srog gcod pa'i tshe: gti mug 'khrul ba'i bdud dang bsdong : nyin mtshan 'gyu ba dus drug tu: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: rnam shes 'khyams po khrid la shog: hūm̐: rbad cing bskul ba'i las mkhan 'bum: chos shig dmag dpung myur du bskyed: mkhar rdzong bshig pa mang yod kyang : gtsug lag bshig pa bstan pa'i dgra: dam nyams bstan bshig sgrol la shog:

dgra la dmag 'dren mang yod kyang : bdag la dmag 'dren thad kyi dgra: dmag dpon dmag mi rten dang phrol: dgra sdang byed pa mang yod kyang : 'tshe bar byed pa lag dmar dgra: sha rtsa lag dmar sgrol la shog: jag chom byed pa mang yod kyang : ka cha 'phrog pa shom pa'i dgra: bdag la 'tshe ba'i jag chom sgrol: dam tshig bral ba mang yod kyang : slob ma dam nyams nang gi dgra: bsam ngan sdang ba'i bran g.yog sgrol: dug lnga 'dzin pa brgya yod kyang : sbyar dug blud pa shom pa'i dgra: dug ma khyim bcas sgrol la shog: hūm̐: rin chen gter gyi srung ma rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: dmag dpon sod la dmag mi gtor: go cha mtshon cha dum bur chog: ma g.yel bka' yi las byed 'bum: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma 'bul: de nas bka' skyong yongs rdzogs kyi bskul pa ni: hūm̐: lhun grub chos dbyings pho brang nas: log 'dren bdud bzhi bsnol ba'i steng : dpal chen gsang ba zil gnon lha: bka' brgyad 'dus pa dgu yi tshogs: dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs skur bzhengs shig: thams cad mthu stobs dpa' ba'i shugs: drag po'i gzi byin che ba'i rtsal: mnga' dbang che btsan 'bar ba'i me: dpal 'bar myur mgyogs rbad pa'i sngags: bskul bzhengs tha tshig sgrog pa'i dam: phrin las thams cad 'byin par mdzod: hūm̐: dpal chen khro rgyal 'dus pa'i tshogs: bskul lo ye shes rgyang ma ring : brten no yi dam byin ma yal: mngag go thugs dam rgyud ma 'gyang : rbad do chos skyong mthu ma chung : g.yab bo pho nya bang ma bul: sha khrag rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la: skal ldan rnal 'byor sdong grogs mdzod: skal med dgra la chad pa phob: log 'dren dam nyams rtsad nas chod: tshe bdud pho mo'i snying rtsa phyungs: dam sri 'dre rgod khong khrag rol: gson 'dre pho mo'i bla srog bkums:

bar chod rtsom pa'i mgo lus phrol: mi kha sbyor ba'i dbang po snubs: jag rkun chom po rjes med thongs: 'gras pa'i dgra bo rten yul phung : nad bdag god 'dre phye mar shigs: rkyen ngan bar chad dgra la phob: dus la bab bo dam tshig dgongs: de ring drag po'i zor chen 'phen: mthu ldan srung ma dmag dpung skyed: dgra bo ma gtogs sku bzur cig: dmar chen gtor ma drag po'i mtshon: nyes can dgra bo'i snying du ya: lo zla zhag dus bzhag thabs med: za ma chu tshod da lta nyid: myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra ya du pra mo ha: du shag ning le dgra bo'i snying la hur thuṃ rbad bhyoḥ zhes gtor ma 'phang ngam bskyal: ye shes dang 'jig rten gyi dmag dpung bskyed nas: stong khams thams cad khengs par 'phros te dgra bo'i yul khang phung zhing brlag: phyi nang gi rkyen ngan rnams myur mar zhi bar bsam zhing bskul: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra pad 'byung ngas: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: dregs pa'i dmag bskul 'brug sgra bzhag: gnas skabs khag chen ma yin par: dus min bskul du m-i gtub ste: dregs pa sde brgyad khro ba'i skyon: gnyan pa'i bskul pa sa ma ya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal padma rong nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o// // pha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsad pa dug gi spu gri nag po bzhugs so: khrag 'thung dmod pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: sa ma ya: e maḥ rgya gar mkhas pa drag sngags thod phreng gis: dregs pa srog thig snying 'byin nag po'i rgyud: bsad pa las bzhi'i rim pa bstan par bya: sa ma ya: dang po drag po'i snod dam lcags kyi hom du: liṅga dbang po tshang bar bris: zan ling bzhag:

gser skyems dang bsgral chas gri lag zhing lpags bya rog dang 'ug pa'i sgro thun rdzas sna tshogs hom gzar: gu gul dkar nag sogs mkho ba'i rdzas rnams tshang bar bsham: de nas las kyi rim pa bzhin: rdo rje slob dpon gyi dmod pa'i drag sngags kyi chas gos nag po: phung byed shāntiṃ garbha'i rgyud ltar bya ste: thog mar gser skyems 'thor zhing : rol mo dang dbyangs bcas nas khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: mi mngon chos dbyings lhun grub pho brang nas: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dur khrod e yi dbus: bka' brgyad zil gnon lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: phyi rim dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi srung ma che: dam can rgya mtsho'i dmag tshogs dgongs su gsol: ye shes spyan gyis bdag la gzigs su gsol: yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dpung la bzhengs: rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtshos rgyab rten mdzod: chos skyong dam can pho nya las la bskul: ma nyes dpang po mdzod cig thugs dam can: rin chen gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: dam nyams bdud kyi mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig: ma nyes ma len rnal 'byor sngags 'chang bdag: dkar po dge bcu thar lam tshul ci bzhin: bsgrub pa'i snying stobs dge ba ldan lags kyang : dam nyams dgra 'dis bdag la brnyas btsugs so: mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer: chos skyong srung ma khyed la phod btang nas: 'gras btsal do bsdos bka' 'gal zhing bcu 'di: yi dam lha yis mgon skyabs ma mdzad cig: las mkhan pho nya rnams la gnyer du gtad: dgra 'di mgon byed ye shes 'jig rten rnams: rin chen gser skyems bzang po 'di bzhes la: byad ma dam nyams 'di la rang gshed phob: bka' 'gal sdig can 'di la chad pa chod: bstan dgra bdud rigs 'di yi srog rtsa chod: log lta skal ngan 'di la dal kha phob: dam nyams 'di la ma mgon gzhan du dengs:

gal te 'di yi dpung grogs byed srid na: dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi bka' yang bcags: rig 'dzin brgyud pa rnams kyi dam yang bkral: de bas rang rang gnas su 'gro bar gyis: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag 'khor bcas rnams: rin chen gser skyems 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: mtho bas zhabs bskum dma' bas dbu chums shig: bar pas sku bzur g.yas g.yon phyogs su bzhud: gnam lcags phur bu thun rdzas reg phung gis: sku la phog kyang ma nyes smras pa'i tshe: so so'i ci bzhin bka' las ma 'da' bar: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gser skyems sbreng zhing ma nyes dpang du dkon mchog bzhugs par bsam: de nas liṅga gu gul bdug cing rngam yangs kyi hom du ral gri dang 'khor lo'i dbus su gnam lcags khang par bskyed cing : drag sngags ma lus pa'i bdag nyid dmod pa bor chog he ru ka'i skur gsal ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: rang nyid dpal chen dmod pa'i khro rgyal khrag 'thung he ru ka chen po sku mdog mun rum drag tu gtibs pa'i gzugs can: sku stod sum cu rtsa gsum srid pa'i rtser slebs pas: gzugs med khams bsngangs shing brgyal ba: sked pas gzugs khams snang srid khyab pas lha srin 'byung po bran du khol ba: sku smad 'dod khams na raka dmyal khams bco brgyad la thug pas bgegs srin 'byung po phye mar gzhom pa: sku'i cha la bskal pa 'jigs pa'i dus kyi me ltar 'bar zhing pho nya dang las mkhan skar ltar 'khrugs pa'i tsha zer 'phro ba: stong gsum khyon las 'das pa'i zhal dgu rngam zhing khro la spyan rtsa glog ltar 'gyu zhing shangs nas bskal pa'i rlung nag 'bud pa: dbu skra dmar nag srid rtser g.yeng zhing thod skam dang rin po che'i prog zhu la: dar nag gi cod pan 'phur zhing sbrul rigs lngas brgyan pa: phyag g.yas pa dgu na gnam lcags rdo rje nag po mkha' la gdeng ba me'i tshwa tshwa can bsnams shing :

g.yon pa dgu na khro rgyal srid pa las kyi phur bu thog rgod ltar 'dril ba: sku stod la zhing chen gyi 'gying gos glang chen gyi g.yang gzhi chu srin gyi dpung g.yogs seng lpags kyi 'phyang rgyan: khrag zhag gi thig le: thal chen gyi tshom bu: rus pa'i rgyan drug byas shing : rdo rje dang rin po che'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa: thod rlon gyi do shal dang : stag lpags kyi sham thabs: rgyu ma'i rtsi phreng : sbrul lnga'i ga shal dang yan lag brgyan cing : drag po'i chas du ma dang ldan pa: zhabs brgyad gyad kyis dor stabs bgrad pa: lha srin bsnol ba'i khrir brjid pa: de'i pang du 'byung lnga'i dbang mo nag la 'jigs pa'i dbyibs can 'khyud pa: zhal gsum gdangs shing spyan mig glog ltar 'gyu ba dur khrod rgyan gyi chas can: g.yas gsum gri gug phyar zhing : g.yon gsum thod khrag yab la stob pa: gzig sham dkris shing zhabs bzhi yab la 'khril ba: yab yum bskal pa'i me lta bu'i klong du gsal ba'o: de'i mdun du thugs kyi sprul pa sgrol byed shan pa snying zan sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: srin po'i gzugs can mi sdug pa'i chas dgu dang ldan pa: 'joms byed srid pa'i phur bu dmar lhang nge ba: mgal ba'i sol me nas bton pa ci bzhin tsha ba'i ngar dang ldan pa 'dril zhing 'debs pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri badzra kī li kī la ya ma hā yakṣa kā la rū pa karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la ram̐ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ badzra duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyo hūm̐ phaṭḥ

ces sngags bzlas shing phur bu byin gyis brlab: de nas hom khung du liṅga dgra bo'i rten du dmigs pa ni: phaṭḥ mdun du e dang kaṃ las grub pa'i gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom dmar nag 'jigs shing ya nga ba: steng na zhe sdang gi me 'bar ba: logs na nga rgyal gyi ser ba 'bebs pa: bar na phra dog gi rlung dmar 'tshubs pa: nang na gti mug gi mun nag 'thib pa: 'og na 'dod chags kyi khrag mtsho phyur ba: 'chi bdag gshin rje'i bsad khang : srog bdag bdud kyi btson ra: btsan dmar 'bum gyi bsha' ra: las mkhan pho nya 'bum gyi brub khung : srog gcod shan pa 'bum gyi bsad ra: sgrol ging ma mo 'bum gyi thun lam: sha za srin po pho mo'i 'gyu srang : nad bdag pho mo rnams kyi rgyu lam: dur sri phra men kun gyi sgrub gnas: khang sgrom nag po rngam la 'thug pa dmar la 'bar ba: zin nas thar pa med pa'i nang du: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo lus sngo ba ham pa skya la rid pa bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing nad rlangs gtibs pa: mgo bo lho nub mtshams su bstan cing : rkang pa byang shar mtshams su bsdams pa: yan lag rnams lcags sgrog gis dam par bsdams shing : mgon skyabs kyi lha dang phral ba: kho'i lhan cig skyes pa'i lha dang 'dre gnyis dug sbrul dkar nag tu gyur nas: ro rkyang gi lam du zhugs shing dbang po dam du bsdams te: srog khrag gi dwangs ma 'jib cing dbang po'i sgo dgur brgyud de za zhing dkris pa: g.yas g.yon du 'chi bdag gi sdig pa pho mo'i snying rtsa dkrug cing yan lag bzhi nas snying khrag 'jib pa: sdom dang rus sbal rnams kyis dbang po'i sgo rnams bkag cing snying rtsa 'dren zhing smre sngags gis 'o dod tser ba nyam thag pa'i gzugs can zhig tu gyur: de'i phyi rol za byed kyi gcan spyang 'gugs byed kyi pho nya: sgrol byed kyi las mkhan: 'ded byed kyi shan pa: 'khrid byed kyi mon pa dpag tu med pas bskor cing :

nam yang 'bros pa'i gnas med par gyur: om̐ badzra thun nṛ tri ru tra mā ra ya ma dzaḥdzaḥdzaḥ de nas lan gsum 'gugs shing nam yang 'bros dbang med par bsam: na mo: drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang : chos kyi bka' bden pa dang : dge bdun gyi bka' bden pa dang : gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang bcom ldan zhi khro rab 'byams dkyil 'khor rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : kun bzang dpal dgu'i lha tshogs zhi ba rigs lnga he ru ka mched dgu: sems dpa' yab yum bcu drug khrag 'thung bzhi: thub pa rigs drug sgo skyong dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : dpal chen khrag 'thung he ru ka yab yum ye shes kyi khro bo bcu phyogs skyong 'dul byed bcu: ta krita khro bo bzhi: lce spyang ma mo brgyad: sgo skyong srung ma dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : che mchog bla med khrag 'thung yab yum he ru ka rigs bzhi kau rī ma mo 'bum sde dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad sgo ba bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : 'jam dpal gshin rje 'bar ba yab yum: gshed chen sde bzhi: za byed pha bcu: gsod byed ma bcu: ging chen sde bzhi: bdud po sde bzhi: rtsis pa rigs bzhi: shan pa sgo skyong dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : dbang chen khro rgyal rta mgrin yab yum: zil gnon khro rgyal rigs brgyad: khrag 'thung dbang gi sras bzhi: khams brgyad sprul pa'i ma mo: 'chi bdag dmus long brgyad sbrel: pho nya 'byung lnga'i gzugs can: sgra sgrogs 'brug mo sde bzhi: khyi spyang sha za gcan gzan: sgo ba dregs pa dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum sras bzhi: khrag 'thung khro bo bcu khra thabs 'bar ba: shwa na ma mo rigs bzhi: re ma ti mched bzhi:

sa bdag mched bzhi: skyes bu ging bzhi: bdud po phur thogs bzhi: sgo skyong phur srung dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : khro rgyal bla med he ru ka yab yum ma mo bzhi: khrag 'thung ma mo bcu bzhi: srog gcod sman mo nyer gsum: lha bdud btsan gyi ma bzhi: lce spyang sring mo bzhi: dus kyi phung byed ma mo bye ba: sgo ba sde dpon dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : dpal chen drag po thod phreng rtsal yab yum gu ru zil gnon rtsal rig 'dzin sde bzhi: dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa'i rig 'dzin brgyad: dgongs brda snyan brgyud dam tshig man ngag lung gi slob dpon yab yum: rdo rje rin chen padma las kyi rigs sogs gnas yul gyi dur khrod dpa' bo ḍākki la sogs rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : sngags bdag 'jig rten khro bo yab yum: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu: sgo skyong phyi nang sde brgyad dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : drag sngags dmod pa'i khro rgyal yab yum: snying 'byin rigs lnga: srog bdag shan pa sde bdun: dus 'dzin mon pa mched brgyad: phung byed gnod sbyin rigs bzhi sgo skyong dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang : gzhan yang sgo ba brgyad sgo ma brgyad: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad: las kyi mkha' 'gro rigs bzhi: ging chen sde bzhi: ma mo mched bdun: las kyi sring brgyad: laṅka srin po bcu: zhing skyong tshogs brgyad: dur khrod ma mo brgyad: 'bar ma pho nya dgu: dus kyi pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi: sa bdag sum cu so gnyis: bod skyong brtan ma bcu gnyis: dus kyi lha mo: dus drug bdag mo: tshe ring mched lnga: sprul pa'i pho nya bye ba sa ya rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du yang dpal ye shes kyi mgon po legs ldan phyag bzhi pa: srog bdag bya rog gdong can: zhing skyong dpal 'bar stobs ldan: ma gza' rdor legs shan pa:

btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung : klu rgyal mun pa stag ring : dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad: klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan: lha chen rgyal ba thod dkar: gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo: sman btsun las mkhan mched brgyad: klu bdud nā ga raksha: dge bsnyen yaksha ging dmar: gza' rgod shan pa mig dmar: klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring : gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu: las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog: srin mo gdong dmar mgo gsum: dam can raksha thod phreng : mon pa gcer bu spun bdun: la sogs pa sgrub chen bka' brgyad kyi srung ma mthu stobs dang ldan pa khyed rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang : khyad par du'ang chos nyid de bzhin nyid dang chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa chen po'i mthu dang nus pa la brten nas: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: dkon mchog gi sgos dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi zur dgra: snga dgra lag gis brdar zhing : phyi dgra zhe ru 'chang ba: da dgra thad du langs pa: spyi dgra rlung ltar 'tshubs pa: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mchod pa'i mdangs 'phrog pa: ting nge 'dzin gyi bcud bsdus pa: dngos grub la bar du gcod pa: phug gi lha la gnod pa: bar gyi mi la 'tshe ba: khyim sgo phyi nang la gnod pa: che sri ri bo'i rtse nas 'bab pa: chung sri rgya mtsho'i klong nas 'gyu ba: dar sri dur khrod nang nas langs pa: gri sri gzhon pa'i snying du zhugs pa: thab sri spyad dang nor la chags pa: dur sri gshin yul 'og nas don pa: dgra sri phyogs bzhi'i mtshams nas langs pa: phung sri sgo bzhi'i zur nas langs pa: gyod sri thabs 'khon yul la chags pa: na sri 'byung bzhi dbang po 'khrug pa: 'chi sri srog bdag khram la 'debs pa: mug sri bse rag yul la chags pa: rkyen sri nad bdag mkha' la 'gyu ba: god sri ra ba'i phug na zhen pa: gzhan yang bstan pa'i le gu lha log: bslabs pa'i slob ma dam log:

bzhag pa'i bran g.yog ngo log: nyos pa'i chung ma snying ring : gtam pa'i shag rogs mna' zan: 'dres pa'i mdza' rogs snying ngan: bsten pa'i mgo dpon khrel med: rus kyi nang tshan rgyab log: bcos pa'i nad pa gsos log: skyabs pa'i yon bdag gzhung ngan: mchod pa'i yul lha khrel med: gzhan yang phu'i chos g.yag la 'tshe ba: mda' yi mchod zhing 'phrog pa: bar gyi grwa slob bcom pa: dmag sna jag sna ston pa: sngon nas sgug dgos zer ba: rgyab nas 'ded dgos zer ba: rtsod dgos 'phrog dgos zer ba: bcom dgos gtor dgos zer ba: dben ri gnyan po bshig pa: gtsug lag chos 'khor bcom pa: dge 'dun mthun gnyis phye ba: gsang sngags chos la smad pa: ma nyes kha yog 'gel ba: tshe dang srog la gnod pa: dbang thang g.yang la 'phrog pa: lam gyi mgron po bcom pa: gzhan yang skra nag bzhin du spyi bor g.yab pa: rtsang dmar bzhin du mdun nas gzengs pa: khyi dmar bzhin du phyi ru 'brang ba: rta rnga bzhin du rgyud la 'khril ba: thag nag bzhin du mgul nas bsdams pa: g.yer ma bzhin du dgra kha bye ba: bra bo bzhin du zur btsugs byed pa: g.yab dar bzhin du mi kha phyar ba: gnod sems sdang zhing gzhan mthu bskul ba: bsam sbyor ngan zhing dmod ngan 'dren pa: mi la lha med tshad ya btsugs pa: lha la mthu med ya bor bzung ba: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di: mgo 'khor bar gyis: yid 'khrugs par gyis: smyo zhing 'bog par gyis: lcags kyu can gyis snying nas zungs: zhags pa can gyis ske nas chings: lcags sgrog can gyis yan lag sdoms: dril bu can gyis myos su chugs: las rlung drag po'i rta la bskyon: mun nag 'jigs pas mdun nas sus: gshin rje'i pho nya rnams kyis 'gul nas chings: las mkhan gyi pho nya chen po mthu me dpung las tsha ba: dug mda' las gzer ba: spu gri las rno ba: thog rgod las myur ba khyed rnams kyis: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di nyid:

nam mkha' nas byi'u chung khras ded pa lta bur: sa bzhi nas sbur ma rlung gi bskyod pa lta bur: ri kha nas ra lug gcan gyis ded pa lta bur: chu nang nas nya mo sram gyi ded pa lta bur: yul gru nas rngon pas ri dwags ded pa lta bur: steng 'og nas sha rtsas lag dmar ded pa lta bur: gling khams 'dir nyes can gyi btson pa khrid pa lta bur: steng 'og gar gnas kyang : steng nas gnam gyi 'ju thag chod: 'og nas sa'i rten phur phud: tshe phyi ma la dus ma 'debs: skye 'chi gnyis la khung ma g.yar: gling bzhi'i sa la rjes ma btsal: rdo khab len gyis lcags phye 'gam pa ltar gzugs kyi liṅga dmigs rten: ming gi byang bu dmar po: bla'i 'khor lo nag po: yid kyi shog bu khra bo: 'di la rang dbang med par khug cig: om̐ badzra aṅku sha dzaḥ ratna pā sha hūm̐: padma spho ṭa baṃ: karma ghaṇḍe hoḥ e thun dza ya: rbad myog ya: trig sha ya: dun khying ya: ru tra ya: khug lo shag: om̐ te lo sha ya rbad: ne lo sha ya rbad: bhandhai brag tshal pa: danti kha thun dgra sri mā ra ya dza dzaḥ rbad bhyoḥ ha la ha la shig shig: ces thun la sngags shing pho nya'i tshul gyis brab: de nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: 'bru nag gi dpal gtor mtho'am khru re la rtsang phur bdun dug rdzas sna tshogs kyis brgyan la de'i khog par 'gugs pa'i sngags bcug cing rbad bskul dang sbrags te dgra phyogs sam pho nya rang phyogs su las mkhan 'gyu ba'i tshul gyis 'phang : de yang gtor ma mtshon cha lta bur bskul nas dgra bo bsgral zhing rnam shes liṅgar bkug par bsam: gtor ma sha khrag byas nas chos skyong gi gtang rag tshul du kha bsngo byas pas: ljags mtshon cha'i sbu gus bcud blangs shing : snyigs ma 'gyu byed kyi pho nya dang mtshon cha grangs med du bsgyur nas 'phang : pho nya 'gyed pa'i zor lam dus thebs ldog yang mi dgos: 'gugs pa'i dus ni nyin phyed nam phyed: srod lha 'dre 'gyu ba'i dus rnams su thugs dam bskul zhing 'gugs:

pho nya dmag 'gyed rim pa ni: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu bsha' ra bzhi bskor gyi nang nas yin pas dam ldan sngags pa gal che: lung las: las mkhan phrin las bsgrub mi sgrub: rnal 'byor sngags pa rang la rag: ces gsungs pa ltar: rnal 'byor phyi nang gi gnad gsum dang mi 'bral pa'i ngang la: 'gugs dgos par bshad: de nas pho nya 'gyed pa ni: hūm̐: dug rlangs nag po 'thibs pa'i gnas: ma ru rtse yi dur khrod nas: che mchog bka' yi bstan srung ma: lce spyang srog bdag ma mo 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: gang la bya ba khyod kyis shes: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba dang : rnal 'byor bdag la 'tshe ba'i dgra: gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa yi: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di: myur du 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: dam nyams dgra la rbad pa'i tshe: ma mo srog len zhums se zhum: bla 'gugs pho nya sha ra ra: ngan sngags rnga sgra di ri ri: rbad do ma mo mthu ma chung : dam nyams dgra bo las ngan gyi: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: nyin mo nyi ma'i zer la chibs: mtshan mo mun pa'i smag la bsres: dus drug 'khrul pa'i bdud dang bsdong : gnyid dang yengs la bla sems rkus: 'byung ba gtor la phung po shigs: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: bhyo ma mo du kha kha l̥ dze ta ma breng breng dgra bo'i srog la dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes gtor ma 'phang : de nas shar phyogs yang dag gi srung ma ni: hūm̐: rngam pa rong gi dur khrod du: yang dag thugs kyi bka' nyan pa: gnas pa'i ma mo dbang phyug brgyad: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: rbad cing bskul ba bdag gis bcol: 'gugs shing bsgral ba khyod kyi las: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang :

bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: da lta tho rangs stag gi dus: khyod nyid 'gugs pa'i pho nyar bskul: rbad cing las la bskul ba'i tshe: ma mo'i dmag tshogs thibs se thib: bla 'gugs sman mo nyi li li: ma btang ma shor khug la shog: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra shwa na ma mo ya du pra mo dgra bgegs chaig dza dzaḥrbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas lho phyogs gshin rje'i pho nya: hūm̐: bsil ba tshal gyi dur khrod dbus: gshin rje gshed kyi bka' nyan pa: ging bdud rtsis pa shan pa 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: srog bdag bye ba'i dus la bab: bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i: bla srog don snying khyer la shog: da lta nam langs yos kyi dus: 'gugs pa'i pho nya khyod la bskul: dam nyams las ngan sdig can 'di: rnam shes rten dang phrol la shog: bskul cing las la snyog pa'i tshe: bdud dang dmag jag sha ra ra: bdud zhags dgra 'dzin khyugs se khyug: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ du khying kha kha ya du dgra bo byad mi srog la dza dzaḥrbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas dbang chen rta mgrin gyi bka' srung ni: hūm̐: bha ga la yi dur khrod skyong : dbang chen khro bo'i bka' nyan pa: srog bdag khams brgyad long ba dang : 'dab can 'brug dang khyi spyang tshogs: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: rbad do dgra bo khug la shog: da lta nyi shar 'brug gi dus: 'gugs pa'i pho nya khyod la bcol: dgra bo mi nor yul zhing rnams: phye mar dkrug cing khug la shog: nad yams cho 'phrul sna tshogs thongs: 'chor med pho nyas khug la shog: las mkhan dgra srog 'gugs pa'i tshe: ma mo'i nad yams thu lu lu: long ba cho 'phrul nyi li li: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ nag po dunting kha ṭa ru tra na dam nyams dgra bo dza dzaḥ

zhes 'phang ngo : de nas phur pa phrin las kyi bka' srung ni: hūm̐: kun rgyu ma mo 'tshogs pa'i gnas: rdo rje gzhon nu'i bka' srung pa: shwa na sa bdag ging bdud rnams: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: bskul lo las mkhan mthu ma chung : dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: myur du 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: da lta nyi dros sbrul gyi dus: pho nya las mkhan khyod rbad kyis: pha rol bstan dgra sgos dgra 'di: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: pho nya las la chas pa'i tshe: shan pa srog gcod rongs se rong : las mkhan gri brdar habs se hab: dam nyams sdig can byad ma 'di: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra shwa na mu dha hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐: dgra bo'i srog la yaṃ yaṃ dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas bla med kyi bka' srung ni: hūm̐: khrag zhags mun gling dur khrod nas: yon tan ma mo'i bka' srung ma: ma sring srin mo sha za 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: dgra bgegs 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: da lta nyin phyed rta yi dus: pho nya 'gyed pa'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: mi rta nang mtshan pha sde rnams: myur du phung shing phye mar dkrugs: bla srog don snying khyer la shog: las mkhan dmag tshogs 'gyed pa'i tshe: stong khams pho nya tshubs se tshub: mtshon cha'i char pa si li li: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ pra dun ya bhyo dza na: dgra bo'i bla srog khug dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas bla ma rig 'dzin gyi bka' srung ni: hūm̐: khrag zhag khol ba'i dur khrod klong : bla ma rig 'dzin bka' srung pa: shan pa mon pa dmar nag rnams: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: da lta nyi ma phyed yol lug:

shan pa rbad pa'i dus la bab: bstan pa'i dgra bo mi nor rnams: yams nad sna dgus sdus la shog: srog rtsa dmar po chod la shog: bka' bzhin phrin las sgrub pa'i tshe: pho nya 'dur 'gros khyugs se khyug: gshin rje'i gad mo di ri ri: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ du dza kha la rbad du dgra bo dza dzaḥrbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas 'jig rten mchod bstod ni: hūm̐: u tsa la yi dur khrod skyong : 'jig rten khro rgyal bka' nyan pa: srog bdag dregs pa'i sde chen 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: ma shor dgra bo khug la shog: da lta nyi nub sprel gyi dus: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: snga dgra phyi dgra 'chang ba 'di: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: nyes can dam nyams shor ra re: pho nya las la mngags pa'i tshe: srog bdud bla 'gugs zhums se zhum: bdud mo tshe len nyi li li: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya du ta rbad lo shag dgra bo dza dzaḥrbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas dmod pa drag sngags kyi bka' srung ni: hūm̐: rlung nag 'tshubs pa'i dur khrod nas: dmod pa drag sngags srung ma ni: btsan rgod gnod sbyin bye ba 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: da lta mun rub bya yi dus: las mkhan rbad pa'i dus la bab: bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bo 'di'i: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: pho nya las mkhan rbad pa'i tshe: gshin rje khram thogs nyi li li: btsan dmar shwa kha tha ra ra: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ha pa ya du na rbad: dgra bo khug dza dzaḥrbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas bar khyams bka' sdod kyi bskul ba ni: hūm̐: srin po 'tshogs pa'i dur khrod skyong : dkyil 'khor pho brang bka' srung tshogs: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro ma mo rnams:

ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma 'bul: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: da lta srod 'phros khyi yi dus: rbad bskul pho nya las la chos: gdug cing sdang ba'i dgra bo 'dis: don snying nang rol dkrugs la shog: bskul ba'i pho nya mthu ma chung : dgra yul had kyis 'ded pa'i tshe: stong khams na bun chi li li: rlung dmar shwa kha 'u ru ru: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: e yam kha la kha la dgra bo'i srog la dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas las kyi pho nya'i bskul ba ni: hūm̐: ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod skyong : pho brang 'bar ba'i bka' nyan pa: sring mo laṅka zhing skyong rnams: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma bzhes: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: las la bskul lo chas pa'i tshe: da lta srod 'khor phag gi dus: bla 'gugs shan pa dgra la myur: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo 'di'i: mi nor 'khor bcas khug la shog: srog bdag pho nya mthu ma chung : bla 'gugs pho nya rbad pa'i tshe: mun nag 'jigs cing thibs se thib: ltas ngan sgra skad lhangs se lhang : myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ du na bhe ta hri har dgra bo'i rnam shes dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas skyong ma rbad pa ni: hūm̐: 'byung po 'tshogs pa'i dur khrod nas: bod khams mnga' bdag ma mo 'bum: 'bar ma bstan ma dus kyi bdag: mched lnga las mkhan bye ba 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma 'bul: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: bla rkun sman mo las la chos: da lta nam phyed byi ba'i dus: rbad do pho nya las la chos: phyi nang dgra bgegs 'byung po'i rigs: bla tshe rnam shes khug la shog: mngags pa'i las mkhan bang ma bul: dgra srog bla tshe sdud pa'i dus: srog bdag ru mtshon lhabs se lhab: sman mo bla 'gugs zhungs se zhung : myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod:

om̐ ting dza rbad lo shag dgra bo'i srog la dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang ngo : de nas gter srung rbad pa ni: hūm̐: rngam chen 'khrugs pa'i dur khrod skyong : bka' brgyad yongs kyi srung ma che: las mgon sde brgyad sha za 'bum: ma thogs myur du gnas 'dir byon: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma 'bul: lhag ma pho nya rbad pa'i rten: dgra bo 'gugs pa'i dus la bab: da lta phyed yol glang gi dus: las mkhan dmag tshogs dgra la rbad: dgra bo'i mi nor yul zhing bcas: bshig cing chom la med par gyis: bla srog rnam shes khug la shog: shan pa'i dmag dpung 'gyed pa'i tshe: stong khams me 'od chi li li: nad sprin smug nag thibs se thib: myur du 'gugs pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ raksha har khying dung dung dgra bo'i rnam shes bla srog dza dza rbad bhyoḥ zhes 'phang zhing 'gugs par bsam: de nas lha dbye bya ba ni: bya rog gi sgro dang 'ug pa'i sgro gnyis lha dbye ba'i phyag rgya: hūm̐: khā kha mu kha bya rog gdong : khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams sdig can las ngan 'di: lha dang phyes la bdud dang sprod: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: ban bon srung ba'i lha dang phrol: pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phyes: mo lha phrag pa g.yon nas phyes: skyes lha rten yul mkhar dang phyes: zhang lha gnyan po rgyab nas phyes: ma lha lte ba'i khong nas phyes: srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phyes: rigs lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phyes: srung lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phyes: skyob pa'i lha dang da phyes shig: mgon pa'i lha dang da phyes shig: rten pa'i lha dang da phyes shig: yul zhing mkhar dang da phyes shig: pha tshan rus dang da phyes shig: mthun grogs mdza' dang da phyes shig: skyob byed srung ma ban bon rigs: bya spu rlung gis khyer bzhin gtor: khā kha mu kha mthu ma chung : phyes shig gtor ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ khā kha mu kha dgra bo shag phyes: hu lu mu kha dgra bo shag phyes:

ru tra mā ra ya dgra bo shag phyes: rbad dza thun bhyo dgra bo shag phyes: zhes dbye rgyas lha dang phyes nas: hu lu mu khas bdud dang sprod par bsam: hūm̐: hu lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong : khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: mnyam por 'gro ba'i bdud dang sprod: 'chi bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: srog bdag bdud dang da sprod cig: bar chad bdud dang da sprod cig: ma rungs bdud dang da sprod cig: 'khyer 'dre bdud dang da sprod cig: las ngan bdud dang da sprod cig: sngon gyi bdud dang da sprod cig: 'phral gyi bdud dang da sprod cig: za ba'i bdud dang da sprod cig: 'khyer ba'i bdud dang da sprod cig: gshin lcags bdud dang da sprod cig: sprod cig dgra bo ma shor cig: shan pa lag dmar lag tu sprod: mon pa pho mo'i lag tu sprod: srog gcod 'bum gyi lag tu sprod: sprod cig hu lu mu kha ma: dus la ma 'da' dam la nyon: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: myur du sprod la med par mdzod: om̐ hu lu mu kha dun dun pra mo raksha ya kha la dun shig rbad bhyoḥ zhes dgra bo bdud dang sprad cing myur du sgrol ba'i las la chas par bsam: de nas spyi mthun dgra bo brab: hūm̐: bskul lo rbad do pho nya'i tshogs: las mkhan las la ma zhan cig: pho nya rgyug log ma byed cig: chos skyong mthu med mi srid kyis: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan 'di: phung po rnam shes rten dang phrol: zungs shig chings shig byed du chugs: chod cig gtubs shig rdul du rlog: yar sha 'then la dgra sha zo: ma sha chod la dgra khrag 'thung : phan tshun gtor la phye mar gtubs: gnam lcags thog gi ser ba phob: spu gri 'khor lo'i so la bskyon: drag sngags rdo rje'i char pa phob: dgra bo 'di yi mgon byed kyi: ban bon lha srung ma lus dang : ye shes 'jig rten gang yin pa: rdul du brlag pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra trag raksha ha la ha la:

ru tra bhandha ya bhandha ya mu lo ma sha khrag la kying kying rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces thun gyis brab: de nas phur bu thogs te: hūm̐: nga ni snang srid yongs kyi bdag: nga ni khro bo kun gyi bdag: nga ni srid gsum kun gyi gnyen: nga ni ma mo yongs kyi gtso: nga ni chos skyong kun gyi yab: nga ni dam nyams khyod kyi gshed: nga las che ba su yang med: mthu che khro rgyal zil gyis gnon: lha srin sde brgyad nga yi bran: dregs chen bco brgyad nga yi 'khor: nga yi thugs kyi sprul pa'i sras: shan pa snying zan mthu bo che: sku mdog dmar nag gshin rje'i tshul: srog la rngam pa'i las mkhan po: sku la me dpung chi li li: ba spu tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: dmod pa'i drag sngags 'u ru ru: rang 'dra'i shan pa bye ba 'bum: dgra bo'i srog gcod sha ra ra: phyag na gnam lcags phur pa bsgril: zlog byed badzra kī la ya: mgo bo khrag 'thung khro bo'i zhal: bla ma rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba: dbang drag rig 'dzin spungs se spung : mgrin pa rgya mdud drag po'i mkhar: yi dam rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba: chos skyong dmag tshogs thibs se thib: 'chang bzung gza' rgod 'gyu ba'i lam: mkha' 'gro rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba: shan pa mtshon thogs zengs se zeng : chu srin klu bdud sdod pa'i gnas: dam can rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba: shan pa gri brdar yugs se yug: zur gsum srog gcod spro ba'i dbal: gter bdag rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba: srog gcod spu gri rubs se rub: yongs rdzogs dus la bab pa'i tshe: las byed rnams kyis mnga' gsol ba: bsgral 'debs sha khrag tha ra ra: hūm̐: rbad do las mkhan mthu bo che: sras mchog stobs kyi phur bu de: bsrung phyir klad du lan gsum bskor: bzlog phyir sked du lan gsum bskor: pho rgyud zil gnon g.yas su bsgril: mo rgyud dbang sdud g.yon du bsgril: bsgral phyir mdun du lan gsum bsgril:

'beb phyir snying du lan gsum tshad: hūm̐: bskul lo phur bu gang nas byung : dang po phur bu steng nas byung : klu dang ma mo 'thab pa'i tshe: ma mo snang srid bdag mo yis: gza' bdud mgo dgu las la bskul: 'brug mo'i ra bar mgar kha bcas: me rlung sbyor ba'i gnam lcags bzhus: bzlog med thog rgod phur bu bcas: 'phang med stong khams me yis gang : klu srin ma rungs rdul du brlags: sngon tshe dngos rtags myur mgyogs pa: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: de nas phur bu gang nas byung : ye shes 'jig rten 'thab pa'i tshe: dpal chen badzra ku mā ras: snang srid ma mo las la bskul: rten 'brel mthu yi rdzas sbyar byas: srid pa'i ri rab phur bu grub: 'phangs pas snang srid tshwa tshwa 'phros: btab pas 'jig rten khams kun bshig: sngon tshe dngos rtags myur mgyogs pa: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: de nas phur bu gang nas byung : mu stegs ston pa ha ling dung : slob dpon shāntiṃ garbha gnyis: phyi nang sa mtshams rtsod pa'i tshe: dmod pa drag sngags las la bskul: gdab chog sde dpon phur bu bcos: tshad pas mu stegs khrag yang bskyugs: btab pas brgyal zhing myur du gum: sngon tshe dngos rtags myur mgyogs pa: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: de nas phur bu gang nas byung : slob dpon seṅge sgra sgrogs dang : mu stegs ston pa lnga brgya gnyis: phyi nang nus rtsal rtsod pa'i tshe: drag po seṅge sgra sgrogs kyis: ma gza' shan pa las la bskul: lha klu mi yi drag rdzas la: gnam lcags khro phur zur gsum bcos: tshad pas ston pa lnga brgya bred: btab pas ngan sngags bdag po bsgral: sngon tshe dngos rtags myur mgyogs pa: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: de nas phur bu gang nas byung : slob dpon 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang : mu stegs ma hor dunti gnyis: mthu stobs kha khyer bor ba'i tshe: bcom ldan 'jam dpal bshes gnyen gyis:

gshin rje khri 'bum las la bskul: dug phur brgya dang rtsa brgyad bsgrubs: gdengs pas mu stegs yul khams phung : btab pas rjes med rtsad nas brlags: sngon tshe dngos rtags myur mgyogs pa: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: de nas phur bu gang nas byung : slob dpon padma 'byung gnas dang : lha srin gdug can 'thab pa'i tshe: rdo rje legs pa'i bka' las bskul: rdo rje phur pa dpag med bcos: gzir bas lha 'dre'i srog snying phul: btab pas nam yang mi ldang gyur: sngon tshe dngos rtags myur mgyogs pa: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: de nas phur bu gang nas byung : phyi rabs rjes 'jug sngags 'chang la: dgra bgegs dam sris bsnyad btsal bas: nus ldan drag sngags slob dpon gyis: sras mchog shan pa phur bur bsgrubs: bskul bas dgra bo phung zhing bkug: btab pas srog gcod 'dus byas bshig: myur mgyogs shan pa'i phur bu khyod: de ring dgra bo'i snying du ya: hūm̐: btab bo badzra kī la ya: dgra bgegs lha dang phral ba'i phyir: spyi bo'i gtsug tu kī la ya: bstan la nam yang mi sdang phyir: dpral ba'i dkyil du kī la ya: gzugs kyi dbang po gzhom pa'i phyir: rog skyong mig la kī la ya: dri tshor dbang po dgag pa'i phyir: bshang lam gnyis su kī la ya: sgra tshor dbang po nub pa'i phyir: skar khung rna bar kī la ya: ro 'dzin kha tham lkugs pa'i phyir: lce rkan og mar kī la ya: brkyang bskum sgrog tu bcug pa'i phyir: yan lag gnyis su kī la ya: rten pa'i rnam shes gtor ba'i phyir: snying dang dbu mar kī la ya: mgyogs byed dum bur gcod pa'i phyir: 'dor byed rkang par kī la ya: dgra bo'i rigs rgyud rtsad gcod phyir: sa bon gsang bar kī la ya: rtsa 'khor phung po bshig pa'i phyir: lte ba'i dkyil du kī la ya: rnam shes rten dang phral ba'i phyir: dkar nag mtshams su kī la ya: steng gi pho la kī la ya:

'og gi mo la kī la ya: rigs rgyud bu la kī la ya: yul mkhar zhing la kī la ya: khyim dang nor la kī la ya: rdzas dang spyad la kī la ya: pha spun rus la kī la ya: gnyen dang grogs la kī la ya: hūm̐: dam nyams dgra bo las ngan khyod: dang po zhe sdang pha yi khams: klad rus rkang la kī la ya: de nas 'dod chags ma yi khrag: sha khrag don snying kī la ya: de nas za 'dre lto bar chags: gti mug gzugs la kī la ya: khyod kyi snying kha sgong bu'i dbus: dkar dmar 'od kyi zer thag can: srog rlung ljang gsal 'gyu ba'i rten: rnam shes bdag 'dzin phung po la: shes rab snying rjes phur bu 'debs: dug lnga'i bag chags gzhom zhing bsregs: snang mched 'od gsal ngo bo sprad: khyod kyi bla ma nga yin no: las ngan de dang ma phral na: rigs drug ngan song rgyun du 'khor: mtshan 'dzin phung po de yal na: khyod kyang rgyal ba'i sras su skye: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha zhal mjal: khyod kyi rnam shes phur rtser gtod: hūm̐: gtub bo badzra kī la ya: 'phang ba slar yang ma ldog badzra kī la ya: skyai 'chi rtsad nas chod cig badzra kī la ya: 'khor ba'i mtshan 'dzin shigs shig badzra kī la ya: dug lnga rtsad nas chod cig badzra kī la ya: bag chags ru tra sgrol cig badzra kī la ya: rnam shes mkha' la stims shig badzra kī la ya: dus la bab bo badzra kī la ya: om̐ badzra kī la ya sarba bighnān trig nan gzer thum nan: om̐ sarba duṣṭāṃ e dza bhyoḥ rbad du shag ya nan lo hag tshal pa dun du na bhyo bhyoḥ kha la du ti na dun shig shig: ru tra rbad tshal pa myog myog: thuṃ thuṃ: dam nyams byad ma'i sha khrag snying la chod chod: dgra bo gzer thuṃ trig nanaḥrbad bhyoḥ

zhes bsgral zhing rnam shes 'og min du spar ba ni: hoḥ khyod kyi rnam par shes pa de phur pa'i khong seng brgyud de rgyangs kyis thon nas 'og min lhun grub dag pa'i zhing khams su: chos sku kun bzang yab yum gyi thugs kar yar 'phros shig: de yang ye shes kyi klong dang dbyer med du 'dres nas sangs rgyas par gyur cig: e spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ ces pas skar mda' 'phros pa ltar chad nas chos sku'i thugs dang dbyer med par bsam: de nas thun brdeg pa ni: hūm̐: nyungs dkar rgyal po shwa rī raṃ: yang dag khro rgyal dmod pa ya: bzlog med drag po'i thun rdzas kyis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: 'byung ba'i dug thun rlung ltar 'tshubs: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dmod pa'i rdzas: dug thun sprin nag chi li li: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: me thun tshwa tshwa si li li: khro rgyal dbang chen dmod pa'i rdzas: dug lnga gzhom pa'i dbal zor 'dis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: phur thun drag po thog ltar 'beb: rdo rje gzhon nu'i dmod pa'i rdzas: zor 'bebs myur mgyogs sha ra ra: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: rakta rgya mtsho'i rba klong 'khrugs: ma mo rbod gtong dmod pa'i rdzas: nad rlung yams kha thu lu lu: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: mtshon cha drag po skar ltar 'khrugs: rig 'dzin thod phreng dmod pa'i rdzas: rno ngar sgrol 'debs wa la la: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: rlon thun dug chu me re re: 'jig rten khro rgyal dmod pa'i rdzas: myos byed dug zor lams se lam: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: rdo thun rbab rgod nyi li li: drag sngags khro bo'i dmod pa'i rdzas: zi ra gnam lcags thog chen gyis: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: hūm̐: tshe thun dmod sngags 'u ru ru: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs dmod pa'i rdzas:

me 'bar skar ma khrugs se khrug: dgra bgegs lnga phung rdul du rlog: om̐ thun dza raṃ dza rbad dza shig dzaḥ kha thaṃ srog gzer dril nan bhyo bhyoḥ de nas sde dpon rim pa bzhin gyi phyag mtshan thogs nas gtub pa ni: dang po gshin rje'i phyag mtshan be con thogs nas: hūm̐: dpal chen dmod pa drag sngags kyi: pho nya dregs pa'i sde dpon tshogs: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: dgra bgegs dam nyams bsgral ba'i lus: gcod cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: gshin rje ya ma rā dza yi: thugs dam gnyan po dus la bab: be con 'bar bas klad nas chum: sgrol cig gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ya ma rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: de nas dgra satwa thogs nas: hūm̐: bdud po'i bskang rdzas drag dkar che: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: dgra satwa 'bar bas tshal bar khos: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ du pra ma dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: de nas phur bu thogs nas: hūm̐: srin po glog gi phreng ba can: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: phur bu 'bar bas snying la bsnun: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ laṅka ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: de nas zangs gri thogs nas: hūm̐: gnod sbyin me dbal zangs btsan rje: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: zangs gri 'bar bas dbang po phrol: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ yaksha na dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: gri gug thogs nas: hūm̐: lha yi sde dpon dbang phyug che: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: gri gug 'bar bas dum bur phrol: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shwa ri na dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: rtse gsum thogs nas: hūm̐: ma gcig stobs chen u ma dhe: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: rtse gsum 'bar bas dbang po dkrugs: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ u ma dhe wa dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: 'khor lo thogs nas:

hūm̐: las kyi ma mo srid pa'i rgyal: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: 'khor lo 'bar bas chod cing gtor: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma mo ru lu dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: spu gri thogs nas: hūm̐: srog bdag e ka dzā ṭi ma: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: spu gri 'bar bas tshal par gtub: om̐ e ka dzā ṭi dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: zhags pa thogs nas: hūm̐: zhang blon rdo rje 'bar ba yi: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: bdud zhags nag pos 'ching zhing drud: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ she la ging rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: gri zor thogs nas: hūm̐: lha yi sde dpon tshangs pa che: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: gri zor 'bar bas bskrad par gyis: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ dhe wa shwa ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: rdo rje thogs nas: hūm̐: dam can skyes bu rdo rje legs: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: rdo rje 'bar bas gtub cing gzhom: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra sā dhu dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: mda' gzhu thogs nas: hūm̐: gza' bdud ki kang rā hu la: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: gnam lcags thog mdas dgra snying mdzer: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ rā hu la dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: beng thogs nas: hūm̐: lha chen ma hā kā la ya: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: beng chen dmag tshogs dgra la 'gyed: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ nā tha kā la dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: khrag zor thogs nas: hūm̐: dge bsnyen bdud 'dul drag po rtsal: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: khrag thun nad char dgra la thob: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ti pa ra tsa ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ral gri 'gugs mo thogs nas: hūm̐: bdud po gdug pa'i srog len po: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab:

shang lang 'bar bas mgo lus phral: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ mu ta ti du ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: tri shul thogs nas: hūm̐: kā la drag po nag po che: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: tri shul dgra bo'i srog rtsa phug: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ kā la kro dha dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ru mtshon thogs nas: hūm̐: gnod sbyin chen po gang ba bzang : thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: ru mtshon dgra bo'i snying la bsnun: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ gha ru bha tra dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: thog dang ser ba thogs nas: hūm̐: thog 'bebs gnod sbyin smug nag pa: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: dgra la thog ser char pa phob: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ki kang bha du shag dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ru mtshon thogs nas: hūm̐: spyi bdud rgyal po ging ka ra: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: ru mtshon g.yab cing dgra yul 'joms: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ rā dza ging du dgra bo'isrog la rbad rbad: bswe'i mdung ring thogs nas: hūm̐: btsan rgod srog gzan shan pa dmar: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: btsan mdung dgra bo'i lus ngag choms: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shu la rā tsa dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ba dan thogs nas: hūm̐: srog bdag gnam thel dkar po che: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: mdung dar ba dan dgra la rgyobs: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ badzra sā dhu dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ral gri thogs nas: hūm̐: yam shud dmar po btsan gyi rje: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: ral gris dgra bo'i mgo lus phrol: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ shu la rā tsa dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: thod khrag thogs nas: hūm̐: bgegs rgyal bī na ya kā rje: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab:

khrag thun nad rlung dgra la 'phyo: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ bhū ta rā dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: mtshon gyi gru gu thogs nas: hūm̐: nag po dus mtshan re ma ti: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: mtshon gru sngo dmar dgra la phob: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ re ma ti kā la phob dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: nad rkyal thogs nas: hūm̐: klu bdud smyon pa dbugs sdud po: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: nad yams dal kha dgra la phob: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ nā ga raksha dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: sbrul zhags thogs nas: hūm̐: sa bdag nag po sbrul mjug can: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: sbrul zhags 'khyug 'debs dgra bo chings: sgrol cing gtub pa'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ bhū mi pa du dza dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: de nas tho ba thogs nas: hūm̐: dpal chen pho nya las mkhan 'bum: thugs dam gnyan po'i dus la bab: dam nyams dgra bo sdig can 'di: rngam yangs khro mo'i gtun khung du: khro rgyal rdo rje'i tho bas brdung : lha 'am 'os te brlag par byed: rdul phran bzhin du phye mar shig: om̐ dun tsa nye lo rbad shu kha dun te ya dza raṃ mu ta na ya: dam nyams dgra bo'i sha la rbad rbad: snying la bhyo bhyoḥ srog la hur hur: ru tra mā ra ya rbad rbad: bhyo bhyoḥ myog thuṃ dril nan: zhes gtub cing hom gzar gyis dkyil 'khor thams cad la mchod cing : cha gcig gtor ma 'bul du bzhag: de nas 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: che mchog zhi khro'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: padma gsung gi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs zhal phyes shig:

bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i zhal phyes shig: chos skyong gter bdag gter srung zhal phyes shig: pho nya yongs rdzogs 'khor bcas zhal phyes shig: hūm̐: gti mug bsgral ba'i klad pa rkang gnyis mchod: zhe sdang bsgral zhing māṃ sa sha yis mchod: 'dod chags bsgral zhing rakta khrag gis mchod: nga rgyal bsgral zhing tshil bu pags pas mchod: phrag dog bsgral nas nang rol don snying mchod: bdag 'dzin bsgral zhing lhag ma rus pas mchod: ru tra bsgral ba'i sha khrag stong khams khang : phyes shig phyes shig bla med mchod pa 'bul: hūm̐: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal phyes shig: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs shig: skye mched chos nyid zhal phyes shig: zab yangs bde stong mgrin par bskyil: rtog med ye shes dbyings su thim: lhun grub ngo bo'i don rtogs shog: ces bka' brgyad spyi'i rtsa sngags rang rang sngags kyis 'bul zhing : sman rag gis bran: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes shing dgyes pa bskyed par bsam: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra drag sngags pad 'byung ngas: smon lam rten 'brel zab mo'i bka' bab tshe: slob dpon chen po shāntiṃ garbha dang : dkyil 'khor gcig tu tshom bur 'tshogs pa'i tshe: ma 'ongs rje 'bangs chos rgyal gdung rgyud dang : las can skal ldan brgyud 'dzin la dmigs nas: phyi mor bdud blon bstan dgra bsgral ba'i ched: dmod pa bor chog 'khor lo cha dgu dang : dregs pa'i las mtha' bsha' ra gong 'og bzhi: legs par zhus nas shog dril la bkod de: mgul du sba zhing snying du 'chang byas nas: dben gnas chen mo bsam yas mchims phu ru: kun la ma bstan mgul khug ma ru grags: spel bar phangs nas rin chen sgrom dag tu: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal brda yi yi ger bris: yang mtha'i don du rin chen gter du sbos: sangs rgyas ye shes skye ba rtags ldan la: legs par sprod cig bka' srung drag po rgya:

dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gnyan rgya: kho bo padma gter bdag gling pas padma sbas pa'i tshal nas khrom gter du gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o/ /sarba maṅgalaṃ// // ba) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: rtsang bzlog pho nya myur mgyogs bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag 'dra padma 'byung nas kyis: dregs pa dmod sngags rbad pa'i rten: drag po rtsang gi las rim bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: dang po rtsang gi dgos bzhi ni: drag po'i mtshon cha yin pa'i phyir: rtsub shing tsher ma can la dgos: gdug pa'i snying la 'debs pa'i phyir: rtse mo dmar la zur gsum dgos: chos skyong pho brang yin pa'i phyir: sked pa ser la rgya mdud dgos: 'chor med lcags ri yin pa'i phyir: smad ni nag la rngam pa dgos: med thabs med pa rnam bzhi ni: rtsang phur pho brang yin pa'i phyir: bzlog pa'i gur khang med thabs med: sgo skyong srung ma brten pa'i phyir: bha su'i thag pa med thabs med: srog gcod shan pa dgyes pa'i phyir: dmar rgyan rbad sngags med thabs med: dur khrod bkod pa rdzogs pa'i phyir: ru tra'i zhing gzhi med thabs med: de sogs rtsang gi dgos pa brgyad: sa ma ya: dang po rtsang gi 'dzugs thabs ni: gnyis su bsnol ba srin mo'i 'gros: rtse mo zur gsum phur bu'i 'gros: gcig la bsnol ba 'tshub ma ris: mang du bsnol ba pho nya'i 'gros: mtha' gnyis sprad pa shan pa'i 'gros: mig mang drwa ba srung ba'i rtsang : drwa mig 'gyur khug dmag thabs rtsang : 'tshub cing g.yo ba bzlog pa'i rtsang : de sogs rim pa bzhin du btsugs: dmar chen raktas bran byas nas: rtsang bzlog rbad bskul 'di ltar bya: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba e yi klong : dmar nag me dpung 'tshubs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dir:

pho nya rtsang gi lha tshogs gshegs su gsol: las byed shan pa'i dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol: myur mgyogs las mkhan dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol: rtsal ldan dregs pa'i tshogs bcas gshegs nas kyang : rtsang phur dur khrod gnas 'dir bzhugs su gsol: dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i rakta 'bul: phyi nang 'gal rkyen bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dang po rtsang phur gang nas byung : dang po rtsang phur dbyings nas byung : che mchog khro rgyal chen po rgyal: 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs kun gyis: cho 'phrul sna tshogs sdang ba'i tshe: rigs bzhi'i ye shes khro bo la: thugs dam gsal rdzogs legs bkod de: dug lnga 'khrul ba'i bud shing de: shes rab rig pa'i satwa res bcad: bcad gtub rtsang phur bzhogs pa'i tshe: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi ru grub: zlum po zhi ba'i rtsang phur de: gti mug lha yi bdud la btab: me long ye shes ngang du bsgral: bskul lo zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: rgyas pa gru bzhi'i rtsang phur de: nga rgyal phung po'i bdud la btab: mnyam nyid ye shes ngang du bsgral: bskul lo rgyas pa'i phrin las mdzod: zla gam dbang gi rtsang phur de: nyon mongs 'dod chags bdud la btab: sor rtog ye shes ngang du bsgral: bskul lo dbang gi phrin las mdzod: zur gsum drag po'i rtsang phur de: zhe sdang 'chi bdag bdud la btab: bya grub ye shes ngang du bsgral: bskul lo drag po'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de nas rtsang phur gang nas byung : lha dang lha min 'thab pa'i tshe: lha bu lag pa bzhi pa yis: ye shes khro bcu las la bskul: las kyi dgra satwa 'bar ba des: lha min tshogs pa'i yongs 'dus bcad: bcad gtub rtsang phur bcas pa la: zhi rgyas dbang drag bzhi ru grub: thog mda' rtsang phur de las byung : btab pas lha min g.yul ngo zlog: bskul lo phrin las dus la bab: de nas rtsang phur gang nas byung : rtsang phur mu stegs yul nas byung :

zhang zhung bon gyi lung pa ru: mu stegs rten pa'i bla shing skyes: gdug rtsub 'byung po mang po tshogs: de dag mu stegs kun gyis rbad: nang pa'i bstan la sdang ba'i tshe: slob dpon rig 'dzin rnam brgyad kyis: sde dpon sum cu las la bskul: snang srid snod kyi drag rdzas bsdus: dam can spun dgus mgar bzo brgyab: gcod pa'i satwa re rngam chen brdungs: srin po srin mo'i snying khrag gis: ngar btab bsgral ba'i dmod pa bor: de nas dregs pa dmag la rbad: sde dpon khrag 'thung sum cu yis: mu stegs bsgral zhing shing yang bcad: ma hor dun ting nag po yi: tsitta dngos su blangs byas te: dmod pa bor chog sgrom yang byas: shing de dang po shar du yo: nad gdon zhi ba'i dmod pa bor: de nas lho ru 'gyel ba'i tshe: bsod nams rgyas pa'i dmod pa bor: de nas nub tu bzhogs pa'i tshe: khams gsum dbang sdud dmod pa bor: de nas byang du sgrig pa'i tshe: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i dmod pa bor: mu stegs snying khrag ngar kyang blud: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i phyag tu phul: slob dpon chen po rnam brgyad kyis: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gzhi bkod: ru tra'i snying la gtor ma bzos: mu stegs nag po'i thod par bzhag: phrin las bzhi ldan rtsang gis brgyan: dmod pa'i drag sngags btab pa'i tshe: gang la btab kyang bzlog med grub: mu stegs yul la lan gsum tshad: thams cad khrag bskyugs brgyal zhing ring : khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: bskul lo sngon gyi phrin las mdzod: de nas rtsang phur gang nas byung : drag sngags padma thod phreng gis: u tsa la ru bzhugs pa'i tshe: 'byung po mang pos bar chad brtsams: shan pa dmar nag las la mngags: laṅka 'du ba'i shing bcad te: phrin las bzhi yi rtsang phur bcos: thod phreng phyag tu phul ba'i tshe: slob dpon khrag 'thung chen po yis: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gzhi bkod: dam sri nag po'i thod pa ru:

ru tra de yi snying bshos btsugs: phrin las bzhi ldan rtsang gis brgyan: drag sngags dmod pa bor ba'i tshe: rtsang la me yi tshwa tshwa 'thor: 'byung po 'dre rgod snying la tshad: khrag bskyugs ring zhing srog snying phul: bskul lo rtsang phur las la bzhengs: de nas rtsang phur gang nas byung : phyi rabs rig 'dzin rjes 'brang gis: dug shing tsher ma can dag la: phrin las bzhi ldan rtsang phur bcos: ma traṃ dkyil 'khor zhing gzhi bris: 'bru nag zan la gtor ma bzhengs: drag po'i lcags snod nang du btsugs: chos skyong pho nya bskul ba'i tshe: sngon gyi tha tshig dran par gyis: bskul lo rtsang phur pho nya'i tshogs: khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: log 'dren dam nyams cham la phob: 'dre rgod gdug pa'i g.yul ngo zlog: chag che nyam nga bar chad zlog: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces rakta bran zhing : hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mo chos nyid dbyings dang ldan: mar gyi rtse mo rigs drug gnas su brjid: sked pa rgya mdud ka dag lhangs se lhang : 'od gsal rdo rje'i chos nyid rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da thob cig: a 'thas nyon mongs bag chags rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar rtse skye med zang thal sha ra ra: mar rtse rtog med shes pa bun ne bun: sked pa stong nyid 'od gsal lhags se lhag: ye shes lnga ldan lhun grub rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la da thob cig: tshogs drug 'khrul pa'i ngan goms bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar rtse kun gzhi ye grol sangs se sang : mar rtse gang shar gsal stong khro lo lo: sked pa rgya mdud khregs chod wa la la: kun gzhi bde stong rig pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: 'khrul rjes 'brang ba'i bdag 'dzin rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar rtse ye shes lnga ldan thibs se thib: mar rtse dug lnga rang grol sa la la: rgya mdud gang shar chos sku khro lo lo: nyams rtogs don gnyis mthar phyin rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: ma rtogs 'dzin pa'i 'khrul gzugs rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar rtse zhi ba'i lha tshogs spungs se spung : mar rtse chos skyong las byed khyugs se khyug: sked pa rgya mdud yi dam ya la la: dkyil 'khor 'dus pa'i sgrub chen rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: sgrub pa'i bar chad log 'dren rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mo khrag 'thung khro bo 'bum: mar gyi rtse la dam can dbye ba brgya:

sked pa rgya mdud khro mo thibs se thib: khro rgyal chen po'i dmod pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: khro bo khro mo'i rig sngags rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar rtse phyogs skyong khro bcu bye ba 'bum: mar rtse lce spyang ma mo sa ya stong : sked pa rgya mdud ta kṛta sgo ba 'gyings: zhi ba 'dus pa'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: snang srid yongs kyi byad kha rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar rtse kau rī ma mo shigs se shig: mar rtse sgo srung bka' sdod nyi li li: rgya mdud dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad gar: yang dag rbad pa'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dri za grul bum gdon tshogs rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la gshed chen bcu gnyis rngam: mar gyi rtse la sgo srung gdong can 'phyo: rgya mdud gshin rje yab yum so gnyis 'gyed: 'jam dpal rbad pa'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: bdud dang gshin rje'i khram kha bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la khams brgyad ma mo rgyug: mar gyi rtse la lce spyang nga ro sgrogs: sked pa rgya mdud dmus long dmod pa bor: dbang chen rbad pa'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: klu dang sa bdag gtad khram dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la shwa na re ti myur: mar gyi rtse la ging dang pho nya rngam: sked pa rgya mdud bdud dang sa bdag g.yo: rdo rje gzhon nu rbad pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dmag 'khrug mtshon gyi bskal pa dgra la zlog:

hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la dus drug ma mo 'gyings: mar gyi rtse la gling bzhi myur byed 'gyu: sked pa rgya mdud ma mo brgyad rnams khro: rbod gtong ma mo'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: yams nad mu ge'i bskal pa dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la ki kang khyab 'jug 'gyu: mar gyi rtse mor dam can btsan dmag sdud: rgya mdud ma mo sngags srung chen mo 'gyings: thod phreng drag po'i pho nya rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: ban bon ngan pa'i byad ltas dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la srog bdag yab yum 'gyings: mar gyi rtse la sde dpon sum cu rngam: rgya mdud sgo skyong gdong can gad mo sgrog: 'jig rten dmod pa'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: snang srid lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mor gsod byed yab yum brgyad: mar gyi rtse la sgo skyong sman mo 'bum: sked pa rgya mdud sde dpon dgu po g.yo: drag sngags dmod pa'i pho nya'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: phyugs g.yang nyams pa'i god sri rtsang gis zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse mor ging dang laṅka rngam: mar gyi rtse la keng rus phra men brgyad: sked par zhing skyong sde brgyad dmag tshogs sdud: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs dmod pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dam nyams byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: lo zla zhag zla'i skag rkyen dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gdug pa'i rtsang phur rtse mo gnyis dang ldan: yar gyi rtse la khā kha mu kha 'gyings: mar gyi rtse la btsan rgod seng gdong rbad:

sked pa rgya mdud lha klu dge bsnyen tshogs: gter srung gter bdag dmod pa'i rtsang phur 'di: dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dam chos sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra la zlog: hūm̐: zil gnon khro rgyal 'dus pa'i rtsang phur 'di: che chung tshad ni stong gsum 'jig rten khengs: mang nyung tshad ni gaṅgā'i bye ma tsam: mtho dman tshad ni srid rtse mnar med sleb: rno ngar tshad ni reg gcod spu gri'i rlung : myur mgyogs tshad ni gnam lcags thog rgod dbal: nus rtsal tshad ni stong khams 'jig rten bshig: srid gsum 'dus pa drag po rno dbal rtsang : dgra bgegs byad ma'i snying la da thob cig: dam sri 'dre rgod 'byung po bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bskul lo rtsang phur myur mgyogs mthu bo che: rbad do dam can pho nya las la chos: sgrol 'debs bzlog bskul las la mngags pa'i tshe: rtse mo zhe sdang me ri lhabs se lhab: sked pa nga rgyal thog ser sha ra ra: rtsa ba gti mug mun pa chi li li: logs la rlung dmar shwa kha 'u ru ru: drwa mig mtshon cha'i char pa si li li: bar khyams nad yams bu yug tshubs se tshub: zur gsum gdug pa'i rakta chi li li: myur mgyogs las mkhan mtshon 'debs wa la la: hūm̐: rbad do rtsang phur las la chos: 'debs so dgra bo'i snying du ya: chod cig dgra srog myur du chod: dam can shan pa'i dus la bab: de ring rtsang zor dmar po 'dis: lha yi bka' chad bab pa zlog: lha min mtshon cha 'khrug pa zlog: gshin rje'i 'khor lo bskor ba zlog: bdud kyi zhags pa nag po zlog: btsan gyi shwa rdel sprugs pa zlog: klu yi gtad du bcug pa zlog: ma mo'i nad sna sdang ba zlog: the'u rang phung shig gtong ba zlog: rgyal po'i smyo 'bog snying gzer zlog: 'gong pos g.yang la rku ba zlog: rgyal 'gong phyi la 'brang ba zlog: gnod sbyin rtsis la 'debs pa zlog: gza' yi byad phur phog pa zlog:

'dre mo mi ru brdzu ba zlog: sman mos bla tshe rku ba zlog: gre bos shes rgyud dkrugs pa zlog: bse rag phugs su tshud pa zlog: dbang thang za kha nyams pa zlog: longs spyod g.yang kha ral ba zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong phur kha zlog: pha mes dur sri langs pa zlog: gzugs med 'dre 'bod rgyag pa zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: lo zla zhag dus skag rigs zlog: pho bdud mo bdud dal kha zlog: spyi bdud chung bdud dal kha zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: om̐ ma tsa du tri na sa ma ya bhyo zlog: om̐ trig khroṃ bhyoḥ ma ni mā ra ni bhyoḥ mā ra ya du bhyoḥ dan ting sham lo dgra la zlog: ces zlog sngags mang du bgrang : zor las dus yin na rtsang dgu blangs shing zor du 'phang : drag sngags rtsang gi las rim 'di: bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: thathathathatha: nananan: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan gter bdag gling pas padma'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur: yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul gyis bgyis pa'o// // ma) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: kun bzang zhi ba'i bzlog pa dug lnga dbyings grol bzhugs so: kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug skal ldan la: phan phyir bzlog byang chen mo bstan: ye shes mtsho rgyal brda'i yi ge bris: rlung gi 'khor lo'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: de las bzlog pa gso zhing raktas bran la: rang nyid ma bcos lhun grub bde stong gi ngang bskyed rdzogs thams cad 'don sgom du sbrags: gtor chung dang liṅga sha dum bcas bshams nas: dang po bzlog pa'i byung khungs bshad pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings khyab brdal klong yangs dbus:

rin chen sna tshogs nyi zla padma'i gdan: kun tu bzang po yab yum bde stong ngang : chos sku mthing nag mnyam bzhag skyil krung bzhugs: bzang mo dkar gsal zung 'jug bde chen 'khril: ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje dam tshig dkar: zhi ba dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: skye med ngang las don dam ci bzhin 'byung : 'dul dka' rigs drug 'dren pa'i dus la bab: thugs dam bskul lo bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : kun bzang gzhi yi gshis lugs la: nga bdag rlung gi bar chad byung : skye med rig pa'i he ru kas: ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms: khregs chod lta ba'i gtor chen bshams: ka dag don mthong rgyan gyis spras: kun gzhi khyab brdal snod du bzhag: shes rab drug ldan rtsang gis brgyan: ro ma'i khrag gi raktas bran: nga bdag bsgral nas g.yang gzhi bkod: kun tu rgyu ba'i pho nya bsngags: brdal khyab dbyings kyi gtor gdugs phub: 'khor 'das zil gnon bya khyung btsugs: phyir mi ldog pa'i 'khor lo bskor: thug phrad ro snyom zor chen bsgrigs: shar grol 'dzin med thun rdzas bshams: 'byin 'jug rdo rje'i drag sngags bzlas: bde stong khro bo khro mo bskul: kun gzhi ro gcig dmod pa bor: 'khor 'das bral ba'i zor 'phang tshe: 'gyu ba phra rags 'khrul rgyun chad: cir snang chos nyid ngang du bzlogs: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: bcom ldan rigs 'dus chos sku kun tu bzang : sku mdog mthing nag mi shigs brtan pa yis: gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa'i las rlung ngan pa zlog: phyag drug pha rol phyin drug ldan pa yis: tshogs drug 'khrul ba'i nga bdag gzung 'dzin zlog: zhal gsum sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa yis: sgo gsum tha mal shor ba'i ngan lam zlog: thugs rje'i spyan dgu phyogs bcur gzigs pa yis:

'gro ba'i ma rig 'khrul mun ngan lam zlog: zhabs bzhi tshad med bzhi dang ldan pa yis: 'gog lam rtag chad mu bzhi bzlog tu gsol: bzang mo thabs shes gnyis de spel ba yis: chags lam 'gog pa'i las rlung bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje'i skyil krung don dam 'khrul 'khor gyis: rnam rtog g.yo ba'i nyon mongs rlung gsum zlog: sems dpa' rdo rjes kun yid gnyis 'dzin zlog: ye shes khrag 'thung sgrib pa'i ma rig zlog: gsal stong khrag 'thung bying rmugs 'thib pa zlog: rig stong khrag 'thung nyon mongs sgrib pa zlog: bde stong khrag 'thung las kyi sdug bsngal zlog: mngon 'byung khrag 'thung snang ba'i zhen pa zlog: dran rig khrag 'thung kun brtags mtshan ma zlog: lhan skyes khrag 'thung nga bdag 'dzin pa zlog: kun grol khrag 'thung bzang ngan spang blang zlog: don gyi khrag 'thung a 'thas gol sa zlog: hūm̐: kun bzang yab yum zhe sdang 'dzin pa zlog: rin 'byung yab yum nga rgyal 'dzin pa zlog: snang mtha' yab yum 'dod chags 'dzin pa zlog: don grub yab yum phrag dog 'dzin pa zlog: mi bskyod yab yum gti mug 'dzin pa zlog: rnam snang yab yum dug lnga'i rmongs 'dzin zlog: sa snying ser pos nga rgyal gdug rtsub zlog: nam mkha'i snying pos stong nyid gol sa zlog: spyan gzigs dmar pos 'dod chags g.yo 'khrugs zlog: phyag rdor mthing nag gti mug blun rmongs zlog: byams pa dkar pos zhe sdang khro ba zlog: sgrib pa rnam sel las kyi sgrib pa zlog: kun tu bzang pos bzang ngan ris 'byed zlog: 'jam dpal dbyangs kyis shes bya'i bag chags zlog: rdo rje sgeg mos gzugs kyi chags 'dzin zlog: phreng ba ma yis sgra yi dngos 'dzin zlog: glu dbyangs ma yis dri yi myong 'dzin zlog: rdo rje gar mos ro bro'i 'du 'dzin zlog: me tog ma yis gzugs kyi 'dzin pa zlog: dhū pe ma yis dri yi 'dzin pa zlog:

ā lo ma yis yid kyi 'dzin pa zlog: dri chab ma yis ma dag rgyud sgrib zlog: gshin rje'i gshed kyis rtag par lta ba zlog: rta mgrin rgyal pos chad par lta ba zlog: stobs po che yis 'gog pa'i lta ba zlog: bdud rtsi 'khyil bas sgrub pa'i bdag 'dzin zlog: lha dbang brgya byin pham ltung sdug bsngal zlog: thag bzang ris kyis 'thab rtsod sdug bsngal zlog: shākya thub pas skye rga na 'chi zlog: seṅge rab brtan glen lkug sdug bsngal zlog: thub pa kha 'bar bkres skom sdug bsngal zlog: chos kyi rgyal pos btso bsreg sdug bsngal zlog: dug lnga thams cad ye shes dbyings su zlog: sna tshogs thams cad chos nyid klong du zlog: sems can thams cad sangs rgyas zhing du zlog: 'khor ba thams cad mya ngan 'das par zlog: gnyis su 'dzin pa mnyam pa nyid du zlog: bzang ngan thams cad ro gcig ngang du zlog: dgra gnyen thams cad pha ma'i ngang du zlog: phung po lnga nyid rgyal ba rigs lngar zlog: 'byung ba lnga nyid lha mo lnga ru zlog: rnam shes tshogs brgyad sems dpa' brgyad du zlog: rtag chad mu bzhi tshad med bzhi ru zlog: yul brgyad rtog pa rnam thar brgyad du zlog: dbang po'i sgo dgu theg pa rim dgur zlog: snod bcud thams cad sangs rgyas zhing du zlog: gzugs rnams thams cad lha dang lha mor zlog: sgra rnams thams cad 'byin 'jug sngags su zlog: sdug bsngal thams cad bde chen ngang du zlog: snang ba thams cad gsal ba'i ngang du zlog: 'gyu ba thams cad stong nyid ngang du zlog: gshis lugs thams cad khregs chod ngang du zlog: dgag sgrub bral ba zang thal ngang du zlog: sgrib g.yogs bral ba ka dag ngang du zlog: 'gro 'ong bral ba khyab brdal ngang du zlog: skye 'gag bral ba kun gzhi'i klong du zlog: gdod nas dag pa rang byung chen por zlog: dug lnga rang grol sha khrag phud kyis mchod: bskul lo bzhengs shig bzlog bsgyur dus la bab:
sems can sangs rgyas thob pa'i phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas yul padma rong bal phu yar 'brog mtsho gangs ri lha btsan rngam 'dra'i mdun nas khrom gter du gdan drangs shing padma chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o// // tsa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: che mchog khro bo'i bzlog pa stobs bcu rang shar bzhugs so: che mchog 'dus pa'i lha la phyag mtshal lo: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra kho bo pad 'byung ngas: kun gyi yang bcud zab khyad can: bzlog pa stobs bcu rang shar bstan: mtsho rgyal brda yi yi ger thob: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor chung liṅga sha khrag skyems bcas bshams la 'di skad do: hūm̐: bskal pa'i me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: byol song gtso brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: ma bcos lhun grub dpal chen he ru kas: nyi shu rtsa gcig zhal gdang spyan rtsa 'khyil: bzhi bcu'i phyag na thabs shes mtshon cha 'dzin: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas bcu rdzogs: gnam zhal dbyings phyug dbu dgu pang du 'khyud: ye shes sprul pa'i khro rgyal tshogs kyis bskor: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las bcol: da lta dus ngan yang mtha' mar 'grib ste: khro rgyal chen po'i mngon spyod dus la bab: thugs dam dus las ma 'da' phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dang po bzlog pa gang nas byung : khro rgyal che mchog dpal chen la: 'jig rten khro bos 'gran btsal bas: ye shes he ru ka pa yis: 'byung lnga khyab brdal ma traṃ gzugs: snang srid gnyis bsdus dpal gtor bshams: rang byung kun bzhi'i bhandha btsugs: khro bcu 'dus pa'i rtsang gis brgyan: thabs shes dkar dmar rgyan gyis spras: 'byung thabs glog gi bha sus bcings:

ye shes lnga ldan khyung gis brgyan: ye nas phub pa'i gtor gdugs bskyon: mkha' dbyings bzang mo'i raktas bran: sgra gcan rlung gi pho nya rbad: hūm̐ sgra drag po'i zlog sngags bzlas: rang 'dra'i khro chung 'gyed pa'i tshe: 'jig rten khro bo'i srog snying phul: dam tshig bka' yi bran du bkol: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: de nas bzlog pa gang nas byung : mtha' 'khob bye ma'i gling zhes par: dam chos dge bcu dben pa'i yul: las su srog gcod sdig pa spyod: chos su mi dge'i dmar mchod 'gyed: sems can shi tshad dmyal bar skye: yul der bi ma mi tra byon: dam chos bstan du ma btub ste: thugs ngal yi mug skyes pa'i tshe: dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro kun gsal mas: lung bstan skye med rang sgra ru: dug lnga ye shes lngar bsgyur ba'i: zhi khro 'dus pa'i bzlog pa brtsams: ma rig 'khor ba stongs so skad: slob dpon bi ma mi tra yis: nga bdag bsgral nas zhing gzhi bkod: rig pa rdo rje'i dpal gtor bshams: gnas lugs bstan pa'i rtsang phur btsugs: du ma ro gcig snod du bzhag: thabs shes spel ba'i rgyan gyis spras: rgyu 'bras phra zhib bha sus bsdams: bzlog med zang thal zor chen bshams: kun khyab dbyings kyi gdugs kyang bklubs: ma yengs dran pa'i bya khyung btsugs: gcig shes kun grol dmod pa bor: rtog med shes pa'i zlog sngags bzlas: rig pa rdo rjes zor brgyan pas: sems can yul stong sangs rgyas thob: sngon tshe bzlog pa de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: bzlog bsgyur phrin las bcol ba'i tshe: sems can ngan 'gror 'khrid pa yi: blo ngan 'khor ba'i btson ra zlog: hūm̐: dpal chen che mchog rang byung he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag klong la khyab pa yis: ma rig 'khrul ba'i gti mug bzlog tu gsol: nyi shu rtsa gcig rngam zhal bgrad pa yis:

dpa' bo thig le'i gegs skyon bzlog tu gsol: g.yas pa nyi shus rdo rje phyar ba yis: zhe sdang yul 'dzin sgrib pa bzlog tu gsol: g.yon pa nyi shus dung dmar bsnams pa yis: 'dod chags bdag 'dzin srid pa bzlog tu gsol: dmar ser dbu skra gyen la phyogs pa yis: zang thal 'pho ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan pa yis: zhing khams rigs lnga'i sa lam bar chad zlog: zhal gdangs mche gtsigs spyan rtsa bgrad pa yis: tshogs drug rnam g.yeng 'dzin pa bzlog tu gsol: sgro gshog g.yas g.yon mkha' la bgrad pa yis: phyi nang gnyis 'dzin snang ba bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: bzang ngan zhen pa'i 'khri ba bzlog tu gsol: bco brgyad zhabs ni gling bzhir bgrad pa yis: kun rtog brgyad cu'i gnyis rtog bzlog tu gsol: gnam zhal dbyings phyug pang du 'khyud pa yis: nyon mongs bzhi bcu'i zhen pa bzlog tu gsol: dbu dgu rngam zhing dgyes zhal khro ba yis: rim dgu'i theg pa'i bar chad rmongs 'dzin zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: rtsa rlung thig le'i gegs skyon bzlog tu gsol: zhabs brgyad brkyang bskum yab la 'khril ba yis: bdag 'dzin a 'thas zhen pa bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod la sogs rgyan gyis mdzes pa yis: phyi yul 'dzin pa'i kun brtags bzlog tu gsol: me dpung dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: nga rgyal khengs sems bag chags bzlog tu gsol: byol song gtso brgyad gdan la bzhugs pa yis: phrag dog las kyi rlung dmar bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bhi shwa kro ti yab yum gyis: rtsa yi bar chad thams cad zlog: raksha kro ti yab yum gyis: kun da'i bar chad thams cad zlog: ghu na kro ti yab yum gyis: rig gzhi'i 'khrul mun bar chad zlog: yaksha kro ti yab yum gyis: rlung gi bar chad thams cad zlog: hūm̐: phyogs skyong bcu yis dge bcu'i bar chad zlog:
