ta krita rigs bzhis lam bzhi'i bar chad zlog: lce spyang ma brgyad tshogs brgyad 'khrul ba zlog: sgo ma rigs bzhis rtag chad mu bzhi zlog: hūm̐: zhi khro 'dus pa'i lha tshogs thugs dam can: mar gyur 'gro ba rigs drug sems can rnams: ngan song bdud kyi dbang du shor ba zlog: blo ngan 'khrul ba'i dbang du gtong ba zlog: rdzas nor yul la chags pa'i nga bdag zlog: dam chos dge bcu bcom pa'i g.yeng ba zlog: nyams rtogs ting 'dzin gcod pa'i bslu brid zlog: tha ma rang srog phung ba'i ka cha zlog: ma dag rigs drug 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams: lugs ldog sangs rgyas 'khor lo'i klong du zlog: lugs 'byung srid pa'i sa bon stong par mdzod: hūm̐: kun bzang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho rnams: sha khrag phud dang gtor ma 'di bzhes la: ma dag 'khrul ba'i bar chad bzlog byas nas: chos nyid lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma dang phud kyis mchod: dge ba bcu la bar chad gang byung yang : bzlog pa 'di la shin tu 'bad pa gces: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs sems can mtha' yas don: zhi khro 'dus pa'i bzlog pa bzhag: thar lam them skas e ma hoḥ slob dpon bi ma mi tra'i phyag bzhes 'di: yang gsang shog dril mgul khug ma: spel bar phangs nas gter du sbas: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sems can log chos blo thag chod: shi tshad gdug 'dre ngan song skye: de rnams sangs rgyas thob phyir bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas yul padma rong nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // tsha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: yang dag he ru ka'i bzlog pa bsod nams gter bum bzhugs so: che mchog yang dag 'dus pa'i lha la bstod:

sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bzlog pa bsod nams gter bum bstan: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal lha yi lcam: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs skal ldan las 'phro can: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor ma dang liṅga sha dum bcas bshams la: hūm̐: shar phyogs zla gam ru tra bsnol ba'i steng : bcom ldan dpal chen khro rgyal he ru kaḥ dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'bar: yum chen kro ti shwa ris sku la 'khril: ye shes me dpung klong yangs dbus su 'gying sa: thugs kyi lha tshogs dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po la: lha 'dre yul gyi cho 'phrul byung : lo thog rtsi bcud 'bras bu skam: longs spyod dkor nor dbul zhing bkres: hūm̐ chen ka ra spyan drangs nas: rten 'brel dus rtags dmod pa'i tshe: slob dpon chen po hūm̐ ka ras: yang dag thugs kyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum de: rin chen dngul gyi snod du bzhag: zhi ba'i snod dbal rtsang phur btsugs: ru tra bsgral nas g.yang gzhi bkod: dug rdzas thun dang zor chen bsgril: chos nyid drag po'i rnga chen brdungs: rig sngags dmod pa'i bzlog pa byas: dbang phyug ma brgyad las la bskul: las zor pho nya rbad pa'i tshe: lha 'dre bdud kyi cho 'phrul zhi: chos rgyal longs spyod phun sum tshogs: sngon tshe bzlog pa de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: bsod nams longs spyod mnga' thang la: sdang ba'i bar chad thams cad zlog: hūm̐: sku mdog mthing nag rngam par ston pa yi: ye shes sku yis nyon mongs bse rag zlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: yi dam lha yi dngos grub yal ba zlog: dbu skra smin ma me ltar 'bar ba yis: ma mo mkha' 'gro'i dam tshig yal ba zlog:

bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: sgro gshog mkha' la rab tu bgrad pa yis: bse rag mi la chung sri bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: dpal dang 'byor pa nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: yum chen kro ti shwa ris 'khyud pa yis: lus kyi bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nyams pa zlog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro chags dgyes pa yis: rtsa rlung thig le nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod chas dang rab tu ldan pa yis: spar kha sme ba nyams pa bzlog tu gsol: yab kyis zhabs brkyang yum gyis 'khril ba yis: kha rje dbang thang ral pa bzlog tu gsol: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: log 'dren bdud kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: buddha khrag 'thung mi g.yang nyams pa zlog: ratna khrag 'thung nor g.yang nyams pa zlog: padma khrag 'thung rta g.yang nyams pa zlog: karma khrag 'thung lug g.yang nyams pa zlog: buddha shwa ris 'bru g.yang nyams pa zlog: ratna kro tis gos g.yang nyams pa zlog: padma kro tis zas g.yang nyams pa zlog: karma kro tis yul bcud nyams pa zlog: hūm̐: kau rīs yul gyi bcud nyams zlog: tsau ris sa yi bcud nyams zlog: pra mos rtsi thog bcud nyams zlog: bai tas shing thog bcud nyams zlog: pukkas 'bru yi bcud nyams zlog: ghasmas chu yi bcud nyams zlog: tsaṇḍas me tog bcud nyams zlog: siṃ has rtsa yi bcud nyams zlog: byā gṛs nang gi bcud nyams zlog: sri las phyi yi bcud nyams zlog: shwa nas bar khyams bcud nyams zlog: kri tas zhing gi bcud nyams zlog: kaṅkas sa bon bcud nyams zlog: khā khas lo bcud nyams pa zlog: hu lus bang ba'i bcud nyams zlog: stag gdong shar phyogs bcud nyams zlog: phag gdong lho phyogs bcud nyams zlog: seng gdong nub phyogs bcud nyams zlog: spyang gdong byang phyogs bcud nyams zlog: dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis:

g.yang nyams dbul sri ngan pa zlog: god sri bse rag 'gong po zlog: bkrag nyams mi kha ngan pa zlog: stong gi bram mchu gshe ba zlog: the'u rang sri la rku ba zlog: btsan sri rta nad mtsher bcu zlog: god sri 'gong po spun dgu zlog: byis sri li la chung bdud zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: hūm̐: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: dbang thang g.yang nyams bzlog tu gsol: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: longs spyod phywa g.yang nyams shing yul du lo thog mi skye ba dang : phyugs kyi 'o ma mi 'byung ba la: bzlog pa 'di gang mang bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra rig 'dzin rtsa gsum gling pas padma sbas pa'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing padma chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // dza) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'jam dpal sku'i bzlog pa me yi spu gri dmar po bzhugs so: 'jam dpal sku yi lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: yang bzlog me yi spu gri bstan: byad zor phur kha gang zhig la: dmod pa bor chog sa ma ya: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo'i dus: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor chung dang liṅga sha khrag rnams bshams shing sha chen gyi gsur btang : hūm̐: lho phyogs chu glang zla gam bsnol ba'i steng : bcom ldan khro rgyal khrag 'thung gshin rje'i gshed: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'bar: yum chen bhe ta za byed sku la 'khril: ye shes me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : 'jam dpal gshin rje'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung :

nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa nyid: dar zhing rten 'brel rgyas pa'i tshe: zhang zhung mu stegs bon po yis: phrag dog 'gran sems skyes nas kyang : rkyen dang bar chod sdang ba byung : nang pa thams cad bka' gros te: slob dpon 'jam dpal gdan yang drangs: slob dpon chen po bshes gnyen gyis: gshin rje sku yi dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral nas zhing gzhi bkod: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum byas: las mkhan shan pa rtsang gis bskor: drag sngags gshin rje'i zor chen bsgril: rig sngags mthu yi rnga chen brdungs: dmod sngags drag pos gshin rje rbad: zor bzlog spu gri bstan pa'i tshe: mu stegs yul du dmar nad phyur: phyi nang bdud kyi byad kha zlog: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: byad kha phur kha dgra la zlog: hūm̐: sku mdog ser nag rngam par ston pa yis: pho rgyud khro bo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: mo rgyud ma mo'i byad kha dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar nag me ltar 'bar ba yis: snang srid khro bcu'i byad kha dgra la zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: bon gyi byad kha thams cad dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: ban gyi byad kha thams cad dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa yis: skye bo'i dmod kha thams cad dgra la zlog: yum mchog bhe ta za byed 'khril ba yis: sngags pa'i byad kha thams cad dgra la zlog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: bud med dmod pa'i byad kha dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: yul lha'i byad kha thams cad dgra la zlog: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis: pho lha'i byad kha thams cad dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: yul 'dre'i byad kha thams cad dgra la zlog: hūm̐: ya ma rā dzas gshin rje'i byad khram zlog:

sgrol yum dpal 'bar ma mo'i byad kha zlog: ral pa gcig mas srin mo'i byad kha zlog: dbang po myos byed bdud kyi byad kha zlog: gtum chen mo yis bdud mo'i byad kha zlog: khrag gi bdag mos ma yams byad kha zlog: me ru rtse yis btsan gyi byad kha zlog: 'od zer ma yis sman mo'i byad kha zlog: gling bzhi gtsug 'byams gson 'dre nag mo zlog: ral pa rtsal dgus gnod sbyin byad kha zlog: re ma ti yis btsan mo'i byad kha zlog: srin mo mgo 'phyang mo 'dre'i byad kha zlog: nag 'joms mthing nag klu yi byad kha zlog: nag mo ral gcig sa bdag byad kha zlog: phywa g.yang dkar pos dgra lha'i byad kha zlog: shel ging gdong dgus rgyal po'i byad kha zlog: khrag 'joms dkar ser lha min byad kha zlog: shel gyi mig dgus lha yi byad kha zlog: glang mgo smug nag gza' yi byad kha zlog: dkar spyang mche gtsigs dam can byad kha zlog: gsod byed chen pos gnam thel byad kha zlog: ya ba ti yis dmu yi byad kha zlog: dred kyi gdong can gnam smin byad kha zlog: bdud mo gser 'grogs sa thel byad kha zlog: mig dmar smug nag mgon po'i byad kha zlog: khrag gi ral gcig bar thel byad kha zlog: za ba dmar nag mi min byad kha zlog: rmigs pa dung kas rlung lha'i byad kha zlog: glu mo pus 'gros dri za'i byad kha zlog: me yi kha rlangs gshin rje'i byad kha zlog: gter pa sngo nag lha yi byad kha zlog: mche gtsigs chen mos srin mo'i byad kha zlog: dug ti dmar mos klu bdud byad kha zlog: bdud 'joms smug nag dbang ldan byad kha zlog: ral gcig ma yis gtad khram byad kha zlog: btsan tri nag pos mkha' 'gro'i byad kha zlog: chos rgyal dkar ser lo yi byad kha zlog: rdo rje ral chen zla ba'i byad kha zlog: gdong dgu nag mos zhag gi byad kha zlog: phya sang mthing nag dus kyi byad kha zlog: 'bar ma chen mos chu tshod byad kha zlog:

dmar mo mgo dgus 'gong po'i byad kha zlog: thod dbyug mthing nag shi gshed byad kha zlog: phag mgo nag mos gri bo'i byad kha zlog: srin mo zangs mchus ltas ngan sna tshogs zlog: shar gyi sgo mas shar phyogs byad kha zlog: lho yi sgo mas lho phyogs byad kha zlog: nub kyi sgo mas nub kyi byad kha zlog: byang gi sgo mas byang gi byad kha zlog: ging chen sde bzhis ban byed pho nya zlog: bdud po sde bzhis bon byed pho nya zlog: rtsis pa sde bzhis lo zla'i rtsis 'debs zlog: shan pa sde bzhis mthu sgrub byad kha zlog: lha srin sde brgyad byad kha zlog: sde dpon dgu yi byad kha zlog: dpal mgon bdun cu'i byad kha zlog: sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa zlog: ltas ngan ye 'drog glo bur zlog: mi mthun gnod pa'i bar chad zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: 'jam dpal gshin rje'i lha tshogs rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byaur bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: byad ltas ngan pa dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: pha rol gyi byad kha sdang zhing mthu rtags dang lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul byung na bzlog pa 'di ci mang dgos: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bzlog pa me yi spu gri bzhag: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: ban bon sngags btsun mthu 'gran byed: rkyen kha blo bur bar chod ldang : de dus bar chod bsal ba'i phyir: yang bzlog zab mo sa ma ya: thugs kyi sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gnyan rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: padma gter bdag gling pas padma sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bsgyur/ yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul zhes pa'o/ /shog ser gyi bu dpe las bshus so// // wa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gsung rta mgrin gyi bzlog pa zil gnon stobs 'dus bzhugs so: dbang chen khro bo 'dus pa'i lha la bstod: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bzlog pa zil gnon stobs 'dus bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: nga yi rjes 'brang bu slob kyis: ye shes mi bsgrub dregs pa brten: de yi rten 'brel smon lam gyis: rang nyid nus pa nyams pa yi: gzhan gyis rang nyid zil mnan te: rang mgo mi 'og 'chor 'char 'byung : ci byed de la phan pa'i thabs: pha rol zil gnon bzlog pa bstan: yang bzlog zab mo 'di nyid ni: dpa' bo'i lag gi mtshon dang mtshungs: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ma 'ongs nyi shu mgo tshugs tshe: las can sras dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dang po gtor ma dang liṅga sha dum bcas bshams shing : hūm̐: nub phyogs zla gam klu bdud bsnol ba'i steng : dbang chen khro rgyal padma he ru kaḥ dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'bar: yum mchog padma gzi ldan sku la 'khril: ye shes me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : dbang chen khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs:

dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : nang pa sangs rgyas bstan pa la: mu stegs ma hor nag po yis: dbang phyug chen po bsgrubs nas kyang : nang pa zil mnan sgra yang tshad: nang pa pham zhing chos kyang nub: thugs ngal yi mug skyo ba'i tshe: slob dpon nā gardzu na yis: dbang chen zil mnon dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral nas zhing gzhi bkod: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum bshams: dmar nag shan pa rtsang rigs btsugs: rig sngags las kyi zor thun bsgril: zil gnon dbang gi rnga chen brdungs: dmod sngags thog mda' nag pos btab: ārya de wa'i thugs rgyud bskul: las mkhan sde bzhi'i pho nya rbad: zil gnon zor bzlog gtab pa'i tshe: mu stegs gdug pa'i g.yul ngo pham: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: gzhan gyis zil gnon dgra la bzlog: hūm̐: sku mdog dmar nag rngam par ston pa yis: ye shes dbyings kyis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: 'jig rten khro bos zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: dbu skra dmar nag me ltar 'bar ba yis: snod bcud chung gis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: mu stegs bon gyis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: snang srid ma mos zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa yis: nyon mongs bdud bzhis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: yum mchog padma gzi ldan 'khril ba yis: ma rgyud mkha' 'gros zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: dpa' bo yongs kyis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: steng phyogs lha yis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis:

bar phyogs gnyan gyis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: 'og phyogs klu yis zil gnon bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: rdo rje dbang chen lus kyis zil gnon zlog: padma dbang chen ngag gis zil gnon zlog: buddha dbang chen yid kyis zil gnon zlog: ratna dbang chen mthu yis zil gnon zlog: karma dbang chen stobs kyis zil gnon zlog: hūm̐: zhi ba 'dul byed zhi bas zil gnon zlog: khro bo 'dul byed khro bcus zil gnon zlog: ma mo 'dul byed ma mos zil gnon zlog: khyung 'dul chen pos khyung gis zil gnon zlog: dregs pa 'dul byed dregs pas zil gnon zlog: ma bdud 'dul byed sring bzhis zil gnon zlog: klu 'dul chen pos klu yis zil gnon zlog: gza' 'dul chen pos gza' yis zil gnon zlog: the'u rang 'dul byed the'u rang zil gnon zlog: 'byung po 'dul byed 'byung pos zil gnon zlog: btsan rnams 'dul byed btsan gyis zil gnon zlog: gnod sbyin 'dul byed gnod sbyin zil gnon zlog: rgyal po 'dul byed rgyal pos zil gnon zlog: bdud 'dul chen pos bdud kyis zil gnon zlog: sku sprul ma mos dri zas zil gnon zlog: gsung sprul ma mos klu srin zil gnon zlog: thugs sprul ma mos gshin rjes zil gnon zlog: yon tan ma mos me lhas zil gnon zlog: phrin las ma mos srin mos zil gnon zlog: sha za ma mos rlung lhas zil gnon zlog: srog gcod ma mos dbang ldan zil gnon zlog: kun rgyu long bas tshangs pas zil gnon zlog: 'dod khams long bas dgra lhas zil gnon zlog: gzugs med long bas dmu yis zil gnon zlog: long ba brgyad brgyad bco lnga'i 'khor bcas kyis: snang srid yongs kyi cho 'phrul zil gnon zlog: chu yi pho nyas dge bsnyen zil gnon zlog: me yi pho nyas gnam thel zil gnon zlog:

rlung gi pho nyas bar thel zil gnon zlog: sa yi pho nyas sa thel zil gnon zlog: rlung gi 'brug mos sde brgyad zil gnon zlog: me yi 'brug mos brtan mas zil gnon zlog: sa yi 'brug mos yul lhas zil gnon zlog: chu yi 'brug mos rgyal 'gong zil gnon zlog: rngam khyi brgyad kyis pho nyas zil gnon zlog: lce spyang brgyad kyis dmod pas zil gnon zlog: hūm̐: snang srid ye shes 'jig rten gyis: zil gyis gnon dang bcings pa zlog: bskrad gzir bsregs mnan gtad pa zlog: dmod pa rbad bskul 'phen pa zlog: ban gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: bon gyi byad kha dgra la zlog: snang srid cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: dus kyi chad pa dgra la zlog: sa g.yo than ltas dgra la zlog: dmag 'khrug mu stegs dgra la zlog: ltas ngan brgyad cu dgra la zlog: mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen rnams kun: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dbang chen rta mgrin lha tshogs rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: gzhan gyis zil gyis gnon pa yi: bsam sbyor ngan pa dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: gzhan gyis rang nyid zil gyis gnon pa dang bcings pa sogs dang : rmi lam rgyal 'gong la dbang zhu ba dang : pha rol brtsad pas rang pham pa dang : gzhan gyis dbang che byas pa sogs rmi lam: dngos su pha rol gyis dbang du bsdu ba bshams song na: de'i dus su bzlog pa 'di la 'bad pa gces: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bzlog pa stobs 'dus zil gnon bzhag: phyi rabs skal ldan rjes 'jug la: mtha' 'khob skye bos dgra brtsam zhing : zil gnon dbang sdud 'byung ba'i tshe: bzlog pa 'di la 'bad pa mchog: srid gsum stobs 'dus gu hya rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya:

sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter bdag gling pas padma sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas zhal rgyas so/ /yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul zhes pas bgyis/ shog ser gyi bu dpe las bshus so/ /maṅga laṃ// // zha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: phrin las phur pa'i bzlog pa rngam pa glog phreng bzhugs so: rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha la phyag 'tshal 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng ngas: bzlog pa rngam pa glog phreng bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mi rnams glo bur rkyen dbang 'gro: bar chod sdang zhing dus min 'chi: de yi rkyen bzlog zab khyad can: yang zab snying gi byang bu 'di: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor chung dang liṅga sha dum bcas bshams shing : hūm̐: byang phyogs zla gam lha chen bsnol ba'i steng : phrin las khro rgyal badzra ku mā ra: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'bar: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sku la 'khril: ye shes me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : phrin las khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgya gar chos kyi rgyal po la: rkyen ngan bdud kyis bar chad sdang : skag dang 'chi ltas brdegs pa'i tshe: pra bha hastī spyan drangs te: bar chod bsal ba'i thabs lags zhus: rig 'dzin pra bha hastī yis: rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral nas g.yang gzhi bkod: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum bzhengs: dmar nag pho nya'i rtsang gis bskor: phur bu las mkhan brgyad brgyas bskor: mthu stobs rtsal gyis zor thun bsgril: rngam chen rdo rje'i gsang rnga brdungs: zlog sngags me dpung 'khor lo bskor: ye shes khro bcu las la bskul:

shwa na sa bdag pho nyar rbad: rkyen bzlog dmod pa bor ba'i tshe: bar chad bdud rigs dbyings su bsgral: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: chag chen nyam nga thams cad kyang : bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: hūm̐: sku mdog mthing nag rngam par ston pa yis: yi dam lha yi bka' chad dgra la zlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: ma sring mkha' 'gros sun ma dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar po me ltar 'bar ba yis: steng phyogs lha yi bar chad dgra la zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: lha min bar chad thams cad dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: bar phyogs gnyan gyi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu brgyan pa yis: 'og phyogs klu yi bar chad dgra la zlog: yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs 'khril ba yis: snang srid ma mo'i bar chad dgra la zlog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: rtsa rlung 'byung 'khrug bar chod dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: nyon mongs bdud bzhi'i bar chod dgra la zlog: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis: glo bur rkyen gyi bar chod dgra la zlog: me ri dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: rnam rtog nyams grib bar chod dgra la zlog: hūm̐: buddha kī las sku yi bar chad zlog: badzra kī las thugs kyi bar chad zlog: ratna kī las yon tan bar chad zlog: padma kī las gsung gi bar chad zlog: karma kī las phrin las bar chad zlog: hūm̐ chen khro bos lha yi bar chad zlog: rdo rje sgra 'byin dri za'i bar chad zlog: phag dang rmigs bus yul gyi chag chen zlog: rnam rgyal khro bos rgyal po'i bar chad zlog: rdo rje snyems mas me lha'i bar chad zlog: stag dang bya rgod dus kyi chag chen zlog: dbyug sngon khro bos gshin rje'i bar chad zlog:

rdo rje sder mos srin po'i bar chad zlog: g.yag dang bya rog lo yi chag chen zlog: gshin rje'i gshed kyis btsan gyi bar chad zlog: dur khrod bdag mos srin po'i bar chad zlog: shwa ba 'ug pas zla ba'i chag chen zlog: mi g.yo khro rgyal ma mo'i bar chad zlog: rdo rje gtun khung klu dbang bar chad zlog: gzig dang khwa tas zhag dus chag chen zlog: rta mgrin rgyal pos gnod sbyin bar chad zlog: rdo rje gtum mos rlung lha'i bar chad zlog: byi la phu shud grong gi bar chad zlog: 'dod pa'i rgyal pos bdud kyi bar chad zlog: rdo rje mda' snyems bgegs kyi bar chad zlog: spyang ki khra yis sgo yi chag chen zlog: bdud rtsi 'khyil pas klu bdud bar chad zlog: rdo rje sgra 'byin dbang ldan bar chad zlog: seṅge pha waṃ khyim gyi chag chen zlog: khams gsum rnam rgyal gza' yi bar chad zlog: rdo rje gsod byed grul bum bar chad zlog: dom dang sre mong rmi ltas mtshan ngan zlog: stobs po che yis the'u rang bar chad zlog: rdo rje spyod mas mi min bar chad zlog: dred dang byi bas rkyen dang nyam nga zlog: pu shud mgo can dmu yi gnod pa zlog: skya ga'i mgo can sa bdag gnod pa zlog: srin bya'i mgo can 'gong po'i gnod pa zlog: khra yi mgo can mo 'dre'i gnod pa zlog: shwa na mthing nag phung sri'i gnod pa zlog: shwa na dmar nag dri za'i gnod pa zlog: sri la ser nag god 'dre'i gnod pa zlog: sri la sngo nag sgab 'dre'i gnod pa zlog: mthing nag re tis nad kha zug pa zlog: ser nag re tis dur kha bye ba zlog: dmar nag re tis spar sme nyams pa zlog: ljang nag re dzus gyod kha bye ba zlog: ya byin ma yis dgra kha bye ba zlog: de byin ma yis yul lha'i bar chad zlog: bswe byin ma yis sa sgo bye ba zlog: phag byin ma yis gshed sgo ral pa zlog: skyes bu chen po ging bzhi yis:

phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad zlog: bdud po phur thogs sde bzhi yis: chag che nyam nga bzlog tu gsol: lo skag zla skag zhag skag zlog: za skag nad skag 'chi skag zlog: dbang thang kha rje nyams pa zlog: tshe zad za 'dre 'khor ba zlog: bgegs rigs ye 'drog glo bur zlog: bar chod gdon bgegs byad ma zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje gzhon nu'i lha tshogs rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis: gnod pa'i bdud dang bar chad rnams: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: rkyen dang bar chad sogs rtags dang mtshan ma ngan pa byung na bzlog pa 'di gang mang dgos: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: yang bzlog rngam pa zlog phreng bzhag: ma 'ongs dus kyi tha ma la: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/

/sarba maṅga laṃ// // za) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: yon tan ma mo'i bzlog pa drag sngags spu gri bzhugs so: rbod gtong ma mo'i lha tshogs sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bzlog pa drag sngags spu gri bstan: ma 'ongs yang mtha' lnga bdo'i dus: 'go nad sna dgu rlung ltar 'tshubs: bcos thabs med pa'i nad rigs dar: de dus bzlog thabs man ngag ni: gdams pa khyad 'phags e ma hoḥ yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor chung dang liṅga sha dum bcas bshams shing : hūm̐: shar lho zla gam ma mo 'bum sde'i steng : bcom ldan dpal chen bla med he ru kar: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad 'bar: yum mchog nyid zhi kun bzang sku la 'khril: ye shes me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : yon tan khro rgyal 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgya gar kā ma shrī yis: ma mo khros pa'i kha rlangs las: dmar nad rgyug 'gyel 'brum bu byung : rgyal mo sam bho ṭa zhes pas: dha na saṃ skṛ spyan yang drangs: nad bcos gdams pa ci lags sam: zhes pa'i smra ba'i gtam zhus so: slob dpon dha na saṃ skṛ yis: rbod gtong ma mo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi bkod: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum bzhengs: dmar nag pho nya rtsang gis brgyan: nad bdag gzhom pa'i zor thun bsgril: drag sngags shes rab rnga chen brdungs: zlog sngags rlung gi spu gri bskor: che ba'i mkha' 'gro las la bskul: 'jig rten ma mo pho nyar rbad: nad 'joms dmod tshig bor ba'i tshe: ma mo 'khrugs pa'i nad yams zhi: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: phyi nang nad gdon bar chad rigs: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod:

hūm̐: sku mdog ljang nag rngam par ston pa yis: ye shes ma mo'i nad yams dgra la zlog: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: 'jig rten ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis: snang srid ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: sha za ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: las kyi ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa yis: gling bzhi ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: yum mchog kun bzang nyid zhis 'khril ba yis: snang srid 'khrugs pa'i yams nad dgra la zlog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: srog gcod ma mo'i yams nad dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: mkha' la 'gyu ba'i yams nad dgra la zlog: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis: yul la chags pa'i yams nad dgra la zlog: me ri smug nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: grong yul khyim gyi yams nad dgra la zlog: hūm̐: gsal snang 'bar dkar lha 'khrug yams nad zlog: 'od gsal 'bar ser gza' 'khrug yams nad zlog: shel gsal 'bar dmar klu 'khrug yams nad zlog: klong gsal 'bar ljang bdud 'khrug yams nad zlog: bde 'gros khros mas btsan 'khrug yams nad zlog: thod phreng dkar mos bdud 'khrug yams nad zlog: ma mo khros mas dmu 'khrug yams nad zlog: khrag 'thung khros mas gnyan 'khrug yams nad zlog: bdud rtsi khros mas rgyal po'i yams nad zlog: bde sbyor khros mas gnod sbyin yams nad zlog: srid pa dkar mos gshin rje'i yams nad zlog: sngon mo dbyings phyug sa bdag yams nad zlog: bdag nyid chen mos lha min yams nad zlog: gcig spyod dkar mos brtan ma'i yams nad zlog: dkar mo dbyings mos dbang mo'i yams nad zlog: mthing nag chen mos re ti'i yams nad zlog:

dbang sdud dmar pos srin mo'i kha rlangs zlog: ser mo las mkhan yul lha'i yams nad zlog: srid pa chags byed khrag skyug dmar bshal zlog: srid pa cha snyoms 'brum bu dkar nag zlog: 'dod khams gtso mos snying gzer rgyug 'gyel zlog: ral gcig dkar mos me dbal sha khol zlog: rin chen srid 'bebs gnyan glang tar pa zlog: gling bzhi skyi phud nag po gsum sgril zlog: padma gar dbang lhog rgod sha 'dzing zlog: rdo rje gar dbang rims nad me lce zlog: har ting dkar mos stod 'dzin lce 'bam zlog: dun ting nag mos sbos 'gas glang thab zlog: shantiṃ nag mos tshad pa mgo gzer zlog: grubting nag mos hag skyug ḍa ru zlog: srin mo dkar mos bshal nad lhog yams zlog: srin mo sngon mos rgya mdzer nag po zlog: srin mo g.yang bzhis mdze dmar pags nad zlog: srin mo za bas rlung gi nad rnams zlog: srin mo gsod byed mkhris nad rnam lnga zlog: srin mo dmar ser 'dus pa'i nad rnams zlog: srin mo stob byed bad kan nad rnams zlog: dkar mo mche gtsigs chu yi nad rnams zlog: nag mo mche gtsigs zha grum nad rnams zlog: dmar mo zangs mchus gnyan gzer rigs bzhi zlog: ser mo rkang ldag bdun drug nag po zlog: siṃ ha ma yis tre tre nag po zlog: khā kha ma yis snying rlung mgo 'khor zlog: hu lu mu khas rtsa grum nad rnams zlog: pukka si yis smyo 'bog nag po zlog: rdo rje kun grags shar gyi nad bdag zlog: rdo rje drag bsnyen lho yi yams nad zlog: rdo rje g.yu sgron nub kyi nad bdag zlog: rdo rje gsal 'grogs byang gi nad bdag zlog: sring mo dkar mos mi yi nad rnams zlog: gshin rje'i sring mos nor gyi nad bdag zlog: klu yi sring mos rta yi nad rnams zlog: gnod sbyin sring mos ra lug nad rnams zlog: sngon mo 'bum gyis nad kha dar ba zlog:

dkar mo 'bum gyis yams kha g.yo ba zlog: smug nag 'bum gyis dus tshod chad pa zlog: dkar mo 'bum gyis sngon las nad rigs zlog: dregs pa'i bu mos 'phral rkyen nad rigs zlog: gling bzhi dbang chen 'gram 'khrug nad rims zlog: smug nag sa zhis bka' chad nad rigs zlog: rgya mtsho'i gling dbang 'khu ldog nad rnams zlog: srin mo bzhi yis lha srin dal kha zlog: ma mo bco brgyad snang srid cho 'phrul zlog: nad bdag rims bdag pho mo zlog: khram kha rkyen ngan glo bur zlog: lo zla zhag gi skag rigs zlog: dus tshod g.yo 'gul chad pa zlog: mi mthun bar chad than ltas zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs la: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'bul: bzlog bsgyur phrin las dus la bab: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: nad dal yams kha zug pa zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: nad kha yams kha dar ba dang : 'byung bzhi 'khrug cing glo bur bka' chad kyi nad sogs 'byung na 'di la gang mang 'bad par bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs sems can don slad du: bzlog pa drag sngags spu gri bzhag: yams nad 'joms pa'i gnyen po ru: yang bzlog zab mo 'di ga zab: rin chen gsang ba'i gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas/ lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o// // 'a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bla ma rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i bzlog pa bdud bzhi g.yul 'joms bzhugs so: bla ma thod phreng sku la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: bzlog pa bdud bzhi g.yul 'joms bstan:

ma 'ongs rjes 'jug skal ldan la: dkyil 'khor bsgrub cing spel pa'i tshe: las ngan bdud kyis bar chod sdang : de phyir bar chad zlog pa'i thabs: snying byang zab mo thugs kyi rgya: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor ma liṅga sha dum bcas bshams shing : hūm̐: lho nub zla gam pad nyi ro yi gdan: bla ma drag po rdo rje thod phreng rtsal: dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: yum mchog gsang ba ye shes sku la 'khril: bskal pa'i me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : mchod rten bde byed brtsegs pa'i drung : rig 'dzin 'dus pa rgya mtsho yis: bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i tshe: dam sri spun dgu'i bar chad brtsams: rig 'dzin 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams kyis: las mtha' bsgrub pa'i cha lag bcom: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor gdab: ru tra bsgral ba'i sa gzhi bcags: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum bzhengs: gtum drag pho nya rtsang phur btsugs: dam sri bsgral ba'i zor thun bsgril: mthu stobs dpal gyi thod rnga brdungs: bzlog bsad dregs pa'i 'khor lo bskor: ma gza' shan pa pho nyar rbad: rtsal chen dmod pa'i zor 'phang tshe: dam sri spun dgu dam la btags: phyin chad nam yang mi sdang byas: sgrub pa'i rkyen ngan bar chad zhi: sngon tshe bzlog byung khungs yang bzang : bar du rten 'brel gnad kyang zab: tha ma bzlog pa'i tshig kyang tshang : de bzhin de ring rnal 'byor gyis: sgrub pa'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sku mdog dmar smug rngam par ston pa yis: bla ma sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: zhal gdangs ljag 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrug pa yis: yi dam sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis:

ting 'dzin sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: khro bo sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: dam can sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa yis: chos skyong sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: yum mchog gsang ba ye shes 'khril ba yis: dkyil 'khor sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: nor lha sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu brgyan pa yis: gter bdag sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis: gter srung sgrub la bar du gcod pa zlog: me ri smug nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: sgrub la bar du gcod pa'i dam sri zlog: hūm̐: lhun gyis grub pa'i rig 'dzin chen po yis: zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: phyag rgya chen po'i rig 'dzin chen po yis: rgyas pa'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin chen po yis: dbang gi dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: rnam par smin pa'i rig 'dzin chen po yis: drag po'i dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: slob dpon chen po mañdzu shrī yis: dkyil 'khor sgrub pa'i thang lhod bar chad zlog: slob dpon chen po nā gardzu na yis: gzhi len mtshon gyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: slob dpon chen po hūm̐ chen ka ra yis: mtshams gcod sgo yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: slob dpon chen po bi ma mi tra yis: mchod rdzas bkram pa'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: slob dpon chen po pra bha hastī yis: gzhung bsrang sngags kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: slob dpon chen po dha na saṃ skṛ yis: gzhan snang dbang sdud bar chad bzlog tu gsol: slob dpon chen po rombu gu hya yis: dbang bzhi'i dngos grub bar chad bzlog tu gsol:

slob dpon chen po shāntiṃ garbha yis: las mtha' rgyas 'debs bar chad bzlog tu gsol: dgongs brgyud ye shes slob dpon chen po yis: dgongs brgyud klong dgu'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: brda brgyud ye shes slob dpon chen po yis: shog ser gter gyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: snyan brgyud ye shes slob dpon chen po yis: bshad sgrub spel ba'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: dam tshig dbang gi slob dpon chen po yis: chos bdag tshe yi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: man ngag lung gi slob dpon chen po yis: 'gro don gdul bya'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: shes rab rgyud kyi slob dpon chen po yis: chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: nyams chag bskang ba'i slob dpon chen po yis: rtsa rlung nyams pa'i bar chad bzlog tu gsol: me long rdo rje ṛgs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: sgrub pa'i shar phyogs bar chad bzlog tu gsol: mnyam nyid rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: sgrub pa'i lho phyogs bar chad bzlog tu gsol: sor rtog padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: sgrub pa'i nub phyogs bar chad bzlog tu gsol: bya grub las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: sgrub pa'i byang phyogs bar chad bzlog tu gsol: sgo ma las kyi pho nya rigs bzhi yis: sgrub pa'i mtshams kyi bar chad bzlog tu gsol: buddha stong nyid mkha' 'gro rnam gnyis kyis: sgrub pa'i steng 'og bar chad bzlog tu gsol: ma gza' shan pa rdor legs btsan rgod kyis: sgrub pa'i bar chad dgra sri bzlog tu gsol: phyi yi mi kha gleng gzhi zlog: nang gi mchod rdzas bcud nyams zlog: gsang ba'i nyon mongs dug lnga zlog: dam sri 'byung pos glags lta zlog: gser 'brong g.yu 'brong bar chad zlog: srin mo sman mos gnod pa zlog: rgyal 'gong bse rag dam sri zlog: bgegs rigs lan chags 'byung po zlog: sgrub pa'i bar chad rkyen ngan zlog:

nyams pa dgra bo'i steng du zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: rdo rje slob dpon lha tshogs kyis: sha khrag gtor ma bdud rtsi bzhes: rnal 'byor sgrub pa'i skal ldan la: bar chad rkyen ngan gang byung zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol/ sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma gar dbang gis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: bzlog pa bdud bzhi'i g.yul 'joms bzhag: sgrub la bar chad 'byung srid na: bzlog pa yod chog zab mo rgya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bshus pa'o// // ya) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'jig rten khro bo'i bzlog pa dgra yul dpung 'joms bzhugs so: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa dgra yul dpung 'joms bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: dam sri 'dre rgaud 'byung po yis: chos rgyal gdung brgyud rnams la 'tshe: gtsug lag rnams kyang sprul pa sdud: bod khams mi rnams sbas yul smon: sa steng gtam ngan grags pas khyab: sdug bsngal bzod glags skad cig med: lha min gnas dang mnyam pa 'byung : de dus dgra bzlog gnyan po ru: sde dpon bzlog pa rlung mgyogs bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: liṅga gtor chung sha dum bcas bran cing 'di skad do: hūm̐: nub byang zla gam dregs pa pho mo'i steng : bcom ldan dpal chen dregs pa he ru kaḥ dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: yum mchog srid gsum spyi 'dul sku la 'khril: bskal pa'i me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : dregs pa 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgya gar rdo rje gdan drung du: mu stegs ru bzhi'i dmag dpung g.yos: chos 'khor bcom par shom pa'i tshe: rombu gu hya gdan drangs nas: dmag bzlog gdams pa zhus pa'i tshe: slob dpon rombu gu hya yis: phung shul dgu yi sa sna la: dur khrod pho brang nag po brtsegs: ru tra bsgral zhing gzugs bzhi bkod: dregs pa 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: phung thod nang du dpal gtor bzhag: rtsub shing dgu yi rtsang phur btsugs: dregs pa dmag 'gyed 'khor lo bskor: rig sngags thod rnga nag po brdungs: g.yul bzlog nag po'i zor chen bshams: sde dpon sum cu pho nya rbad: bzlog bsgyur dmod pa bor ba'i tshe: mu stegs he bzhi'i dmag dpung bcom: chos 'khor gtsug lag rab tu brtan: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag la: dgra yi dmag chen g.yo ba yi: dpung dang 'khor g.yog thams cad zlog: hūm̐: sku mdog khams nag rngam par ston pa yis: srid pa las kyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: pha rol dgra yi srung ma ban bon zlog: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis: pha rol dmag gi rgyab rten lha srung zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: pha rol dmag gi dpon po bsgral zhing zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: pha rol dgra yi dmag mi gtor zhing zlog:

dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa yis: pha rol dgra yi go cha mtshon cha zlog: yum mchog srid pa spyi 'dul 'khril ba yis: dgra yi yul khang sa brten bzlog tu gsol: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: dgra bo'i pha spun nang tshan bzlog tu gsol: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: dgra bo'i phyugs zhing sgo nor bzlog tu gsol: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis: dgra bo'i dpa' ba'i gzi brjid bzlog tu gsol: me dpung dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: dgra bo'i mthu stobs nus pa bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: ya ma rā dzas dgra bo'i pho lha zlog: e ka dzā ṭis dgra bo'i ma lha zlog: skos rje drang dkar dgra bo'i skyes lha zlog: bdud mo re tis dgra yi yul lha zlog: srin po glog phreng dgra yi skyed lha zlog: ha shaṃ sbal mgos dgra bo'i mgon lha zlog: gnod sbyin me dbal dgra yi srog lha zlog: mon mo sha zas dgra yi zhang lha zlog: lha yi sde dpon dgra bo'i mtshon cha zlog: u ma dhe was dgra bo'i go cha zlog: srid pa'i rgyal mos dgra yi g.yul ngo zlog: e ka dzā ṭis dgra bo'i 'og rta zlog: rdo rje khyung rgyal dgra bo'i bla srog zlog: tshangs pa dkar pos dgra dmag g.yas pa zlog: rdo rje legs pas dgra dmag g.yon pa zlog: gza' bdud mgo dgus dgra yi dmag gdong zlog: ma hā kā las dgra bo'i sna 'dren zlog: rdo rje bdud 'dul dgra yi dpung bskyed zlog: dmu bdud nag pos dgra bo'i g.yul chen zlog: kā la drag pos dgra yi bla rten zlog: gang ba bzang pos dgra yi bla shing zlog: thog 'debs smug pos dgra yi bla 'khor zlog: spyi bdud rgyal pos dgra yi dbang thang zlog: srog zan dmar pos dgra yi rlung rta zlog: gnam thel dkar pos dgra yi lus lha zlog: yam shud dmar pos dgra yi spar kha zlog: bgegs kyi rgyal pos dgra yi sme ba zlog:

nag mo dus mtshan dgra yi gza' skar zlog: klu bdud mgo dgus dgra yi lo shing zlog: sa bdag nag pos dgra yi bsod nams zlog: sgo ma kaṅkas shar gyi dgra dpung zlog: sgo ma srin byas lho yi dgra dpung zlog: sgo ma 'dre byas nub kyi dgra dpung zlog: sgo ma dur byas byang gi dgra dpung zlog: lha srin sde brgyad dgra yi dpung tshogs choms: dmag dpon dmag mi bzlog tu gsol: dgra bgegs dam nyams las ngan gyi: mthu dang nus pa nyams par gyis: stobs dang gzi brjid nyams par gyis: tshe dang bsod nams nyams par gyis: dpal dang dbang thang nyams par gyis: snga dgra rtsad nas chod cing zlog: phyi dgra cham la phob cing zlog: da dgra rten dang phrol zhing zlog: bzlog cig dgra bo byad ma zlog: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs rnams: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: pha rol byad ma gang zhig gis: dgra shom dmag 'dren ngan pa'i tshogs: gzhom zhing bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: dmag 'khrug dgra shom 'jigs pa snang gyur na: zlog byed 'di la gang mang 'bad pa gces: sa ma ya: kho bo drag sngags pad 'byung gis: bzlog pa dgra yul dpung 'joms bzhag: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: dmag 'khrug mtshon bskal dar ba'i tshe: bzlog pa reg gcod 'khor lo rgya: yi ger gzugs shing gter la sbos: bstan dgra sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas pad tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus grub bo// // ra) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmod pa drag sngags kyi bzlog pa ki kang 'khor lo bzhugs so: dmod pa drag sngags 'dus pa'i lha la bstod: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis:

bzlog pa ki kang 'khor lo bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: dam sri 'dre rgod yul la chags: pho mo kun gyi snying du zhugs: gri btsan sha mgo rlung ltar 'tshub: bar chad sna tshogs sdang ba'i tshe: sri bzlog zab mo tsaṇḍi rgya: sri gcod spu gri reg chod bzhag: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor ma liṅga sha dum bcas bshams shing : hūm̐: byang shar zla gam ru tra pho mo'i steng : dpal chen drag sngags dmod pa he ru kaḥ dbu dgu phyag ni rnam pa bco brgyad pa: yum mchog 'byung lnga'i bdag mo sku la 'khril: bskal pa'i me dpung klong yangs dbus na 'gying : dmod pa drag sngags dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog pa'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : za hor siṅga'i yul dag tu: chos rgyal dharma bho dhi'i gdung : sri chen langs shing skag chen zhugs: yul yang rkyen kha blo bur hrag: shāntiṃ garbha spyan drangs te: gdung rgyud srid kyi rten 'brel zhus: slob dpon shāntiṃ garbha yis: drag sngags dmod pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral zhing g.yang gzhi bkod: drag po'i gtor chen zur gsum bzhengs: gnam lcags khro chu'i snod du bzhag: dur khrod sa la brub khung bcos: rno ngar drag po'i rtsang gis brgyan: drag sngags 'dus pa'i zor chen bsgril: ngan sngags gdug pa'i thod rnga brdungs: bsad pa spu gri'i 'khor lo bskor: srog bdag sde tshogs pho nyar rbad: gzir 'bebs dmod pa bor ba'i tshe: sri chen skag rkyen byed pa zlog: yul gru'i glo bur bar chod bsal: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: skag dang sri chen bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: sku mdog dmar nag rngam par ston pa yis: snang srid yongs kyi skag chen 'bebs pa zlog: dbu skra dmar ser me ltar 'bar ba yis: steng phyogs lha yi skag chen 'bebs pa zlog:

zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan rtsa 'khrugs pa yis: bar snang lha 'dre'i skag chen 'bebs pa zlog: bco brgyad phyag na mtshon cha bsnams pa yis: pho rgyud yongs kyi skag chen 'bebs pa zlog: spu gri'i sgro gshog mkha' la bgrad pa yis: mo rgyud yongs kyi skag chen 'bebs pa zlog: dur khrod chas brgyad rab tu rdzogs pa yis: sde brgyad dmod pa'i skag rkyen dgra la zlog: yum mchog 'byung lnga'i bdag mos 'khril ba yis: phyogs skyong dmod pa'i skag chen dgra la zlog: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la chags pa yis: sde dpon dmod pa'i skag chen dgra la zlog: dur khrod chas kyis rab tu brgyan pa yis: yul lhas dmod pa'i skag rkyen dgra la zlog: yab yum zhabs ni brkyang bskum 'khril ba yis: pho nyas dmod pa'i skag rkyen dgra la zlog: me dpung dmar nag klong du bzhugs pa yis: lo zla zhag dus skag rnams bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: gshin rje tshe bdag pho sri bzlog tu gsol: gsod byed nag mos mo sri bzlog tu gsol: me yi kha rlangs che sri bzlog tu gsol: bdud mo nag mos chung sri bzlog tu gsol: srin mo gnod byed dar sri bzlog tu gsol: srin mo snying 'byin rgan sri bzlog tu gsol: gang ba bzang pos god sri bzlog tu gsol: gnod sbyin sha zas dbul sri bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐ chen dkar pos gri sri bzlog tu gsol: thar pa nag pos dur sri bzlog tu gsol: btsan rje nag pos rmangs sri bzlog tu gsol: yaksha nag pos btsan sri bzlog tu gsol: brda mdzes nag pos thab sri bzlog tu gsol: yam shud dmar pos nad sri bzlog tu gsol: rdo rje mdzes pas dgra sri bzlog tu gsol: khu le lag dgus phung sri bzlog tu gsol: gzhon nu gtum pos nad sri bzlog tu gsol: gnam sman rgyal mos lcong sri bzlog tu gsol: sa sman rgyal mos 'chi sri bzlog tu gsol:

chu sman rgyal mos gser sri bzlog tu gsol: me sman rgyal mos yul sri bzlog tu gsol: rkyen ngan skag dang bar chad bzlog tu gsol: lo zla dus kyi sri chen bzlog tu gsol: pha mes yongs kyi rkyen kha bzlog tu gsol: sgab 'dre rmangs 'dre 'dre mo bzlog tu gsol: gre bo the'u rang bse rag bzlog tu gsol: mi 'dod byur dang skag chen bzlog tu gsol: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs rnams: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: skag dang spar kha sdig pa dang : khyim du sri che zhugs shing na tsha rgod pa: chung sri zhugs pa: dbul sris zhing dang phyugs la gnod pa byung na: bzlog pa 'di la brtson par bya ba gal che'o: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa ki kang 'khor lo bzhag: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: mi la rkyen dang skag rigs sdang : sri dang bar chad rlung ltar 'tshub: de dus bzlog pa drag sngags bcol: skag sri bzlog par the tshom med: bar chad bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal padma rong gi cha nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas bod yig tu zhal bsgyur ba'o// // la) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bya khyung dgu'i bzlog pa me'i 'khor lo bzhugs so: dpal gyi sprul pa khyung chen bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa me yi 'khor lo bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor chung dang sha dum liṅga bcas bshams nas: hūm̐: mthing nag 'bar ba chos nyid e yi klong : srid pa dbyings kyi rdzu 'phrul pho brang nas:

sprul pa'i bya khyung dmag tshogs bye ba 'bum: dbyings nas skur bzhengs phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : ston pa byang chub rdo rje yis: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i tshe: klu bdud nag po bā su tas: bod khams yongs la mdze shu btang : ston pa chen po bcom ldan gyis: ye shes dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor bsgoms: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las kyis: bya khyung dpag yas pho nyar rbad: krang kring sgra chen sgrog pa'i tshe: klu bdud 'khor bcas bred cing 'gyel: kha rlangs nad kyis mi sdang byas: phyi nang chos kyi bar chad zlog: sngon tshe bzlog pa de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'gal rkyen mtshan ma ngan pa dang : klu dang sa bdag gnod pa zlog: hūm̐: buddha bya khyung steng phyogs gdon bgegs zlog: badzra bya khyung shar phyogs gdon tshogs zlog: ratna bya khyung lho phyogs gdon tshogs zlog: padma bya khyung nub phyogs gdon tshogs zlog: karma bya khyung byang phyogs gdon tshogs zlog: he ru bya khyung bar snang gdon tshogs zlog: kā la bya khyung 'og phyogs gdon tshogs zlog: bha ti bya khyung mtshams bzhi'i gdon tshogs zlog: dzñā na bya khyung phyogs bcu'i gdon tshogs zlog: hūm̐: sku mdog sna tshogs cir yang ston pa yis: lha srin sde brgyad gdon tshogs dgra la zlog: dbu skra dmar ser sprin ltar gtibs pa yis: mgon pos dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: thabs shes rwa gnyis gnam du gzengs pa yis: ye shes 'jig rten gdon tshogs dgra la zlog: rwa bar yid bzhin nor bus brgyan pa yis: dbul phongs bkres skom sdug bsngal dgra la zlog: spyan mig nyi zla tshwa tshwa khol ba yis: gza' brgyad dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zhal gdangs mche gtsigs pas: sde dpon dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: dug sbrul pho nya zhal du gsol ba yis:

mdze nad sna dgu sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: g.yas pa spu gri'i sgro gshog bco brgyad kyis: pho rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: g.yon pa chu gri'i sgro gshog bco brgyad kyis: mo rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: rlung gri'i sgro gshog me zer 'phro ba yis: sras rgyud dmod pa'i drag sngags dgra la zlog: dur khrod rus pa'i rgyan dang ldan pa yis: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro'i sun ma dgra la zlog: sdigs mdzub rtse gnyis nyi zlas brgyan pa yis: ma rig mun pa'i smag rum dgra la zlog: lte bar khro zhal dgra bgegs gsol ba yis: dam nyams bdud rigs log 'dren bzlog tu gsol: mjug sgro bcu po thog rgod 'gyu ba yis: sa bdag gdug pa'i dal kha dgra la zlog: sder mos gdol pa pho mo 'dzin pa yis: klu yi kha rlangs dug rigs dgra la zlog: bskal pa'i me dpung klong na bzhugs pa yis: klu chen brgyad kyi gdug rtsub dgra la zlog: ye 'drog sum brgya drug cu zlog: glo bur brgyad cu gya gcig zlog: dus min 'chi ba rnam brgyad zlog: rbad 'dre rbod gtong phur kha zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: khro rgyal khyung gi lha tshogs rnams: dgra sha khrag mchod 'di bzhes la: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams: klu yi gtad khram byung srid kyi: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: klu'i bar chad byad ltas dus su bzlog pa bya: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra drag sngags thod phreng gis: bzlog pa me yi 'khor lo bzhag: klu dang sa bdag gnyen por shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs te shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // sha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs kyi bzlog pa mtshon cha gzer 'debs bzhugs so: bka' skyong yongs rdzogs tshogs la bstod: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa mtshon cha gzer 'debs bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: gtor chung dang sha dum liṅga bcas bshams la: hūm̐: dur khrod me dpung 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: bam ro skam rlon brtsegs pa'i gdan steng du: gsang ba zil gnon chos skyong srung ma rnams: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : bod yul bsam yas bzhengs pa'i tshe: bod kyi lha 'dre gdug can gyis: gnam la char med than pas sdang : sa yi rtsi bcud rnams kyang bskams: rtsig pa nyin brtsegs mtshan mor bshig: rten 'brel mi rung sna tshogs byung : rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: slob dpon padma spyan yang drangs: lha 'dre dam btags zhus pa'i tshe: rig 'dzin padma 'byung gnas kyis: mchims phu dben pa'i sgrub gnas su: bka' brgyad gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral ba'i g.yang gzhi bkod: ting 'dzin mthu yi gtor chen bshams: mngon spyod drag po rtsang gis brgyan: bdud 'dul sngags kyi zor chen bsgril: klong yangs chos nyid thod rnga brdungs: ye shes drwa ba'i 'khor lo bskor: sgo skyong bka' gter las la bskul: bden gnyis snying rje'i zor btab pas: lha 'dre bsngangs shing srog snying phul:

bod khams bkra shis bde zhing legs: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gis: 'khu ldog rkyen ngan bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: khro bo ya mānta kri yis: shar gyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: khro bo pra dzñā ta kri yis: lho yi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: khro bo padma ta kri yis: nub kyi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: khro bo bighnān ta kri yis: byang gi g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: rta phag sprel spyang gdong can gyis: mtshams bzhi'i g.yo 'khrug bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: g.yag mgos lha yi 'khu ba zlog: sbrul mgos lha min 'khu ba zlog: gzig mgos gza' yi 'khu ba zlog: sprel mgos rgyu skar 'khu ba zlog: pha waṃ sa bdag 'khu ba zlog: dred mgos dmu yi 'khu ba zlog: dom mgos gshin rje'i 'khu ba zlog: chu srin shel ging 'khu ba zlog: sdig mgos shi 'dre'i 'khu ba zlog: khwa tas dri za'i 'khu ba zlog: stag mgos grul bum 'khu ba zlog: bya rgod me lha'i 'khu ba zlog: wa yis btsan gyi 'khu ba zlog: chu srin can gyi 'khu ba zlog: khu byug srin mo'i 'khu ba zlog: khra mgos klu yi 'khu ba zlog: pu shud ma mo'i 'khu ba zlog: shwa mgos gnod sbyin 'khu ba zlog: khwa tas dbang ldan 'khu ba bzlog: skya gas rlung lha'i 'khu ba zlog: srin byas dge bsnyen 'khu ba zlog: phag gdong bgegs kyi 'khu ba zlog: kaṅkas the'u rang 'khu ba zlog: pha waṃ sman mos 'khu ba zlog: bya rog yul lha'i 'khu ba zlog: khu byug dgra lha'i 'khu ba zlog: ra mgos phug lha'i 'khu ba zlog: sprel gdong skyes lha'i 'khu ba zlog: spyang gdong snang srid cho 'phrul zlog: hūm̐: rdo rje rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: phyi yi rten 'brel nyams pa zlog: rin chen rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: nang gi rten 'brel nyams pa zlog: padma rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: gsang ba'i rten 'brel nyams pa zlog:

las kyi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro mas: don gyi rten 'brel nyams pa zlog: khro bo badzra ging ka ras: las kyi rten 'brel nyams pa zlog: khro bo ratna ging ka ras: dbang thang rten 'bral nyams pa zlog: khro bo padma ging ka ras: ngag gi rten 'brel nyams pa zlog: khro bo karma ging ka ras: yid kyi rten 'brel nyams pa zlog: hūm̐: las kyi ma mo mched bdun gyis: mchod rten bzhengs pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: sring mo chen mo mched bzhi yis: gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: laṅka chen po bcu drug gis: mkhar rdzong brtsegs pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: zhing skyong chen po brgyad rnams kyis: yul bzung byed pa'i bar chad bzlog: hūm̐: dur khrod keng rus ma brgyad kyis: bag ma gtong len bar chad zlog: hūm̐: klu 'dul bya khyung mched brgyad kyis: so nam zhing pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: 'bar ma chen mo dgu rnams kyis: ro sreg dur 'debs nyes pa zlog: hūm̐: pho nya drug cu rtsa bzhi yis: mgron po lam zhugs bar chad zlog: hūm̐: sa bdag chen po so gnyis kyis: sa bcud nyams pa'i bar chad zlog: hūm̐: kong btsun de mos nam mkha'i tshad than zlog: dpal ldan ha ris bar snang char med zlog: gangs dkar sha med sa yi 'bru skam zlog: 'brog chen 'khor 'dus phyugs kyi dkar med zlog: gangs kyi yum chen thog ser g.yo ba zlog: kha rag khyung btsun lo yi btsa' than zlog: gser chen mkha' lding sad kyi sgar bu zlog: rma ri rab 'byams lo 'dre 'bu srin zlog: btsan la rol pas rlung dang g.yer shing zlog: mo btsun ug chos lo nad sna dgu zlog: g.yu yi dril bus yams nad dus 'khrug zlog: dpyid kyi rgyal mos dbyar dgun go log zlog: dbyar gyi rgyal mos 'bru bcud nyams pa zlog: ston gyi rgyal mos kha char go log zlog: dgun gyi rgyal mos sa g.yo ri nyil zlog: dus drug lha mos dus tshod mi snyoms zlog:

tshe ring mched lngas dus tshod nyams pa zlog: lo yi bar chad ngan pa zlog: nad yams dus skag ngan pa zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: chos skyong dam can srung ma rnams: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma bzhes: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi: nyes pa'i rkyen ngan dgra la zlog: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: lo nyes gzhi bdag gis 'khu ba: rten 'brel gang yang nyams pa byung na bzlog pa 'di bya'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas yul padma bkod kyi cha bal phu yar 'brog mtsho nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bsgyur ba'o/ /maṅga laṃ// // sa) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gter srung gi bzlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhugs so: dpal chen 'dus pa'i srung mar bstod: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: gsang sngags bstan la sdang zhing sdug: gter gyi chos la gshe zhing sgrog: gter min zog po lha bzhin mchod: rig 'dzin sprul sku khyi ltar smod: dam nyams dred pos kha chos ston: gsum ldan bla mas grong sgo nyul: lta log bdud sprul seng ltar 'gying : pad 'byung nga yang yi mug skye: de dus bdud sprul bzlog pa'i thabs: spu gri'i rlung 'khor 'di kho na: skal med bzlog pa'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gtor ma dang liṅga sha dum bcas bshams shing : hūm̐: khrag zhag rba klong mi rta bam chen steng : bya rog ming can bka' gter srung ma'i tshogs: dbyings nas skur bzhengs bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : bsam yas mchims phu'i sgrub gnas su: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas la:

bdud blon mang pos 'gran yang btsal: gsang sngags chos la smad pa bab: smras pa'i chos la tshad kyang btsugs: slob dpon drag po thod phreng gis: drag sngags 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gzhi bting : dmar nag drag po'i zor chen bsgril: shan pa 'tshogs pa'i rtsang gis brgyan: dmod pa bor chog zor thun bsgril: gnyer gtad gter bdag bka' la bskul: bstan srung shan pa pho nyar rbad: bdud 'dul ngan sngags dmod bor tshe: ma rungs bdud blon tshar yang bcad: phyin chad mi sdang tha tshig bsgrags: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag la: gzhan gyi bsam sbyor log pa dang : mi kha dmod tshig bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: bya rog mgon pos gling bzhi'i mi kha zlog: zhing skyong dpal 'bar lha srin mi kha zlog: e ka dzā ṭis sde brgyad mi kha zlog: gza' bdud mgo dgus snang srid mi kha zlog: rdo rje legs pas bsam ngan mi kha zlog: shan pa dmar pos sbyor rtsub mi kha zlog: btsan rgod 'bar bas phung thal mi kha zlog: klu rgyal stag ring yul lha'i mi kha zlog: smyon pa lag brgyad grong gi mi kha zlog: klu sman 'od ldan khyim gyi mi kha zlog: lha chen dkar pos pho rgyud mi kha zlog: gnod sbyin mi bdud mo rgyud mi kha zlog: sman btsun sha zas brgya yi mi kha zlog: klu bdud rakshas stong gi bram mchu zlog: gza' rgod mig dmar gter gyi bar chad zlog: klu btsan bla 'gugs gter chos smad pa zlog: gnyan rgod dug gdong sngags la sdang ba zlog: las mkhan spu gris gter ston smad pa zlog: srin mo gdong dmar gter gnas smad pa zlog: raksha thod phreng shog ser smad pa zlog: mon pa gcer bus the tshom bdud rigs zlog: yongs rdzogs pho nyas log lta'i bdud rigs zlog: bsam ngan 'chang ba'i skal chad zlog: bdud kyis snang ba bslu ba zlog: srin mos mi ru brdzu ba zlog:

zab gter gnyan la sdang ba zlog: dus tshod skar mtshan ngan pa zlog: snod ngan dred po dam log zlog: slob ma snying ngan kha 'jam zlog: gzungs ma dam med g.yer mo zlog: sbyin bdag gzhung ngan ngo log zlog: log sbyor 'chang ba'i bdud rigs zlog: bzlog go dmar nag gtor mas zlog: bsgyur ro ltas ngan dgra la sgyur: hūm̐: dam can chos skyong srung ma rnams: sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod: ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol: gzhan gyi mi kha sdang ba dang : chos la sgro gshe g.yeng na 'di zab bo: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa spu gri'i 'khor lo bzhag: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: dam nyams sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ha) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: ltas ngan brgyad cu'i bzlog byang srid pa'i 'khor lo bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: bzlog pa srid pa'i 'khor lo bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: lha srin 'khrug pa'i cho 'phrul las: ltas ngan brgyad cu rtsa gcig dang : mi srid srid pa'i ltas ngan 'byung : de dag bsgyur ba'i cho ga ni: las kyi rim pa zab rgya can: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: ltas ngan bzlog pa'i gnyen por shog: sa ma ya: de la dang po bca' gzhi'i lag len ni: shing ngam sa dag rdo la ni: ci ltar 'tshams pa'i gzhi bca' zhing : de dbus sa yis rnga mong ni: bong bu tsam zhig bca' bya ste: de la re ba'i ghandha bkal: chag che nyam nga'i rdzas kyis bkang : mi kha bsgyur ba'i byang bu bzhag: de steng bya khyung khro bo bca': khyung gi lto bar bzlog sngags bcug: shar du rgyal po bswe zhu can:

lho ru gri bo dmar nag gri khram can: nub tu 'dre mo bya mchu can: byang du god bdag re zhu can: de'i shar lhor mi dkar po mgo gsum: lho nub tu mi ser po mgo gsum: nub byang du mi nag po mgo gsum: byang shar du mi dmar po mgo gsum: de'i phyi rol du khram gri thogs pa'i mi nag bcu gsum: mgo gsum la sogs gri khram la: rgyal po la sogs rang rang chas: de'i phyi rol mar me bcu: de'i phyi rol ngar mi changs bu bcu: de'i phyi rol mi kha'i rdzas: de'i phyi rol nam mkha' brgya: de'i bar bar mda' 'phang brgya: de'i bar bar changs bu brgya: de'i mtshams srung bzhi bzhag: de sogs lag len zhib tu byas: de nas chu gtsang gis bran la: sa ma ya: om̐ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ lan gsum gyis sbyang : hūm̐: mdun du gling bzhir bkod pa yi: lcags ri mu khyud bcas pa'i dbus: snod kyi rnga mong gwa pa'i steng : snang srid bya khyung khro bos zhon: shar phyogs rgyal 'gong bswe zhu can: lho phyogs gri bos bsha' gri thogs: nub phyogs 'dre mo bya mchu ma: byang phyogs god bdag re zhu can: mtshams bzhi dkar ser dmar ljang gi: mi reng mgo bo gsum pa re: phyi rol khram thogs bdud bcu pa: ltas ngan brgyad cu 'khor dang bcas: dran rdzogs wal gyis gsal bar gyur: ces gsal gdab cing lan gsum du 'gugs gzhug bya: ltas ngan sogs dmigs gsal byung na de gang byung ba de 'gugs kyang chog: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: nga ni snang srid yongs kyi bdag: lha srin sde brgyad zil gyis gnon: hūm̐: nyon cig snang srid cho 'phrul gyis: srid pa chags pa'i gdon tshogs nyon: mar me ngar gzugs changs bu dang : ting lo yas stags sna tshogs bsngo: 'dod yon khyod nyid tshims nas kyang : bzlog pa'i phrin las dus la bab: rkyen ngan dgra la bsgyur du gsol: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung :

lha yi dbang po brgya byin la: bdud bzhi 'khrug pa'i brda than byung : lus kyi 'od nyams 'chi ltas phog: slob dpon snang ba 'od can gyis: gling bzhi'i than bzlog dkyil 'khor bcas: 'dod yon sna lnga'i yas stags bsngos: bzlog bsgyur phrin las bcol ba'i tshe: tshangs pa brgya byin snyun las grol: cho 'phrul ltas ngan thams cad zlog: sngon byung bzlog pa de bzhin du: de ring bzlog bsgyur phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: than byung dang po steng nas byung : 'dab chags rwa can ltas ngan byung : de yi ltas ngan khyung gis zlog: ltas ngan gnyis pa bar nas byung : dug sbrul gshog pa can gyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyung gis zlog: ltas ngan gsum pa 'og nas byung : sa yi byi nag sder mo can: de yi ltas ngan khyung gis zlog: ltas ngan tshangs pa srid pa'i khyung : mgo yi rwa la dud 'gro'i than: de yi brda than khyod kyis zlog: ngo stod gdong pa mi yi than: de yi ltas ngan khyung gis zlog: bya yi mchu can 'dab chags than: de yi brda than khyod kyis zlog: bzlog go bya khyung khyod kyis zlog: hūm̐: ltas ngan rnga mong khyod las byung : mgo bo lug yin gnod sbyin than: de yi brda than khyod kyis zlog: mgul pa bya yin dbang phyug than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: sgal pa'i sha lhag sde brgyad than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rmig bzhi'i glo ba sa bdag than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mjug gu bong bu ma mos than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ltas ngan rgyal po'i lus la byung : mgo bo'i bswe zhu the'u rang than: de yi brda than khyod kyis zlog: lus gzugs btsun pa 'gong po'i than: de yi brda than khyod kyis zlog: snying ngan kha 'jam lha min than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: zhi zhing 'dra ba bdud bzhi'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bsha' gri 'dzin pa shan pa'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog:

khram shing khur ba gshin rje'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ltas ngan 'dre mo khyod la tshang : bya yi mgo can bdud kyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: re ba'i thul pa nad bdag than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: brang gi sha lhag ma mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lte ba dmyal zangs rigs drug than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bslu brid mkhas pa ngan song than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: brdzu ba mkhas pa mkha' 'gro'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ltas ngan god bdag khyod la tshang : re ba gyon pa bdud kyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gos log rul ba ma mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lag pa dmar ba sha za'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mi nag khram thogs gshin rje'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo bo gsum pa rigs bzhi'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gling bzhi'i srid pa'i ltas ngan zlog: hūm̐: gzhan yang bzlog cing bsgyur ba ni: bya nag sder 'dzing ye 'drog than: bzlog gau mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: gnam gyi sprin dmar sde brgyad than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: rlung dmar 'tshub pa ma mo'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: shwa pho ru 'dzing btsan gyi than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: chu gnas 'thab pa klu bdud than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: wa mo brgyal ba 'dre mo'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: 'ug pa dgod pa srin mo'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: tho rangs mdzo ngur gnod sbyin than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: srod la bya grags yul 'dre'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: nam phyed rta mtsher btsan gyi than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: khyi nag ngu zug gshin rje'i than:

bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: dur khrod spyang ngur dur sri'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: gcan gzan 'thab pa gri bo'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: sa g.yo 'byung ba dus 'khrug than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: khol chen nyin dag 'pho 'khyug than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: lo nyes byung ba sa bdag than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: god kha sdang ba 'byung po'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: ri dwags khyim zhugs srin mo'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: bya than 'bebs pa 'chi bdag than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: rlung nag khyim g.yo nam gru'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: gzugs med lag pa pho nya'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: gzugs med 'dre 'bod ma yams than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: thog ser g.yo ba gza' 'khrug than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: dngul dkar 'bar ba dus 'khrug than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: shing 'gyil skam pa na tsha'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: khang khyim 'khyags pa rgyal 'gong than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: nyi ma'i 'od nyams lha min than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: khyim nang 'od 'khyil ma mo'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: chag grum sdang ba 'gong po'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: gtor lhag mang ba sgab 'dre'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: char chu mi snyoms 'byung po'i than: bzlog go mdos glud khyod kyis zlog: bzlog go mdos dang gtor mas zlog: bzlog go ltas ngan brgyad cu zlog: bsgyur ro dal kha dgra la sgyur: bzlog bsgyur phrin las 'grub par mdzod:

ces phrin las bcol zhing bzlog pa bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // a) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: 'dre mo bong zhon gyi bzlog pa rmi lam bsgyur chog bzhugs so: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: rmi lam bsgyur chog zab mo bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: gang yang 'tshams pa'i snod dag tu: bong bu gwa pa nag po'i steng : 'dre mo nag mo'i gzugs bya zhing : zhing lpags g.yang gzhi g.yas ral gri: g.yon pas nad rkyal smad re sde: sked la khram shing lus ni sdug: re ba nag po'i snod phyi sha: de la bud med nag mo dgu: mi dmar gri khram shing thogs dgu: phyi rol changs bu dgu dang brgyad: shing ris mda' 'phang rgyang bu dang : nam mkha' la sogs brgyad brgyad bskor: chu gtsang bran zhing lan gsum du: rmi ltas ngan pa gang byung bkug: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog khro bo'i rgyal: nga ni bdud 'dul 'jigs pa'i sku: snod kyi snang srid lha 'dres nyon: 'dod yon yas stags sna tshogs 'bul: dga' mgu spro ba'i sems ldan na: rmi ltas mtshan ngan bzlog par mdzod: hūm̐: sngon tshe bzlog pa gang nas byung : rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan des: rmi lam ngan zhing 'byung bzhi 'khrugs: slob dpon padma spyan drangs nas: bong zhon rmi lam bsgyur chog bcas: snang srid mkha' la bsgyur ba'i tshe: khri srong lde'u btsan 'byung 'khrugs sangs: sngon tshe bzlog byung de bzhin du: de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag gi: rmi ltas mtshan ma ngan pa zlog: mun pa nag po'i sku lus kyis: lha 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: gdug pa'i khro gnyer ldan pa yis: gza' 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol ba yis: klu 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: g.yas pas ral gri 'dzin pa yis:

sde 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: g.yon pas nad rkyal bsnams pa yis: yul 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: sked la khram shing bcug pa yis: dmag 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: re sde nag po'i smad dkris kyis: 'byung 'khrug rmi lam ngan pa zlog: bong nag gwa pa zhon pa yis: 'chi ltas rmi lam ngan pa zlog: bud med dgu yis bskor ba yis: pho rgyud 'khrug pa'i rmi ltas zlog: mi dmar dgu yis bskor ba yis: mo rgyud 'khrug pa'i rmi ltas zlog: dmag 'khrug rmis pa yul 'khrug than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ri nyil rmis pa yul byad ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: thog ser rmis pa mthu byed ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: char drag rmis pa mya ngan ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: nyi ma dgu shar gza' yi ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gos nag gyon rmis nad kyi ltas: de yi ltas ngan ngan khyod kyis zlog: sha khrag rmis pa nad yams ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: 'bru nag rmis pa mgo nad ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: la bab thur log sgal ba'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bud med dad rmis 'dre mo'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bande rmis pa rgyal po'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: btsun gzugs mang rmis dam sri'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: byis pa mang rmis 'gong po'-i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: sprang po mang rmis bse rag ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rngon pa mang rmis pho nya'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gcan gzan mang rmis lha yi ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: khyi nag kha 'thab gshin rje'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: spre'u mang rmis rgyal 'khyams ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: na chung rgyan med gson 'dre'i ltas:

de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rang la mtshon bsnun byad kha'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rang nyid pham rmis nyams pa'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: g.yang la lhung rmis ngan 'gro'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: chu yis bying rmis 'khor ba'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mdzo nag mang rmis bdud kyi ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gcer bu ngu rmis gshin po'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lho phyogs 'gro rmis gshin rje'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo la me shor na ba'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: so bud skra byi nad slong ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: chas phung gtor brlag shor god ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: yul don mthar 'gro 'chi ba'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: 'bu srin mang rmis nyams grib ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: sbra nag mang rmis nyams grib ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: khang nag mang rmis myang ngan ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: me 'bar mang rmis bon byad ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: dur khrod mang rmis dri za'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mtshon cha mang rmis ban byad ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: snod stong mang rmis kha 'gong ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gshin po mang rmis sems chags ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rdo rbab mang rmis lha min ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ro langs mang rmis 'byung po'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: long ba mang rmis sdug bsngal ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lkug pa mang rmis ngag mnan ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rang ro rang khur 'byung 'khrug ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: dur 'debs rmis pa dur sri'i ltas:

de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: nyi nub rmis pa 'chi ba'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mdzo pho mang rmis klu bdud ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bud med gcer mo brtan ma'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: btson bzung lcags bcug mthu yi ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ske bcad mig brus btsan gyi ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: hrul po gyon rmis dbul po'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: dgra la nor shor pho lha'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: khang zhig khang rul 'chi 'pho'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lo skam brlag bcom rlung 'khrug ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: zas rigs gtor brlag 'gong po'i ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rang dma' gzhan mtho zil gnon ltas: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ltas thams cad kun: bzlog cing bsgyur ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces rmi lam ngan pa sa ya 'bum sde yod kyang ngan pa gang byung de bzlog pa'i dmigs pa bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /maṅga laṃ// // ki) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: wa la sprel zhon gyi bzlog pa ltas ngan than bzlog bzhugs so: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: than bzlog ngan pa bsgyur chog bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: bca' gzhi lag len rim pa ni: ci ltar 'tshams pa'i snod dag tu: wa mo dmar mo mgo brgyad la: spre'u ser po mgo gsum bskyon: g.yas gsum gri mda' nam mkha' la: g.yon gsum khram gzhu rgyang bu'o: phyi rol lo skor bcu gnyis la: de yang mgo gsum re re la: lag na gri khram dag gis brgyan: phyi rol ngar mi changs bu brgyad: mda' 'phang nam rgyang brgyad brgyad bkod:

mi kha'i yas stags sna tshogs brgyan: chu gtsang bran zhing lan gsum 'gugs: hūm̐ hūm̐: nyon cig lan chags than gzugs nyon: dkon mchog bden pa'i tshig la nyon: chos nyid rgyu 'bras don la ltos: lan chags glud gtor bzang po dang : 'dod yon sna tshogs khyod la bsngo: chag che nyam nga brda than sgyur: dgra yi yul la skyes chos tshul: hūm̐: dang po bzlog byung gang nas byung : bsam yas has po'i rtsa ba ru: sde rigs gsum la than sna phog: rkyen ngan rnam pa sna tshogs byung : slob dpon padma spyan drangs nas: than bzlog yul gru zhus pa'i tshe: spre'u wa zhon bzlog pa brtsams: than bsgyur yul gru bkra shis grub: sngon byung bzlog pa de bzhin no: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis: than ltas ngan pa 'byung ba zlog: hūm̐: spre'u ser po mgo gsum gyis: lha yi cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: g.yas gsum gri mda' nam mkha' yis: snang srid cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: g.yon gsum gri gzhu rgyang bu yis: 'og phyogs cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: wa mo dmar mo mgo brgyad kyis: ma mo gson 'dre'i cho 'phrul zlog: lo skor bcu gnyis 'khor g.yog gis: lo zla zhag dus than rigs zlog: mda' 'phang nam rgyang sna tshogs kyis: za ma chu tshod than rigs zlog: mi la mgo gsum ru tra'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: sha lhag rigs can las ngan than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: yan lag ma tshang ma mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: dbang po ma tshang gshin rje'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: don snod ma tshang lha min than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: dud 'gro mgo gsum bdud kyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo bo bzhi pa ma mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo bo gnyis pa dri za'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bya yi mchu can 'dre mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog:

yas 'gem mas 'gem 'gong po'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo bo med pa pho lha'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: phrag pa ral ba gri bo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rgyab tu lag 'byar shi 'dre'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: tsitta med pa 'byung po'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: glo ba med pa btsan gyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mchin pa med pa dmu yi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mkhal ma med pa sha za'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rgyu ma med pa 'byung po'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lag pa med pa 'byung po'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rkang pa med pa srin mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bu ga med pa rab chad than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rgyu ma bshal ba btsan 'gong than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rgyab tu rkang 'byar sman mo'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: yan lag med pa sa bdag than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: yan lag gsum pa re ti'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo mjug log pa bka' chad than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mjug ma med pa me lha'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gcan gzan gzugs can rgyal po'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: zo lag brang brdung dur sri'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mi yi gzugs can rgyal po'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: lto sbyor nag po gshin rje'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: sgal pa sbyor ba phung sri'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: chu yi gtsug gtor dmu btsan than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: sha ma sgal 'bur dam sri'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ro 'dzing dpung dkar 'chi bdag than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog:

ltag par kha 'byar ro la than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mgo med mche can dmus long than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gcan gzan mchu can mgul lha'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: dmag gru nag po gza' yi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: chu gnas gzugs can klu yi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: 'dab chag gzugs can rlung lha'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: ri dwags gzugs can sde brgyad than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: gnyis la mgo gcig byad kha'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: rta nag gnyis sbrel btsan gyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: mdzo nag gnyis sbrel bdud kyi than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bya nag gnyis sbrel sha za'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: chad lhag dag ni log pa'i than: de yi ltas ngan khyod kyis zlog: bzlog go ltas ngan dgra la zlog: bsgyur ro nam yang ma ldang zhig: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas glud gsum kha phyir bsgyur la 'di skad do: hūm̐: nga ni bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i sku: nga ni khrag 'thung mthu stobs dbang : nga ni srid gsum rngam klong sku: rnga mong khyung bzhon sde tshogs dang : 'dre mo bong bzhon sde tshogs dang : wa la sprel bzhon sde tshogs nyon: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: 'bru sna dkor chas rdzongs su 'debs: tsha ram sgog tsong rdzongs su 'debs: chag grug grum pa rdzongs su 'debs: glud dang changs bu rdzongs su 'debs: khyod kyi lam ston dgra la chos: dgra bo'i mi la rabs chad thongs: dgra bo'i nor zas dbul por thongs: dgra bo'i yul zad stong par thongs: khyod kyi za kha de ru ston: deng nas 'di ru ma 'tshe zhig: gal te 'di ru 'tshe byed na: khro rgyal 'bar ba'i mtshon char g.yo: drag sngags rdo rje'i ser ba 'bebs: ngan sngags spu gri'i so la bskyon:
