thar med dmyal ba'i btson du bcug: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du 'joms: de bas rang rang gnas su dengs: om̐ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ ghrihna ghrihna hūm̐ ghrihna pa ya ghrihna pa ya hūm̐: ā na ya ho bha ga wān badzra bhi dho ra ṇa ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ he ka ya byad ma kho rang la rang gshed rang la phob cig: om̐ du pra ma byad ma kho rang la rang bdud rang la phob cig: om̐ badzra hu lu ra baṃ byad ma kho rang la rdegs shig: om̐ badzra dza ṭa raṃ byad ma kho rang la rbad cig: bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: ces zlog sngags rnams bzlas shing zor sna ru rdzong : dgra bo'i yul du chas par bsam: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos sbas yul nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bod yig tu bsgyur ba'o// // khi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: bsrung bzlog gur gyi drwa mig bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: rang srung pha rol rgol 'joms kyi: drwa mig me yi 'khor lo bstan: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzungs kyis zungs: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: srung 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa ni: dbyer med skad cig dran rdzogs su: ma bcos lhun grub 'di ltar bsgom: hūm̐ bhyoḥ badzra ram̐ tsakra hūm̐: hūm̐: stong pa'i ngang las skad cig dran rdzogs su: dpal chen che mchog smug nag 'jigs byed sku: nyi shu rtsa gcig zhal gdangs mche ba gtsigs: g.yas g.yon bzhi bcus rdo rje bhandha 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan sgro gshog dbyings la brgyangs: bco brgyad zhabs 'dor lha srin sde brgyad brdzis: yum mchog gnam zhal dbu dgu pang du 'khyud: yab yum me ri dmar nag klong du gsal: om̐ shṝ he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭḥ rang nyid che mchog tu gsal ba'i thugs kar hūm̐ mthing nag 'bar ba: gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur: de yi mthar sngags phreng me yi spu gri ltar g.yas su 'khor bas: lus phyi nang gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad bsregs: 'od zer zhal nas thon te yum gyi lam la brgyud: gsang ba'i gnas nas yar drangs te mgal me 'khor ba lta bur gyur: thugs kar hūm̐ gi nā da'i nang du kun bzang : zla tshes la longs sku rdor sems: mgo sked la nṛ yig ljang khu: ha khog la bsrung bya pho mo: g.yas g.yon rgyab tu zhing kha: mdun du nor rdzas: zhabs kyu'i nang du srung ba'i khro bo dang bcas pa tshud de: me yi phung po gcig tu gyur: om̐ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa rī badzra kī li kī la ya: ma hā yaksha karma raṃ raṃ dzwa la raṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badzra rakṣa: slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas steng thams cad rdo rje'i gur khang : 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi: bar thams cad rdo rje'i rwa ba drwa mig rnams la me yi bya khyung : dpag tu med pas gtams te bskal pa'i rlung yang mi bgrod pa'i rang bzhin du gyur: nang gi khro bo dkar po stong gi zhal bdag la gyu zhing :

srung ba'i sngags sgra di ri ri sgrog par bsgom: om̐ ā li kā li dzñā na pañtsa: kro ti shwa ri ā yurdzñā na ma ma rakṣa bhrūm̐: bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la srungs shig badzra rakṣa: de'i phyi rol du me yi tsakra dmar po rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yas su 'khor ba'i gur: de'i phyi rol zlog byed khro bo nag po stong zhal phyir gyu zhing pha rol byad ma bzlog pa'i sngags sgra di ri ri sgrog par gyur: om̐ badzra kro ta kā la pa ha tsan hūm̐ phaṭḥ bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bo byad ma 'byung po 'dre rgod byad zor phur kha ngan pa thams cad dgra bo kho rang la zlog cig: a mu ka bhandha sha ma zlog zlog: ru tra ma tha ma tha zlog zlog: bhū ta sarba tshindha tshindha zlog zlog: trig thum dgra la zlog zlog: gzer thum dgra la zlog zlog: de'i phyi rol du dug gi rlangs pa smyo byed rdzas kyi gur du gyur nas: pha rol byad ma rnams tshar bcad par gyur: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: ram̐ ram̐ ram̐: de nas bzlog bsad bya ba ni: hūm̐: ram̐ ram̐ ya hoḥ mdun du stobs ldan khro bo nag po'i 'og tu: gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa: rno ngar gyi rang bzhin g.yas su 'khor ba: 'og spu gri dmar po zangs las grub pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa g.yon du 'khor ba: rtsibs bsnol ba'i bar thams cad: dgra bgegs byad ma mngon sum gsal bar gyur: steng 'og gnyis g.yas g.yon drag tu 'khor bas: dgra bo byad ma'i sha khrag dmar nyil nyil du gtub pa: de'i phyi rol me ri dmar nag 'tshub mas thul gyis bsreg cing gzhom pa gcig tu gyur: om̐ badzra ma tri ma tri thun bhyoḥ dgra bo byad ma nṛ tri dza dzaḥ ru tra mā ra ya ka waka tsi gtub gtub: dgra bo'i lus la rbad rbad: ngag la ching ching : yid la rmug rmug: dbang po myog myog: sha la rbad rbad: rtsa la rbad rbad: rus pa la rbad rbad:

srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa 'gas 'gas: ya ma bhyo bhyoḥ bzlog bzlog: dgra bo byad ma mi nor lha srung dang bcas pa bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: dgra bo byad ma'i rang mthu rang la zlog cig: rang srog rang gis chod cig: rang nus rang la zug cig: dgra bo byad ma'i lha srung kho rang la phob cig: gshed du phob cig: bdud du phob cig: om̐ lokt+ri pā la nan: nā ga pa sha nan: bhandha sha ya rbad: te lo sha ya rbad: ni lo sha ya rbad: shaṇṭa shaṃ mo rbad: raksha ma ti rbad: dgra bo byad ma'i zor kha thams cad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: ces lag rdeb dang bcas nas bzlog pa bya: gzhan yang byad ltas gang byung yang dmod la bzlog pa bya: phur thogs stong gis brab kyang mthu mi 'byung ngo : de phyir sngags dang bskyed rim gtso bor bya: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: o rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos lcags byi lor sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing gsang sngags chos gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ sarba maṅga laṃ// // gi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gzu dpang gser skyems snang srid sgo 'byed bzhugs so: gsang ba 'dus pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: gser skyems gling bzhi'i sgo 'byed phyir: snang srid kun gyi sgo dbye bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: snod gtsang yid du 'ong ba'i nang du rin po che'i brdar phye 'bras chang rgun chang sogs kyi gtams: sgo dbye'i 'cham dang bcas nas: dkar gtor 'don mchan/ hūm̐: mi mngon dag pa phyogs bcu rab 'byams nas: bzhugs pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs skur bzhengs shig: rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi dpung grogs mdzod: hūm̐: shar phyogs rgyal po yul 'khor srung : dri za 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs drag po'i zor lam phyes:

mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar skums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar chum: bar pa rnams kyi sku bzur la: gtor ma'i zor lam ma gcod cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs rgyal po 'phags skyes po: gshin rje 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs drag po'i zor lam phyes: mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar skums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar chum: bar pa rnams kyi sku bzur cig: gtor ma'-i zor lam ma gcod cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs rgyal po spyan mi bzang : klu dbang 'bum gyi 'khor dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs drag po'i zor lam phyes: mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar skums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar chum: bar pa rnams kyi sku bzur cig: gtor ma'i zor lam ma gcod cig: hūm̐: byang phyogs rgyal po rnam thos sras: gnod sbyin 'bum gyi tshogs dang bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs drag po'i zor lam phyes: mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar skums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar chum: bar pa rnams kyi sku bzur cig: gtor ma'i zor lam ma gcod cig: hūm̐: mtshams bzhi dag la gnas pa yi: me lha srin mo rlung lha dbang : sprul pa yang sprul bye ba 'bum: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: mtshams bzhi drag po'i zor lam phyes: mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar skums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar chum: bar pa rnams kyi sku bzur cig: gtor ma'i zor lam ma gcod cig: hūm̐: steng 'og gnyis su gnas pa yi: lha dang sa bdag gzhi bdag bcas: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: steng 'og drag po'i zor lam phyes: mtho ba rnams kyi zhabs yar skums: dma' ba rnams kyi dbu mar chum: bar pa rnams kyi sku bzur cig: gtor ma'i zor lam ma gcod cig: hūm̐: lha klu gnod sbyin gza' brgyad dang : rgyun skar dbang phyug nyer brgyad de: gdong la gnas shing 'gyu ba yi: sgra gcan zin phung hal khyi sogs:

dus tshod mkha' la dbang ba rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: de ring drag po'i zor lam phyes: dbu chum zhabs skums phyogs su byol: dgra bgegs ma gtogs sku bzur cig: mthu ldan rnams kyis phrin las mdzod: ces gser skyems 'bul zhing g.yas g.yon du bzhugs par bsam: de nas nang gi sgo dbye ba ni: dang po shar phyogs su gser skyems btang zhing 'di skad do: hūm̐: shar phyogs sgo ma lcags kyu ma: rdo rjes mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: mthu rtsal sgo 'byed sha ra ra: nus stobs dmag dpung nyi li li: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phyes: dmag dpung drag po myur du skyed: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas lho phyogs su mchod cing : hūm̐: lho phyogs sgo ma zhags pa ma: rin chen mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: mthu rtsal sgo 'byed sha ra ra: nus stobs dmag dpung nyi li li: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs gser sgo ser po phyes: dmag dpung drag po myur du skyed: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas nub tu mchod cing : hūm̐: nub phyogs sgo ma lcags sgrog ma: padmas mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: mthu rtsal sgo 'byed sha ra ra: nus stobs dmag dpung nyi li li: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs zangs sgo dmar po phyes: dmag dpung drag po myur du skyed: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas byang du mchod cing : hūm̐: byang phyogs sgo ma dril bu ma: rgya gram mtshan pa'i lde mig bsnams: mthu rtsal sgo 'byed sha ra ra: nus stobs dmag dpung nyi li li: gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs lcags sgo nag po phyes: dmag dpung drag po myur du skyed: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: sgo ma rnams kyis sgo phyes la: 'phrang pa rnams kyis 'phrang sgrol cig: pho brang lha tshogs bzhengs su gsal:

mthu rtsal dmag gi dpung ni bskyed: gzi byin dpa' ba'i rdzu 'phrul stobs: myur du bzhengs bskul phrin las mdzod: ces sgo phye zhing gtor ma dpag shing : mdos rnams mdun dang g.yas g.yon du bzhag ste: dmag tshogs bskyod cing dgra bo'i yul du chas par bsam: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas zhal bshus so// // ngi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: srin mo za lam mgyogs pa'i shugs 'chang bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: bdag 'dra kho bo padma 'byung gnas ngas: srin mo za lam bzlog pa bstan: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: sha za ḍākkis sun kha sdang : de dag bzlog par zor lam phye: gdams pa yang zab sa ma ya: de nas srin mo za lam gyi bzlog pa lha grangs ltar dang : zor lam phye ba'i mo gzugs lo brgyad byis pa tsam las mi chung bar bya: rgyun du bzlog pa 'don zhing gso: sha khrag dang gtor ma liṅga bcas pa bsham: raktas bran zhing : hūm̐: bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo bhyo bhyoḥ srin mo za lam dpag tshad bdun cu 'das pa'i pha rol na: zangs ri dmar mo'i rngam thang kya ma kyu: zangs lam dmar mo'i gyu khug ldam ma ldem: khrag mtsho dmar po'i rgyu ma lang ma ling : sha za mang pos 'dur rgyug cham ma chems: mi min 'byung po'i sgra skad lhang ma lhong : srin bya mchu dmar gshog 'gyur 'ar ma 'ur: zangs mkhar dmar po rtse dgu zing nge ba: g.yang gzhi'i rgyal mtshan rlung gis lhab lhub bskyod: shin tu 'jigs pa'i pho brang de nyid du: las kyi ma mo dmar nag bzhugs pa'i yul: chos sku'i bdag nyid 'dod khams gtso mo'i gzugs: sku mdog dmar nag char sprin gtibs pa 'dra: phyag g.yas zangs gri g.yon pas nad rkyal bsnams: sku stod dur khrod mi lpags g.yang gzhi gsol:

sku smad re sde nag po'i sham thabs dkris: lte bar nyi shar gtsug nas sgro gdugs brgyan: 'khor du las kyi ma mo brgyad kyis bskor: bzlog bsgyur bcol phyir gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol: dur khrod thod mkhar 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs: sha khrag dgra ling dbang po'i 'dod yon bzhes: bzlog bsgyur phrin las gnyan po'i dus la bab: hūm̐: don dam chos nyid gzugs sku srin mo'i tshul: sa lam rdzogs kyang las kyi ma mor brdzu: sku mdog dmar nag zangs kyi mgo bo can: dgra la dmag 'dren rang la bzlog mi shes: stobs kyis stong khams snang srid bran du bskol: srid pa'i rgyal mo dmar nag re ma ti: dgra la dmag 'dren g.yul ngo bzlog pa'i tshe: dmag gi rgyal mo nag mo srid rgyal ma: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: ma rungs gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: srid pa'i rgyal mo dkar mo dung skyong mas: shar phyogs mdos zor drag po 'phen pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna drongs shar phyogs dgra bgegs sgrol: lha yi rgyal mo dkar gsal re ma ti: zor gyi sna 'dren dkar mo srid rgyal mas: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: shar phyogs sun ma dgra la bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: srid pa'i rgyal mo ma mo glog ma sprin: lho phyogs mdos zor drag po 'phen pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna drongs lho phyogs dgra bgegs sgrol: srin mo'i sras mo ma mo dril nag ma: zor gyi sna 'dren dmar nag srid rgyal mas: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: lho phyogs mdos zor dmag gi sna drongs shig: lho phyogs sun ma dgra la bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: srid pa'i rgyal mo nag mo khri sde mas: nub phyogs mdos zor drag po 'phen pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna drongs nub phyogs dgra bgegs sgrol: bdud kyi sras mo nag mo dril dmar ma: zor gyi sna 'dren dmar mo srid rgyal mas:

khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: nub phyogs mdos zor dmag gi sna drongs shig: nub phyogs sun ma dgra la bzlog tu gsol: hūm̐: srid pa'i rgyal mo sngon mo nor 'dzin mas: byang phyogs mdos zor drag po 'phen pa'i tshe: zor gyi sna drongs byang phyogs dgra bgegs sgrol: klu yi sras mo sngon mo 'brug zhon ma: zor gyi sna 'dren ma mo srid rgyal mas: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: byang phyogs mdos zor dmag gi sna drongs shig: hūm̐: mtshams bzhi ma mo khrag ral srid pa'i rgyal: mtshams bzhi mdos zor drag po 'phen pa'i tshe: bzlog pa'i sna drongs mtshams bzhi'i dgra bgegs sgrol: srin po'i ma gcig me yi gdong pa can: zor gyi sna drongs mtshams bzhi'i dgra bgegs sgrol: srin po'i ma gcig mi yi gdong pa can: zor gyi sna 'dren srin mo khrag mdog bzhis: khrag mchod bdud rtsi 'bar ba 'di bzhes la: mtshams bzhi mdos zor dmag gi sna drongs shig: mtshams bzhi'i sun ma sdang ba'i dgra la zlog: hūm̐: rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po dri za'i skag rnams sgyur: rin chen mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po gshin rje'i skag rnams sgyur: padma mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po klu yi skag rnams sgyur: las kyi mkha' 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po gnod sbyin skag rnams sgyur: rdo rje shugs 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po me lha'i skag rnams sgyur: rin chen shugs 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po srin po'i skag rnams sgyur: padma shugs 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po rlung lha'i skag rnams sgyur: las kyi shugs 'gro'i sun ma zlog: ming po bgegs kyi skag rnams zlog: hūm̐: las kyi mkha' 'gro bye ba 'bum: zas su sha dang khrag la dgyes: las su gsod dang gcod la brtson: gos su mi lpags rlon pa gyon: gcer mo skra dmar thur du 'phyangs:

ba spu'i bu ga re re nas: khrag gi char pa si li li: bhyo bhyo ma mo dgra la chos: bhyo bhyo ma mo bgegs la chos: zor sna dgra bo'i steng du drongs: zor dpung las kyi ma mos skyed: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dgra bo'i bdun rgyud rtsad nas chod: mā ra ya yi las mdzod cig: bhyo ma mo rakmo thun bhyo ya: rakmo a bya thun bhyo ya: ru lu ta bya thun bhyo ya: dzā ṭi ma thun thun bhyo bhyoḥ bhyo thun rbad do ya khying dgra la bhyoḥ ma dun bhyo ya tri bhyo bhyoḥ dgra la rbad rbad: thun shag du breng le ha ta ya dgra la zlog:

ces gtor ma dpag tshad bdun cu'am: gom pa bdun cur bskyal la 'phang : dgra bo'i yul du chas shing ma mo'i nad kyis myos par bsam: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng ngas: las kyi ma mo rbad pa'i thabs: za lam srin mo'i bzlog pa bzhag: dgra bo sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: bdag 'dra padma gter bdag gling pas sbas yul padma'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing*/ gsang sngags chos 'khor gling du shog ser nas dag par zhal bshus so/ /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ci) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: glud rabs lha mi'i snang rgyan bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: hri3rgya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: glud rabs lha mi'i yid 'phrog bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: gang rung 'tshams pa'i snod mchog tu: sku glud rgyan can bzhag byas nas: mar me bcu dang ting lo bcu: 'brang rgyas bcu dang gtor chung bcu: changs bu brgya las mi nyung bar: yas stags sna tshogs dag gis bskor: gos lag dri ma can yang bskon: om̐ ā hūm̐: gsum dang : ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ gis bag chags sbyang : rang nyid rigs 'dus lhar gsal nas: hoḥ rang nyid che mchog yi dam du gsal ba'i mdun: bhrūm̐ las dbang chen sa bzhi gru chad ldan pa de'i dbus su: yi ge kṣa sngo nag yongs su gyur pa bgegs kyi rgyal po bī na ya ka sku mdog kham nag g.yas changs bu dang g.yon dkar me 'dzin pa: de la bgegs chen bcu dang lan chags pho gdon mo gdon gyi tshogs kyis bskor bar gyur: om̐ ṭākki rā dza hūm̐ phaṭ: bhū ta rā dza aṅku sha dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum gyis bkug cing bstim: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog kun 'dus sku: nga ni dus gsum gsang ba'i mdzod: nga ni snang srid yongs kyi gtso: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: hūm̐: nyon cig bgegs rigs lan chags mgron: skye ba tshe rabs snga phyi nas: sha 'khon bu lon 'khor ba'i rigs:

de ring sbyang phyir yas stags 'bul: sku yi glud du 'brang rgyas bsngo: gsung gis glud du ting los bsngo: thugs kyi glud du dkar mes bsngo: yon tan glud du changs bus bsngo: phrin las glud du yas stags bsngo: tsha ram sgog tsong la phug 'di: de ring bgegs rigs khyod la bsngo: rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la: gnod 'tshe sdang bar ma ston cig: hūm̐: dang po glud byung gang nas byung : lha yi dbang po brgya byin la: 'byung bzhi nyams pa'i nad kyis thebs: lha bu snang ba 'od ldan gyis: rin chen ngar gyi mi pho bcos: sku glud rgyan ldan yas stags bsngos: lha dbang brgya byin snyun las grol: de nas ngar glud gang nas byung : btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan la: 'byung 'khrugs snyun gyis zin pa'i tshe: slob dpon padma 'byung gnas kyis: sku glud rin chen rgyan can bcos: yas stags sna tshogs bsngos pa'i tshe: khri srong lde'u btsan snyun las grol: de nas ngar glud gang nas byung : de ring sgyu sbyor sbyin bdag gi: tshe rabs snga phyi'i lan chags rnams: sbyang phyir sku glud rgyan can bsngo: hūm̐: bgegs kyi tshogs rnams tshur nyon dang : mi bas glud bzang ya mtshan ldan: mthing gi skra lo nyi li li: 'jam 'bol mdzes ldan shigs se shig: mu tig bsil ma'i klad pa 'dir: dbu ma thar lam sha ra ra: gzi yi spyan mig 'od ldan 'di: lta stangs 'dzum mdangs ya la la: dung gi tshems phreng dkar po 'di: bzhad gad skar tshogs spungs se spung : byi ru'i ljags dmar leb chen 'di: smra brjod glu dbyangs sha ra ra: gser dngul thabs shes rna ba 'di: sgra snyan grags stong lhangs se lhang : lag gnyis mu men ma na hoḥ phyag rgya pad kor kyi li li: don snying zho sha rnam lnga 'di: tshogs brgyad ma 'gags sangs se sang : gsang ba baiḍūr grub pa 'di: bde stong dga' bzhi lams se lam: rkang pa bden gnyis zangs lcags 'di: zhabs bro gar sgyur khrigs se khrig:

na bza' dar tshon sna lnga 'di: rlung gis bskyod cing pu ru ru: spyi bo'i nam mkha' sna tshogs 'dis: 'ja' gur yid 'phrog spungs se spung : sku rten 'brang rgyas ri ltar nyil: gsung rten ting lo 'bras ltar spungs: thugs rten sgron me nyi ltar gsal: yon tan changs bus khyon yangs khengs: phrin las yas stags phun sum tshogs: de phyir sku glud rgyan dang ldan: sbyin bdag 'di yi glud du bsngo: hūm̐: shar phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: sprin gyi shugs 'chang 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: shar phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: lho phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: rlung gi myur can 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: lho phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: nub phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: me yi zin phung 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: nub phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: byang phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: glog gi myur 'gros 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: byang phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: shar lho'i bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: lo yi pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: shar lho'i dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: lho nub bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: zla ba'i pho nya 'khor dang bcas:

bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: lho nub dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: nub byang bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: zhag gi pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: nub byang dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: byang shar bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: dus kyi pho nya 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: byang shar dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: dbus phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: bī na ya ka 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: dbus phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: steng phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: 'brug gi mgo can 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: steng phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: 'og phyogs bgegs kyi rgyal po ni: dur phag mgo can 'khor dang bcas: bran du bgegs chen bcu yis bskor: yang 'khor bgegs rigs bye ba 'bum: sku glud rgyan can 'di longs la: deng phyin gnod pa ma byed cig: 'og phyogs dgra la za kha ston: hūm̐: phyi nang bgegs rigs lan chags rnams: bsngos pa bzhin du tshim gyur cig: re ba bzhin du skong gyur cig: bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub gyur cig: khyod kyi lan chags byang byas nas: da ni khyod la lam bstan no: chas la myur du 'gro bar gyis: de nas kha phyir bstan nas rdzong 'debs byas shing : hūm̐:

shar phyogs lha yi yul du bsngo: dri za'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: lho phyogs gshin rje'i yul du bsngo: grul bum gnod pa khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: nub phyogs ma mo'i yul du bsngo: klu dbang skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: byang phyogs bdud kyi yul du bsngo: gnod sbyin skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: shar lho'i shel ging yul du bsngo: me lha'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: lho nub btsan gyi yul du bsngo: srin mo'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: nub byang gnod sbyin yul du bsngo: rlung lha'i skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: byang shar klu bdud yul du bsngo: dbang ldan skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: steng phyogs tshangs pa'i yul du bsngo: lha min skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: 'og phyogs sa bdag yul du bsngo: dmu yi skag rkyen khyod kyis zlog: mi kha yas stags rdzongs su 'debs: nam yang sdang bar ma gyur cig: hūm̐: da ni khyod la lam bstan pa: snang srid lha 'dre'i phyag tu 'bul: dge bshes glud du chas pa'i tshe: 'dren ston chos bshad sgar chen 'dra: pho glud rgyan can chas pa'i tshe: dpa' bo rgyan gyis phyug pa 'dra: mo glud rgyan can chas pa'i tshe:

mo btsun bag mar brdzangs pa 'dra: rgas pa'i glud du chas pa'i tshe: sde dpon yul la phyogs pa 'dra: byis pa'i glud du chas pa'i tshe: lha phrug rtse ra mthud pa 'dra: de bas glud bzang ya mtshan ldan: bsngo'o 'bul lo tshim gyur cig: tshims shing rang rang gnas su dengs: de nas thun gyis brab cing : hūm̐: nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ nga ni khrag 'thung khro bo'i rgyal: nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed: so so rang rang gnas su dengs: ci ste mi 'gro 'tshe byed na: rdo rje'i me yi char chen 'bebs: mtshon cha dum bu skar ltar 'khrug: lus ngag rdul phran bzhin du brlag: de bas ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: om̐ badzra he ru ka kro ta hūm̐ phaṭḥ gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya u tsa ta ya phaṭḥ om̐ sumbha ni sumbha ni hūm̐ sogs hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags brjod cing thun gyis brab: dmigs med chos nyid stong gsal 'phrul gyi gdeng dang mi 'bral bar bsngo: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas sbas yul nas gdan drangs shing : shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ /yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul lo// // chi) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gzu dpang dang zor mda' dug gi spu gri dgra bo'i snying gzer bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha yi tshogs la bstod: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: zor lam dug gi spu gri bstan: ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga brgya la: 'dre rgod mu stegs mtha' bzhi 'khor: sngags pa nang rgyal mthu rtsal rtsod: dam nyams bdud kyis bstan la sdang : de dus gdab chog dge chod bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i mtshon char shog: gser skyems sbreng zhing bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams bdag gi dpung grogs su chas par bsams shing : hūm̐: chos dbyings lhun grub ka dag klong yangs nas: kun bzang zhi khro'i dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: mi mngon dag pa rdzu 'phrul dbyings nas bzhengs:

rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag gi rgyab rten mdzod: hūm̐: lha srin sde brgyad gzhi bdag gnyan po dang : phyogs skyong zhing skyong bka' sdod pho nya rnams: dam la gnas pa'i dregs can ma lus kun: gser skyems phud dang dkar gtor 'di bzhes la: de ring rnal 'byor bdag gi rogs dan sgrubs: dam las ma 'da' sngon gyi dam tshig dgongs: dam bca' bzhin du bcol ba'i phrin las mdzod: ces gser skyems btang liṅga gang rung 'gugs la dang po gzu dpang mkhyen gsol bya ba ni: phyogs skyong bcu'i zor thogs nas: hūm̐: bla ma rig 'dzin dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: ma nyes dpung du bzhugs mdzod thugs dam can: zhi khro che mchog lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : padma gsung gi lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : phur pa phrin las lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : bka' srung dam can lha tshogs gzu dang dpang : ma nyes rig 'dzin bdag gi dpang po mdzod: ma nongs ye shes lha la mkhyen par gsol: nyes med rig 'dzin rnal 'byor sngags 'chang la: dam nyams dgra bo byad ma las ngan gyis: byas pa med kyang rin chen srog la rgol: chags pa med kyang bu lon rgyun du ded: rnal 'byor bdag la ye shes lha med zer: chos skyong dam can khyed la mthu med zer: yid la dmigs pa'i dgra bo byad ma 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: hūm̐: nga ni che mchog thod phreng rtsal: nga ni khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ nga ni khro bo kun gyi rje: nga ni ma mo kun gyi yab: nga ni dgra bgegs khyod kyi gshed: chos dbyings klong nas bzhengs pa'i tshe: stong nyid 'brug sgra 'u ru ru: bar snang dbyings nas bzhengs pa'i tshe:

stong gsum tshwa tshwa si li li: drag po'i phrin las bskul ba'i tshe: snod bcud bskal me wa la la: zor thun pho nya rbad pa'i tshe: shan pa srog len khyugs se khyug: hūm̐: bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor drag po 'di: de ring steng du mi 'phen na: gal te steng du 'phros srid na: tshangs pas bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: steng phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor gnyan po 'di: de ring shar du mi 'phen na: gal te shar du 'phros srid na: dri zas bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: shar phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring lho ru mi 'phen na: gal te lho ru 'phros srid na: gshin rjes bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: lho phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring nub tu mi 'phen na: gal te nub tu 'phros srid na: klu dbang bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: nub phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring byang du mi 'phen na: gal te byang du 'phros srid na: gnod sbyin bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: byang phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring shar lhor mi 'phen na: gal te shar lhor 'phros srid na: me lhas bdag gi grogs mdzod gcig: shar lho'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring lho nub mi 'phen na: gal te lho nub 'phros srid na: srin pos bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: lho nub dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring nub byang mi 'phen na: gal te nub byang 'phros srid na: rlung lhas bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: nub byang dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di:

de ring byang shar mi 'phen na: gal te byang shar 'phros srid na: dbang ldan bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: byang shar dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: hūm̐: bdag gis bsgrubs pa'i gtor zor 'di: de ring 'og tu mi 'phen na: gal te 'og tu 'phros srid na: sa bdag bdag gi grogs mdzod cig: 'og phyogs dgra bgegs rdul du rlog: de ring zor 'di dgra la 'phen: bgegs dpung phye ma dum bur shigs: myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod:

ces 'phangs shing dgra bo rdul du brlags par bsam: de nas bka' brgyad srung ma kun 'dus ltar zor 'phen pa ni: zor rdzas rim pa bzhin thogs te: hūm̐: nga ni khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ lce spyang ma mo pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor nyungs thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ ma mo kha thun nag po dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni yang dag he ru kaḥ dbang phyug nyer brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor dug thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ shwa ri nag mo kha thun nag po dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed: ging bdud shan pa pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor me thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ tsa ti ghṛ wa dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni dbang chen khro bo'i rgyal: srog bdag khams brgyad pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zur phur thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ rakmo du na ti ru dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku: shwa na sa bdag pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor khrag thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ shwa na bhu mi ṭi ru dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni ma mo rbod gtong sku: ma sring srin mo pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor mtshon cha bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ ma mo ra dun kha la dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni drag po me phreng can: shan pa dmar nag pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor mtshon thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ shu la tri ta ra dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

hūm̐: nga ni 'jig rten khro bo'i rgyal: dregs pa'i sde dpon pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor rdo thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ ma hā khying tra na dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni dmod pa drag sngags sku: btsan 'gong gnod sbyin pho nyar 'gyed: phyag na kong zor tshe thun bsnams: mtshon zor dgra bo'i snying du ya: om̐ tsa ti nā tha dgra bo'i srog rtsa chod chod rbad rbad bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: hūm̐: nga ni stobs 'dus he ru kaḥ las mkhan shan pa thabs shes tshul: gzhu ni srin mo khrag ral ma: mda' ni shan pa srog gi bdag: myur mgyogs las la rbad pa'i tshe: gza' rgod dbyings las 'gyu ba ltar: dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya: phaṭ ṭa ka la ma dun rbad du na bswo thun shang tsha kha la dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ces zor mda' brgyab cing gtub par byas: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas zhal bshus so/ shog ser gyi bu dpe las bshus so/ /maṅga laṃ// // ji) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dmod pa dgu'i bzlog zor bzhugs so: bka' brgyad gsang ba'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo: sa ma ya: dmod pa dgu yi bzlog zor ni: sngags pa phur pa thogs pa dgu: dge slong gseg shang thogs pa dgu: bon po phying rnga thogs pa dgu: skyes pa go mtshon thogs pa dgu: mo mtshun chung ngu ma mda' dar dang gser skyems thogs pa dgu: byis pa 'ur rdo thogs pa dgu: gcod pa rkang gling thogs pa dgu: shan pa spu gri thogs pa dgu: yugs sa thal zor thogs pa dgu: de rnams kyis zor bzlog dang sbrags nas thal mo brdab cing : thal ba dang sran ma thun du bshur: mtshon thogs rnams kyis bswo sgra ldir: gser skyems thogs pa dgu yis gser skyems mchod cing : hūm̐: lha klu gzhi bdag gnyan po dang :

gdong la gnas pa'i dregs can rnams: gser skyems gnyan po 'di bzhes la: mdos zhal dam nyams dgra la sgyur: gtor zor dgra bo'i steng du 'phen: sgo phyes 'phrang sgrol sdong grogs mdzod: de nas sngags pa phur thogs dgu'i sran ma bshur zhing : hūm̐: nga ni che mchog he ru kaḥ drag sngags dmod pa'i pho nya rbad: bzlog go chag chen nyams nga zlog: dgra dpung thal ba rdul du rlog: de nas dge slong dgu'i sher snying dang bcas nas: hūm̐: bstan gnyis gtso bo bcom ldan 'das: mu stegs log lta tshar gcod pa: bzlog go gdug pa'i g.yul ngo bzlog: than ltas chag chen bsgyur du gsol: de nas bon po dgu yis thun brdeg cing : bswo: bon nyid g.yung drung snang gshin bdag: byad kha bzlog phyir dbal chen rbad: bzlog go byad ltas dgra la zlog: rmi ltas mtshan ngan dgra la sgyur: de nas skyes pa go mtshon thogs pa dgus: hūm̐: pho rgyud 'dus pa'i drag sngags pa: dpa' rtsal skyes bu dgra la chos: bzlog go dmag dpung g.yul ngo zlog: skyes pa'i mtshon dal dgra la sgyur: de nas byis pa dgu'i 'ur rdo brgyang zhing : hūm̐: dpal gyi las mkhan byis pa'i gzugs: chung sri bzlog cing gnam rdo 'phen: yul 'dre 'gong po bzlog tu gsol: rkyen kha bar chod dgra la sgyur: de nas rkang gling thogs pa dgu'i rkang gling gtser zhing : phaṭḥ gdod nas dag pa chos dbyings klong : skye med mkha' 'gro'i dmag tshogs sgyur: snang srid cho 'phrul dgra la zlog: rkyen kha blo bur bsgyur du gsol: shan pa spun dgu'i gri rtser bskyon nas: hūm̐: rbad pa'i shan pa dpung dmar tshogs: dam nyams dgra bo'i srog snying phrol: bzlog go 'chi ltas dgra la zlog: de nas yugs sa dgu yis thal ba gtor zhing : bhyoḥ mya ngan rkyen kha dgra la sgyur: snang srid mo rgyud cho 'phrul zlog: ming rus skag rkyen dgra la phob: om̐ du tsa ya nye lo shag ma rā ya dgra la bhyo bhyo zlog zlog:

ces bzlog pa bya: snang srid cho 'phrul bshig pa'i phyir: bzlog pa cha dgu 'di dag zab: than mdos gnyis la bzlog par bya: rkyen ngan zhi bar the tshom med: zab khyad bzlog pa sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bsgyur: yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul zhes// // nyi) bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: dgongs gsol rngam yangs khyab brdal bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: dgongs gsol rngam yangs klong chen bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: sa ma ya: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: hoḥ dgongs su gsol lo: hoḥ gzigs su gsol lo: spros pa med pa'i dbyings: yangs pa chen po'i gnas: 'dod rgu sprul pa'i dur khrod chen po nas: sgrub chen gsang ba zil gnon lha tshogs dgongs su gsol: che mchog 'dus pa'i lha tshogs sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog 'dzin rig 'dzin yongs kyi dkyil 'khor: thugs rje mnga' ba'i gter mdzod: byin rlabs nus rtsal gyi sdong po: mthu stobs smon lam gyi shugs can: khro bo 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor khro mo 'dus pa'i gnas mchog: chos skyong 'dus pa'i sku mkhar: las mkhan tshogs pa'i dmag dpung : gzi byin me las ngar tsha ba: mthu stobs thog las shugs che ba: myur mgyogs glog las 'gyu rkyen pa: snang srid rlung las khyab che ba khyed rnams kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul nas: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig: spyir sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra: rnal 'byor bdag gi sgos dgra: mi min mi ru brdzu ba: lha min lha ru brdzu ba: mi nga la lha med zer ba: lha khyod la mthu med zer ba: ngos la bstod cing lkog nas smad pa: dgra ya dang gyod ya byed pa: 'dzing ya dang 'khon ya byed pa: 'thab ya dang rtsod ya byed pa:

dmag sna dang jag sna ston pa: rku sna dang bcom sna gtad pa: kha 'o ma bas 'jam zhing : snying tsher ma bas rtsub pa: bsam ngan log sbyor shom pa: dam nyams byad ma yul dang bcas pa: pha tshan dang bcas pa: sde tshan dang bcas pa: nang tshan dang bcas pa: de rnams myur du bsgral ba'i phrin las mdzod cig: skyes pa pho rgyud la bab na: shing skam la me btang ba lta bur thongs shig: za ma mo rgyud la bab na lo thog ser bas btab pa lta bur thongs shig: skyes pa dar ma la bab na rgya zam sked pa nas chag pa lta bur thongs shig: chung rgyud byis pa la bab na sa bon me la bsregs pa lta bur thongs shig: phyi yi phyugs nor la phog na sran phung dbyug pas gtor ba lta bur thongs shig: nang gi srid pa g.yang la phog na: thal skya rlung gis g.yos pa lta bur thongs shig: mkhar khang yul zhing la phog na thog rgod brag la brgyab pa lta bur thongs shig: dam nyams pa'i dgra bo 'di: gnam sa gling bzhi ri rab kyi zom: ban bon gyi skyabs 'og: nyi zla'i go bar sprin gyi them skas: sa 'og sa steng gang du gnas kyang : rang dbang med par khug la: ye shes kyi khro bo las byed kyi srung ma khyed rnams kyis: gnam sa tsam gyi zhal gdongs shig: glog dmar tsam gyi ljags rkyongs shig: gangs ri tsam gyi mche ba gtsigs shig: da lta nyid du bka' yi gtor ma 'di dang mnyam du bzhes shig: ces gtor chen rdzong zhing bzlog pa lan gsum bya: dar nag g.yab cing dmod pa bor: gtor ma chu'am mer bsreg: bzhengs bskul gtor ma zur du bya na gtor chen las byang nang gi bskul btang shing 'phangs kyang chog: de nas gtor snod rnams khyer gom pa dgu'i mtshams su log nas: sgab 'dre dam sri rnams lan gsum du bkug cing : sa rim pa dgu'i 'og tu las kyi gshin rje kha tham nag po chu srin gyi gzugs can kha yar gdangs pa'i khar gtod: nam yang mi ldang ba'i dmigs pa byas te: rta bro las gzhung ltar brdung ngo :

sa ma ya: de nas gtor gzhong kha yar slong la me tog 'thor zhing : hūm̐: gsang ba zil gnon dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i tshogs: kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin phung sna tshogs 'bul: rten 'brel zab mo'i sbyin bdag bkra shis shing : 'dzam gling phyogs bde yar zla ltar 'phel shog: om̐ sa ma ya ma hā siddhi pha la hoḥ de nas shul med tho zhig bslangs nas: thams cad zhal phyir gyu zhing : 'di ltar brjod: hūm̐: tho ni khyung nag drag po'i gnam lcags mchu: me gshog brgyangs shing sgab 'dre dam sri chod: 'byung po dam sri bya khyung khyod la bcol: nam yang phyi ru 'byung bar ma gyur cig: om̐ ā tri sha khrom trig sha gri khram nye lo ya dam sri bhandha bhandha rbad rbad: de nas phyi mig mi lta zhing gom pa bcu gsum log nas phye mar dang bkra shis pa'i 'bras kyang rol te: lha rgyal lo zhes brjod: gtang rag gtong zhing dngos grub len chog dang : tshe 'gugs sogs rgyas par bya'o: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan rjes 'jug phyir: zab pa'i mthar thug yang snying chos: bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon bzhag: bka' brgyad chos skor brgya rtsa sbas: yang zab 'di 'dra sbas pa med: 'di yi phan yon bsam mi khyab: sgrub pa'i mchog thun dngos grub myur: las mtha' bzlog pas bar chad zhi: gang la gang 'dul zab pa'i khyad: bzlog pa 'di la tshang bar nges: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: ban bon shi tshad gdug 'drer skyes: de phyir dam sri tsha ngar lhags: 'dre rgod 'byung po sa steng kheng : gtsug lag chos 'khor rnams kyang 'jig: de dus bka' brgyad ma gtogs pa'i: bzlog yan tsam gyis rkyen mi bzlog: de phyir sbas yul gangs can rong : sangs rgyas srog 'dzin gang bzhugs pas: bzlog pa 'di nyid shin tu gces: chos rgyal gdung brgyud thugs kyi sras: skal ldan skyes bu rnams la spel: 'di nyid 'don pa'i skyes bu ni:

bande sangs rgyas ye shes pa: gter ston bdun nas rim brgyud de: o rgyan gter bdag gling pa 'byung : de dus zab chos 'di 'phrad shog: legs ldan mgon po bya rog gdong : bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho rnams: chos 'di thugs kyi sras la sprod: skal ngan log rtog bdud kyi rigs: chos 'dir mi dad tha mal tshogs: gzugs kyi dbang po rnam shes snubs: sa ma ya: shes rab blo ldan las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: bdag 'dra o rgyan gter bdag gling pas rab byung bcu pa'i lcags byi lor sbas yul bal phu lung gi gnas mchog mtsho 'brog gnam zhal dbang phyug ma'i gnas: bka' brgyad 'dus pa'i pho brang gi mdun pha bong bya rog 'dra ba'i ske 'og nas rgya mtsho rba rlabs drag tu 'phyo ba'i klong nas khrom mang dang bcas nas gdan drangs tshe: klu bdud nā ga rakshas gter sgrom dngos su kun gyis mthong bar phul zhing : glang lo tshes bcu'i nyin nas dbu bzung ste shog ser nas zhal bsgyur bas shar ba'i tshes lnga la grub bo/ yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul zhes pas bgyis pa'o/ shog ser gyi tsha bo las bshus so// // ti) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zor chen thog mda' reg chod bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: zor mda' thog gi spu gri bstan: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: 'dre rgod 'byung po rlung ltar 'byung : bdud rigs bar chad sdang ba'i tshe: bzlog bsad tsa tri nag po yi: reg chod rlung gi spu gri bstan: sa ma ya: drag po'i lcags snod dam: thod ngan nang du ru tra'i snying gzugs zur brgyad pa gdan chos 'byung dang bcas shing : de'i nang du dmag 'gyed rbad pa'i 'khor lo bcug: drag po'i shing la rtsang phur brgya dang brgyad gzugs: de yang che chung tshad ni khru gang las ma chung bar bya: tha mar thun rdzas dgu yis bskor te:

nyin re bzhin byin gyis brlabs la bzhag: spu gri dang zor rdzas rnams bton rim bzhin byin gyis brlab dgos phyir ma traṃ gi sa gzhi'i khar zor chen la bskor te ba su tas dkris shing bzhag: rgyun du raktas bran: dang po zor chen byin gyis brlab pa ni: hūm̐: 'og min dag pa khyab brdal klong yangs nas: gsang ba yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: sgrol mtshon byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol: rakta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: zor rdzas mtshon gyi 'khor lor byin gyis rlobs: bka' yi srung ma pho nya dam can rnams: ru tra bsgral ba'i snying khar dur khrod dbus: stobs ldan dregs pa'i zor la bzhugs su gsol: dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i pho nyar mnga' gsol lo: rakta dmar gyi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: phyi ni mtshon cha nang ni pho nya'i dmag: gang la btab kyang bzlog med drag po'i zor: skam zor tshogs ni me lce ya la la: rlon zor tshogs ni nad yams chi li li: zor 'gyed pho nya mtshon thogs rongs se rong : spu gri rlung gshog myur mgyogs khyugs se khyug: gang la btab kyang thogs med gshin rje'i rdzas: dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i mtshon cha chen por gyur: om̐ thun dza raṃ dza nag po kha thun ya: ru tra ha la shig rbad mā ra ya thuṃ thuṃ:

zhes brgya phrag gis thun sngags: de nas gser skyems song nas gter srung sogs mtshon cha'i 'khor lo'i zor chen 'phen pa ni: rnga brdung dung bus rakta sbreng zhing drag tu rbad pa ni: zor chen lag tu thogs la 'di skad do: hūm̐: rgya gar dur khrod u tsa lar: gdug pa'i tsandan rkang gcig drung : nyin mo khrag gi char pa 'bebs: mtshan mo nad kyi na bun 'khrigs: dus drug rnam shes bu yug 'tshubs: dug gi ser rgod dmar nag 'dril: bam ro gsar rnying ri ltar nyil: 'byung po sha za rlung ltar 'tshubs: dur bya kaṅka sprin ltar gtibs: las kyi zhing skyong gad mo sgrogs: gdug pa'i thod mkhar dbyings dang mnyam: phyi na zhe sdang rlung dmar 'tshubs: nang ni zur gsum me ri 'bar: de dbus bam gyi gdan steng du: srog bdag mgon po bya rog gdong : bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can: ba spu'i bu ga re re nas: khrag gi zhag chu mtsho ltar 'khyil: 'khor du srog bdag 'bum gyis bskor: skad cig tsam gyis stong khams nyul: ma thogs myur du da tshur byon: bya rog gdong can dbyings nas bzhengs: gter srung shan pa pho nya 'bum: rdzu 'phrul myur mgyogs klong nas bzhengs: gri rkang gling bu'i gdangs kyis 'bod: sngon tshe slob dpon padma yis: bka' dang dam bca' ci bzhin du: de ring drag po'i zor dpung skyed: khrag mchod dmar po 'di bzhes la: zor sna chos skyong pho nyas drongs: bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: hūm̐: legs ldan nag po'i dus la bab: srog bdag nag po'i dus la bab: bya rog gdong can dus la bab: zhing skyong dpal 'bar dus la bab: gter srung pho nya'i dus la bab: dgra la zor sna da drongs shig: sgrol ba'i mtshon cha da thob cig: bzlog pa'i ru mtshon da g.yobs shig: rlung gi spu gri da skor cig: zor thun char pa da phob cig: rbad pa'i pho nya rtsal ma zhan: bhyo bhyo dgra bo'i steng du bhyoḥ

bya rog gdong can dgra la bhyoḥ zhing skyong stobs ldan dgra la bhyoḥ sngags bdag ma mo dgra la bhyoḥ gza' mchog dug gdong dgra la bhyoḥ 'bar ba rdor legs dgra la bhyoḥ mun pa stag ring dgra la bhyoḥ smyon pa lag brgyad dgra la bhyoḥ gsang ba 'od ldan dgra la bhyoḥ rgyal ba thod dkar dgra la bhyoḥ mi bdud seng mgo dgra la bhyoḥ sman btsun chen mo dgra la bhyoḥ nā ga raksha dgra la bhyoḥ dge bsnyen ging dmar dgra la bhyoḥ shan pa mig dmar dgra la bhyoḥ klu btsan bla 'gugs dgra la bhyoḥ gnyan rgod dug gdong dgra la bhyoḥ las mkhan rlung gshog dgra la bhyoḥ srin mo mgo gsum dgra la bhyoḥ raksha thod phreng dgra la bhyoḥ mon pa gcer bu dgra la bhyoḥ bya gcan sha za dgra la bhyoḥ sprul pa yang sprul dgra la bhyoḥ dgra srog dmar po chod la shog: sangs rgyas bstan la sdang ba'i dgra: sgos su bdag la 'tshe ba 'di: da lta nyid du sgrol la shog: pho rgyud rnams kyi sha la zo: mo rgyud rnams kyi khrag la 'thung : chung rgyud rigs rgyud snying nas drongs: dgra la thog gri sna tshogs phob: dgra la dri gri sna tshogs phob: dgra la bam gri sna tshogs phob: dgra la me gri sna tshogs phob: dgra la mu gri sna tshogs phob: dgra la dbyangs gri sna tshogs phob: dgra la lceb dri sna tshogs phob: lhog rgod mdze nad dgra la phob: gnyan rgod tre tre dgra la phob: dmu chu zha grum dgra la phob: khong lhog rgyug 'gyel dgra la phob: sbos 'gas glang thab dgra la phob: rims yams me lce dgra la phob: khrag skyug dmar bshal dgra la phob: 'go nad gzer thum dgra la phob: steng grib khas thams dgra la phob: rgya 'dzer 'brum nag dgra la phob: dgra bo'i yul zhing thog gis khongs: dgra bo'i mgo snying nang rol skyugs: rbad do pho nya mthu ma chung : da lta skad cig chu tshod 'dir: dgra bo'i don snying dkrugs la shog: gnam sa gling bzhir gar gnas kyang :

bla tshe rnam shes rten dang bcas: las kyi pho nya zor chen khyod: rbad cing dgra la 'gyu ba'i tshe: stong khams tshwa tshwa me yis khongs: zur brgyad dbal kha ston pa'i tshe: sde brgyad shan pa las la bskul: phyag rtsang mtshon cha 'debs pa'i tshe: shan pa 'bum gyis dgra yul khongs: dug thun sna dgu 'debs pa'i tshe: dgra bo'i yul rjes thal bar rlog: phung thod sna tshogs sbub pa'i tshe: dgra yul ri rab mgo mjug ldog: pho nya las la 'gyu ba'i tshe: lug dang gcan spyang 'phrad bzhin thongs: shan pas dgra dbugs bsdu ba'i tshe: dur byas sha la rol bzhin thongs: dus la bab bo da rbad do: bhyo bhyo dgra la da bhyo'oḥ myur du sgrol ba'i phrin las mdzod: bhyo bhyo ma hā kā la he ka thun bhyoḥ kā la khā kha mu kha dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: bhyo dun tsa kha la ya dun rbad chod bhyoḥ dun de ya dgra bo'i srog la rbad rbad: ma ru kī li he na dgra bo'i snying la bhyo bhyoḥ srog la rbad rbad: dbugs la sdud sdud: mā ra ya rbad rbad: shag tu tshal pa phye ma ye phaṭḥ ces zor 'phang ngo : gtor zor pho nya dang shan pa'i rang bzhin: dug mtshon dang nad rlangs khol ba de: nam mkha'i mthongs nas gnam lcags thog babs pa ltar: dgra bo brlag cing sa rim dgu pa'i 'og tu go ldog drag pos gshegs par bsam: gzhan yang dkyil 'khor dmag rnams zor chen 'phen pa'i tshe: dpung dang rogs dan bskyed cing zhal nas hūm̐ phaṭ kyis sgra sgrogs drag por bskul zhing phyag gis mtshon cha'i sgyogs chen dgra la phab par bsams te: gtor zor rnams rim pa bzhin du dmigs pa rang gal che: de yang zor 'phen thabs rnam pa mang du 'byung ste: sreg pa me thab tu 'phen pa: 'gugs pa pho nya ru 'phen pa: bzlog pa dmag thabs su 'phen pa: bsgral ba mtshon cha ru 'phen pa: gtor chen thun rdzas su 'phen pa: bsko ba dug rlangs su 'phen pa: chos nyid bde stong du bsgyur ba sogs gang la dmigs pa gzhung bzhin las:

pho nya ru 'phen na: rang nyid yi dam dus kyi sgom pa'i tshul gyis 'phang : mtshon cha ru bskyed na: lha gang yin gyi phyag mtshan du mos: gzhan rnams yang de bzhin la: stong nyid 'phen na: bdag gzhan bral ba'i bsgral ba dug lnga rang bsgral nas: 'dren pa chos dbyings klong du bstim pa'o: sa ma ya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: gtad rgya: gter bdag gling pas sbas tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bsgyur ba yi ge pa ni chos nyid bdud 'dul rtsal// // thi) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: zhun mar smon lam bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: dkyil 'khor bya ba rdzogs nas ni: smon lam dga' ston rim pa ston: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: dkyil 'khor bya ba mthar phyin nas: dga' ston tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : dkyil 'khor mdun du dkar me brgya: gtams shing mched lcam 'dus byas te: rdo rje slob dpon gzungs ma dang : dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi dam tshig nyams: phyi nang sgrib pa bshags pa dang : nam yang gcig tu tshogs pa'i phyir: bshags pa smon lam bdi ltar brjod: thams cad pus btsugs thal sbyar nas: om̐ āḥhūm̐: om̐: kong bu rin po che snod chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par gyur: āḥmar khu 'dod yon lnga'i rang bzhin rgya mtsho'i klong dang mnyam par gyur: hūm̐: sdong bu ye shes lnga'i me nyi zla chos nyid kyi rang bzhin ltar gsal bar gyur: hrīḥ de las mchod pa'i ā lo ke dpag tu med pa 'phros pas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du rdo rje slob dpon gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor la 'bul bar bgyi: om̐ dharma dzñā na ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: de nas mgrin gcig tu: e ma hoḥ chos rnams rang bzhin skye med rnam dag kyang : ma rig dbang gis bdag 'dzin so sor phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi:

thugs dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: longs sku ye shes 'gags med 'char ba la: ngar 'dzin dbang gis sna tshogs rtag chad 'dzin: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gi: gsung dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: sna tshogs sprul sku rang byung rtsol bral ba: yid spyod blo yis 'khor 'das ris su phyes: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs dag gis: sku dang 'gal ba mthol bshags bzod par gsol: dkyil 'khor gcig tu dam tshig bka' nod pa'i: rdo rje mched dang lcam dral grogs rnams la: log lta rkyen gyur ma dag ci mchis pa: deng nas bzung ste mthol bshags bzod par gsol: phyi nang rtsa ba yan lag dam tshig gi: sdom pa nyams dang 'gal bar gyu pa dang : mchod rdzas ma tshang 'byor rdzas chung ba sogs: bag med ci mchis mthol bshags bzod par gsol: om̐ badzra sa twa hūm̐: e ma hoḥ bla med gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor la: bdag lus longs spyod dge rtsa'i phyi nang bcud: rang byung gsal ba'i sgron me sbar te 'bul: kun gzhi rnam dag skye med kong bu ru: ka dag khregs chod gshis kyi mar khus bkang : lta ba zang thal 'od gsal sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: sna tshogs rang shar ma 'gags kong bu ru: ye shes lnga ldan dran rig mar khus bkang : sna tshogs 'dzin med rang byung sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: rtsa khams rnam dag 'khor lo'i kong bu ru: byang sems bde chen rgyas pa'i mar khus bkang : rlung sems tsitta gsal ba'i sgron me 'di: rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor gzungs la 'bul: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon gnyan gyis dbu bzung nas: rang byung ye shes sgron me sbar ba'i tshe: ma rig mun pa'i stong khams gsal ba na: dmyal ba'i zangs kha'i nang du mi gtong zhing : nyon mongs las kyi dbang du mi gtong zhing : smon lam rten 'brel zhun me 'di sbar bas:

bdag 'dzin gcong rong zab mor mi gtong zhing : rigs drug 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mi myong shog: bsod nams tshogs chen zhun me 'di sbar bas: dkyil 'khor gnyan gyi mchod pa mi nyams shing : zad med nam mkha' mdzod la spyod par shog: hoḥ rdo rje slob dpon dkyil 'khor rigs kyi bdag: shes rab gnyan gyis 'brel ba'i gzungs ma rnams: tshe rabs mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i ting 'dzin gyis: sa gsum dkyil 'khor rten la 'tshogs par shog: rdo rje mched dang lcam dral dam tshig can: skye ba 'di dang tshe rabs thams cad du: dkyil 'khor 'di bzung rnga yab dpal ri ru: pad 'byung rgyal ba'i sras su 'tshogs par shog: 'da' ka rdo rje dam tshig gnyan po yi: rgyud dang lung gis 'brel ba'i skal ldan rnams: sa bcu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog: yi dam bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs: tshe rabs rtag tu bdag gis yi dam lhar: 'dzin cing chos kyi sgra chen sgrog par shog: smon lam bzang po'i rten 'brel bslu med kyis: bden tshig skad cig deng 'dir 'grub par shog: ces bsngo ba smon lam bya zhing rdo rje slob dpon la phyag dang bskor ba bya: dga' ston gyi rten 'brel bzang po bsgrig: sa ma ya: e ma bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs rjes 'jug bu yi don: rjes kyi rten 'brel bya ba bzhag: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: rgya: gtad rgya: sarba maṅga laṃ// // di) ༈ wa la sprel zhon gyi bca' thabs zin bris bzhugs so/ ci ltar 'tshams pa'i snod dag tu/ wa mo dmar mo mgo brgyad la/ spre'u ser po mgo gsum yod pa bskyon/ lag g.yas gsum gri mda' nam mkha' bzung ba/ g.yon gsum khram gzhu rgyang bu bzung ba zhig go /phyi rol lo skor bcu gnyis la de yang mgo gsum re re'o/ lag na gri khram bzung ba/ phyi rol yas stags dang ngar mi dang changs bu brgyad dgos/

mi kha'i yas stags sna tshogs btab/ lcags ri khar mda' 'phang nam rgyang brgyas bskor mdos chings bya/ mtheb skyu 'bru sna dkar gsum sha dum gang mang shel tshig changs bu bcas bsham/ bong zhon bca' thabs ni/ snod gang rung nang du bong bu gwa pa nag po'i steng 'dre mo nag mo gzugs kyi stod la g.yang gzhi g.yas ral gri g.yon nad rkyal smad re sde sked la khram shing re ba nag po'i snod phyi sha byas pa gcig bca' dgos so/ de yi 'khor bud med nag mo dgu/ mi dmar gri dang khram shing thogs pa dgu/ phyi rol yas stags dang changs bu brgya dang brgyad dgos/ de'i phyi lcags ri khar nam mkha' rgyang bu mda' 'phang shing ris bcas re re la brgyad re 'dzugs/ mdos chings bya/ de nas rnga mong khyung zhon gi bca' thabs ni/ shing ngam gang rung steng*/ sa yi rnga mong bong bu tsam re ba'i gandha lha bkal chag che ba'i rdzas kyis bkang*/ mi kha bsgyur ba'i byang bu sogs bzhag /de steng bya khyung khro bo bca'/ khyung gi lto bar zlog sngags bcug 'khor shar du rgyal po bswe zhu can lho gri bo dmar nag gri khram can/ nub tu 'dre mo bya mchu can/ byang du god bdag re zhu can/ bar mtshams shar lho mi dkar po mgo gsum/ lho nub mi ser po mgo gsum/ nub byang mi dmar po mgo gsum/ byang shar mi nag po mgo gsum/ de yi phyi rol mi nag bcu gsum mgo gsum re yod pa de skabs dang bstun kyang rung*/ thams cad gri khram thogs pa yod/ de yi phyi rol ngar mi ting lo bcu yas stags 'brang rgyas bcu/ gtor chung bcu phyi rol mar me bcu bar mtshams bzhir srung bzhi shar rgya stag lho g.yu 'brug nub bya dmar mo byang du rus sbal rgya bo/ changs bu brgyad mi kha'i rdzas chen bco brgyad 'debs dgos mthar lcags ri khar nam mkha' brgya/ mda' bkra brgya/ 'phang bkra brgya/ rgyang bu brgya dgos/ bsdu na brgyad re 'dzugs kyang rung la/

༈ 'di gsum la gtsog glud 'bul mi rung*/ rdzong 'debs gtsang ma sna tshogs la gang mang bsags dgos/ blo rten gsal cha gzhung nas shes mchan / ༈ khyung gi lto 'khor/ khyung gshog rnams dpe bris ltar 'dzugs/ ༈ rnga mong gi yan lag rnams la tsakli dpe ri'u bris dmod dgu'i tsakli so sor 'dzugs dgos// // ni) ༈ bka' brgyad chen mo gsang ba zil gnon las: gter bdag gter srung kyi las byang dregs dpung nag po dgra snying dmar 'byin bzhugs so: gsang ba zil gnon lha la 'dud: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: chos skyong gter srung sgrub pa'i thabs: dregs dpung dgra snying dmar 'byin bstan: mkha' 'gro mtsho rgyal lha yi lcam: yi ger thob la gter du sbos: lnga brgya dus kyi tha ma la: ban bon ngan pa bdud kyi rigs: 'dre rgod 'byung po bstan pa'i dgra: de sogs skal ngan bsgral ba dang : sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srog shing phyir: yang gsang snying gi byang bu nyid: dbang thob dam ldan sngags pa yis: yid la bskul ba tsam gyis chog: sgrub par brtson na lta ci smos: de phyir zab rgya khyad par 'phags: lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'khor: mchod khang ka cha rten rnams bsrung : gter chos ka gcig phyi na 'brang : spyad na nas bre tsam la myur: phor kha'i mchod pa tsam gyis dgyes: log lta yid 'gyu tsam gyis 'khu: mchod bstod bsam pa tsam gyis 'grub: rbad bskul rtsa sngags tsam gyis chog: bla rten srog yig tsam la 'khor: rjes 'jug dbang thob tsam yang skyong : de phyir dregs pa spu gri'i rtse: bstan pa srung ba'i mel tshe 'di: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog:

sa ma ya: dbang thob lung ldan sngags pa yis: chos skyong sgrub pa bya ba'i thabs: dur khrod dam ni shing gcig drung : stegs bu dbus nyid mtho ba la: dug khrag gri khrag chag chag gdab: ma traṃ g.yang gzhi dkyil 'khor bkod: dbus dang phyogs bzhi dkyil 'khor mdog: de yi phyi rol rtsibs brgyad la: de yi phyi rol rtsibs dgu pa: phyi rol dkyil 'khor gzhan dang mtshungs: dbus su thod pa mtshan ldan nang : bla 'khor bla rdo dar snas dril: steng du dar nag gur yang phub: g.yas su mdung ring nag po la: bla dar gzugs dang bskang rdzas brgyan: g.yon du mdung ring nag po la: ru mtshon zlog sngags rbad sngags bri: rgyab tu mda' mo sgro gsum la: gri rgod snying dang shwa rde'u: me long phur pa rdo rje dang : dar mtshon sna lnga ba dan ste: rgyan gsum la sogs rgyas par btags: mdun du sman gtor rakta bsham: gtor ma stod ni spyi mthun ltar: smad ni pad 'dab thod skam ste: nyi shu rtsa gcig dag gi phreng : sku 'bag tsa ka li yang gzugs: rtse mor me ri rgyal mtshan brgyan: lte ba srog yig rtsa sngags bzhag: lho ru tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang : rtag gtor stod zur smad zlum la: nyi shu rtsa gsum dag gis bskor: sha sna snying sna liṅgas brgyan: rakta skyems bcas tshang bar bsham: nub tu bum pa ril bu'am: bum rdzas tshang bar chu yis bkang : kha rgyan mgul chings tshang bar byas: me long sindhu ra yis byugs: ha ri ni sa hūm̐ srog bcas: hring dza zhes pa'i yi ge bri: de dag bum pa'i kha yang brgyan: byang phyogs rgyun gtor lha grangs ni: dmar gtor sha dang nyungs sgog brgyan: rbad pa'i zor bzlog chung ngur bzhag: de la dug thun nag po gzugs: rdo rje phur pa dag kyang bzhag: phyi rol mi lpags g.yang gzhi yis: 'khor yug dag tu bskor bar bya: ma 'dzom shog bu 'khor yug la: mi lpags dur khrod chas kyang bri: zur bzhir mi lpags rgyal mtshan rtser:

bhandha skam po'i tog kyang bskyon: rgyu ma'i rda rdi drwa ba bri: gri bzhi mda' bzhi phur pa bzhi: mdung bzhi me long bzhi dang ni: sbal sbrul rgyan 'phyangs rnams kyang bri: spyi bor mi lpags bla bre ni: gru gsum bsrung bzlog sngags kyang bri: mdun du brub khung nag po ni: phung shul dgu yi sa la bcol: de yang ru tra'i snying gar brtsegs: logs gsum shan pa klu dang gnyan: sku 'bag bris sam 'bur dod bzhengs: bang rim dgu yi ri mo bri: rgyun lam dregs pa'i tsakli btsugs: de steng ri rab phur pa la: liṅga rgya chings thag pas btags: phyi rol rtsang dang mtshon chas bskor: thun rdzas la sogs bshams pa dang : thun gtor rnams kyang rim bzhin phul: mchod gzhung dag ni gzhan dang mtshungs: rang nyid khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ dpa' gcig yab yum bskyed kyang rung : mdun tu bka' srung pho brang bsgom: yang na rang nyid bya rog gdong : sde brgyad dpung dang bcas pa bsgom: sgrub pa'i bsnyen pa rtags rdzogs nas: liṅga 'gugs sngags bsad sngags bzlas: dgra bo sod rtags byung nas su: sbyin sreg bya'am gtad par byas: dgra bo dpung chen gong non gtso: de nyung dag ni gang byas rung : cung zad 'gyang na mi rgyud chad: rang la ldog cing 'khu ba dang : dgra la rbad kyang mi 'gro na: sku 'bag mgo mjug ldog nas su: thun gyis brab cing tha tshig bsgrag: dgra bo rtsad brlag byung nas su: byad bkrol gtad bkrol 'khor lo bskor: de yang bka' brgyad gzhung bzhin byas: pha rol mthu che mi thub na: kho yi lo shing de yi dgra: gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad ni: gzugs 'gros lo shing de la bskyon: dmod pa bor la zor yang 'phang : de yang kho rang yul du bskyal: de nas cis kyang ma thub na: dregs pa rbad pa'i 'khor lo bskor: de nas dgra bo rtsad nas brlag: dgra bo rjes sa shin tu gces: ri bshig bya na gter du sbas: rgyun bsnyen mthu sgrub mi dgos na:

las mtha' tsam gyis bsgral las bya: 'grub na dbang bzhi rnams kyang blang : rjes su bla 'khor 'chang bar bya: bka' brgyad bzlog pa'i skabs su ni: dkyil 'khor gzhung las tshang phyir du: zur du sgrub gtor ma lags pa'i: gzhan gyi mchod pa bya mi dgos: las byang sngags la bskyal nas bzhag: dgong mo gtor 'bul rim ltar bya: dkyil 'khor lag len bca' gzhi tshang : sa ma ya: de nas dkyil 'khor skad cig dran rdzogs su: dmigs pa wal gyis 'di ltar bsgom: rol mo dbyangs chen gzhung ltar la: rkang gling gtser zhing dri gsur btang : hūm̐: rang nyid skad cig dpal chen he ru kaḥ che mchog khro rgyal khrag 'thung smug nag sku: zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhal gdangs spyan rtsa 'khrugs: smin ma dbu skra dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar: thod skam brgyan cing dar nag cod pan bskyod: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas dung dmar stob: dur khrod chas brgyad dpal gyi chas bcus brgyan: yum mchog rnam zhal mthing nag gri thod 'khyud: bskal pa'i me dpung bam chen gdan la 'gyings: om̐ shrī he ru ka kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rtsa sngags gtso gcig ltar na de bzhin byas kyang chog: de nas dpal chen bskyed cing drag sngags kyi sgrub pa ltar na: hūm̐: snang srid klong yangs snod bcud drag po'i zhing : phyi nang dkyil 'khor dur khrod e yi klong : lha srin sde brgyad bsnol ba'i khri steng du: dpal chen che mchog khrag 'thung he ru kaḥ sku mdog smug nag stong khams gling bzhi 'jigs: nyi shu rtsa gcig rngam zhal srid rtser gnon: zhal gdang drag sngags hūm̐ sgra 'brug ltar ldir: spyan dmar thams cad tshwa tshwa skar ltar 'khrugs: shangs nas drag po rlung 'gyu 'u ru ru: snyan nas grags stong sgra skad di ri ri: dbu skra thod phreng me dpung lhabs se lhab: g.yas pa nyer gcig lcags rdor rtse dgu bsnams: g.yon pa nyer gcig lha srin klad khrag dkrugs:

dur khrod chas brgyad dregs pa pho nyar 'gyed: bco brgyad zhabs ni gling bzhir dor stabs bgrad: yum mchog rnam zhal mthing nag pang du 'khyud: zhal dgu khro zhing g.yas g.yon bco brgyad la: gri thod 'dzin cing dur khrod chas dang ldan: zhabs 'khril yab yum bskal me'i klong du gsal: snang srid snod bcud rang mdangs rol rtsal shar: om̐ shrī he ru ka ma hā kro ti shwa ri hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces rang nyid che mchog tu gsal ba'i mdun du dur khrod dang dkyil 'khor lha bskyed pa ni: hūm̐: rang nyid che mchog stobs ldan gsal ba'i mdun: dur khrod chen po me rlung 'tshub rgyas ni: snang srid khro bcu bgrod tshe ya nga ba'i: shin tu 'jigs pa'i gnas mchog pho brang dbus: khrag zhag rba rlabs mtsho ltar 'khyil ba'i klong : mi ro rta ro ri ltar brtsegs pa'i gnas: padma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng : srog bdag mgon po dpal ldan bya rog gdong : zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku che yan lag rags: drag po spyan mig tshwa tshwa tho ro ro: shangs nas rlung g.yos zhal nas rngam mche gtsigs: dbu skra dmar nag stong khams sprin ltar gtibs: thod skam brgyan cing dug sbrul cod pan 'phur: phyag g.yas gri gug nam mkha'i mthongs nas phyar: g.yon pas bhan dmar rakta zhal du 'dren: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' chas rgyan dang ldan: zhabs gnyis 'gying bag khrag 'thung rol pa'i stabs: yum mchog tsaṇḍi dmar mo srin gzugs ma: zangs mchu ldan zhing mche gtsigs dgra sha za: gri thod 'dzin cing yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas brgyad dpa' chas rgyan dang ldan: zhabs gnyis 'gying bag khrag 'thung rol pa'i stabs: yum mchog tsaṇḍi dmar mo srin gzugs ma: zangs mchu ldan zhing mche gtsigs dgra sha za: gri thod 'dzin cing yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas rdzogs g.yas brkyang g.yon pa 'khril: me ri dmar nag klong du gsal bar bskyed: yab yum sprul pa'i bya rog dmar nag brgyad:

rngam mchu brdar zhing mkha' la lam lam 'jums: snang la rang bzhin zang thal ngang du bskyed: om̐ ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha ya: kro ti ni tsa ti baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: shar phyogs me rlung dur khrod bam gyi steng : lho btsan nag po dpal ldan seṅge'i gdong : zhal gdangs ljags 'dril rno dbal mche ba gtsigs: thod skam brgyan cing dar nag cod pan 'phur: phyag g.yas btsan mdung g.yon pas dgra snying bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs gnyis dor stabs kyis: stag mo ri bkra myur mgyogs shugs 'chang brdzis: yum mchog bdud mo sha za seng gdong 'khril: kha ṭwāṃ dgra snying 'dzin cing mgul nas 'khyud: dur khrod chas ldan yab yum me klong gsal: om̐ ma hā dakṣi ṇa shu la siṃ ha du li ṇi hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: lho phyogs me rlung dur khrod bam gyi steng : ma mo srog bdag e ka dzā ṭi la: dmar nag khro zhal dbu skra thod skam brgyan: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril spyan gsum glog ltar 'gyu: phyag g.yas ral gri g.yon pas nad rkyal bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan 'brug mo mgo dgu chibs: bskal pa'i me 'bar smug nag klong du gsal: om̐ kro ti e ka dzā ṭi rakmo ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ hūm̐: nub phyogs dur khrod me ri dmar nag klong : gza' bdud nag po khyab 'jug rā hu la: ljang sngon dbu dgu bya rog mgo dang bcu: thams cad khro zhing dbu skra thod skam 'bar: g.yas g.yon dang po ral gri chu srin gdugs: mtha' gnyis mda' gzhu sbrul gyi zhags pa 'khyugs: lte bar khro zhal gdangs shing dam nyams za: sbrul mjug 'khyil zhing glog zhags dmar mor chibs: sprin nag sngo mar dug rlangs dbus su gsal: om̐ hri rā hu la ki kang du pra ma ya dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ hūm̐: byang phyogs me rlung dmar nag 'bar ba'i klong : btsan rgod chen po dam can rdo rje legs: sku mdog dmar nag dbu la bswe zhu gsol: khro gtum spyan 'khrugs mche bas ma mchu mnan:

phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas tsitta bsnams: 'jol ber sngo khra gsol zhing seṅge chibs: bskal pa'i me ri dmar nag klong du gsal: om̐ badzra sa dhū tsa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: phyi rim gnam lcags 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad steng : khrag mtsho padma ru tra'i gdan steng du: gnod sbyin btsan rgod khrag 'thung 'bar ba ni: sku mdog dmar nag bswe khrab rmog zhu gsol: dar dmar rtsi ber gsol zhing ru dar brgyan: spyan rtsa rab 'khrugs mche bas ma mchu gnan: phyag g.yas tsan dan beng chen dmag gi gter: g.yon pas btsan mdung zhags pa spring spring 'khyugs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan brgyan: swag lham gsol zhing rag pa rting dkar chibs: me rlung dmar nag 'tshub ma'i klong du gsal: om̐ yaksha ma hā shu la tsa tri dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ hūm̐: dur khrod 'bar ba baṃ gyi gdan steng du: klu rgyal chen po mun pa stag ring ni: sngo nag dbu dgu sbrul gdengs ral pa bsigs: zhal rnams khro la g.yas g.yon ral gri sbrul: mtha' gnyis dgra satwa nad kyi rkyal pa thogs: rngam pa'i gzugs can dur khrod chas dang ldan: chu srin la chibs me dpung klong du gsal: om̐ nā ga kha dun rā dza dza bhyo bhyoḥ hūm̐: dur khrod dmar nag rngam yangs bam gyi gdan: gnod sbyin chen po mi bdud seng mgo ni: dmar nag zhal gdang thod skam dbu la brgyan: phyag g.yas gri gug g.yon pas thod khrag thogs: dur khrod chas ldan dred mong mi zan chibs: srab mda' sbrul nag thod rlon phreng bas brgyan: me ri 'bar zhing rlung nag g.yo nang gsal: om̐ yaksha siṃ ha du ma ra raksha ya dza hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: dur khrod chen po bam chen bsnol ba'i steng : dge bsnyen chen po yaksha ging dmar ni: zhal gdangs ljags 'dril dbu skra me ltar 'bar: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas phur bu bsgril: dur khrod chas ldan btsan rta dmar zhur chibs: rab 'jigs 'bar ba srog bdag tshul du gsal:

om̐ ti pa ra tsa yaksha ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ hūm̐: 'jigs rung 'bar ba bam gyi gdan steng du: lha chen gnyan po rgyal ba thod dkar ni: zhi ba'i cha lugs dung khrab rmog zhu gsol: phyag gnyis dgra satwa dar mdung zhags pa 'khyugs: stag ral gzig shubs ral gri 'od ldan bsnams: lcang shes rlung shugs chibs shing rdzu 'phrul tshul: kha char bu yug 'tshub 'khyil klong du gsal: om̐ a mi dhe wa si ta rā dza hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: dug rlung 'bar ba bam gyi gdan steng du: gza' rgod spen pa spu gri mi dmar ni: dbu dgu rngam cing zhal gdangs khro zhing 'khrugs: dbu skra rab 'bar thod skam dar dmar brgyan: dmar po me zer mdog can phyag drug pa: g.yas gsum spu gri g.yon gsum dgra snying 'dzin: dur khrod chas ldan snang srid rlung la chibs: myur zhing tsha ngar 'khrigs pa'i klong du gsal: om̐ ki kang tsakṣu rakta tri hūm̐ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: me rlung 'bar ba klong yangs bam gyi gdan: dam can chen po raksha thod phreng ni: smug nag mdog can 'ob zhu bswe khrab gsol: phyag g.yas thod phreng g.yon pas snying phreng 'dzin: ra rgod chibs shing myur mgyogs pho nyar gsal: om̐ badzra raksha bhandha kha la ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: dur khrod smug nag bam gyi gdan steng du: srin mo khrag ral gdong dmar chen mo ni: zhal gsum phyag drug khro la dur khrod chas: g.yas gsum spu gri ral gri chu srin bsnams: g.yon gsum bhandha kha ṭwāṃ tsitta 'bar: chibs su phung stag nag po mgo dgu chibs: khrag zhags rgya mtsho mer ba'i klong du gsal: om̐ badzra raksha kro ti li raksha du bhyo dza dzaḥ hūm̐: de yi phyi rol rtsibs dgu ru: rgya mtsho mer pa'i klong yangs dbus: klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan ni: sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma: sbrul gyi gdengs ka bdun dang ldan: nor bu 'bar bas yan lag brgyan: phyag g.yas lcags kyu 'bar ba dang : g.yon pas sbrul gyi zhags pa 'dzin:

sa bdag rus sbal mgo dgu chibs: sngo nag rlung gi sgong bur gsal: om̐ nā ga pra bha ṇi paṃ dza hūm̐ dzaḥ hūm̐: dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad pa: mi nag mgo dgu lag pa brgyad: shin tu khro la mi bdud gzugs: g.yas bzhi lcags kyu rgyu zhags bsnams: g.yon bzhi snying dang mi lpags bsnams: dur khrod chas ldan zhabs gnyis myur: om̐ she la du ging rā dza hūm̐ dza dzaḥ hūm̐: klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring ni: dmar nag srin lus 'dab chags sder: lag gnyis lus tshad bcu gsum ring : lcags kyu mi snying dmar po bsnams: lus la sbrul nag stong gis brgyan: zhabs gnyis dor stabs gcer bu 'jigs: om̐ nā ga shu la tsa tri rbad bhyo dzaḥ hūm̐: shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar ni: gcer bu 'jigs pa'i cha byad can: phyag gnyis spu gri ngar ma 'dzin: g.yon pas mi lpags g.yang gzhi rdeb: stag sham zhabs gnyis gar sgyur tshul: dgra srog rngam pa'i tshul du gsal: om̐ tsa tri ya shu la ha tri dza dzaḥ hūm̐: sman btsun chen mo sngo nag ma: ral bsig phyag g.yas mda' dar la: g.yon pas g.yu yi ne'u le 'dzin: gcer mo 'jigs pa'i nyams gyur bsgom: om̐ bhe ru hi ma mo raksha dza dzaḥhūm̐: klu bdud nā ga raksha ni: sku mdog sngo nag srin gzugs pa: sbrul nag ral pa khrag gis brgyan: g.yas g.yon sbal sbrul gcer bu lus: zhabs dor khrag rlung dbus su gsal: om̐ nā ga kha dun raksha dza dzaḥ hūm̐: gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu ni: nag po lcags sdig dgu yis brgyan: phyag drug g.yas g.yon rim pa bzhin: 'khor lo gtun shing be con dang : rgyu zhags snying dang khrag bkang bsnams: sku smad sbrul mjug dug rlangs gsal: om̐ phe sha pā paṃ ya du dza dzaḥ hūm̐: las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog ni: dmar po mi lus zangs sprel gdong : spu gri gshog pa gcer bu pa: phyag gnyis rlung gri 'khor lo 'dzin: zhabs gnyis bya sder dgra snying bsnun: me rlung 'tshub ma'i dbus su gsal:

om̐ yam shu ghṛ wa dza dzaḥ hūm̐: mon pa nag po 'jigs pa'i gzugs: zhal gsum khro zhing ral nag bsigs: g.yas g.yon bam ro pho mo drud: gar bsgyur dgra sha dgyes par bskyed: om̐ ya ma du ra kā la dza dzaḥ hūm̐: gzhan yang sprul pa yang sprul pa: sha za gcan spyang nyi khri stong : bya nag rngam 'gyur nyi khri stong : rang 'dra las mkhan bye ba 'bum: dgra srog gcod pa'i pho nya rnams: snang stong 'dzin med ci bzhin du: bdag mdun thugs ka'i sa bon gyis: rang bzhin gnas nas spyan drangs gyur: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dza dzaḥ

de nas spyan 'dren pa ni rkang gling rol mo drag tu bsgrag: hūm̐: dur khrod rngam brjid rol pa'i klong dkyil nas: mgon po bya rog gdong can gshegs su gsol: sprul pa dur khrod rang rang gnas mchog nas: zhing skyong lha btsan nag po gshegs su gsol: srog bdag e ka dzā ṭi gshegs su gsol: gza' bdud khyab 'jug mgo dgu gshegs su gsol: btsan rgod rdo rje legs pa gshegs su gsol: 'bar ba khrag 'thung chen po gshegs su gsol: klu rgyal mun pa stag ring gshegs su gsol: gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo gshegs su gsol: dge bsnyen yaksha ging mar gshegs su gsol: lha chen rgyal ba thod dkar gshegs su gsol: gza' rgod spen pa spu gri gshegs su gsol: dam can raksha thod phreng gshegs su gsol: srin mo khrag ral ma mo gshegs su gsol: klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan gshegs su gsol: dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad gshegs su gsol: klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring gshegs su gsol: shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar gshegs su gsol: klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring gshegs su gsol: shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar gshegs su gsol: sman btsun sngo nag chen mo gshegs su gsol: klu bdud nā ga rakṣa gshegs su gsol: gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu gshegs su gsol: las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog gshegs su gsol: las byed mon pa nag po gshegs su gsol: phyi nang sprul pa yang sprul gshegs su gsol: dam nyams byad ma bsgral phyir gshegs su gsol: om̐ badzra sa mā ya dharma pā la dzaḥdzaḥ de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: dur khrod pho brang 'bar ba'i gnas mchog 'dir: dam nyams ru tra bsgral ba'i zhing gdan dbus: khrag 'thung dgyes pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol: bstan pa srung ba'i chos skyong nus rtsal shugs: skyed mdzad rin chen gter gyi srung ma rnams: sngon gyi pad 'byung tha tshig dran la bstod: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni:

hūm̐: rakta'i yon chab lbu ba phyogs bcur g.yo: dbang po'i me tog ri rab brjid ltar spungs: sha rus bsregs pa'i dri mchog ngar dang ldan: rkang mar lha ba zhag gi sgron me sbar: gser zhun mdangs ldan mkhris pa'i dri chab gtams: ru tra'i snying bshos dmar nag nang rol brgyan: rkang gling sgra ldan rol mo 'brug ltar ldir: phyi yi mchod sprin dpag yas zhing bkod 'di: chos skyong gter bdag srung ma'i tshogs rnams la: 'bul lo dam nyams dgra bo cham la phob: sangs rgyas bstan pa rtag tu rgyas par mdzod: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dye shabda āḥhūm̐: dgra bgegs kyi ma hā māṃ sa la kha raṃ khā hi: sogs nas rakta l ma hā tsitta l go ro tsa na l ba su ta l i daṃ bha lingta khā hi: de nas sman gtor rakta ni: hūm̐: bhandha'i snod du bdud rtsi mtsho ltar bskyil: ga ṇa'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo dbyings dang mnyam: dmar chen bdud rtsi zhag g.yo bcud dang ldan: rtag gtor dpal chen bshos bu khyon gyis brgyan: rgyun gtor nar ma spyan gzigs mthun pa'i rdzas: dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'di: 'bul lo sangs rgyas bstan pa gnyan po srungs: dam nyams dgra la chad pa drag po phob: om̐ sarba dharma pā la ya: pañtsa a mṛ ta rakta bha lingta pū dza me gha sa mu dra om̐ āḥhūm̐: kha kha khā hi: de nas spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis bskang ba ni: hūm̐: dpal ldan ye shes mgon po bya rog gdong : bka' yi chos skyong dam can srung ma'i tshogs: thugs dam gnyan po bskang ba'i dam rdzas ni: phyi mchod rnam lnga'i dam rdzas bha lingta: gsang mchod sbyor sgrol gnyis med mchod pa'i mchog: mi lpags g.yang gzhi bla bre mkha' la bkram: ru tra'i sha rus dur khrod rdza ltar nyil: rta nag g.yag nag khyi nag lug nag dang : bya nag sbrul nag dar nag ru mtshon dang : mda' mdung ral gri rtse gsum thug dang brgyan:

dar tshon me long shwa rgyan rtsis kyi bkra: bla 'khor srog 'khor sku 'khor rbad 'khor dang : bzlog 'khor las mtshon bzlog gtor thun gyi rdzas: rten gtor rtag gtor rgyun gtor thun gtor dang : pho brang dur khrod rgyan bkod mdzes pa'i tog: phyi nang mnyes pa'i mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'dis: las mgon bya rog gdong can thugs dam bskang : dpal 'bar zhing skyong lho btsan thugs dam bskang : ma mo sngags kyi bdag mo'i thugs dam bskang : gza' bdud khyab 'jug mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang : dam can rdo rje legs pa'i thugs dam bskang : btsan rgod 'bar ba khrag 'thung thugs dam bskang : klu rgyal mun pa stag ring thugs dam bskang : gnod sbyin mi bdud seng mgo'i thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen yaksha ging dmar thugs dam bskang : lha chen rgyal ba thod dkar thugs dam bskang : gza' rgod shan pa spu gri'i thugs dam bskang : dam can raksha thod phreng thugs dam bskang : srin mo khrag ral ma mo'i thugs dam bskang : klu sman gsang ba 'od ldan thugs dam bskang : dge bsnyen smyon pa lag brgyad thugs dam bskang : klu btsan bla 'gugs lag ring thugs dam bskang : shan pa btsan rgod mi dmar thugs dam bskang : sman btsun chen mo sngo nag thugs dam bskang : klu bdud nā ga raksha'i thugs dam bskang : gnyan rgod dug gdong mgo dgu'i thugs dam bskang : las mkhan spu gri rlung gshog thugs dam bskang : las byed mon pa nag po'i thugs dam bskang : phyi nang sprul pa yang sprul thugs dam bskang : dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskangs gyur nas: bar chad bsal zhing dngos grub stsol ba dang : phyi nang bstan dgra dam nyams rtsad nas chod: rnal 'byor bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: hoḥ dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gsang ba'i lha tshogs kyi: mchod rdzas ma tshang bsnyen sgrub g.yel ba dang : bskyed rdzogs ma gsal nor 'khrul chad pa dang :

le lo btang snyoms 'khrul tshogs ci mchis pa: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: ces yig brgya bzlas: chos skyong 'khu ba sogs byung na bskang ba gtso che: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐: bskal pa me ltar 'bar ba'i klong dkyil nas: 'jigs byed che mchog legs ldan bya rog gdong : dur khrod chas rdzogs srid gsum stobs 'dus pa: mthu stobs dbang phyug khyed la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dpal 'bar chen po zhing skyong seṅge'i gdong : dur khrod chas rdzogs rol stabs stag steng bzhugs: dgra srog gcod tshe lho btsan lus bzung ba: ma hā kā la khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sngags srung chen mo ma mo ral gcig ma: ye shes dbyings kyi gtso mo dmar nag gzugs: ral gris dgra srog gcod cing nad rkyal 'phyo: sngags srung chen mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: nam mkha'i dbyings kyi dbang sgyur ljang sngon zhal: mkha' la rgyu zhing dgra la thog ser 'beb: rwa yi mda' gzhu 'dzin cing dgra snying 'dzer: khyab 'jug chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bya ra dam can gyis: padma'i bka' nyan seṅge dkar mo zhon: dam nyams bsgral nas tsitta zhal du gsol: rdo rje legs pa khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: srog bdag gnod sbyin khrag 'thung chen po ni: me 'od mdog can btsan zhags dgra la 'debs: dmag dpung bskyed cing sangs rgyas bstan pa srung : chos skyong chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: klu rgyal chen po mun pa stag ring ni: sngo nag sbrul ral ral gri dgra la 'debs: bstan dgra bdun rgyud rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa: klu bdud chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gnod sbyin chen po mi bdud seng mgo ni: sku mdog dmar nag dred mong smyon pa chibs: bdag la sdang ba'i byad ma'i srog snying phrol: gnod sbyin chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dge bsnyen chen po yaksha ging dmar ni:

rdo rje phyar zhing phur bu bgegs la 'debs: rta dmar zhon cing stong gsum yud kyis bskor: dge bsnyen chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: lha yi rgyal po mi dkar zhi tshul 'chang : lha rta zhon cing ru dar dkar po bsnams: rin chen gter srung phyi nang bar chad bsal: rgyal ba thod dkar khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gza' rgod spu gri mi dmar mkha' la rgyu: dam nyams dgra la thog ser myur du 'bebs: dur khrod chas ldan rlung rta chibs mdzad pa: ki kang chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: dam can chen po raksha thod phreng ni: ra rgod la chibs dgra bo'i snying rtsa len: smug nag 'ob zhu gsol mdzad dregs pa che: gter srung chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: srin mo khrag mdog sha za me 'od gdong : phung stag la chibs dgra bo'i tsitta len: mtshon cha drag po char chen dgra la 'beb: khrag ral ma mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: klu mo chen mo gsang ba 'od ldan ni: rol mtsho sa ya stong gi gnyer 'dzin ma: nor bu rgyan cing sgrub la dngos grub ster: klu yi dbang mo khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: bdud kyi dge bsnyen chen po lag brgyad pa: lcags kyu gdeng mdzad dgra bo'i snying nas bzung : mi lag tsitta 'dzin byed bdud ging che: nag po dgra 'joms khyod la bstod do: hūm̐: klu btsan mi zan bla 'gugs pho nya ni: brkyang bskum lag pas stong gsum dgra snying snyob: srin lus dmar nag sder mos lcags kyu 'dzin: shan pa lag ring khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: btsan gyi shan pa gcer bu dmar nag pa: g.yang gzhi dmar po dgra yul zhing la rdeb: mchong rgyug tshul gyis dgra la ltas ngan 'bebs: btsan rje dmar po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: sman mo chen mo 'byung lnga'i mnga' bdag mo: mda' dar ne'u le 'dzin mdzad bstan srung ma: mi snying stong la rang snying khengs mdzad ma: g.ya' gangs nags chu'i sman mo che la bstod do:
