hūm̐: nā ga raksha klu bdud sngo nag gzugs: sbrul gyi zhags 'dren gling bzhi'i dgra bo 'ching : gar sgyur cho 'phrul stobs dbang chos 'khor skyong : nā ga raksha khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: gnyan rgod nag po dbyings la 'gyu byed pa: mi lus lcags sdig mgo dgus dgra sha za: byad ma brnag pa'i snying khrag hub kyis 'debs: gnyan rgod dug gdong khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: las mkhan dmar po spu gri'i gshog pa can: mgo bo zangs sprel sder mo bya yi gzugs: dgra la rbad tshe srog rtsa snying khrag gtub: spu gri rlung gshog khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: mon pa gcer bu shan pa nag po ni: ral nag bsigs shing dgra bo pho mo drud: nang rol 'dren cing gar stabs rdzu 'phrul bsgyur: mon pa chen po khyod la bdag bstod do: hūm̐: phyi nang sprul pa dam can srung ma'i tshogs: thugs dam bskul mdzad dmigs pa'i dgra bo sgrol: bstan pa'i srog skyong sgrub pa'i phrin las mdzod: dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bdag bstod do: zhes bstod cing phrin las rnams ngag gis brjod: de nas sgrub pa'i thugs dam 'dzab bskul ni: hūm̐: dam can rgya mtsho 'dus pa'i tshogs: 'dzab kyi thugs dam phrin las rnams: sgrub pa'i dam bca' brtan po bzung : deng sang thugs dam gnad nas bskul: zhes sngags rnams mdun bskyed dam: mjug tu yod pa ltar bzlas sgrub pa'i sngags: de nas sngags rdzogs cing thun gtor 'bul ba ni: lcags snod du liṅga dang gtor ma bshams shing : hūm̐: mdun du drag po lcags kyi hom̐: rngam yangs shor med btson khang du: dam nyams dgra bo'i gzugs ling ni: chaig kho rang mngon sum gsal: de nas lan gsum dgra bo'i lus ngag gsal te dguug: hūm̐: dam can chos skyong bka' sdod bden pa'i mthus: gzugs ling 'di la dgra bo myur du khug: las mkhan pho nyas ma shor dam du zungs: om̐ badzra aṅku sha dgra bo dza dzaḥ

de nas bsgral ba dang bstab pa cha la bya rung ngo : hūm̐: dam can pho nya chos skyong gis: dam nyams dgra bo bsgral zhing gtub: dkyil 'khor lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: lhag ma med par bzhes su gsol: ces rtsa sngags kyis 'bul: yang na khā hi gcig pus dbang po rnam brgyad 'bul kyang chog: sa ma ya: de nas dgra bo bkug cing thun gyis brdeg pa ni: sgrub pa las gzhung sngags 'chang gis: rang nyid che mchog gsal ba'i ngang : sngags kyis pho nya'i rgyud la bskul: dgra bo'i rnam shes bla 'khyams ni: nyin mtshan dus drug bkug bya zhing : rgyun du smra ba mi bya ste: dgra bo'i ming byang sham bu bcas: 'gugs pa'i las sngags kha bsgyur bya: om̐ ma hā kā la khā kha mu kha kro ti ṇi tsa ti baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ ma hā ḍākki ṇi shu la siṃ ha du li ni hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ kro ti e ka dzā ṭi rakmo ru lu hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ hrī rā hu la ki kang du pra ma ya dza hūm̐ bhyoḥ om̐ badzra sa dhū tsa na hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ yaksha ma hā shu la tsa tri dza hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ nā ga kha dun rā dza dza dzaḥ om̐ yaksha siṃ ha du ma ra raksha ya dza hūm̐ dzaḥ om̐ ti pa ra tsa yaksha ghṛ wa hūm̐ phaṭḥ om̐ a dhe wa si ta ra tsa dza hūm̐ dzaḥ om̐ ki kang tsakṣu rakta tri hūm̐ dza dzaḥ om̐ badzra raksha bhandha kha la ya hūm̐ dza dzaḥ om̐ raksha kro ti li raksha du bhyo dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga pra bha ṇi paṃ dza hūm̐ dzaḥ om̐ she la du ging rā dza hūm̐ dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga shu la tri rbad bhyo dzaḥ om̐ tsa tri ya shu la ha tri dza dzaḥ om̐ bhe ru hi ma mo raksha dza dzaḥ om̐ nā ga kha na raksha dza dzaḥ om̐ phe sha pā paṃ ya du dza dzaḥ om̐ yam shu ghṛ wa dza dzaḥ om̐ ya ma du ra kā la dza dzaḥ zhes rtsa sngags bzla zhing 'grub rtags ma byung gi bar du bsgrub: de nas dgra bo 'gugs pa'i rtsa sngags kyi sham bur: byad ma chaig dza dzaḥ nā ga shu la tri king kā la shag dun tu tra dza dzaḥ ya shag rū pa kā wa tsi dza dzaḥ ma ra du chings ya rbad thun dgra bo dza dzaḥ

de nas bsgral thun sbrags pa ni: rtsa sngags sham bur: ha la du na trag raksha tri hur thum kha la ru tra rū pa mā ra ya rmyog thum rbad rbad: srog rtsa chod chod: snying rtsa 'gas 'gas: mā ra ya khug bam ril shag dgra bo'i lus ngag ma ra du na shig shig: ces thun brdeg cing bsgral bar bya: de nas sreg pa la sham bur kha bsgyur sngags ni: ya ma du ru tra ru tra ri ha na la shag tshal pa dgra bo'i lus ngag yid la ram̐ ram̐: ru tra kha la dun bhandha mā ra ya kā wa tsi dzwa la ram̐ ram̐ shig shig tshal pa dun bhyo bhyoḥ de nas mnan pa kha bsgyur sham bu ni: ya ma dam sri mā ra ya: satwaṃ bha ya nan: ru tra mā ra ya dgra sri satwaṃ bha ya nan: chaig trig kha dun rbad bhyo kā wa tsi nan nan: zhes mnan pas nam yang mi ldang myur du sgrol bar nges so: sa ma ya: de nas tha tshig bsgrag cing gtor ma 'bul ba ni: thun gtor bshams nas: hūm̐: ston pa shākya thub pa dang : bar du rig 'dzin thod phreng dang : che mchog khrag 'thung chen po yis: ci ltar bka' bsgos gnyer gtad pa'i: dam la gnas pa'i srung ma rnams: dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon gyi tha tshig dran mdzod cig: nyes pa'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di: steng 'og phyogs mtshams gar gnas kyang : bla tshe rnam shes rten dang phrol: nam gyi phar phyed tshur phyed la: dgra bo'i bla 'khyams khug la shog: bla rkun jag pa'i dus la bab: las mkhan pho nya'i dus la bab: dus la bab bo dam ma g.yel: bcol ba'i phrin las ma byas na: dus gsum sangs rgyas bka' yang bcag: rdo rje 'dzin gyi dam yang nyams: na rag rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung : de bas dam las ma 'da' bar: dmigs pa'i dgra bo'i khug la shog: nyes can dam nyams shor ra re: da lta nyid du sgrol bar mdzod: om̐ dharma pā la ya dza ha la ru tra'i snying tsa chod ya rbad ya bhyoḥ

zhes rgyun gtor ltar na khā his 'bul: dgra chos yin na gzhung bzhin bya: zor ni zur du gsal ltar 'phang : dmigs pa rgyas bsdus blo yis dpag: sgrub pa'i dbang bzhi zur du gsal: spros med dbang bzhi blangs kyang chog: sa ma ya: bdag 'dra padma thod phreng gis: dregs pa spu gri dmar po'i skor: gter srung dgra la rbad pa'i thabs: gcig dril sgrub pa zab khyad can: rtags thon myur mgyogs sa ma ya: bka' brgyad sgrub gzhung med pa la: 'di nyid spel du mi rung phyir: gsang rgya myur du sba bar gyis: dam nyams bsgral ba'i mtshon char shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gsang rgya: zab rgya: gtad rgya: kho bo u rgyan rtsa gsum gling pa chos kyi rgya mtshos padma sbas pa'i tshal nas gdan drangs shing shog ser nas bsgyur bas/ theg chen a ti yo ga'i bstan pa 'grib pa med cing*/ mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don gnyis 'grub par bya ba'i slad phyogs bcur dus kun dar rgyas bstan pa'i dge legs 'phel bar stsol// // sarba maṅga laṃ// // pi) ༄༅/ sgrub chen bka' brgyad gsang ba zil gnon las/ bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyi cho ga khrigs su bsdebs pa gsang chen nor bu'i dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ na mo gu ru padma kā ra ye/ snang stong sku ni mtshan dpe'i rang bzhin mi shigs mkha' yi rdo rje ste/ /grags stong gsung ni na da'i rang sgra brjod pa kun gyi rjes su 'jug /rig stong thugs mchog 'dus ma byas gang nam mkha'i khyab bdag 'pho 'gyur spangs/ /rigs rnams kun gyis khyab pa'i bdag nyid mtsho skyes bla mar gus pas 'dud/ /nyi zla'i rgyu ba rab tu za bas dbu ma'i zhal ras drag tu gtum/ /snying rje'i thugs la byams pa'i rang bzhin rno dkar tshems kyi myu gu rngam/ /byang chub 'gal zla'i srog dbugs len phyir sna tshogs sprul pa'i mtshon cha thogs/ /he ru ka dpal btsun mor bcas pas skye ba kun tu rjes 'dzin mdzod/

/gtsang smer 'dzin pa'i gnyis snang ma rig las dang nyon mongs lcags kyi khams/ /rtog bral ye shes gser 'gyur rtsi yis mi shigs gtso sbyangs gsar du bskrun/ /'di ko gsang sngags thabs mang la sogs yon tan brgya phrag du ma las/ /gtso bor snang phyir 'di yang sngon gyi dam pa dag gi rjes su 'brang*/ de'ang rgyal ba thams cad kyis gdul bya sems can gyi blo dang mthun par chos kyi phung po bgrang du med pa zhig gsungs pa thams cad kyang bsdu na theg pa gsum du 'du ba yin zhing*/ de thams cad kyang thar thug gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa kho na la gzhol zhing*/ de kho na nyid 'bras bu nges pa'i phyir/ theg pa chen po de la'ang rgyu 'bras gnyis su yod pa yin te/ brtag pa gnyis pa las/ rgyu lam mos par rgyu chos kyis/ /'khor lo rab tu bskor byas te/ /rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam zhig /ma 'ongs dus na yod pa yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar la/ de'ang don kyi gnad mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdo rje theg pa kho nar 'du ba yin te/ 'jam dpal sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ theg pa sna tshogs thabs tshul gyis/ /'gro ba'i don la rtog pa po/ /theg pa gsum gyis nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bur gnas/ zhes gsungs pas/ theg pa 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bgrod pa cig pu'i lam gyi mthur thug pa yin pas na/ zab mo'i lam 'dir smin byed dbang gi sgo nas zhugs pa'i gang zag dag gis 'bras bu'i chos yang dag pa rgyud la brtan par bya ba'i nye rgyu'i gnad ni/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gis bsdus pa'i dam tshig dam tshig gnyis las/ de las 'di ni yan lag gi dam tshig rnams kyi snying po bdud rtsir grags pa nyid yin te/ rgyu 'phrul rtsa rgyud las/ dkar rtsi dmar rtsi dri sha chen/ /dag pa'i snod chu mi 'dor ro/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/ 'di nyid du cho ga bzhin nyams su blangs pas dam tshig rang gi ngo bo la gnas shing*/

nyes ltung gzhan yang 'joms par 'gyur ba dang*/ 'bras bu'i chos rgyud la 'jog pa sogs yon tan du ma lhan skyes su 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dir nyams su blang ba'i rim pa go bde bar gtso bor dmigs te bshad pa la bdun/ bdud rtsi'i ngo bo bzhag pa/ nges tshig bstan pa/ bsten par gsung tshul/ rnam grangs kyi dbye ba/ dam rdzas bsags tshul/ sgrub pa nyams su blang ba/ de'i phan yon brjod pa'o/ /dang po ni/ bdud rtsi bam brgyad las/ srid gsum ye nas bdud rtsi lnga/ /ma bcos lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /dug gsum srid gsum sku gsung thugs/ /ye nas bdud rtsi yin pa'i phyir/ /nges pa'i klong nas bka' stsal to/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar 'khor 'das thams cad ye nas bdud rtsi lnga'i ngo bor gnas pa yin no/ /gnyis pa nges tshig ni/ a mṛ 'chi ba med pa ste bdud rtsi'i sgra la 'jug pa yin te/ ji skad du/ gtsang smer 'dzin bdud dam rdzas rtsis/ /ye shes ngang du ro gcig pa/ zhes gsungs pa ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ sgyu 'phrul le lag las/ bdud rtsi ye nas dag pa'i chos/ /blang dor med pa kun las 'das/ ye bsrungs chen po'i dam tshig tu/ /mkhas pas dwang du blang bar bya/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ye nas blang dor med pa'i chos nyid du rgyan gyi rol pa yin pa dang*/ rigs lnga'i rang bzhin dngos grub kyi rdzas spyod pa'i grogs su 'gyur ba lags so/ /bzhi pa ni/ bdud rtsi yon tan gyi rgyud las/ gtso bo dam rdzas bdud rtsi lnga/ /rtsa ba brgyad la yan lag stong*/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi sman du sbyar/ ra sā ya na sman chen po/ /zos pas mchog thun dngos grub thob/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa ba brgyad la rnam pa lngar 'byung ste/ sngon byung dang*/ phyi'i dang*/ nang gi dang*/ gsang ba'i dang*/ sgrub pa lag len gyi rtsa ba brgyad dang lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ sngon dpal chen pos ru tra bsgral ba'i skabs zag pa rgya mtshor 'phangs pa'i rgyu las bdud rtsi kun gyi phyi mo tsan dan sbrul gyi snying po'i sdong por grub ste/

de yang sdong po tsandan smug po/ rtsa ba mū la pa tra/ yal ga li shi /lo ma ghandha pa tra/ me tog gur gum/ 'bras bu dza ti/ thang chu ga pur/ shun pa shing tshar snang ba'o/ /gnyis pa ni/ gong gi sman sna brgyad po deng sang yongs grags ltar ro/ /gsum pa ni/ mchog chen mi la tshang bar gsungs te/ lte ba/ sha rus/ yan lag /skra sen/ don snying*/ dbang po lnga/ rkang mar/ lpags pa sogs rtsa ba dang sdong po la sogs pa'i tshul du gnas pa'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ yab kyi rgyu bzhi dang yum gyi rkyen bzhir snang ba'o/ /lnga pa sgrub pa lag len gyi rtsa ba brgyad la lnga tshan brgyad de/ gtso bo lnga/ snying po lnga/ 'bras bu lnga/ yon tan lnga/ sdud pa lnga/ dul ba lnga/ dgod don lnga/ dgos chas lnga'o/ /dang po ni/ dri chen/ dri chu/ byang sems/ rakta/ sha chen no/ /gnyis pa ni/ bam gtsang ma'i dbang po lnga/ gsum pa ni/ dud 'gro rmig zlum/ rmig leb/ rmig pa kha brag /'dab chags/ phyi ba rnams kyi sha'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ cu gang*/ sindhu ra/ a ru ra/ spos chen/ lhang tshil rnams so/ /lnga pa ni/ a mṛ ta'i phabs rgyun/ ga pur/ gur gum/ dzā ti/ tsan dan no/ /drug pa ni/ a ga ru nag po/ du ru ka /li ga dur/ dbang lag /sug smel dang lnga'o/ /bdun pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon/ rdo rgyal thebs/ karma ging chen/ las byed/ gzungs ma dang lnga'o/ /brgyad pa ni/ dkyil 'khor/ mchod pa/ rdzas/ yo byad/ kā pa la mtshan ldan dang lnga'o/ /de ltar rtsa ba brgyad po de rnams la yan lag stong sbyar ba ni/ lnga tshan phyi ma gnyis ma gtogs pa'i gong ma drug po de rnams re rer rtsi bcud kyi sman du gyur tshad sbyar bas yan lag stong ngo*/ /lnga pa dam rdzas kyi rgyu bsags pa ni/ de'ang rdzas kyi gtso bo bdud rtsi lnga las/ dri chen dang dri chu ni bla ma dam pa'am rim gnyis kyi lam la slob pa'i rnal 'byor pho mo dam tshig dang ldan pa las blangs te de nyid kyang lus rngul ba dang*/ byang sems nyams pa dang*/

na ba dang*/ ngal zhing dub pa'i dus ma yin par byung ba'i dri che chung ngo*/ byang sems ni khye'u gtsang ma'am/ rang ngam/ rang nyid dang shes rab ma rdul 'dzag pa'i dus snyoms par zhugs pa'i byang sems dkar dmar la bshad kyang*/ gter byon 'khrul med kyi gu ru yab yum gyi byang sems la gtso bor bya'o/ /sha chen gyi klad pa rkang dmar/ tshil bu gsum la gang yang rung ba'o/ /'di lnga ni dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i rdzas su gyur pa'i phyir lcags kyu lnga zhes grags pa'o/ /sha lnga las mi sha ni/ rab skye ba bdun pa'i sha'o/ /ma rnyed na mtshams med kyi las dang mi bsad pa ma yin pa'i skyes pa dar ma nad med g.yul du bsad pa'i sha'o/ /ba glang gi sha ni yun ring por nad kyis gdung ba ma yin par shi ba'i sha'o/ /glang po'i sha ni dngos sam/ yang na ba glang dkar po'i sha'o/ /rta dang khyi ni kha dog dkar po can nad ngan pas shi ba ma yin pa'i sha'o/ /'di dag ni dngos grub thams cad gsal bar byed pa'i sgron ma lngar grags pa'o/ /gong gi bdud rtsi lnga la brda'am skyobs lngar grags pa'ang sbyar te/ dri chu'i gla rtsi/ dri chen gyi a ru ra/ rakta'i du ru ka /byang sems kyi ga pur/ sha chen gyi tsan dan dmar po'o/ /gzhan yang 'bras bu gsum la sogs pa'i sman rnams/ rnying zhing ro nus yal ba dang dri mas sbags pa sogs spangs shing*/ gtsang zhing gsar pa dri ro dang ldan pa dag bsags/ bod sman gyi rigs rnams 'tshol ba'i dus ni rtse mo rnams dpyid/ rtsa ba rnams ston dus sogs su btsal dgos te/ de'ang ston zla tha chung la sman gyi bcud rdzogs la/ dpyid zla 'bring por sman gyi lha mo drod g.yo bas na zla ba de gnyis kyi nya dang bco lnga la sman gyi srung ma rnams kyis nyul bas dngos grub myur bar gsungs shing*/ dus der rigs bzang khye'u gtsang ma khrus byas gos bzang po dang ldan pas/ lha dang sman gyi srung mar phyag dang bcas pas 'thu bar bya'o/

/drug pa sgrub pa nyams su len pa la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bsnyen pa sngon du 'gro bas/ phun sum tshogs pa lngas sgrub pa'i gzhi bzung ba nas brtsam/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor bya ba'i bar sgrub khog bzhin tshang bar song nas/ khyad par khrol sgrub kyi dkyil 'khor zhi ba zhe gnyis dang*/ rigs brgya gang rigs kyi dkyil 'khor legs par 'du bya'o/ /dkyil 'khor 'god pa la/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams lngar pho mo'i thod par rigs lnga yab yum gyi snying po bris pa 'du byas la/ dbus su byang sems dkar dmar dang mi'i sha gtso bor gyur ba'i kha dog dkar ba'i sman gyi rigs dang*/ rin po che mu tig dkar po/ 'bras sogs 'bru dkar gyi rigs/ srog chags dkar po'i sha sna snying sna la sogs pa dang*/ de bzhin shar gyi thod par dri chen dang ba glang gi sha gtso bor gyur pa'i kha dog dmar ser du gyur pa'i sman dang*/ rin po che 'bru'i sde tshan rnams bkod cing*/ lho'i thod par sha chen gyi dwangs ma dang khyi'i sha gtso bor gyur pa'i kha dog sngo ba'i sde tshan gyi sman dang*/ 'bru dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa dang*/ nub tu padma'i rakta dang*/ rta'i sha gtso bor gyur pa'i kha dog dmar po'i sde tshan gyi sman dang*/ 'bru dang*/ rin po che la sogs pa dang*/ byang du dri chu dang glang po che'i sha gtso bor gyur pa'i kha dog ljang khu'i sde tshan gyi/ sman dang*/ 'bru dang*/ rin po chen la sogs pa rnams bkod par bya'o/ /gzhan shes par bya ba'i sman gyi kha dog dang dri ror gnod pa'i spyang ki spang bar gsungs te/ de'ang dri'i spyang ki sgog pa/ shing kun la sogs dri nga ba rnams dang*/ sha'i spyang ki pu shud zer mo/ mdzo dril rnams kyi sha'o/ /me tog gi spyang ki ni/ spru ma/ ri sho /sran ma rnams kyi me tog go /ro'i spyang ki gzhob kyi rigs/ thal tshwa/ ba tshwa/ bong nga dkar dmar/ hong len rnams so/

/mdog gi spyang ki lnga dang spang rgyan sngon po'i me tog go /sman rnams kyi mang nyung gi tshad ni/ la sman sum gnyis/ bod sman sum cha la/ nang gi sman dang sha rnams de'i phyed/ sngo dang spod kyis sum cha thub par sbyar/ zhes pa ltar bya dgos so/ /de ltar 'du byas pa'i thod pa de dag dkyil 'khor gyi lding khri bar ma'i steng du shar lho nub byang sogs ma nor bar sbyang khrus mdor bsdus dang bcas rigs brgya'i lha sngags bzla bzhin pas bkod/ dar sna tshogs kyis bkab cing*/ tshon rkud sna lngas rgya gram du btab pa'i sne mor rdo rje btags pa/ thod pa dbus ma'i khar bzhag /sne mo gcig shos las steng du rmu thag gis sbrel cing*/ mth-ing dkar dmar ba'i gdugs phub par tshangs pa dang brgya byin sogs kyi sku'ang 'dogs/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas kyi rim pa gya nom bsham bkod legs par bya'o/ /spyi don gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gsum/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gzhung 'asrang la/ sman khrol bu'i dgongs pa dang*/ phye ma'i dgongs rgyud dang gsum mo/ /dang po ni skyabs sems sogs sngon 'gro song nas dngos gzhi ting 'dzin rnam gsum nas bstod pa'i bar song ste/ bdag mdun sgrub rdzas dbyer med par bltas la/ dzap khang dbye ba ltar mdun du sman gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub par bya ba'i skabs/ 'dir 'jug go /gnyis pa sman khrol bu'i dgongs pa dang sbyar ba'i las rim la bzhi las/ dang po dam pa rigs brgyas sbyang ba ni/ rnam dag chos dbyings ngang nyid las/ /rang byung mchod pa'i phung po ni/ /kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin lta bur/ /dpag yas nam mkha' gang bar gyur/ zhes pa'i mthar/ na maḥs manta buddha haṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa ma ye swā hā/ oṃ shrī badzra rā ga dhū pe dhu/ oṃ shrī badzra rā ga puṣpe pu/ oṃ shrī badzra rā ga a lo ka hrīḥ oṃ shrī badzra rā ga gandhe hoḥ zhes mchod rdzas byas la mdun bskyed kyi sdom ni/

lha bskyed dbang bskur gnas su dzapa/྄ spyan 'dren me tog 'thor mchod bstod/ sman srung spyan 'dren rtog bsal dzapa/྄ ces pa ltar dgu las/ dang po dam tshig bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med dbyings/ /rang bzhin spros bral kun khyab snying rje'i mdangs/ /'gyur med a dkar rgyu yi thig ler shar/ /de las e yam̐ bam̐ sum̐ ram̐ bhrūm̐ chad/ /nam mkha' rlung chu sa me'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /bhrūm̐ yig yongs gyur kun bzang gzhal med khang*/ /gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs brgyad kyis brgyan/ /rtsig pa lnga ldan 'dod snam pha gu dang*/ drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shus rjes/ /rtsibs bzhi mu khyud gru chad bar khyams ldan/ /ye shed 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /seng glang rta mchog rma bya mkha' lding khri/ /padma nyi zla'i gdan la dwangs ma'i srog /de las so so'i phyag mtshan yig 'brus mtshan/ /'od zer 'phro 'dus don byas yongs gyur pa/ /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis rgyal ba'i 'khor lor shar/ /dbus su rdo rje sems dpa' dbyings phyug yum/ /mthing gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin mnyam par sbyor/ /shar rtsibs rnam par snang mdzad sangs rgyas spyan/ /dkar po 'khor lo dril 'dzin mnyam par sbyor/ /lho rtsibs rin chen 'byung ldan mā ma kī/ /ser po rin chen dril 'dzin mnyam par sbyor/ /nub rtsibs snang ba mtha' yas gos dkar mo/ /dmar po padma dril 'dzin mnyam par sbyor/ /byang rtsibs don yod grub pa dam tshig sgrol/ /ljang gu ral gri dril 'dzin mnyam par sbyor/ /rtsibs mchan shar lhor sa snying lā sye dkar/ /mnyam sbyor rin chen myu gu me long 'dzin/ /lho nub nam snying mā lye sku mdog ser/ /mnyam sbyor rin po che dang phreng ba 'dzin/ /nub byang spyan ras gzigs dang glu ma dmar/ /mnyam sbyor padma dkar po pi waṃ 'dzin/ /byang shar phyag na rdo rje gar ma ljang*/

/mnyam sbyor rdo rje rtse lnga gar rgya 'ching*/ /de yi phyi rol gru chad grwa bzhi la/ /shar lho byams pa mai tri dhū pe ma/ /dkar ser klu yi shing dang spos khang 'dzin/ /lho nub sgrib pa rnam sel mo tog ma/ /dmar ser glegs bam me tog phreng ba 'dzin/ /nub byang kun tu bzang dang mar me ma/ /dmar ljang rin chen snye ma sgron me 'dzin/ /byang shar 'jam dpal dbyangs dang dri chab ma/ /dkar ljang utpal la dang dung phur 'dzin/ /thams cad g.yon pa'i phyag na dril bu bsnams/ /yab rnams mnyam skyil yum rnams brtul zhugs tshul/ /shar khyams dbus su kun tu bzang po mthing*/ /mnyam bzhag phyag rgya rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs/ /nub khyams dbus su bzang mo dbang sngon mdog /ting 'dzin phyag rgya mnyam pa'i skyil mo krung*/ /kun kyang mnyen lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun sdug gzi byin mchog tu 'bar/ /zhi tshul dgus mdzes mtshan dang dpe byad ldan/ /lha rdzas dar gyi stod g.yogs smad dkris dang*/ /zi ldar gar gyi phu dung rin po che'i/ /dbu rgyan snyan cha mgul rgyan se mo do/ /do shal dpung rgyan phyag zhabs gdu bu dang*/ /gser sked la sogs bcu gsum chas kyis spras/ /shar lhor lha thub dkar po pi wang 'dzin/ /lho ru mi yi thub ser gseg par 'dzin/ /lho nub yi dwags thub dmar rin chen sgrom/ /nub byang byol song thub mthing pu ti 'dzin/ /byang du lha min thub ljang go cha 'dzin/ /byang shar dmyal ba'i thub nag me dang chu/ /kun kyang tshangs spyod mchog gi sprul sku'i tshul/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ /shar sgor gshin rje'i gshed dang lcags kyu ma/ /smug nag mnyam sbyor mi mgo lcags kyu 'dzin/ /lho sgor stobs po che dang zhags pa ma/ /ser nag rdo rje thod snod zhags pa 'dzin/ /nub sgor rta mchog dpal dang lcags sgrog ma/ /dmar nag thod sbrul 'chang zhing lcags sgrog 'dzin/
/byang sgor bdud rtsi 'khyil dang dril bu ma/ /ljang nag rdo rje rgya gram dril bu 'dzin/ /kun kyang gar dgu'i ros sgeg dur khrod kyi/ /chas can 'bar ba'i me phreng dbus na bzhugs/

gnyis pa dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs lnga so so'i phyag rgya bcings te/ oṃ ma hā shu n+ya ta dzñā na badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3 haṃ/ de bzhin du thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ ā darsha/ sā ma tā/ pra tya bekṣa ṇa/ kṛ tyā nuṣṭha na/ rnams brjod nas/ lha tshogs rnams kyi spyi bo'i gnas lngar de bzhin gshegs pa lnga rjes chags kyis zhu ba'i ye shes lnga'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ /nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs/ /phung po lnga sangs rgyas lngar gnas gyur nas dbang rtags su de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu brgyan par gyur/ gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ rdo rje'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du 'ching zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ma hā kā ya badzra swa bhā wa atma ko3 haṃ/ de bzhin du/ wākka dang*/ tsitta la sbyar zhing*/ lha rnams kyi spyi mgrin snying gar zla ba padma nyi ma la gnas pa'i oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de'i 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs rgyud bskul/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar byon nas yi ge gsum la thim/ yongs su gyur pa las rnam snang 'od dpag med mi bskyod pa dang bcas pa'i skur gyur par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs rnams badzra sa mā dzaḥ sa sad par byas/ hūm̐/ phyogs dus dkyil 'khor bdag nyid che/ /mi dmigs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor las/ /dkyil 'khor thams cad spyan drang ngo*/ /rang snang dbyer med dkyil 'khor la/ /'jug pa'i mtshan nyid mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /phyogs dus kun nas gshegs par gyis/ /bsnyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rab tu rdzogs/ /nye bar gyur pa'i dam tshig mchog /oṃ e hya hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi kā dṛ shya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs la gnyis med du bstim mo/ /lnga pa rig pa'i me tog dor ba ni/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya oṃ/

ā badzra sa ma ya ā/ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ swā badzra sa ma ya swā/ hā badzra sa ma ya hā/ zhes rig pa'i me tog dor bas/ sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam mo/ /drug pa mchod bstod ni/ kun bzang zhabs bsil/ bzhi bsnol/ sman gtor rakta la sogs pa zhi khro phrin las gzhung bzhin mchod cing*/ bsdu na/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa ni/ sogs kyi mthar sngags mchod kyeis kyang chog go /bstod pa rtsa rgyud las gsungs pa'i gzhi bstod yongs rdzogs sam/ mi nus na/ brjod med shes rab mi g.yo chos kyi sku/ /bde chen longs spyod rdzogs sku rigs lnga'i gtso/ /thugs rje thabs mkhas rgya mtsho rol pa'i lha/ /zhi khro sprul pa'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod par bya'o/ /bdun pa sman srung spyan 'dren ni/ slob dpon gyis kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dar g.yab/ spos dkar bsreg cing rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐/ tshangs dang drang srong klu rnams dang*/ /shing dang sman gyi lha mo dang*/ /ra sā ya na'i srung ma'i tshogs/ /sngon tshe 'das dus dang po la/ /kun bzang lha yi spyan snga ru/ khas blangs dam bcas dbang mnos shing*/ /sdom la gnas pa'i rig 'dzin bdag /dus gsum bde gshegs mchod pa dang*/ /sman gyi rig 'dzin bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /'khor dang bcas la spyan 'dren na/ /'dir gshegs dam tshig tshul bzhin dgongs/ /ra sā ya na'i dngos grub stsol/ zhes spyan drangs pas/ sngon sman gyi dam tshig gi dngos grub thob cing*/ sgrub pa po'i sdong grogs mdzad par dam mnos pa'i sman gyi rig 'dzin lha dang drang srong srung ma rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa thams cad byon nas/ sman gyi pho brang steng gi nam mkhar sprin phung gtib pa bzhin bzhugs par bsam mo/ /brgyad pa rtog pa bsal ba ni/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i bdud rtsi 'thor zhing*/ hūm̐/ tshangs dang drang srong gtsang ma za/ /de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad/

/klu dang drang srong gtsang ma za/ /de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad/ /byol song rtswa mchog za ba yang*/ /ji srid 'tsho yi bar du za/ /de dag grol bar ngas ma bshad/ /yang dag don gyi lung 'di nyon/ /rnal 'byor thabs ldan rnams kyis ni/ /chos sku gcig la tha dad pa'i/ /rigs lnga'i mtshan nyid 'dir bshad do/ /de ltar rtogs na grol zhes bshad/ /rang bzhin yongs su dag pa'i rdzas/ /mnyam pa'i dbyings su rab rtogs na/ /gnyis med don gyis zin pa yin/ /ji ltar dmigs pa bzhin du 'grub/ /dngos dang dngos med rtog pa'i mtshan/ /mkhas pas dbus la'ang gnas mi 'gyur/ /ye shes sku lngar bstan pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems ni dkar bas na/ /dri med dkar ba'i ye shes sku/ /rakta chags med dmar bas na/ /chags med rnam dag dag chos kyi sku/ /māṃ sa yid bzhin rin chen lnga/ /dri chen gser mdog snang mdzad de/ /mngon byung sprul pa chos kyi sku/ /dri chu dag byed ljang gu'i mdog /kun tu don grub chos kyi sku/ /sku lnga lhun grub bdud rtsi 'di/ /so so'i lus la gnas pa yin/ /dri chen dri chu rakta dang*/ /māṃ sa sems chu 'di dag kun/ /sems can rtog pa ldog bya'i phyir/ /gtso ru dwang du blang bar bya/ /gtsang dme med par kun gyis spyod/ /de dag grol bar ngas bshad do/ / zhes brjod pas sman gyi drang srong rig 'dzin thams cad gtsang dme'i gnyis 'dzin dag nas 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol ba la dgyes bzhin bzhugs par bsam mo/ /dgu pa dzap la gnyis las/ dang po lha'i dzap ni/ lha tshogs thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems/ /gsal brtan 'gyur med thugs kyi dpal be'ur/ /zla steng ting 'dzin sems dpa' yig 'bru'i gzugs/ /dwangs gsal 'od 'phro sngags kyi phreng bas bskor/ /rang srog yig 'bru zer gyis thugs rgyud bskul/ /lha tshogs thugs las 'od 'phros rgyal ba mchod/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus/

/mdun bskyed lhar thim gzi byin mchog tu 'bar/ /dwangs ma'i 'od zer 'khor 'das khyab par gsal/ /ma dag dngos 'dzin ye shes 'khor lor bsgyur/ zhes dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang sbyar te zhi ba bzhi bcu'i sgos dzap dang*/ spyi dzapa/྄ oṃ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ mi nus na zhi dkyil kho nas kyang rung*/ spro zhing nus na khrag 'thung nga brgyad kyi bskyed sngags len gcig brjod la de'i rkyen gyis khro bor bsgyur ba ste/ hūm̐/ zhi ba'i lha tshogs yongs gyur khrag 'thung lnga/ /gnas yul ma mo dbang phyug sgo skyong sogs/ /lnga bcu rtsa brgyad khro bo'i dkyil 'khor lha/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan dur khrod chas kyis brgyan/ /bskal pa'i me bzhin bzod dka'i gzi brjid 'bar/ khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor che por lhun gyis grub/ ces gsal btab nas mchod cing bstod/ dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du sngar bzhin gyi sgos dzap dang*/ spyi dzapa/྄ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes brgya rtsa bzla'o/ /gnyis pa sman dzap ni/ rang srog sngags kyi 'od zer gzung thag la/ /'khril te sman gyi lha tshogs thugs kar zhugs/ /de dag sku las 'od 'phros 'khor 'das kyi/ /rtsi bcud kun 'dus byang sems ngo bor zhu/ /pho brang steng gi sman srung rig 'dzin kun/ /dam tshig rjes dran brtan g.yo snod bcud kyi/ /dwangs ma'i yon tan 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /dkyil 'khor chen por char bzhin 'bebs par gyur/ zhes pa'i dmigs pa dang ldan pas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sā ya na ta na dza ya gu hya siddhi hūm̐ hrī ṭhaḥ zhes stong du grangs tshang bar bzlas pa'i mtshams su stong tshig kyi mchod pa'ang bya'o/ /thun mjug tu/ rigs brgya'i lha tshogs 'od kyi gong bur zhu/ /gtso bo rigs lnga'i thugs kyi thig ler thim/ /rigs lnga yab yum snyoms 'jug byang sems kyi/

/ngo bor 'od zhu sman dang ro gcig gyur/ zhes brjod la thun bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa rigs lnga sbyang ba ni/ phrin las kyi sdom ni sngar bshad pa bzhin dgu las/ dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med dbyings/ /rang bzhin spros bral kun khyab snying rje'i gdangs/ /'gyur med āḥdakar rgyu y-i thig ler shar/ /de las e yam̐ bam̐ sum̐ ram̐ bhrūm̐ chad/ /nam mkha' rlung chu sa me'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /bhrūm̐ yig yongs gyur kun bzang gzhal med khang*/ /sgo bzhi gru bzhi rta babs brgyad kyis brgyan/ /rtsig pa lnga ldan 'dod rnams pha gu dang*/ /drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shus mdzes/ /rtsibs bzhi mu khyud gru chad bar khyams ldan/ /ye shes 'od phung 'khrigs pa'i dkyil 'khor dbus/ /dbus dang rtsibs bzhir yam̐ las rlung gzhu'i dbyibs/ /de steng ram̐ las dmar nag gru gsum steng*/ /gnas pa'i ā yig yongs gyur ka pā la/ /phyi dkar nang dmar yangs shing rgya che lnga'i/ /so so'i nang du pam̐ las padma dang*/ /āḥlas zla ba māṃ las nyi dkyil steng*/ /byang sems dri chen sha dang rakta'i chur/ /rim bzhin hūm̐ oṃ swā aṃḥhā yig lnga/ /mthing dkar ser dmar ljang gu'i mdog du 'tsher/ /de las 'od 'phros mkha' mnyam 'gro don byas/ /ye shes lnga yi bcud bsdus yongs gyur las/ /rdo rje 'khor lo rin chen padma dang*/ /ral gri'i phyag mtshan rnam lngar yig 'brus mtshan/ /'od 'phros sems can don byas 'khor 'das kyi/ /bcud bsdus bde gshegs lnga yi skur gyur pa/ /dbus su rdor sems ind+ra nī la'i mdog /rdo rje dril 'dzin dbyings phyug yum dang sbyor/ /shar du rnam par snang mdzad zla ba'i mdog /'khor lo dril 'dzin spyan ma yum dang sbyor/ /lho ru rin chen 'byung ldan gser gyi mdog /rin chen dril 'dzin mā ma kī dang sbyor/ /nub tu snang ba mtha' yas rā ga'i mdog

/padma dril 'dzin gos dkar yum dang sbyor/ /byang du don yod grub pa margad mdog /ral gri dril 'dzin sgrol ma yum dang sbyor/ /yab rnams mnyam skyil yum rnams brtul zhugs kyi/ /skyil krung gis 'khril zhi ba'i tshul dgus brjid/ /bcu gsum chas kyis rab mdzes mtshan dper ldan/ /mtha' yas 'od zer spro ba'i bdag nyid can/ /bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs/ zhes pas gsal gdab bo/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba nas drug pa mchod pa'i mthar thug gi bar sngar bzhin las bstod pa ni/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon lta bur so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ bdun pa sman srung spyan 'dren dang*/ brgyad pa rtog bsal sngar bzhin/ dgu pa dzap la gnyis kyi/ dang po lha'i dzap ni/ lha tshogs thugs kar rang 'dra'i ye shes sems/ sogs nas/ ma dag dngos 'dzin ye shes 'khor lo bsgyur/ zhes dmigs pa'i 'phro 'du dang bcas/ sngags tshig ni/ hūm̐ badzra dhṛk/ mūm̐ dhā twī shwa rī/ oṃ dzi na dzik/ lām̐ te shwa ra satwaṃ/ swā ratna dhṛk/ māṃ mo ha ra ti/ āṃ a ro l̥k /pām̐ rā ga ra ti satwaṃ/ hā pradzñā dhṛk /tāṃ badzra ra ti satwaṃ/ zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzla/ gnyis pa sman dzap ni/ dwangs ma'i srog yig 'od kyis thugs rgyud bskul/ /rigs lnga yab yum rjes su chags pa'i ros/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i 'od dang sgras/ /'phags mchog sems can don byas dngos grub dbyig /tshur bsdus byang chub sems rgyun mkha' gsang las/ /babs pas bhañdzar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyil/ /pho brang steng gi sman srung rig 'dzin gyi/ /brtan g.yo'i rtsi bcud bdud rtsi 'bebs par gyur/ zhes bsgoms shing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ dzñā na pañtsa spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes bzla zhing stong tshig gi mchod pa sogs sngar bzhin no/

/thun gyi mjug tu/ lha rnams dga' ba'i mnyam sbyor ye shes lnga'i/ /bdud rtsi'i ngo bor zhu ste dam rdzas dang*/ /dbyer med kha dog dri ro nus ldan pa'i/ /dngos grub kun gyi snying por 'khyil bar gyur/ zhes dang*/ mtshams kyi chang dang*/ 'o ma/ rin po che/ chu rnams kyang de dang de'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi ngo bor zhu bar bsams la/ chang la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta dza gad pra wā ya swā hā/ lan gsum/ 'o mar/ oṃ bi tang saṃ shwa dhā ya kro dhā kro dhī shwa ri swā hā/ rin po cher/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ratna tsitta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ chur/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi shuddha kuṇḍa lī swā hā/ zhes so sor lan gsum re dang*/ oṃ kro dhī shwa rī sho dhā ya swā hā/ zhes pas thun mong du ro'i mchog tu byin gyis brlab par bya'o/ /gsum pa gsang chen rigs gcig gis sbyang ba ni/ phrin las kyi sdom sngar bshad pa ltar dgu las/ dang po dam tshig pa bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐/ chos rnams thams cad stong zhing bdag med dbyings/ /rang bzhin spros bral kun khyab snying rje'i gdangs/ /'gyur med hūm̐ yig rgyu yi thig ler shar/ /de las thugs mchog rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan/ /'od 'phros 'phags mchod byin rlabs dngos grub bsdus/ /'gro rnams byang chub zhing bsgral tshur 'dus hūm̐/ /yongs gyur khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje sems/ /mthing gsal dri med -ind+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu 'dzin/ /dbyings phyug yum 'khyud zhi ba'i tshul dgus 'arjid/ /bcu gsum chas kyis rab brgyan mtshan dper ldan/ /mtha' yas 'od zer 'phro ba bdag nyid can/ /bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bzhugs/ zhes pas gsal gdab/ gnyis pa dbang bskur ba nas/ drug pa mchod pa'i bar sngar bzhin bya'o/ /bstod pa ni/ mi rtog rdo rje thabs kyi ye shes ni/ /dmigs med shes rab yum gyi ngang du rtogs/ /thugs rjes bye brag sna tshogs cir yang ston/

/rdo rje sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces bstod/ bdun pa sman srung spyan 'dren dang*/ brgyad pa rtog bsal kyang sngar bzhin/ dgu pa dzap la gnyis las/ dang po lha'i dzap ni/ rdor sems spyi mgrin snying gar 'khor lo dang*/ /padma rgya gram lte bar oṃ dkar po/ /ā dmar hūm̐ mthing mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor/ /bdag lce rdo rje'i hūm̐ dang sngags phreng las/ /'od 'phros rgyud bskul 'phags mchod 'gro don byas/ /tshur 'dus yab yum gnyam sbyor byang chub sems/ /mu tig ltar dkar dngos grub kun gyi dbyig /rang srog dwangs ma'i hūm̐ la thim par gyur/ zhes mos la/ hūm̐ badzra dhṛk/ mu dhā twī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces brgya rtsa tsam bzla/ gnyis pa sman dzap ni/ dwangs ma'i srog yig 'od kyis thugs rgyud bskul/ /rdor sems yab yum rjes su chags pa'i ros/ /snyoms par zhugs pa'i dga' ba'i 'od dang sgras/ /'phags mchod sems can don byas dngos grub dbyig /tshur bsdus byang chub sems rgyun mkha' gsang las/ /babs pas bhañdzar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bskyil/ /pho brang steng gi sman srung rig 'dzin gyis/ /brtan g.yo'i rtsi bcud bdud rtsir 'bebs par gyur/

zhes pa'i dmigs gnad dang bcas/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta badzra tsitta sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes bzla zhing stong tshig gi mchod pa sogs so/ /thun mjug tu/ ye shes snying po can rnams kyis/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi chos 'di ni/ /snying po chos kyi don la bsdu/ /byang chub spyod pa'i gnas chen yin/ /smad par byas pa'i rdzas lnga po/ /gcig la yon tan lnga lnga'am/ /gcig la'ang yon tan gsum du dbye/ /dam tshig rtsa ba bco lnga yin/ /yang na nyi shu rtsa brgyad do/ /snod bcud dbus su bsdus nas ni/ /thabs dang shes rab rab ldan pas/ /rtog pa'i mtshan ma brtag par bya/ zhes brjod cing rdor sems yab yum yang byang chub kyi sems bde ba chen po chos kyi sku'i rang bzhin du zhu zhing dam tshig gi rdzas dang dbyer med par bsam mo/ /bzhi pa khrol bu'i mjug don la gsum las/ dang po sman che ba'i yon tan brjod de 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rtsa ba 'bum phrag yangs pa'i bcud/ /ra sā ya na la sogs sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud drug sems can kun sgrol ba'i/ /dug lnga sel ba'i sman gyi mchog /dpa' bo'i ro dang mnyam sbyar nas/ /rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs la 'bul/ /bla med 'phrul gyi dngos grub stsol/ zhes dang*/ rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi mtshan don sbyar bas kyang rgya cher mchod do/ /gnyis pa bstod pa ni/ e ma ho sangs rgyas kun tu bzang*/ /gsang chen thig le nyid la rdzogs/ /ma rig mun sel ye shes sgron/ /dpa' bo khyed la skyabs su mchi/ /rang byung dri med bdud rtsi che/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa'i mchog /mi shes sgrib sbyong dbyings bkod mdzad/ /gnyis med gus pas phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes pas ston pa/ chos bdud rtsi/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la bstod pa dang*/ gzhan 'os su gyur pa'i bstod pa ji ltar rigs par bya'o/

/gsum pa dngos grub bsdu ba ni/ phyag rgya'am der btags pa'i las kyi rdo rjes khrol bu'i sman gzhong dar gyis lcibs pas blangs te/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i gnas/ /rnam par mi rtog rtog las 'das/ /kun rdzob tsam du bstan pa mtshar/ zhes brjod de slob dpon gyi phyag tu phul/ des kyang*/ a ho su kha dharma kā ya ni a mṛ ta siddhi hrīḥ zhes dngos grub kyi snying po 'od kyi gong bu'i rnam par thugs kyi thig ler bsdu'o/ /gsum pa bdud rtsi phye mar bsgrub pa la gnyis/ btags btsag sogs kyi dgongs pa dang*/ phye ma dngos kyi dgongs rgyud do/ /dang po la lnga'o/ /dang po 'thags pa la sbyor dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thams cad la dpal gyi chas bcus rtags gdab/ ru lu'i dzap dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor la g.yas su lan gsum bskor/ hūm̐/ mi mngon dbyings na bzhugs pa rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ sogs dang*/ hūm̐/ dgongs shig mkha' 'gro dam can rnams/ /sngon tshe zhal bzhes ma g.yel cig /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'di/ /ming tsam 'dzin par byed pa yang*/ /g.yo sgyu med cing gus ldan par/ /sems kyis blangs te spyi bo yi/ /gtsug tu bzhag ste bkur bar bgyi/ /de skad khyod kyis dam bcas te/ /dpal gyi bka' bzhin bdag mchis na/ /ma thogs myur du stongs la byon/ /bcol ba'i phrin las sgrubs par mdzod/ oṃ shrī he ru ka sa ma ya satwaṃ/ ma nu raksha sī bhyoḥ brahma ṇī bhyoḥ ro'u tri ma bhyoḥ bha na bhe bhyoḥ ku mā rī bhyoḥ ind+ra ya ni bhyoḥ siṃ ha ka la ni bhyoḥ a mṛ taṃ bhyoḥ so'u ma bhyoḥ ta na haṃ bhyoḥ raksha sī bhyoḥ baksha sī bhyoḥ ra tri ma bhyoḥ ra tri re ma ti bhyo: e ka tsa ra ma bhyoḥ ma nu ha ra ma bhyoḥ si ti kaṃ bhyoḥ bhā ya bhe bhyoḥ ma hā ma ra ṇa bhyoḥ agne ye bhyoḥ bha ra hī bhyoḥ tsa munt+ri bhyoḥ bhu ta na bhyoḥ

pā ṇi badzra bhyoḥ ma hā kā lī bhyoḥ tsa kā la badzra bhyoḥ badzra bumpa ka ra ṇa bhyoḥ badzra lambo dhā ra bhyoḥ (badzra ni bar bhyoḥ badzra la bar bhyoḥ badzra pa tri har bhyoḥ badzra ba yer bhyoḥ badzra daṃ shing bhyoḥ dhur paṃ bhyoḥ badzra lan te bhyoḥ badzra ma hā te bhyoḥ badzra pu tsar bhyoḥ badzra ra li bhyoḥ badzra ra mi bhyoḥ) ma ma hriṃ hriṃ dza dzaḥ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭḥ dgra bgegs gnod byed 'byung po mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bskul zhing las la btsud pa sogs bya/ gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar du slob dpon yab yum gyis/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla bzhin du sman rnams zhib par brdung*/ gnyis pa btsag pa ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho phyogs su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ho sa ya bi shuddhe hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes dar tshags la btsag /gsum pa bsre zhing sbyar ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi nub tu slob dpon gyis sngar byin gyis brlabs pa'i chang gi kha phru sbreng zhing*/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta dza gad pra wā ya swā hā/ de bzhin du 'o ma sbreng zhing*/ oṃ bi tang saṃ sho dha ya kro dhī shwa rī swā hā/ rin po che sbreng zhing*/ oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ratna tsitta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ chu sbreng zhing*/ oṃ a mṛ ta bi shuddhe kuṇḍa lī swā hā/ zhes bzla bzhin 'dres par 'phur nas/ dam rdzas phabs rgyun dang dbang lag gi phye ma'ang btab la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta mu sa la mu sa la hūm̐ phaṭḥ ces bzla/ bzhi pa sbol zhing gzhal ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gi byang du slar yang 'dres par sbrus la nam zla dang bstun pa'i phabs rtsi zhim po non tsam blug /de nas 'phel ba brtag phyir dril bus gzhal te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ badzra padma dhā ra hṛ dha ya dharma pañtsa āḥhūm̐: zhes bzla zhing sman thod du blug

/tshon skud sna lngas rgya gram du bcings pa la slob dpon gyis rgyas btab cing*/ hūm̐: dang po sku gsung thugs kyi rgya/ /gnyis pa rdo rje rgya gram rgya/ /gsum pa dbang mchog rtags kyi rgya/ /bzhi pa karma las kyi rgya/ /lnga pa tshe yi ri bo'i rgya/ /drug pa zla gam dbang gi rgya/ /bdun pa chos kyi phyag rgya'i rgya/ /chos kyi dbyings su rgyas gdab bo/ / zhes yas gdab bo/ /lnga pa dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ slob dpon mdun du sman bkod la/ dri lnga dang*/ gu gul/ tshil chen bdug /drag sngags yungs thun dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad/ che mchog gi dzapdabyangs bcas/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /dam rdzas rtsa ba brgyad dang yan lag stong*/ /'bras bu sku gsung thugs su rab sbyar nas/ /dug lnga ma spangs sku gsum lhun gyis grub/ /dbyings nas spyan drangs sangs rgyas skur bskyed do/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum 'phags pa mchod pa dang*/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug thugs dam bskang ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba mchog gi dbus su bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta sa ma ya tiṣṭha lhan/ zhes sman gyi pho brang dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol la/ rang byung gdod nas sogs kyi che ba'i yon tan brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ hūm̐/ rab yangs bdud rtsi'i snod du dam rdzas lnga'i/ /sa bon lnga las phyag mtshan sa bon gyis/ /yongs mtshan 'phro 'dus bde gshegs rigs lngar gyur/ /bdag thugs sngags kyis rgyud bskul 'khor 'das kyi/ /dngos grub bcud bsdus mnyam sbyor byang chub sems/ /bdud rtsir rab 'dres yab yum 'od du zhu/ /'chi med dam rdzas rgya mtshor 'khyil pa'i zhag /rab 'bar dpa' bo 'bru lngas mtshan par gyur/ /hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃ hā: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes brgya rtsa bzla bar bya'o/ /gnyis pa phye ma dngos kyi sgrub pa la lnga las/

dang po 'ju 'dul gyi dgongs pa la gsum las/ dang po ni/ spyi dkyil 'khor sum ldan dbyer med du bsgom tshul ni/ gzhung du shes/ gnyis pa bye brag dkyil 'khor gsum tha dad du sgrub pa la bzhi las/ dang po dkyil 'khor dbye ba'i tshul ni/ bka' brgyad las byang bzlas pa'i bar song nas/ bhrūm̐ bi shwa bi shuddhe phaṭ dzaḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ phaṭ dzaḥ sa mdun bskyed phye/ gnyis pa rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ mtshan nyid yongs rdzogs khrag 'thung dkyil 'khor dbus/ /bde gshegs spyi gzugs che mchog he ru ka /sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston cing*/ /dgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs pa/ /gar dgus rnam rol che mchog he ru ka /gnam zhal yum 'khyud sprul 'khor bsam mi khyab/ /rang bzhin dkyil 'khor chen por lhun gyis grub/ / zhes gsal gdab/ gsum pa bdud rtsi sman gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ pho brang lte bar yaṃ las rlung gzhu'i dbyibs/ /de steng ram̐ las me dkyil gru gsum 'bar/ āḥlas bhandza'i gzhal yas rgya che'i nang*/ /pad zla'i gdan la sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ /hūm̐ oṃ swā āṃ hā las phyag mtshan lnga/ /sa bon gyis mtshan yongs gyur bde gshegs lnga/ /yab yum mnyam sbyor byang sems bdud rtsir zhu/ /de steng dpa' bo 'bru lngas mtshan par gyur/ hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā/ bzhi pa rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor la lnga las/ dang po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dpal chen po/ /yab yum mnyam sbyor byang chub sems sprin las/ khro bo bcu 'phros phyag bcu'i gdon bgegs btul/ /tshur 'dus bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor phyogs mtshams 'khod/ /hūm̐ mdzad rnam rgyal dbyug sngon gshin rje'i gshed/ /mi g.yo rta mgrin 'dod rgyal bdud rtsi 'khyil/ /rnam rgyal stobs po che rnams rngam brjid 'bar/ /rang rtags mtshon cha thogs nas phyogs bcur 'khod/

/oṃ badzra kro dha hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐/ de bzhin du/ bi dza ya/ nī la daṇḍa/ ya mānta ka /ārya a tsa le/ ha ya ghṛ wa/ a pa ra dzī ta/ a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī/ trai lokya bi dza ya/ ma hā ba la sogs sbyar/ gnyis pa rta mgrin dbang gi dkyil 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ rang byung bdud rtsi rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor steng*/ /'gro 'dul ta kṛta khro bo brgyad kyi dbus/ /padma'i lte bar hrīḥlas rta mchog dpal/ /dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas padma/ /g.yon pa rgya gram bdud rtsi'i steng nas gnon/ /phyogs kyi 'dab bzhir bde chen gsang ba'i yum/ /mi pham dkar mo khro gnyer can ma ser/ /ro langs ma dmar ral gcig ljang gu ste/ /gri gug thod 'dzin gcer bu bde nyams rgyas/ /gsang ba'i mkha' la dpa' bo rta mgrin sku/ /phyed nub tsam gyi sbyor ba dus gcig mdzad/ /bde stong dbyer med mnyam rgyas rnam par brjid/ gsum pa sku gdung 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ hūm̐/ phyogs mtshams mthar byed brgyad steng phyogs bzhi ru/ /shar nas rim bzhin khrag 'thung chen po bzhi/ /buddha khrag 'thung smug ljang ser ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gsum rdo rje 'khor lo ti ra dang*/ /g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar kha ṭwāṃ 'dzin/ /ratna khrag 'thung ser smug dmar ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gsum rin chen rdo rje ti ra dang*/ /g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar dgra satwa 'dzin/ /padma khrag 'thung dmar ser ljang ba'i zhal/ /g.yas gsum padma rdo rje ti ra dang*/ /g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar rnge'u chung 'dzin/ /karma khrag 'thung ljang dmar smug pa'i zhal/ /g.yas gsum rgya gram rdo rje ti ra dang*/ /g.yon gsum dril bu bhan dmar thong gshol 'dzin/ khro bo bzhi steng badzra he ru ka /mthing dkar dmar ba'i zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas gsum rtse dgu rtse lnga ti ra dang*/ /g.yon gsum dril bhan 'jig rten g.yo ba'i tshul/ /zhabs bzhis khrag 'thung rigs bzhi'i dbu nas brdzis/

/thams cad rang rang yum 'khyud gar dgu ldan/ /dpal chen chas rdzogs 'bar ba'i klong na brjid/ bzhi pa mkha' mnyam klong gi dkyil 'khor ni/ rdo rje khrag 'thung dbu'i steng gnam zhal yum/ /sngo skya dbu dgu bco brgyad phyag dang ldan/ /dang po'i phyag gnyis rdo rje dril bu dang*/ /lhag ma g.yas brgyad gnas kyi ma mo brgyad/ /g.yon brgyad yul gyi phra men brgyad po bsnams/ /gel pa'i 'dug stangs tshul ldan zhabs brgyad kyis/ badzra khrag 'thung g.yas g.yon dbu gnyis brdzis/ /dbus zhal yum mkhar spyan phyed nub par tshud/ khro 'dzum bde ba'i nyams rgyas 'khril bag chags/ khro bo'i chas can 'bar ba'i klong na brjid/ lnga pa 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor ni/ gnam zhal yum steng che mchog he ru ka /sku mdog smug nag dbu ni nyi shu gcig /bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis phyag gi dkyil 'khor na/ /zhi ba yab rnams g.yas la yum rnams g.yon/ /thub pa drug ni g.yas g.yon gsum gsum bzhugs/ /zhabs brgyad rol pas yum gyi dbu brgyad brdzis/ /gsang ba'i rdo rje yum zhal dbus ma yi/ /smin mtshams mkhar bcug dpal chen rtsa zhal gyi/ /ljags steng nyi dkyil sa nu he ru ka /yab yum mnyam sbyor dkar gsal tshon gang ba'i/ /thugs kar nyi steng rdo rje a yig la/ /gsang sngags 'bru dgu g.yas su bskor bas mtshan/ /gar dgu'i nyams rgyas dpal chen chas rnams rdzogs/ /dri med 'od zer 'phro ba'i klong na bzhugs/ skabs 'dir sbyor ba brgyad kyi rim pa'ang de ltar shes par bya ste/ gtso bo'i ljags steng sa nu he ru ka /yab yum mnyam sbyor ye shes sbyor ba dang*/ /phyag rnams zhe gnyis lhar sbyor phyag mtshan sbyor/ /rdo rje smin mtshams mkhar rol zhal gyi sbyor/ /yum mkhar khrag 'thung dbu tshud dbu yi sbyor/ /gtso zhabs yum gyi dbur sbyor zhabs kyi sbyor/ /rta mgrin yum bzhir rol pa dbang gi sbyor/ /bdud rtsi ye shes sman sbyor rdzas kyi sbyor/

/rdzas dkyil bhandza la sbyor thabs shes sbyor/ /sbyor ba brgyad ldan bde chen nyams brgyar 'bar/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i gtso bor lhun gyis grub/ /phyi rol phyogs mtshams sgrub sde brgyad kyi lha/ /rang rang 'khor bcas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor las/ /'od zer bzhin du gsal brtan 'bar bar gyur/ zhes pa rnams kyis gsal gdab la/ ye shes lngas dbang bskur gnas gsum byin rlabs/ ye shes pa spyan drangs zhing bstim pa rnams sngar ltar bya zhing*/ 'og min chos dbyings mtha' bral zhing khams su/ sogs kyis mchod/ bdag med phyogs bral don dam zung chud cing*/ /byams dang snying rjes dgra zin mi mnga' yang*/ /gdug pa 'dul phyir dus las mi 'da' ba'i/ /'jigs byed he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang dag 'jam dpal gshin rje padma dbang*/ /rdo rje gzhon nu bla med he ru ka /che mchog rig 'dzin dregs 'dul drag sngags sogs/ /bka' brgyad lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod/ zhes pas bstod/ yang na dbang bskur spyan drang bstim pa mchod bstod rnams ma byas kyang chad pa'i skyon tu mi 'gyur/ gsum pa dzap la gsum las/ dang po sman srung spyan 'dren/ gnyis pa rtog pa bsal ba sngar bzhin bya/ gsum pa dzap dngos la/ gzung thag la 'jus te/

shes rab sgrog gis sbrel ba'i gzung thag la/ /rig pa srog gis 'brel ba'i lu gu rgyud/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub ma thob bar/ /skye ba ji srid bar du mi btang ngo*/ zhes dang*/ lnga las/ dang po 'gro ba 'dul ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ bskyed rdzogs rgyas pa'i skabs/ sbyor ba brgyad ldan gyi sgrub pa dang*/ bsdus pa'i skabs su/ gtso bo yab yum gyi byang chub sems kyis sgrub pa'o/ /dang po ni/ hūm̐/ bdag nyid rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dpal chen po'i/ /thugs kar nyi dkyil rdo rje a yig la/ /'bru dgu'i sngags phreng phra zhing gsal bas bskor/ /de las 'od 'phros bdud rtsi'i rlung dkyil bskul/ /me sbar bdud rtsi khol ba'i zer rlangs las/ /dpa' bo 'bru lnga'i 'od zer mchod pa'i sprin/ /'gro 'dul dbang chen sku gdung mkha' klong dkyil/ /'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor thug gi bar/ /rim par spros pas sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud/ /mnyes par byas shing thugs kyi dam tshig bskul/ zhes pa ni mchod pa mas 'bul zhes bya ba'i don no/ / ye shes lnga yi 'od zer bdud rtsi'i rgyun/ /'chi med rdo rje nas bzung rim pa bzhin/ /sku yi dbyibs rgyud mkha' gsang sbyor mtshams nas/ /bdud rtsir babs pas dbang bskur byin gyis brlabs/ zhes pa ni dbang yas bskur zhes bya ba'i don no/ / slar yang sbyor ba brgyad kyi sbyor mtshams nas/ /byang chub sems sprin 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros/ /'phags pa kun mchod mkha' mnyam 'gro don byas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dngos grub dang*/ /'khor 'das dwangs ma'i bcud bsdus bdag la thim/ /gu hya lag gi phyag rgya mtheb srin gyi/ /rta mgrin yab yum la thim mnyam sbyor ba'i/ /byang chub sems dang gcig 'dres 'od zer rnams/ gzung rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor/ /gzung thag rdo rje'i khong gseng nas brgyud de/ /bdud rtsi'i pho brang la thim dam rdzas nyid/

/ye shes bdud rtsi rang bzhin mu tig ltar/ /dri med dkar gsal dwangs mar 'khyil bar gyur/ zhes pa'i don nan tan du bsgoms nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes dgu pa'i dzap nyid du kho na chig dril du bzla zhing*/ stong phrag re'i mtshams su stong tshig gis mchod pa bya ba sogs ni sngar bzhin no/ /thun bsdu ba'i tshe/ 'chi med rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas bzung ste rim bzhin 'od zhu bdud rtsir thim par gyur/ zhes bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa la bdud rtsi bskyil ba dang dbab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ hūm̐/ bhandza gzhal yas khang nang bdud rtsi yi/ /rgya mtshor bskyil steng dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams/ /bde chen dgyes rol sbyor mtshams brgyad kyi mkhar/ /dkar dmar byang sems ye shes bdud rtsi'i bcud/ /dngul chu bzhin du gsal 'tsher 'dzag la khad/ /'pho zhing g.yo ba tsam du 'khyil bar gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kuṇḍa lī hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pa'i mthar phrin las bskul ba ni/ bdag cag skal ldan sgrub pa po'i/ /longs spyod bdud rtsi rdzas mchog gis/ /rgyal ba zhi khro'i thugs dam bskang*/ /dam bca' ma g.yel dam la 'du/ /sman gyi srung ma dam tshig can/ /bdud rtsi sman gyi g.yab dor na/ /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang*/ /sgrub pa po yi phrin las mdzod/ ces 'di 'thor zhing bskul lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mkha' la byang chub sems/ /dkar dmar bdud rtsi sman gyi rgya mtshor phab/ /sman gyi srung ma rig 'dzin rnams kyis kyang*/ /'khor 'das rtsi bcud mtsho la sbrang char bzhin/ /babs pas dngos grub gsol btab dam tshig rdzas/ kha dog dri ro nus ldan rgya mtshor gyur/ zhes bsgom zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta me pra we sha ya pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes stong du bzla zhing dbab pa'i phyag rgyas sman la gtug go /ma mo brgyad bskul ba ni/

hūm̐/ 'das pa'i dus na mngon phyung ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /ye shes thugs kyi sprul pa las/ /'bar ba'i khro bo'i tshogs byung ste/ /'jig rten dregs pa bsgral ba las/ /yul chen brgyad du dur khrod brgyad/ /ma mo chen mo rnam brgyad byung*/ /thabs mkhas thugs rje rmad po che/ /dam tshig dbang gis gshegs su gsol/ /bdud rtsi 'di la byin cig phob/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol/ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐/ zhes nyer gcig tsam brjod cing dbab bar bya'o/ /gsum pa la dbang du bya ba dang gnad la dbab pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sman gyi pho brang nang du rta mchog dpal/ /yab yum mnyam sbyor byang chub sems kyi rgyun/ /'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman dang rab 'dres nas/ /gzung thag rdo rje'i khong gseng lam brgyud pa/ /bdag la rab thim gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ha ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu bhandha bhandha hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ hūm̐/ nga ni dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*/ /gsang gsum 'khor los rab bsgyur zhing*/ /rigs lnga'i khrag 'thung 'khor dang bcas/ /thugs dam dbang gis spyan 'dren na/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin gshegs su gsol/ /dam tshig tshul bzhin ma gshegs shing*/ /grub pa'i mchog dag ma stsal na/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bar 'gyur/ /sa ma ya la dgongs nas kyang*/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*/ /phrin las dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes tha tshig bsgrag/ gnyis pa dpa' bo gcig sgrub lta bu shin tu spros med kyi skabs su gsang zil gzhung gi bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub thabs 'chi med bcud ldan ltar/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs/ stong pa nyid du gyur: stong pa'i nga las bhrūm̐ smug nag yongs su gyur pa las: bhandza mo'i dbyings yangs pa'i klong : phyi nang sgrib g.yogs dang bral ba'i gzhal yas: gru chad zlum bskor lhun gyis grub pa:

de'i dbus su padma nyi zla baṃ gyi gdan la: che mchog he ru ka smug nag snum zhing sgeg pa: zhal gcig phyag gnyis dur khrod chas brgyad rdzogs shing : phyag g.yas thabs kyi rdo rje: g.yon shes rab kyi bhandha bsnams shing khro 'dzum rgyan dang ldan pa: yum gnam zhal dbyings phyug mthing nag zhi ma khro: g.yas gri gug dang g.yon bhandha 'dzin cing : yab la bde stong 'khril zhing bskul ba: yab yum me ri 'bar ba'i klong du gsal ba'o: spyi bor hūm̐ las kun bzang : dpral bar dhī las 'jam dpal: mgrin par hrī las rta mgrin: thugs kar hūm̐ las yang dag: lte bar bhyo las bla med: gsang bar hūm̐ las phur pa: dpung g.yas hūm̐ las drag po: dpung g.yon hūm̐ las stobs ldan: bla g.yas hūm̐ las dmod pa: bla g.yon khroṃ las sprul pa khyung : mdun du hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil ba: rgyab tu hrīḥlas rta mgrin: phyogs bzhir dam tshig mkha' 'gro bzhi: go cha'i lha lnga yab yum thams cad me ri me dpung rab du 'bar ba: de ltar gsal ba'i dpral bar oṃ: mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐: de las 'od zer 'phros pas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs te dam tshig pa bhandza'i lha la thim par gyur: oṃ badzra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur: zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pas gtso bo kun bzang gis dbu brgyan par gyur: oṃ hūm̐ tram̐ hrī āḥ mūm̐ lāṃ māṃ paṃ' tāṃ: a we sha ya a āḥ zhes bhandza'i lha rnam dang gnyis su med par gyur nas sku gzi brjid 'od dang ldan par bsam/ de nas dam tshig dang ye shes dbyer med pa'i lha yab yum gyi mkha' nas 'chi med bdud rtsi 'bab pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pa yi dam gyi lha rnams la phog: yi dam yab yum gyi ting 'dzin gyi rgyud bskul: yi ge yaṃ sngon po 'phros:

yum gyi mkhar phog rlung g.yos pas ā 'bar mu kha zur gsum du bdud rtsi dmar po babs pas yum gyi brda skad la: sa ma ya hoḥ bde bar spyod cig ces pa'i sgras bskul: yang rang gi thugs ka nas yi ge ram̐ dmar po 'phros yab kyi rnam snang lam la phog pas: zla ba'i bdud rts-i nor bu'i rtser babs: bde ba g.yos pas yab kyi rang sgra la: sa ma ya satwaṃ: spyod pa rjes su gnang ngo : zhes pa'i sgras bskul: yum gyis rā ga ya hoḥ zhes pa'i brda sgrogs: yab kyis rā ga ya mi: zhes pas bde bar spyod cing: re ba bskang bar bya zhes pa'i brda'o: de nas dam tshig gi mkha' 'gro bzhis: dzaḥzhes pas yab yum mkha' gsang sbyor zhing phyag rgya dam du bsdam: bam̐ zhes pas bsrub cing spyod: hoḥzhes pas bde ba tshogs g.yos nas: sa ma ya mu ḍa pra we sha ya phaṭḥ zhes pas go cha'i lha thams cad kyis bde bar spyod: oṃ zhes pas yab kyi byang sems yum gyi padmar 'bab: phaṭḥces pas bde ba rab tu g.yos: pra mo ti spha ra ṇa phaṭḥ zhes pas yum gyi mkha' nas byang sems dkar dmar rnams 'chi med rdzas su gyur: slar yang sku las 'od zer gong bu can dpag tu med pa babs ste bhandza'i rdzas rnams dang dbyer med du 'dres pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bcud phun sum tshogs par bsam: yang lha yab yum sbyor mtshams nas mkha' 'gro ma phyag mtshan ldan pa dpag tu med pa 'phros te: lha 'dre mi gsum gyi bcud thams cad bsdus nas sgrub rdzas rnams la thim par bsam: yang rang gi thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo dpag tu med pa 'phros nas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la mchod cing bstod par bsam: yang rang gi thugs ka nas sngags phreng 'od lnga dang ldan pa bar ma chad par 'phros nas lha rnams la phog pas/ lha yab yum gtso 'khor bcas kyi thugs kar sngags phreng 'khor te sngags kyi rang sgra stong gsum la sgrogs pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas byang sems rnams kyi thugs dam rgyud bskul zhing mchod pas brnyes:

tshur 'dus byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad bdag mdun dkyil 'khor la thim par gyur: de bzhin du spyan 'dren mchod pa sog gzhung bzhin: sngags gtso bo ji nus dang de las cha bgos nas go cha'i sngags bzlas: gsham du sdig sgrib sbyong ba la: oṃ sarba pa pā shantiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: tshe bsod rgyas pa la: oṃ puṣṭiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ thams cad dbang du sdud pa la/ oṃ te dzwa ḍākki bha ha ya pā shaṃ ku ru ye swā hā: dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa la: oṃ bhū ta tshindha ma rā ya phaṭḥ bdud rtsi sman sgrub pa'i sngags ni: a mṛ ta pañtsa hrī ṭha bai badzrai a yu dzñā na paṇyai dā hi ku ru ye swā hā: zhes bzla/ de'ang sgrub rtags ma byung bar du bsgrub bo/ /bzhi pa dngos grub len pa la drug las/ dang po mchod pa ni lag len zin bris ltar dang*/ gnyis pa dzap ni/ dkyil 'khor lha tshogs sku gsung thugs yon tan/ /phrin las 'dus pa'i dngos grub kun gyi dbyig /'chi med bdud rtsi 'od kyi rnam par ni/ /bdag la thim nas gnyis su med par gyur/ zhes bsgom zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta mañdzu shrī byā ba lo ki te hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes stong du tshang bar bzla'o/ /gsum pa gsol gdab pa ni/ hūm̐: nam mkha'i mtha' klas chos kyi dbyings la mkhas/ /ma chags spyan mnga' ma bsgribs ye shes gsal/ /thams cad 'dus pa kun nas dgongs su gsol/ /dus las mi 'da' rdo rje'i dam tshig can/ /skyob las mi g.yel yal gam gcig pa'i lha/ /dpal chen dpal 'bar che mchog he ru ka'i/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig rab bskul nas/ /bla med byang chub 'bras bu bdag gis bsgrub/ /'gro ba ma lus thugs rje chen pos bsgral/ /sgrub mchog bdag la sgrub pa chen po mdzod/ /bsnyen pa po la nye ba'i bsnyen pa mdzod/ /dbang chen dbang stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /dngos grub mchog stsol bcom ldan 'das/ /thugs dam dus la bab lags na/

/btang snyoms yal yol mi mdzad cing*/ /dngos grub stsol ba'i dus 'di lags/ /re ba thams cad bskang ba'i phyir/ khyed kyi phrin las dus la bab/ /bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang*/ /gnyis med bdud rtsi'i dngos grub stsol/ / zhes brjod dkyil 'khor la bskor ro/ /bzhi pa dngos grub len pa dngos ni/ lag g.yon mtheb srin rtse sprad lhag ma gsum brkyangs pas bdud rtsi'i steng nas mnan cing*/ las gzhung gi dngos grub bskul ba sbyar ba'i mthar/ a ho su kha dharma kā ya ni a mṛ ta siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i zhag grangs da nangs tshang*/ /bdud rtsi sgrub pa'i rdzas ni de ring rdzogs/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /mi 'gyur sku yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /'gro drug thugs rjes sgrol ba'i gsung mnga' ba/ /ma 'gags gsung gi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ye shes thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs mnga' ba/ /'chi med thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /sa gzhi'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /yon tan lhun grub dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /cho 'phrul mthar phyin mdzad pa'i sku mnga' ba/ /phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod cing dngos grub blang ngo*/ lnga pa me tog dor ba ni/ hūm̐/ 'chi med bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor la/ /ji ltar mchod cing bstod pa ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bsgral ba'i phyir/ /mchod sprin me tog 'bul lags na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ oṃ bo dhi tsitta kā ya wākka tsitta ma hā sa ma ya āḥ zhes me tog dor/ drug pa dbang nod cing bskur ba ni/ sman slob dpon gyi spyi bor bzhag la/ hūm̐/ bdud rtsi'i lha tshogs rang bzhin dkyil 'khor dang*/ /gnyis su med par lhun gyis grub nas kyang*/ /bdag nyid sgo gsum dpal chen 'khor bcas kyi/

/sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med byin dbang bskur/ a mṛ ta kā ya wākka tsitta a bhi ṣiñtsa siddhi pha la hoḥ zhes dbang nod/ slob ma rnams kyis ru lu'i dzap bzla zhing me tog phul te/ hūm̐/ dur khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor du/ /kun tu bzang po'i ngang du ltos bca' na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub dam pa de/ /rdo rje rgyal pos dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ zhes gsol ba gdab slob ma rnams la sman gyi pho brang gi dbang bskur ba ni/ gdod nas ma skyes rnam dag chos kyi dbyings/ /dag dang ma dag mi rtog rtog las 'das/ /dus gsum gcig las skur bstan phyi bshol med/ /dngos grub sna tshogs rlabs chen 'bar ba can/ /su 'dod sbyin gyis da lta nga las longs/ /bskal par bsgribs pa'i gti mug mun pa la/ /sprin mthongs nyi shar khud par dro ba bzhin/ /bdud rtsi rgyal po'i dbang chen 'di byin pas/ /rig 'dzin rgyal ba'i go 'phang thob par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ma hā shrī he ru ka ma hā kro dhi shwa rī satwaṃ sa ma ya a we sha ya āḥ zhes dbang bskur nas phan yon brjod pa ni/ tshe dang skong dang yid du 'ong*/ /bgegs rnams zhi ba la sogs te/ /nad dang bral nas ci 'dod pa'i/ /yon tan rtsa brgyad 'dis thob bo/ /

zhes brjod/ lnga pa rgya bkrol te mchod cing bgo ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta kunda li swā hā/ ma hā gu hya mañdzu shrī siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas nas las kyi rdo rje yum du btags pas sman slob dpon la 'bul zhing*/ e ma ho/ ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam pa'i gnas/ /rnam par mi rtog rtog las 'das/ /kun rdzob tsam du bstan pa mtshar/ zhes brjod cing*/ slob dpon gyis/ a ho su kha dharma kā ya ni a mṛ ta siddhi hrīḥ zhes pas blangs nas sman thod la dkris pa'i srad bu sogs/ badzra pra we sha ya phaṭḥ ces rim par dkrol nas sman kha phye la sman gyi bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma dkar dmar sngo ba'i 'od kyi rnam par bdag gi gnas gsum du thim par bsam zhing*/ a mṛ ta kā ya wākka tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas sman dril bu la gzhal te ji tsam 'phel ba brtags nas sngar gyi stegs la bkod/ thod chang la bdud rtsi cung zad btab nas/ hūm̐/ rang byung gdod nas rnam par dag / ces sogs kyis so so'i mtshan don sbyar bas rgyas par mchod/ g.yon pas mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi lce thog tu bzhag la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: rdo rje lce yi dam tshig la/ /rdo rje can gyi 'bru gsum bsgom/ /bdud rtsi lnga dang sbyar ba'i sman/ /myangs na dngos grub thob par 'gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya siddhi oṃ/ wākka siddhi āḥ tsitta siddhi hūm̐/ zhes rim par blangs te lce la bzhag pas sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thob nas lus kyi rtsa khams thams cad bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i bde stong gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag kyang*/ lus kyi gnas rnams su thig le'ang bya'o/ /rjes kyi bya ba/ dkyil 'khor bsdu ba/ mtshams grol ba nas brtsam/ dga' ston shes brjod kyi bar sgrub chog lhar cha tshang bar bya'o/ /bdun pa phan yon ni/ bam brgyad las/ de dag kun gyi yon tan yang*/

/bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi'i nad rnams sel/ zhes dang*/ lo ni lnga brgya lon bar du/ /mdog ni bcu drug gzhon nu 'dra/ /nad med rtag tu dar la 'bab/ /stobs kyang glang po che dang 'dra/ /mngon shes lnga dang ldan par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa ltar tshe dang lus kyi bcud len mchog tu 'gyur ba yin no/ /yang bam brgyad las/ bdud bzhi nges par 'joms par byed/ ces gsungs pa ltar/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa ma lus pa 'joms par byed cing*/ dug lnga ye shes lngar sbyang bas lam lnga'i spang rtogs rgyud du skye ba sogs mtha' yas te/ snying por dril ba'i gzhung las/ bdag 'dra padma 'byung gnas kyis: phyi rabs skal ldan don slad du: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i sman sgrub bzhag: 'di yi yon tan bsam mi khyab/ bsgrubs pas tshe gcig 'ja' lus 'grub/ /dkyil 'khor mjal dang lha dang mnyam/ /ril bu kha la spyod gyur na/ /'chi med rig 'dzin kun thob cing : phyi ma mkha' spyod dbyings la gshegs: 'chi tshe 'ja' 'od me tog 'char: phyi ma dran pa mi nyams zhing : gzhan don sprul skus 'gro don 'grub: sdig chen rnams kyang rkyen ngan chod: rtsa rlung dbang po sgrib med gsal: pha rol byad dang rkyen ngan zhi: snyon mongs brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gag: rig pa ye shes rang ngo mthong : gzhan yang nad rigs thams cad zhi: dug dang sbyor ba 'go nad bcom: yul du bsgrubs na lo phyugs legs: gzhan yang yon tan phun sum tshogs: de phyir snying byang bla na med: gcig brgyud ma gtogs spel mi bya: zab rgya shog dril mgul khug ma: dbyangs can mtsho rgyal gzugs kyis zungs: spel bar phangs nas gter du sbas: lnga brgya nyi shu'i mgo tshugs tshe: las 'phro can dang 'phrad par shog: zhes bslu med rdo rje'i gsungs gis ched du bsngags pa ltar skal ba dang ldan pa dag gis 'di kho na g.yar dam du 'chang bas bya ba gnad dam pa'o/ /zhar byung gong du ji ltar bstan pa ltar sbyor ba brgyad ldan gyi skabs dpa' bo gcig sgrub nyid du 'don mi dgos shing*/

dpa' bo gcig sgrub kyi skabs sbyor ba brgyad ldan mi dgos pa bcas rig pas 'phrul shes par bya'o/ /e ma/ tshul 'dir 'bad pa'i legs byas zla ba gangs ri ltar dkar yon tan zegs ma 'bum 'phro bas/ /bstan 'gro'i ku mud rnam par rgyas shing nyon mongs tsha ba'i gdung ba dag kyang rab tu sel/ /sa gsum kun tu phan bde'i bdud rtsi rtag par phab pas rdzogs ldan dga' ston gsar du tshes/ /'gro ba 'di kun rgyal ba'i dbang po padma kā ra nyid dang mnyam pa'i rgyur gyur cig /ces pa'ang*/ lung rtogs dam pa'i chos kyi spyan mchog tu yangs pa bla ma tshe dbang bstan 'dzin nas ched du bskul ba bzhin/ phrin las byams pa 'byung gnas sam blo gros dri med zla bar 'bod pas/ rnam snang lo tsā ba chen po gter chen 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsung kho na srog tu bzung*/ gsang ba zil gnon gzhung gi sman sgrub kyi kha 'geng cung zad dang bcas te legs par bsdebs pa byis blos 'gal 'khrul du gyur na snying nas bshags shing*/ dge bas yang gsang snying po'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang*/ der 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam pa rnams zhabs pad rdo rje'i khams ltar rtag tu brtan pa dang*/ 'gro ba thams cad kyang gdod ma'i rgyal sar myar bar 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig /sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha wantu// // hūm̐/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par spro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin la ci bder bzhes su gsol/ oṃ sa pā ri wa ra arghaṃ pā dyaṃ nas shabda pū dzaḥhoḥ sarba pañtsa rakta bha lingta kha kha khā hi/ yang gcig ni/ hūm̐/ ye shes lha tshogs spyan 'dren gshegs/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul/ /sku gsung thugs yon phrin las bstod/ /bag med 'gal 'khrul nyams chag bshags/ ma hā a mṛ ta bha lingta rakta khā hi/ yang na/ hūm̐/ 'og min chos dbyings mtha' bral zhing khams su/

/bde gshegs zhi ba dpal chen he ru ka /sgrub pa bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /phyag rgya gar dang phyi nang mchod pa dang*/ /sbyor sgrol gtor ma rakta'i mchod pa dang*/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi rdzas kyi mchod pa dang*/ /chos nyid rol pa'i mchod pa 'bul lags na/ /gnyis med blang dor med par bzhes nas kyang*/ /thun mchog rigs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sa pā ri wa ra a rghaṃ sogs shabda pū tsa hoḥ ma hā a mṛ ta bha lingta rakta khā hi/ khro bo'i sgrub pa'i skabs 'gre'o/ /thugs dam bskul ba ni/ hūm̐/ mi mngon dbyings bzhugs rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /bskul lo bskul lo sems can don la bskul/ /mdzod cig mdzod cig drag po'i phrin las mdzod/ /chos sku zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yos kyang*/ /gzugs sku 'jigs pa'i cha lugs rdzogs mdzad cing*/ /phyogs bcu dus gsum bde gshegs zhi khro dang*/ /sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha tshogs thugs dam can/ /mi mngon dbyings nas 'dir byon thugs dam bskul/ /drag po'i phrin las mdzad pa'i dus la bab/ /thugs dam thugs rjes dgra bgegs myur du sgrol/ zhes bskul lo/ /bsnyen rgyun dzap rgyun bzla ba la/ oṃ bo dhi tsitta ma hā su kha dzñā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ra sā ya na ta na dza ya gu hya siddhi hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ zhi ba'i skabs la bzla dgos/ khro bo'i skabs la/ oṃ badzra ma hā kro ta padma kro ti shwa ri sogs drag po lnga'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta ha ya ghṛ wa hu lu hu lu bhandha bhandha hūm̐ hrīḥṭhaḥ oṃ a mṛ ta pañtsa hrī ṭha bhai ṣa dzyai ā yu dzñā na puṇyai dā hi ku ru ye swā hā:
